### File: `modules/components/admin/course-delete-button.tsx`

SHA-256: `9f1874835155b0ba307609f9f0164125895c8c5af31f3d75c0562ae25c04116a`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "@platform/hooks/use-async-command";
import { httpRequest } from "@platform/lib/http-request";
import { endpoints } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import type { AdminCourseRow, AdminCoursesLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-courses";
import AdminDialog from "./admin-dialog";
export default function CourseDeleteButton({ course, labels }: { course: AdminCourseRow; labels: AdminCoursesLabels }) {
 const [open,setOpen] = useState(false), router = useRouter(), command = useAsyncCommand(labels.error);
 async function remove() {
  const deleted = await command.run(() => httpRequest({ path: endpoints.adminCourseDelete(course.slug), body: { confirmSlug: course.slug }, failureLabel: labels.error, decode: value => {
   if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || !("deleted" in value) || value.deleted !== true) throw new Error(labels.error);
   return true;
  } }));
  if (deleted) { setOpen(false); router.refresh(); }
 }
 return <div className="lms-course-delete"><button type="button" className="lms-admin-danger" aria-haspopup="dialog" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>{labels.remove}</button>
  {open && <AdminDialog title={labels.confirmTitle} closeLabel={labels.close} pending={command.pending} onClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
   <p><strong>{course.title}</strong></p><p>{course.students ? labels.protectedCourse : labels.confirmRemove}</p>
   {command.error && <p className="lms-error" role="alert">{command.error}</p>}
   <div className="lms-admin-actions">{!course.students && <button type="button" className="btn-primary" disabled={command.pending} onClick={() => void remove()}>{command.pending ? labels.pending : labels.confirm}</button>}
    <button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button" disabled={command.pending} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>{labels.cancel}</button></div>
  </AdminDialog>}
 </div>;
}
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
```

```tsx
  </div>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import type { CurriculumContext, CurriculumTarget } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import CurriculumDialog from "./curriculum-dialog";
export default function CurriculumAction({ context, target, label }: { context: CurriculumContext; target: CurriculumTarget; label: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return <>
    <button type="button" className={target.operation === "delete" ? "lms-admin-danger" : "lms-secondary-button"} onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>{label}</button>
    {open && <CurriculumDialog context={context} target={target} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} />}
  </>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import type { CurriculumContext, CurriculumTarget } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { useAdminSave } from "@platform/hooks/use-admin-save";
import { endpoints } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { readCurriculumForm } from "@platform/features/admin/helpers/read-curriculum-form";
import AdminDialog from "../admin-dialog";
import SaveFeedback from "../save-feedback";
import CurriculumFields from "./curriculum-fields";
export default function CurriculumDialog({ context, target, onClose }: { context: CurriculumContext; target: CurriculumTarget; onClose: () => void }) {
  const { course, labels, revision } = context;
  const command = useAdminSave(endpoints.adminCurriculum(course.slug),labels.error);
  const title = `${target.operation === "delete" ? labels.remove : labels[target.operation]} ${labels[target.kind]}`;
  return <AdminDialog title={title} closeLabel={labels.close} pending={command.pending} onClose={onClose}>
    <div className="lms-curriculum-dialog"><form className="lms-profile-form lms-admin-form" onSubmit={async event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (await command.save(readCurriculumForm(new FormData(event.currentTarget),target,revision))) onClose();
    }}>
      <p className="lms-curriculum-note">{labels.courseLabel}: {course.title}</p>
      {target.operation === "delete" ? <p>{labels.deleteHint}</p> : <CurriculumFields context={context} target={target} />}
      <fieldset disabled={command.pending}><SaveFeedback {...command} labels={{ ...labels, save: target.operation === "delete" ? labels.remove : labels.save }} /></fieldset>
    </form></div>
  </AdminDialog>;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/curriculum/curriculum-fields.tsx`

SHA-256: `09e19e88f0b57a9bd6e1b4c01aa4e7bad76b29e2dad83fdea6b13177fe86b5f8`

```tsx
"use client";
import type { CurriculumContext, CurriculumTarget } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import FormField from "@platform/components/ui/form-field";
import Select from "@khatab/design/ui/select";
import { curriculumPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/curriculum";
import LessonFields from "./lesson-fields";
export default function CurriculumFields({ context, target }: { context: CurriculumContext; target: CurriculumTarget }) {
  const { course, labels } = context;
  const chapter = course.modules.find(chapter => chapter.id === target.chapterId || chapter.id === target.id);
  if (target.kind === "lesson") return <LessonFields context={context} target={target} />;
  const record = target.kind === "chapter" ? chapter : chapter?.sections?.find(section => section.id === target.id);
  return <>
    <FormField label={labels.title} name="title" defaultValue={record?.title ?? ""} required minLength={policy.titleMin} maxLength={policy.titleMax} />
    {target.kind === "section" && <Select label={labels.chapterLabel} name="chapterId" required defaultValue={target.chapterId} options={course.modules.map(chapter => ({ value: chapter.id, label: chapter.title }))} />}
  </>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import Select from "@khatab/design/ui/select";
import type { CurriculumCourse, CurriculumLabels } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
export default function LessonAssignment({ course, chapterId, sectionId, labels }: { course: CurriculumCourse; chapterId: string; sectionId: string; labels: CurriculumLabels }) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(chapterId);
  const sections = course.modules.find(chapter => chapter.id === selected)?.sections ?? [];
  return <>
    <Select label={labels.chapterLabel} name="chapterId" required value={selected} onValueChange={setSelected} options={course.modules.map(chapter => ({ value: chapter.id, label: chapter.title }))} />
    <Select key={selected} label={labels.sectionLabel} name="sectionId" defaultValue={selected === chapterId ? sectionId : ""} options={[{ value: "", label: labels.ungrouped }, ...sections.map(section => ({ value: section.id, label: section.title }))]} />
  </>;
}
```

```tsx
    <LessonMediaFields slug={course.slug} initialUrl={lesson ? videos[lesson.id] ?? "" : ""} initialSeconds={lesson?.durationSeconds} labels={labels} />
    <Checkbox label={labels.preview} name="preview" defaultChecked={lesson?.preview ?? false} />
  </>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import {useHydrated} from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-hydrated";
import {useState} from "react";
import UserSubscriptions from "./user-subscriptions";
import EnrollmentForm from "./enrollment-form";
import type {EnrollmentChange,EnrollmentLabels} from "@platform/types/enrollment";
import type {UserSubscription,AdminUsersLabels} from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export default function EnrollmentManager({userId,subscriptions,courses,labels,userLabels}:{userId:string;subscriptions:UserSubscription[];courses:{slug:string;title:string}[];labels:EnrollmentLabels;userLabels:AdminUsersLabels}) {
 const hydrated=useHydrated();
 const [change,setChange]=useState<Omit<EnrollmentChange,"reason">>();
 const available=courses.filter(course=>!subscriptions.some(row=>row.slug===course.slug));
 return <div className="lms-account-stack">
  <div className="lms-admin-actions"><button type="button" className="btn-primary" disabled={!hydrated || !available.length} onClick={()=>setChange({action:"grant",courseSlug:"",revision:0})}>{labels.grant}</button></div>
  <UserSubscriptions subscriptions={subscriptions} labels={userLabels} renderAction={course=><><p>{course.active ? labels.active : labels.revoked}</p><button type="button" className="lms-text-link" disabled={!hydrated} onClick={()=>setChange({courseSlug:course.slug,revision:course.revision,action:course.active ? "revoke" : "restore"})}>{course.active ? labels.revoke : labels.restore}</button></>}/>
  {change&&<EnrollmentForm initial={change} {...{userId,labels}} courses={change.action==="grant" ? available : courses} onClose={()=>setChange(undefined)}/>}
 </div>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import type { AdminUsersLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import { suspensionPeriods } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import AdminDialog from "./admin-dialog";
export default function ModerationConfirmation({ change, name, labels, pending, error, onConfirm, onCancel }: {
  change: UserModeration; name: string; labels: AdminUsersLabels; pending: boolean; error: string | null;
  onConfirm: () => void; onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const description = change.action === "remove" ? labels.confirmRemove : change.action === "promote" ? labels.confirmPromote : labels.confirmRestriction;
  return <AdminDialog title={labels.confirmTitle} closeLabel={labels.close} pending={pending} onClose={onCancel}>
    <p>{name}</p><p><strong>{labels[change.action]}</strong>{change.action === "suspend" && ` · ${suspensionPeriods.find(item => item.id === change.period)?.label}`}</p><p>{description}</p>
    {error && <p role="alert" className="lms-error">{error}</p>}
    <div className="lms-admin-actions"><button className="btn-primary" onClick={onConfirm} disabled={pending}>{pending ? labels.pending : labels.confirm}</button>
      <button className="lms-secondary-button" onClick={onCancel} disabled={pending}>{labels.cancel}</button></div>
  </AdminDialog>;
}
```

```tsx
import Select from "@khatab/design/ui/select";
import { suspensionPeriods } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { AdminUser, AdminUsersLabels, SuspensionPeriod, UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export default function ModerationControls({ user, labels, period, pending, onPeriod, onAction }: {
  user: AdminUser; labels: AdminUsersLabels; period: SuspensionPeriod; pending: boolean;
  onPeriod: (period: SuspensionPeriod) => void; onAction: (change: UserModeration) => void;
}) {
  return <div className="lms-admin-controls">
    <fieldset disabled={pending}><legend>{labels.access}</legend><p>{labels.accessHint}</p>
      <div className="lms-admin-suspend"><Select label={labels.period} value={period} disabled={pending}
        options={suspensionPeriods.map(item => ({ value: item.id, label: item.label }))}
        onValueChange={value => onPeriod(value as SuspensionPeriod)} /><button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "suspend", period })}>{labels.suspend}</button></div>
      <div className="lms-admin-actions">
        {user.suspendedUntil && <button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "restore" })}>{labels.restore}</button>}
        <button type="button" className="lms-admin-danger" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "ban" })}>{labels.ban}</button>
      </div>
    </fieldset>
    <fieldset disabled={pending || !user.confirmed}><legend>{labels.permissions}</legend><p>{labels.confirmPromote}</p>
      <button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "promote" })}>{labels.promote}</button>
      {!user.confirmed && <p>{labels.unconfirmed}</p>}
    </fieldset>
    <fieldset disabled={pending} className="lms-admin-destructive"><legend>{labels.danger}</legend><p>{labels.confirmRemove}</p>
      <button type="button" className="lms-admin-danger" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "remove" })}>{labels.remove}</button>
    </fieldset>
  </div>;
}
```

```tsx
import AdminPagination from "./admin-pagination";

export default function PhoneConfirmations({ requests, total, page, labels, accountLabels }: {
  requests: PhoneConfirmationRequest[]; total: number; page: number; labels: PhoneConfirmationLabels; accountLabels: AccountLabels;
}) {
```

```tsx
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";
export default function SaveFeedback({ pending, saved, error, labels }: { pending: boolean; saved: boolean; error: string; labels: { save: string; saving: string; saved: string } }) {
  return <><Action kind="button" type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={pending}>{pending ? labels.saving : labels.save}</Action>
```

```tsx
import FormField from "@platform/components/ui/form-field";
import TextareaField from "@platform/components/ui/textarea-field";
import { Checkbox } from "@khatab/design/ui/choice-controls";
import type { TemplateValue } from "@platform/types/workshop-template";
export default function TemplatePrimitiveField({label,value,onChange,nullable}:{label:string;value:string | number | boolean | null;onChange:(value:TemplateValue)=>void;nullable?:boolean}) {
 if(typeof value==='boolean') return <Checkbox label={label} checked={value} onChange={e=>onChange(e.currentTarget.checked)} />;
 if(typeof value==='number') return <FormField label={label} type="number" min={0} max={1000000} value={value} onChange={e=>onChange(e.currentTarget.valueAsNumber || 0)} />;
 return <TextareaField label={label} rows={value && value.length>120 ? 3 : 1} maxLength={6000} value={value ?? ''} onChange={e=>onChange(nullable && !e.target.value ? null : e.target.value)} />;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/template/value-fields.tsx`

SHA-256: `fc5706930a4165d0404d631add2011e81ff0af484c5e81b5982c2608ab9e8924`

```tsx
import { templateLockedFields,templatePolicy } from "@platform/config/workshop-template";
import { useTemplateLabels } from "@platform/hooks/use-template-labels";
import { moveTemplateItem } from "@platform/features/marketing/templates/helpers/move-items";
import type { TemplateValue } from "@platform/types/workshop-template";
import TemplatePrimitiveField from "./primitive-field";
import TemplateItemActions from "./item-actions";
type Props={value:TemplateValue;sample:TemplateValue;name:string;onChange:(value:TemplateValue)=>void};
export default function TemplateValueFields({value,sample,name,onChange}:Props) {
 const {copy:templateCopy,fields:templateFieldLabels}=useTemplateLabels();
 const label=templateFieldLabels[name] ?? name;
 if(templateLockedFields.has(name)) return null;
 if(value===null || typeof value!=='object') return <TemplatePrimitiveField {...{label,value,onChange}} nullable={sample===null} />;
 if(Array.isArray(value)) {
  const prototypes=Array.isArray(sample) ? sample : [],rich=['title','description','manifesto','children'].includes(name);
  const add=(item:TemplateValue)=>onChange([...value,structuredClone(item)]);
  return <div className="lms-template-list"><h3>{label}</h3>{value.map((item,index)=><details className="lms-template-item" key={index}><summary>{label} {index+1}</summary><TemplateItemActions index={index} count={value.length} onMove={to=>onChange(moveTemplateItem(value,index,to))} onRemove={()=>onChange(value.filter((_,i)=>i!==index))} /><TemplateValueFields value={item} sample={prototypes.find(p=>typeof p===typeof item) ?? item} name={typeof item==='object' ? '' : templateCopy.item} onChange={next=>onChange(value.map((v,i)=>i===index ? next : v))} /></details>)}
   {value.length<templatePolicy.maxItems && <div className="lms-template-item-actions">{rich ? <><button type="button" className="lms-text-link" onClick={()=>add('')}>{templateCopy.text}</button><button type="button" className="lms-text-link" onClick={()=>add({kind:'span',className:'highlight-red',children:['']})}>{templateCopy.highlight}</button></> : <button type="button" className="lms-text-link" disabled={!prototypes.length && !value.length} onClick={()=>add(prototypes[0] ?? value[0])}>{templateCopy.add}</button>}</div>}
  </div>;
 }
 const baseline=sample && typeof sample==='object' && !Array.isArray(sample) ? sample : {};
 return <div className="lms-template-fields">{Object.entries(value).filter(([key])=>!templateLockedFields.has(key)).map(([key,item])=>{
  const fields=<TemplateValueFields value={item} sample={baseline[key] ?? item} name={key} onChange={next=>onChange({...value,[key]:next})} />;
  return item && typeof item==='object' && !Array.isArray(item) ? <details className="lms-template-item" key={key}><summary>{templateFieldLabels[key] ?? key}</summary>{fields}</details> : <div key={key}>{fields}</div>;
 })}</div>;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/user-actions.tsx`

SHA-256: `6886635fe231293d067606391a71504d409d1c28b1a3bb71162ef591078f80a2`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import type { AdminUser, SuspensionPeriod, UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import type { AdminUsersLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import { useUserModeration } from "@platform/hooks/use-user-moderation";
import ModerationConfirmation from "./moderation-confirmation";
import AdminDialog from "./admin-dialog";
import ModerationControls from "./moderation-controls";
import UserIdentity from "./user-identity";
import UserStatus from "./user-status";
export default function UserActions({ user, labels }: { user: AdminUser; labels: AdminUsersLabels }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<SuspensionPeriod>("day"), [change, setChange] = useState<UserModeration | null>(null);
  const command = useUserModeration(user.id, labels.error);
  const confirm = async () => { if (change && await command.execute(change)) { setChange(null); setOpen(false); } };
  const action = async (next: UserModeration) => {
    if (next.action === "restore") { if (await command.execute(next)) setOpen(false); }
    else setChange(next);
  };
  if (user.admin) return <span className="lms-admin-protected" title={labels.protectedAdmin}>{labels.protected}</span>;
  return <div className="lms-admin-user-actions">
    <button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button lms-admin-manage" aria-haspopup="dialog" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>{labels.manage}</button>
    {open && <AdminDialog title={labels.manage} closeLabel={labels.close} pending={command.pending} onClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
      <UserIdentity user={user} labels={labels} /><p className="lms-admin-account-email" dir="ltr">{user.email}</p>
      <UserStatus user={user} labels={labels} />
      <ModerationControls user={user} labels={labels} period={period} pending={command.pending} onPeriod={setPeriod} onAction={next => void action(next)} />
      {command.error && !change && <p role="alert" className="lms-error">{command.error}</p>}
    </AdminDialog>}
    {change && <ModerationConfirmation labels={labels} change={change} name={`${user.name} · ${user.email}`} pending={command.pending} error={command.error} onConfirm={() => void confirm()} onCancel={() => setChange(null)} />}
  </div>;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/user-status.tsx`

SHA-256: `a6e1518d9e3b2ff7270c9fde9f6250b2a7c18951100813bb9ad34017e3e23adb`

```tsx
"use client";
import type { AdminUser } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import { useCurrentTime } from "@platform/hooks/use-current-time";
import { userAdministration } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import { suspensionRemaining } from "@platform/features/admin/helpers/suspension-remaining";
import type { AdminUsersLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export default function UserStatus({ user, labels }: { user: AdminUser; labels: AdminUsersLabels }) {
  const now = useCurrentTime(userAdministration.refreshMs);
  const remaining = user.suspendedUntil && now ? suspensionRemaining(user.suspendedUntil, now) : null;
  const blocked = user.permanentlyBanned || Boolean(remaining && !remaining.expired);
  return <div className="lms-admin-status" data-blocked={blocked || undefined}>
    <strong>{user.permanentlyBanned ? labels.banned : remaining && !remaining.expired ? labels.suspended : user.suspendedUntil && !now ? "…" : labels.active}</strong>
    {user.suspendedUntil && !user.permanentlyBanned && <>
      <small>{labels.ends}: <time dateTime={user.suspendedUntil}>{new Date(user.suspendedUntil).toISOString().replace("T", " ").slice(0, 16)} UTC</time></small>
      {remaining && <small>{remaining.expired ? labels.expired : `${labels.remaining}: ${remaining.days} ${labels.days} · ${remaining.hours} ${labels.hours} · ${remaining.minutes} ${labels.minutes}`}</small>}
    </>}
  </div>;
}
```

```tsx
export default function CertificateIssueForm({courses,labels,endpoint,admin=false}:{courses:{slug:string;title:string}[];labels:CertificateLabels;endpoint:string;admin?:boolean}) {

  <h2>{admin?labels.issue:labels.request}</h2><p className="lms-field-hint">{labels.issueHint}</p>
  <fieldset disabled={!hydrated||command.pending||!courses.length} className="lms-settings-name-grid">
   {admin&&<FormField label={labels.username} name="username" required minLength={usernamePolicy.min} maxLength={usernamePolicy.max} dir="ltr" autoComplete="off"/>}
   <Select name="slug" label={labels.course} required options={courses.map(course=>({value:course.slug,label:course.title}))} defaultValue={courses[0]?.slug}/>
  </fieldset>{courses.length?<SaveFeedback {...command} pending={!hydrated||command.pending} labels={{...labels,save:admin?labels.issue:labels.request}}/>:<p>{labels.empty}</p>}
 </form>;
}
```

```tsx
export default function CertificateModerationDialog({record,labels,endpoint,onClose}:{record:CertificateRecord;labels:CertificateLabels;endpoint:string;onClose:()=>void}) {

 return <AdminDialog title={labels[operation]} closeLabel={labels.cancel} pending={command.pending} onClose={onClose}>

   <p>{record.learner_name} — {record.course_title}</p><TextareaField name="reason" label={labels.reason} required maxLength={certificatePolicy.reasonMax} disabled={command.pending}/><SaveFeedback {...command} labels={labels}/>
  </form>
 </AdminDialog>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import Select from "@khatab/design/ui/select";
import FormField from "@platform/components/ui/form-field";
import DateRangeFields from "./date-range-fields";
import type { CommerceRecord,CommerceLabels } from "@platform/types/commerce";
export default function DiscountFields({record,labels,targets,coupon}:{record:CommerceRecord;labels:CommerceLabels;targets:readonly {value:string;label:string}[];coupon:boolean}) {
 const [type,setType]=useState(record.discountType);
 return <><Select name="target" label={`${labels.course} / ${labels.bundle}`} required={!coupon} defaultValue={record.courseSlug ? `course:${record.courseSlug}` : record.bundleSlug ? `bundle:${record.bundleSlug}` : ''} options={[{value:'',label:labels.all,disabled:!coupon},...targets]} />
 <p className="lms-field-hint">{labels.targetHint}</p>
 <div className="lms-commerce-fields"><Select name="discountType" label={labels.discountType} value={type} onValueChange={value=>setType(value as typeof type)} options={[{value:'percent',label:labels.percent},{value:'fixed',label:labels.fixed}]} />
 <FormField name="discountValue" label={labels.discountValue} key={type} defaultValue={type===record.discountType ? record.discountValue/(type==='fixed' ? 100 : 1) : ''} inputMode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]+" required /></div>
 <DateRangeFields record={record} labels={labels} /></>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useCommerceEditor } from "@platform/hooks/use-commerce-editor";
import { emptyCommerceRecord } from "@platform/features/commerce/helpers/empty-record";
import AdminDialog from "@platform/components/admin/admin-dialog";
import CommerceRecordForm from "./record-form";
import CommerceRecordsTable from "./records-table";
import type { CommerceKind,CommerceRecord,CommerceLabels } from "@platform/types/commerce";
export default function ManageCommerceRecords({kind,records,labels,courses,targets,closeLabel}:{kind:CommerceKind;records:CommerceRecord[];labels:CommerceLabels;courses:readonly {slug:string;title:string}[];targets:readonly {value:string;label:string}[];closeLabel:string}) {
 const editor=useCommerceEditor(kind,labels.error);
 return <><div className="lms-admin-heading-actions"><button className="btn-primary" onClick={()=>editor.open(emptyCommerceRecord())}>{labels.create}</button></div>
 <CommerceRecordsTable {...{kind,records,labels}} onEdit={editor.open} />
 {editor.selected && <AdminDialog title={editor.deleting ? labels.remove : editor.selected.revision ? labels.edit : labels.create} closeLabel={closeLabel} pending={editor.pending} onClose={editor.close}>
 {editor.deleting ? <div className="lms-commerce-form"><p>{labels.deleteConfirm}</p>{editor.error && <p role="alert" className="lms-error">{editor.error}</p>}<button className="btn-primary" disabled={editor.pending} onClick={()=>void editor.submit()}>{labels.remove}</button></div> :
 <CommerceRecordForm {...{kind,labels,courses,targets}} record={editor.selected} pending={editor.pending} error={editor.error} onSubmit={form=>void editor.submit(form)} />}</AdminDialog>}</>;
}
```

```tsx
import FormField from "@platform/components/ui/form-field";

import DiscountFields from "./discount-fields";
import CouponFields from "./coupon-fields";
import { commercePolicy } from "@platform/config/commerce";
import type { CommerceKind,CommerceRecord,CommerceLabels } from "@platform/types/commerce";
export default function CommerceRecordForm({kind,record,labels,courses,targets,pending,error,onSubmit}:{kind:CommerceKind;record:CommerceRecord;labels:CommerceLabels;courses:readonly {slug:string;title:string}[];targets:readonly {value:string;label:string}[];pending:boolean;error:string;onSubmit:(form:FormData)=>void}) {
 return <form className="lms-profile-form lms-admin-form lms-commerce-form" onSubmit={event=>{event.preventDefault();onSubmit(new FormData(event.currentTarget));}}>
 <fieldset disabled={pending}><div className="lms-commerce-fields"><FormField name="title" label={labels.name} defaultValue={record.title} required maxLength={commercePolicy.maxTitle} />
 <FormField name="key" label={labels.key} defaultValue={record.key} readOnly={record.revision>0} required dir="ltr" maxLength={kind==='coupons' ? commercePolicy.maxCouponLength : 100} pattern={kind==='coupons' ? '[A-Z0-9_-]+' : '[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*'} /></div>
 <TextareaField name="description" label={labels.description} defaultValue={record.description} maxLength={commercePolicy.maxDescription} rows={3} />
 {kind==='bundles' ? <BundleFields {...{record,labels,courses}} /> : <DiscountFields {...{record,labels,targets}} coupon={kind==='coupons'} />}
 {kind==='coupons' && <CouponFields {...{record,labels}} />}<Checkbox name="enabled" label={labels.enabled} defaultChecked={record.enabled} /></fieldset>
 {error && <p className="lms-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}<button className="btn-primary" disabled={pending}>{pending ? labels.saving : labels.save}</button></form>;
}
```

```tsx
import { useDeadlineExpired } from "@platform/hooks/use-deadline-expired";
import DiscountCountdown from "@/app/components/workshop/discount-countdown";
import type { CountdownContent } from "@khatab/design/types/interactions";
export default function FeaturedOfferBar({offer,countdown}:{offer:{title:string;endsAt:string|null;remaining:number};countdown:CountdownContent}) {
 const options={endsAt:offer.endsAt,durationSeconds:offer.remaining,storageKey:"",tickMs:1000},expired=useDeadlineExpired(offer.endsAt,offer.remaining);
 if(expired) return null;
 return <aside className="top-scarcity-bar lms-featured-offer-bar" aria-label={offer.title}><Container className="top-bar-inner"><div className="top-scarcity-nav-capsule">
 <span className="top-live-item lms-featured-offer-name" title={offer.title}>{offer.title}</span>
 {offer.endsAt && <><span className="top-bar-sep" aria-hidden="true">•</span><DiscountCountdown content={countdown} options={options} /></>}
 </div></Container></aside>;
}
```

```tsx
 return <dl className="lms-commerce-price-summary">{quote.offerMinor+quote.couponMinor>0 && row(labels.subtotal,quote.baseMinor)}{quote.offerMinor>0 && row(quote.offerTitle ?? labels.offerDiscount,quote.offerMinor,true)}{quote.couponMinor>0 && row(labels.couponDiscount,quote.couponMinor,true)}<div className="lms-payment-total"><dt>{labels.total}</dt><dd className="numeral">{quote.totalMinor===0 ? labels.free : `${quote.totalMinor/100} ${labels.currency}`}</dd></div></dl>;
```

### File: `modules/components/commerce/sale-row.tsx`

SHA-256: `17928f82923edad34c27e5d3383bb6843647d6d6a3cc2c0a7a0bc7ffe2c06e70`

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { formatCourseDate } from "@platform/helpers/format-course-date";
import type { SaleRecord, SalesLabels } from "@platform/types/sales";
export default function SaleRow({ record, labels, showCustomer, receiptLabel }: {
  record: SaleRecord; labels: SalesLabels; showCustomer: boolean; receiptLabel?: string;
}) {
  return <tr>
    <th scope="row">{record.title}<small>{record.live ? labels.live : labels.test}</small></th>
    {showCustomer && <td data-label={labels.customer}>{record.username
      ? <Link href={routes.adminUser(record.username)} className="lms-course-text-link">{record.name}</Link>
      : labels.noCustomer}</td>}
    <td data-label={labels.amount}><bdi className="numeral">{record.amountMinor / 100} {labels.currency}</bdi>
      {record.discountMinor > 0 && <small>{labels.discount}: {record.discountMinor / 100} {labels.currency}
        {record.couponCode && <bdi> · {record.couponCode}</bdi>}</small>}</td>
    <td data-label={labels.status}>{labels.states[record.status]}
      {receiptLabel && <small><Link className="lms-course-text-link" href={routes.payment(record.id)}>{receiptLabel}</Link></small>}</td>
    <td data-label={labels.date}><time dateTime={record.createdAt}>{formatCourseDate(record.createdAt, labels.empty)}</time></td>
  </tr>;
}
```

```tsx
import SaleRow from "./sale-row";
import type { SaleRecord, SalesLabels } from "@platform/types/sales";
export default function SalesTable({ records, labels, showCustomer = true, receiptLabel }: {
  records: SaleRecord[]; labels: SalesLabels; showCustomer?: boolean; receiptLabel?: string;
}) {
  const headings = [labels.product, ...(showCustomer ? [labels.customer] : []), labels.amount, labels.status, labels.date];
  return <div className="lms-admin-table-wrap" data-reveal="true" data-reveal-motion="fade">
    <table className="lms-admin-table lms-commerce-table">
      <caption className="lms-visually-hidden">{labels.heading}</caption>
      <thead><tr>{headings.map(label => <th key={label} scope="col">{label}</th>)}</tr></thead>
      <tbody>{records.map(record => <SaleRow key={record.id} {...{ record, labels, showCustomer, receiptLabel }} />)}</tbody>
    </table>
    {!records.length && <p className="lms-admin-empty">{labels.empty}</p>}
  </div>;
}
```

```tsx
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import Link from "next/link";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
export default function CatalogFilters({
  query,
  category,
  interfaceCopy,
  categories,
  copy,
}: {
  query: string;
  category: string;
} & {
  interfaceCopy: Pick<ContentBindings["interfaceCopy"], "categoryLabel">;
  categories: ContentBindings["categories"];
  copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "search" | "searchButton">;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="lms-catalog-controls">
      <form action={routes.courses} className="lms-search" role="search">
        <Symbol name="search" />
        <input
          name="q"
          type="search"
          defaultValue={query}

        <input type="hidden" name="category" value={category} />
        <button type="submit">{copy.searchButton}</button>
      </form>
      <div className="lms-filter-tabs" aria-label={interfaceCopy.categoryLabel}>
        {categories.map((item) => (
          <Link
            key={item.id}
            href={routes.catalog(query, item.id)}
            aria-current={category === item.id ? "page" : undefined}

          >
            {item.label}
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { thumbnailUrl } from "@platform/helpers/media/thumbnail-url";
import AssetImage from "@khatab/design/ui/asset-image";
import { validateArtworkKind } from "./artwork/helpers/validate-kind";
import CourseIllustration from "./artwork/illustration";
import { courseLessons } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export default function CourseArtwork({
  course,
  large = false,
  showLabels = true,
  site,
  lessonLabel,
}: {
  course: Pick<Course,"modules"|"artwork"|"tool"|"categoryLabel"|"thumbnailUrl"|"delivery"|"deliveryLabel">;
  large?: boolean;
} & (
  | { showLabels: false; lessonLabel?: never }
  | { showLabels?: true; lessonLabel: string }
) & { site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "englishName"> }) {
  if (course.thumbnailUrl) return <AssetImage asset={{ src: thumbnailUrl(course.thumbnailUrl), alt: "", width: 560, height: 260 }} className="lms-course-art" />;
  const kind = course.artwork;
  validateArtworkKind(kind);
  return (
    <div
      className={`lms-course-art lms-art-${kind} ${large ? "lms-art-large" : ""}`}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {showLabels && (
        <div className="lms-art-top">
          <span className="lms-art-logo">{site.englishName.toUpperCase()}</span>
          <span>{course.tool}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <svg viewBox="0 0 560 260" fill="none">
        <path
          d="M0 52h560M0 104h560M0 156h560M0 208h560M80 0v260M160 0v260M240 0v260M320 0v260M400 0v260M480 0v260"
          stroke="var(--border-hairline)"
        />
        <CourseIllustration kind={kind} />
      </svg>
      {showLabels && (
        <div className="lms-art-bottom">
          <span>{course.categoryLabel}</span>
          <span className="numeral">
            {course.delivery === "live" ? course.deliveryLabel : `${courseLessons(course).length} ${lessonLabel}`}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/courses/course-card.tsx`

SHA-256: `f42d3c8902d664ed6014ea876eb56317220dd0a28af03272b042ed6a68891f67`

```tsx
import { courseLessons } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
import ProgressBar from "@platform/components/ui/progress-bar";
import CourseArtwork from "./course-artwork";
import CoursePrice from "./course-price";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export default function CourseCard({
  course,
  progress,
  copy,
  site,
  offerCopy,
}: {
  course: Course;
  progress?: {
    count: number;
    total: number;
    percent: number;
    next?: { id: string };
  };
} & {
  copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "lessons" | "continue" | "progress">;
  site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "englishName">;
  offerCopy: Pick<ContentBindings["offerCopy"], "price">;
}) {
  const detailHref = routes.course(course.slug, course.delivery);
  const actionHref = progress
    ? progress.next
      ? routes.lesson(course.slug, progress.next.id)
      : routes.course(course.slug, course.delivery)
    : routes.enrollment(course.slug, course.delivery);
  return (
    <article className="lms-course-card">
      <h3 className="lms-card-title">
        <Action kind="link" href={detailHref}>
          {course.title}
        </Action>
      </h3>
      <Action
        kind="link"
        href={detailHref}
        tabIndex={-1}
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="lms-card-cover"
      >
        <CourseArtwork
          site={{ englishName: site.englishName }}
          course={course}
          showLabels={false}
        />
      </Action>
      <div className="lms-course-card-body">
        <div className="lms-card-summary">
          <div className="lms-card-meta">
            <span>
              <Symbol name="book" />
              {course.delivery === "live" ? course.deliveryLabel : `${courseLessons(course).length} ${copy.lessons}`}
            </span>
            <span>
              <Symbol name="clock" />
              {course.duration}
            </span>
          </div>
          <CoursePrice
            offerCopy={{ price: offerCopy.price }}
            offer={course.offer}
            compact
          />
        </div>
        {progress && course.delivery !== "live" && (
          <ProgressBar
            copy={{ progress: copy.progress, lessons: copy.lessons }}
            {...progress}
          />
        )}
        <Action
          kind="link"
          className="btn-primary lms-full-button lms-card-action"
          href={actionHref}
        >
          {progress ? copy.continue : course.offer.actionLabel}
          <Symbol name="arrow" />
        </Action>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/courses/course-enrollment-action.tsx`

SHA-256: `4377bd1c6ae776548d80ba7132d995c122d8c43e83943fe06d018ee931e42ea3`

```tsx
import { offerBaseAmount } from "@platform/features/commerce/helpers/offer-base-amount";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
import type { CourseDetailsProps } from "@platform/types/course-details";
import EnrollButton from "./enroll-button";
export default function CourseEnrollmentAction({ course, copy, labels, enrolled, nextLesson, supportHref }: Pick<CourseDetailsProps,"course" | "copy" | "labels" | "enrolled" | "nextLesson" | "supportHref">) {
  if (course.delivery === "live" && !nextLesson && (enrolled || offerBaseAmount(course.offer) === 0))
    return <Action kind="anchor" href={supportHref} className="btn-primary lms-full-button">{enrolled ? labels.workshopSupport : labels.workshopBooking}<Symbol name="arrow" /></Action>;
  return <EnrollButton copy={copy} slug={course.slug} firstLesson={nextLesson} enrolled={enrolled} paid={offerBaseAmount(course.offer) > 0} />;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/courses/course-facts.tsx`

SHA-256: `3fce765d1a9da2c9999b2b383c51a1bdc8b4221268a7ffea6816e29a83580a8f`

```tsx
import type { CourseDetailsProps } from "@platform/types/course-details";
import { courseLessons } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers/course-lessons";
export default function CourseFacts({ course, labels }: Pick<CourseDetailsProps,"course" | "labels">) {
  const lessons = courseLessons(course).length;
  const facts = [
    { label: labels.delivery, value: course.delivery === "live" ? course.deliveryLabel || labels.live : labels.recorded },
    ...(course.duration ? [{ label: labels.duration, value: course.duration }] : []),
    ...(lessons ? [{ label: labels.lessons, value: lessons }, { label: labels.chapters, value: course.modules.length }] : []),
  ];
  return <dl className="lms-course-facts">{facts.map(fact => <div key={fact.label}><dt>{fact.label}</dt><dd>{fact.value}</dd></div>)}</dl>;
}
```

```tsx
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";
import CourseCard from "./course-card";
import RevealContent from "@platform/components/marketing/reveal-content";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export default function CourseGrid({
  courses,
  progress = {},
  layout = "public",
  motion = true,
  copy,
  site,
  offerCopy,
}: {
  courses: Course[];
  progress?: Record<
    string,
    import("@platform/features/learning/helpers").CourseProgress
  >;
  layout?: "public" | "dashboard";
  motion?: boolean;
} & {
  copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "lessons" | "continue" | "progress">;
  site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "englishName">;
  offerCopy: Pick<ContentBindings["offerCopy"], "price">;
}) {
  return (
    <RevealContent
      as="div"
      className={`lms-course-grid${layout === "dashboard" ? " lms-dashboard-grid" : ""}`}
      scope="cards"
      motion={motion}
    >
      {courses.map((course) => (
        <div className="lms-card-entrance" data-reveal key={course.slug}>
          <CourseCard
            copy={{
```

```tsx
import { courseContentGroups } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers/course-content-groups";
import { numbered } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers/numbered";
import { formatCourseDuration } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers/format-course-duration";
import type { CourseModule } from "@platform/types/lms";
import type { CourseDetailsLabels } from "@platform/types/course-details";
import CurriculumLesson from "./curriculum-lesson";
export default function CurriculumChapter({ chapter, index, slug, enrolled, labels }: { chapter: CourseModule; index: number; slug: string; enrolled: boolean; labels: CourseDetailsLabels }) {
  const seconds = chapter.lessons.reduce((sum,lesson) => sum+lesson.durationSeconds,0);
  return <details open={index === 0}>
    <summary><span className="numeral">{numbered(index)}</span><b>{chapter.title}</b>
      <small>{chapter.lessons.length} {labels.lessons}{seconds > 0 && <> · {formatCourseDuration(seconds)}</>}</small>
    </summary>
    <div className="lms-curriculum-chapter-body">{courseContentGroups(chapter,labels.ungrouped).map(group => <div key={group.sectionId ? `section-${group.sectionId}` : "unassigned"}>
      {group.title && <h3>{group.title}</h3>}
      <ul>{group.lessons.map(lesson => <CurriculumLesson key={lesson.id} lesson={lesson} slug={slug} enrolled={enrolled} labels={labels} />)}</ul>
    </div>)}</div>
  </details>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";

import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import { useCourseEnrollment } from "@platform/hooks/use-course-enrollment";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
export default function EnrollButton({
  slug,
  firstLesson,
  enrolled,
  paid = false,
  copy,
}: {
  slug: string;
  firstLesson?: string;
  enrolled: boolean;
  paid?: boolean;
} & {
  copy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["copy"],
    "error" | "saving" | "continue" | "enrollLabel"
  >;
}) {
  const { start, pending, error } = useCourseEnrollment({ slug, firstLesson, enrolled, paid, errorLabel: copy.error });
  return (
    <div>
      <Action
        kind="button"
        type="button"
        className="btn-primary lms-full-button"
        disabled={pending || (!firstLesson && !paid)}
        onClick={start}
      >
        {pending ? copy.saving : enrolled ? copy.continue : copy.enrollLabel}
        <Symbol name="arrow" />
      </Action>
      {error && (
        <p className="lms-error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import type { DashboardShellProps } from "@platform/types/dashboard-shell";

import { useId } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useMobileMenu } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-mobile-menu";
import { useProtectedSession } from "@platform/hooks/use-protected-session";
import { endpoints, routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import RevealContent from "@platform/components/marketing/reveal-content";
import DashboardHeader from "./dashboard-header";
import DashboardSidebar from "./dashboard-sidebar";
export default function DashboardShell({
  children,
  name,
  avatarUrl,
  accountMenu,
  interfaceCopy,
  dashboardNavigation,
  site,
  copy,
  showSidebarHelp = true,
  showBrowseLink = true,
  sessionEndpoint = endpoints.auth.session,
}: DashboardShellProps) {
  const navigationId = useId();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const verified = useProtectedSession(pathname, sessionEndpoint, routes.login);
  const menu = useMobileMenu({ breakpointToken: "--breakpoint-mobile" });
  if (!verified) return null;
  return (
    <div className="lms-app">
      <DashboardHeader accountMenu={accountMenu} avatarUrl={avatarUrl} showBrowseLink={showBrowseLink} name={name} site={site} copy={copy} menu={menu} navigationId={navigationId} />
      <div className="lms-app-grid">
        <DashboardSidebar showSidebarHelp={showSidebarHelp} name={name} interfaceCopy={interfaceCopy} dashboardNavigation={dashboardNavigation} copy={copy} menu={menu} navigationId={navigationId} pathname={pathname} />
        <RevealContent className="lms-app-main">{children}</RevealContent>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useBelowBreakpoint } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-below-breakpoint";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";

import type { NavigationAccount } from "@platform/types/navigation-account";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import Link from "next/link";
import NavigationLink from "@khatab/design/ui/navigation-link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useId } from "react";
import { useMobileMenu } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-mobile-menu";
import Brand from "./brand";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
export default function SiteHeader({
  interfaceCopy,
  marketingNavigation,
  copy,
  site,
  account = null,
  actions = {
    home: routes.home,
    start: routes.login,
  },
}: {
  account?: NavigationAccount | null;
  actions?: { home: string; start: string };
  interfaceCopy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["interfaceCopy"],
    "mainNavigationLabel"
  >;
  marketingNavigation: ContentBindings["marketingNavigation"];
  copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "start" | "close" | "menu">;
  site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "name" | "englishName">;
}) {
  const { open, setOpen, menuRef, toggleRef } = useMobileMenu();
  const collapsed = useBelowBreakpoint("--breakpoint-navigation") && !open;
  const id = useId();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  return (
    <header className="site-header lms-site-header">
      <nav
        className="site-navbar"
        aria-label={interfaceCopy.mainNavigationLabel}
      >
        <div className="container lms-navbar">
          <Brand
            href={actions.home}
            site={{ name: site.name, englishName: site.englishName }}
          />
          <div
            className={`lms-marketing-links ${open ? "is-open" : ""}`}
            id={id}
            aria-hidden={collapsed}
            inert={collapsed}
            ref={(element) => {
              menuRef.current = element;
            }}
          >
            {marketingNavigation.map((link) => (
              <NavigationLink
                href={link.href}
                key={link.href}
                aria-current={pathname === link.href ? "page" : undefined}
                onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              >
                {link.label}
              </NavigationLink>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="lms-nav-actions">
            {account ? <Link href={account.href} className="lms-text-link">{account.label}</Link> :
              <Link href={actions.start} className="btn-primary lms-nav-button">{copy.start}<Symbol name="arrow" /></Link>}
            <button
              className="lms-mobile-toggle"
              ref={toggleRef}
              aria-label={open ? copy.close : copy.menu}
              aria-controls={id}
              aria-expanded={open}
              onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
            >
              <Symbol name={open ? "close" : "menu"} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </nav>
    </header>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import {useHydrated} from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-hydrated";
import {useId} from "react";
import {useRemoteLessonNote} from "@platform/hooks/use-remote-lesson-note";
import {useLessonNotes} from "@platform/hooks/use-lesson-notes";
import {notePolicy} from "@platform/config/materials";
import type {SavedLessonNote,NoteLabels} from "@platform/types/materials";
export default function CloudLessonNotes({path,initial,storageKey,labels}:{path:string;initial:SavedLessonNote;storageKey:string;labels:NoteLabels}) {
 const ready=useHydrated(),id=useId(),note=useRemoteLessonNote(path,initial,labels.error),local=useLessonNotes(storageKey);
 return <form className="lms-notes lms-account-stack" onSubmit={event=>{event.preventDefault();void note.save();}}><label htmlFor={id}>{labels.title}</label>
  <textarea disabled={!ready} id={id} value={note.value} onChange={event=>note.setValue(event.target.value)} placeholder={labels.hint} rows={6} maxLength={notePolicy.textMax} aria-describedby={`${id}-hint`}/>
  <small id={`${id}-hint`}>{labels.limit}</small><small role="status">{note.dirty ? labels.unsaved : labels.saved}</small>
  {!initial.text&&!note.value&&local.value&&<button type="button" className="lms-text-link" onClick={()=>note.setValue(local.value.slice(0,notePolicy.textMax))}>{labels.importLocal}</button>}
  <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={note.pending||!note.dirty}>{note.pending ? labels.saving : labels.save}</button>
  {note.error&&<p className="lms-error" role="alert">{note.error}</p>}
 </form>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";

import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import { useLessonCompletion } from "@platform/hooks/use-lesson-completion";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
export default function CompletionButton({
  slug,
  lessonId,
  complete,
  enrolled,
  copy,
}: {
  slug: string;
  lessonId: string;
  complete: boolean;
  enrolled: boolean;
} & {
  copy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["copy"],
    "error" | "saving" | "completed" | "complete"
  >;
}) {
  const { toggle, pending, error } = useLessonCompletion({ slug, lessonId, complete, enrolled, errorLabel: copy.error });
  return (
    <div>
      <Action
        kind="button"
        className={
          complete ? "lms-secondary-button lms-is-complete" : "btn-primary"
        }
        type="button"
        onClick={toggle}
        disabled={pending}
      >
        <Symbol name="check" />
        {pending ? copy.saving : complete ? copy.completed : copy.complete}
      </Action>
      {error && (
        <p className="lms-error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

  storageKey,
  copy,
}: { storageKey: string } & {
  copy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["copy"],

      </small>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import AdminDialog from "@platform/components/admin/admin-dialog";
import { useAdminSave } from "@platform/hooks/use-admin-save";
import { endpoints } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { liveSessionState,liveSessionTime } from "@platform/features/live-sessions/helpers/state";
import type { AdminLiveSession,LiveSessionLabels } from "@platform/types/live-sessions";
export default function AdminSessionRow({session,now,courseName,labels,onEdit}:{session:AdminLiveSession;now:number;courseName:string;labels:LiveSessionLabels;onEdit:()=>void}) {
 const [removing,setRemoving]=useState(false);
 const command=useAdminSave(endpoints.adminLiveSessions,labels.error);
 return <tr><th scope="row">{session.title}<small>{courseName}</small></th>
  <td data-label={labels.starts}>{liveSessionTime(session.startsAt,session.timezone)}</td><td data-label={labels.ends}>{liveSessionTime(session.endsAt,session.timezone)}</td>
  <td data-label={labels.filter}>{session.enabled ? labels[liveSessionState(session,now)] : labels.hidden}</td>
  <td><div className="lms-admin-actions"><button type="button" className="lms-text-link" onClick={onEdit}>{labels.edit}</button><button type="button" className="lms-text-link" disabled={command.pending} onClick={()=>setRemoving(true)}>{labels.remove}</button></div>{command.error&&<p className="lms-error" role="alert">{command.error}</p>}{removing && <AdminDialog title={labels.confirmRemove} closeLabel={labels.cancel} pending={command.pending} onClose={()=>setRemoving(false)}><div className="lms-admin-actions"><button type="button" className="btn-primary" disabled={command.pending} onClick={async()=>{if(await command.save({operation:"delete",id:session.id,revision:session.revision})) setRemoving(false);}}>{labels.remove}</button><button type="button" className="lms-text-link" disabled={command.pending} onClick={()=>setRemoving(false)}>{labels.cancel}</button></div>{command.error&&<p className="lms-error" role="alert">{command.error}</p>}</AdminDialog>}</td>
 </tr>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import Select from "@khatab/design/ui/select";
import type { AdminLiveSession,LiveSessionLabels } from "@platform/types/live-sessions";
export interface SessionCourseChoice {slug:string;title:string;chapters:{id:string;title:string;sections:{id:string;title:string}[]}[];}
export default function SessionAssignment({initial,courses,labels}:{initial?:AdminLiveSession;courses:SessionCourseChoice[];labels:LiveSessionLabels}) {
 const [slug,setSlug]=useState(initial?.courseSlug ?? courses[0]?.slug ?? ""),[chapter,setChapter]=useState(initial?.chapterId ?? ""),[section,setSection]=useState(initial?.sectionId ?? "");
 const chapters=courses.find(course=>course.slug===slug)?.chapters ?? [],sections=chapters.find(item=>item.id===chapter)?.sections ?? [];
 return <div className="lms-live-assignment">
  <Select label={labels.course} name="courseSlug" value={slug} onValueChange={value=>{setSlug(value);setChapter("");setSection("");}} options={courses.map(course=>({value:course.slug,label:course.title}))} />
  <Select label={labels.chapter} name="chapterId" value={chapter} onValueChange={value=>{setChapter(value);setSection("");}} options={[{value:"",label:labels.wholeCourse},...chapters.map(item=>({value:item.id,label:item.title}))]} />
  <Select label={labels.section} name="sectionId" value={section} onValueChange={setSection} options={[{value:"",label:labels.noSection},...sections.map(item=>({value:item.id,label:item.title}))]} />
 </div>;
}
```

```tsx
import { liveSessionState,liveSessionTime } from "@platform/features/live-sessions/helpers/state";
import type { LiveSession,LiveSessionLabels } from "@platform/types/live-sessions";
export default function LiveSessionCard({session,now,joinAllowed,labels}:{session:LiveSession;now:number;joinAllowed:boolean;labels:LiveSessionLabels}) {
 const state=liveSessionState(session,now);
 return <article className="lms-profile-card lms-live-card" data-reveal>
  <Link className="lms-text-link" href={routes.course(session.courseSlug)}>{session.courseTitle}</Link><h3>{session.title}</h3>{session.assignmentTitle && <p className="lms-field-hint">{session.assignmentTitle}</p>}<p>{session.description}</p><strong className={`lms-live-status lms-live-status-${state}`}>{labels[state]}</strong>
  <p><span>{state==="ended" ? labels.endedAt : labels.starts}: </span><time dateTime={state==="ended" ? session.endsAt : session.startsAt}>{liveSessionTime(state==="ended" ? session.endsAt : session.startsAt,session.timezone)}</time></p>
  {state!=="ended" && <p>{labels.ends}: <time dateTime={session.endsAt}>{liveSessionTime(session.endsAt,session.timezone)}</time></p>}
  <small className="lms-field-hint">{session.timezone}</small>
  {state==="active" && (joinAllowed ? <Link href={endpoints.liveJoin(session.courseSlug,session.id)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" prefetch={false} className="btn-primary">{labels.join}</Link> : <p className="lms-field-hint">{labels.locked}</p>)}
 </article>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import FormField from "@platform/components/ui/form-field";
import Select from "@khatab/design/ui/select";
import { Checkbox } from "@khatab/design/ui/choice-controls";
import SaveFeedback from "@platform/components/admin/save-feedback";
import { useAdminSave } from "@platform/hooks/use-admin-save";
import { endpoints } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { liveSessionPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/live-sessions";
import { liveSessionDateInput } from "@platform/features/live-sessions/helpers/state";
import { readLiveSessionForm } from "@platform/features/live-sessions/helpers/validate-input";
import type { AdminLiveSession,LiveSessionLabels } from "@platform/types/live-sessions";
import SessionAssignment,{type SessionCourseChoice} from "./session-assignment";
export default function SessionForm({initial,courses,labels,onClose}:{initial?:AdminLiveSession;courses:SessionCourseChoice[];labels:LiveSessionLabels;onClose:()=>void}) {
 const command=useAdminSave(endpoints.adminLiveSessions,labels.error),[timezone,setTimezone]=useState(initial?.timezone ?? policy.defaultTimezone);
 return <form className="lms-profile-form lms-profile-card lms-live-form" onSubmit={event=>{event.preventDefault();void command.save(readLiveSessionForm(new FormData(event.currentTarget))).then(saved=>{if(saved) onClose();});}}>
  {initial && <input type="hidden" name="id" value={initial.id} />}<input type="hidden" name="revision" value={initial?.revision ?? 0} />
  <fieldset disabled={command.pending}><SessionAssignment {...{initial,courses,labels}} />
   <FormField label={labels.name} name="title" defaultValue={initial?.title} maxLength={policy.titleMax} required />
   <FormField label={labels.description} name="description" defaultValue={initial?.description ?? ""} maxLength={policy.descriptionMax} />
   <Select label={labels.timezone} name="timezone" value={timezone} onValueChange={setTimezone} options={policy.timezones.map(value=>({value,label:value}))} />
   <div className="lms-settings-name-grid"><FormField label={labels.starts} name="startsLocal" type="datetime-local" defaultValue={initial ? liveSessionDateInput(initial.startsAt,initial.timezone) : ""} required /><FormField label={labels.ends} name="endsLocal" type="datetime-local" defaultValue={initial ? liveSessionDateInput(initial.endsAt,initial.timezone) : ""} required /></div>
   <p className="lms-field-hint">{labels.timezoneHint}</p><FormField label={labels.joinUrl} name="joinUrl" type="url" dir="ltr" defaultValue={initial?.joinUrl} maxLength={policy.urlMax} required />
   <Checkbox name="enabled" label={labels.enabled} defaultChecked={initial?.enabled ?? true} />
  </fieldset>
  <SaveFeedback {...command} labels={{save:labels.save,saving:labels.saving,saved:labels.saved}} /><button type="button" className="lms-text-link" disabled={command.pending} onClick={onClose}>{labels.cancel}</button>
 </form>;
}
```

```tsx
import ClientsSection from "@khatab/design/ui/clients-section";
import TestimonialsSection from "@khatab/design/ui/testimonials-section";
import ClosingSection from "@platform/components/marketing/closing-section";
import CoachingSection from "@platform/components/marketing/coaching-section";
import CourseShowcase from "@platform/components/marketing/course-showcase";
import SkillStrip from "@platform/components/marketing/skill-strip";
import SiteHeader from "@platform/components/layout/site-header";
import SiteFooter from "@platform/components/layout/site-footer";
import LandingHero from "@platform/components/marketing/landing-hero";
import InstructorSection from "@khatab/design/ui/instructor-section";
import TransformationSection from "@khatab/design/ui/transformation-section";
import FaqSection from "@khatab/design/ui/faq-section";
import { Fragment, type ComponentProps } from "react";
import RevealContent from "./reveal-content";
export interface LandingModel {
  header?: ComponentProps<typeof SiteHeader>;
  hero: ComponentProps<typeof LandingHero>;
  workSamples?: ComponentProps<typeof ClientsSection>;
  testimonials?: ComponentProps<typeof TestimonialsSection>;
  skills: ComponentProps<typeof SkillStrip>;
  courses: ComponentProps<typeof CourseShowcase>;
  steps: ComponentProps<typeof TransformationSection>;
  instructor: ComponentProps<typeof InstructorSection>;
  coaching: ComponentProps<typeof CoachingSection>;
  faq: ComponentProps<typeof FaqSection>;
  closing: ComponentProps<typeof ClosingSection>;
  footer?: ComponentProps<typeof SiteFooter>;
  order?: readonly LandingSection[];
  motion?: boolean;
}
export type LandingSection =
  | "hero"
  | "workSamples"
  | "testimonials"
  | "skills"
  | "courses"
  | "steps"
  | "instructor"
  | "coaching"
  | "faq"
  | "closing";
const defaultOrder: readonly LandingSection[] = [
  "hero",
  "skills",
  "courses",
  "workSamples",
  "steps",
  "instructor",
  "coaching",
  "testimonials",
  "faq",
  "closing",
];
export default function LandingPage({ model }: { model: LandingModel }) {
  const sections = {
    hero: <LandingHero {...model.hero} />,
    workSamples: model.workSamples && <ClientsSection {...model.workSamples} />,
    testimonials: model.testimonials && <TestimonialsSection {...model.testimonials} />,
    skills: <SkillStrip {...model.skills} />,
    courses: <CourseShowcase {...model.courses} />,
    steps: <TransformationSection contextVariant="plain" reveal {...model.steps} />,
    instructor: <InstructorSection contextVariant="plain" reveal {...model.instructor} />,
    coaching: <CoachingSection {...model.coaching} />,
    faq: <FaqSection contextVariant="plain" reveal {...model.faq} />,
    closing: <ClosingSection {...model.closing} />,
  };
  return (
    <>
      {model.header && <SiteHeader {...model.header} />}
      <RevealContent motion={model.motion ?? true}>
        {(model.order ?? defaultOrder).map((key) => (
          <Fragment key={key}>{sections[key]}</Fragment>
        ))}
      </RevealContent>
      {model.footer && <SiteFooter {...model.footer} />}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRef } from "react";
import { useScrollReveals } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-scroll-reveals";
import { useFragmentNavigation } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-fragment-navigation";
export default function RevealContent({
  children,
  as: Element = "main",
  className,
  scope = "page",
  options,
  motion = true,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  as?: "main" | "div";
  className?: string;
  scope?: "page" | "cards";
  options?: import("@khatab/design/types/interactions").RevealOptions;
  motion?: boolean;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useFragmentNavigation({ rootRef: ref, enabled: scope === "page" });
  useScrollReveals({ rootRef: ref, options, enabled: motion });
  return (
    <Element ref={ref} className={className} data-reveal-scope={scope}>
      {children}
    </Element>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/payments/checkout-button.tsx`

SHA-256: `7b588caf3df3bdb64f1a9f533c146378b3c72ce5de3fb928f6b224d6bed982f7`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "@platform/hooks/use-async-command";
import { paymentRequest } from "@platform/features/payments/client/request";
import { endpoints } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";
export default function CheckoutButton({
  input,
  totalMinor,
  disabled = false,
  labels,
}: {
  input: import("@platform/types/commerce").PurchaseInput;
  totalMinor: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  labels: { pay: string; pending: string; error: string };
}) {
  const command = useAsyncCommand(labels.error);
  const checkout = () =>
    command.run(async () => {
      const result = await paymentRequest<{ checkoutUrl: string }>(endpoints.paymentCheckout, { ...input, expectedTotalMinor: totalMinor });
      window.location.assign(result.checkoutUrl);
    });
  return (
    <div>
      <Action
        kind="button"
        type="button"
        className="btn-primary lms-full-button"
        disabled={command.pending || disabled}
        onClick={checkout}
      >
        {command.pending ? labels.pending : labels.pay}
      </Action>
      {command.error && (
        <p role="alert" className="lms-error">
          {command.error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/payments/order-result.tsx`

SHA-256: `e4443392d190847aec80c071c0509d1f4ecdcb6f43631e2c2bb04229262a51b7`

```tsx
"use client";
import { paymentStatusHint } from "@platform/features/payments/helpers/status-hint";
import Link from "next/link";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";
import { usePaymentStatus } from "@platform/hooks/use-payment-status";
import type { readPaymentReceipt } from "@platform/features/payments/repositories/read-order";
import type { paymentCopy } from "@platform/data/payment-copy";
export default function OrderResult({
  initial,
  labels,
  libraryHref,
  retryHref,
  settingsHref,
  supportHref,
}: {
  initial: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof readPaymentReceipt>>;
  labels: typeof paymentCopy;
  libraryHref: string;
  retryHref: string;
  settingsHref: string;
  supportHref: string;
}) {
  const { order, refresh, pending, error } = usePaymentStatus(initial, labels.error);
  return (
    <section className="lms-profile-card lms-payment-card" aria-live="polite" data-reveal="true">
      <h2>{labels.states[order.status]}</h2>
      <p>{order.title}</p>
      <strong className="lms-payment-amount numeral">
        {order.amount} {labels.currency}
      </strong>
      <p>{paymentStatusHint(order, labels)}</p>
      {order.accessRevoked ? <Link className="lms-text-link" href={supportHref}>{labels.support}</Link> : order.status === "paid" && order.enrolled ? (
        <Link className="btn-primary" href={libraryHref}>
          {labels.course}
        </Link>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Action kind="button" type="button" className="btn-primary" disabled={pending} onClick={refresh}>
            {pending ? labels.checking : labels.refresh}
          </Action>
          <Link className="lms-payment-back" href={order.status === "paid" ? settingsHref : retryHref}>
            {order.status === "paid" ? labels.settings : labels.retry}
          </Link>
        </>
      )}
      {error && (
        <p className="lms-error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  collaboration = false,
}: {

}) {

      className={
        collaboration
          ? "p-ref-collab-actions-row personal-actions"
          : "p-ref-hero-actions personal-actions"

        <a
          key={action.href}
          href={action.href}
          className={`p-ref-btn personal-button p-ref-btn-${action.variant}`}

          }
        >
          {collaboration && (
            <PortfolioIcon name={action.icon} />
          )}
          <span>{action.label}</span>
          {!collaboration && <PortfolioIcon name={action.icon} />}
        </a>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/portfolio/header.tsx`

SHA-256: `49da93bf10c3143b2e3bfff9e4cc528a9668854c2f2d5496b4e19e4836bfa666`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useId } from "react";
import type { PortfolioContent } from "@platform/types/portfolio";
import { usePortfolioNavigation } from "@platform/hooks/portfolio/use-portfolio-navigation";
export default function PortfolioHeader({
  content,
  sectionIds,
  heroId,
}: {
  content: PortfolioContent["header"];
  sectionIds: readonly string[];
  heroId: string;
}) {
  const menuId = `${content.menuId}-${useId()}`;
  const { ref, toggleRef, open, active, close, toggle } =
    usePortfolioNavigation(sectionIds, heroId);
  return (
    <header className="p-ref-site-header personal-header" ref={ref}>
      <div className="p-ref-container p-ref-nav-container">
        <a
          className="p-ref-brand-logo"
          href={content.homeHref}
          aria-label={content.label}
        >
          <span className="p-ref-brand-name">{content.brand}</span>
        </a>
        <nav
          id={menuId}
          aria-label={content.navigationLabel}
          className={`p-ref-nav-menu ${open ? "p-ref-is-open" : ""}`}
        >
          {content.navigation.map((link) => {
            const current = link.href.startsWith("#") && active === link.href.slice(1);
            return (
            <a
              className={`p-ref-nav-link ${current ? "p-ref-is-active" : ""}`}
              key={link.href}
              href={link.href}
              aria-current={
                current ? "location" : undefined
              }
              onClick={close}
            >
              {link.label}
            </a>
          ); })}
        </nav>
        <div className="personal-header-actions">
          <a
            className="p-ref-btn p-ref-btn-primary p-ref-nav-cta"
            href={content.actionHref}
            onClick={close}
          >
            {content.action}
          </a>
          <button
            ref={toggleRef}
            className="p-ref-mobile-toggle personal-menu-toggle"
            type="button"
            aria-label={open ? content.closeLabel : content.openLabel}
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-controls={menuId}
            onClick={toggle}
          >
            <span />
            <span />
            <span />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import {materialPolicy} from "@platform/config/materials";
import {useState} from "react";
import Select from "@khatab/design/ui/select";
import {Checkbox} from "@khatab/design/ui/choice-controls";
import type {MaterialAssignment,CourseChoice,MaterialLabels} from "@platform/types/materials";
export default function MaterialAssignments({courses,value,onChange,labels}:{courses:CourseChoice[];value:MaterialAssignment[];onChange:(value:MaterialAssignment[])=>void;labels:MaterialLabels}) {
 const [slug,setSlug]=useState(value[0]?.courseSlug ?? courses[0]?.slug ?? ""),course=courses.find(course=>course.slug===slug);
 return <div className="lms-account-stack"><Select label={labels.course} value={slug} onValueChange={setSlug} options={courses.map(course=>({value:course.slug,label:course.title}))} />
  <fieldset className="lms-commerce-course-picker"><legend>{labels.assignments}</legend>{course?.lessons.map(lesson=>{
   const selected=value.some(item=>item.courseSlug===slug&&item.lessonId===lesson.id);
   return <Checkbox key={lesson.id} label={lesson.title} checked={selected} disabled={!selected&&value.length>=materialPolicy.assignmentsMax} onChange={()=>onChange(selected ? value.filter(item=>item.courseSlug!==slug||item.lessonId!==lesson.id) : [...value,{courseSlug:slug,lessonId:lesson.id}])} />;
  })}</fieldset><small>{labels.selected}: {value.length} / {materialPolicy.assignmentsMax}</small><p className="lms-field-hint">{labels.hint}</p>
 </div>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import {useState} from "react";
import FormField from "@platform/components/ui/form-field";
import TextareaField from "@platform/components/ui/textarea-field";
import Select from "@khatab/design/ui/select";
import SaveFeedback from "@platform/components/admin/save-feedback";
import {useAdminSave} from "@platform/hooks/use-admin-save";
import {endpoints} from "@platform/config/navigation";
import {materialPolicy as p} from "@platform/config/materials";
import {materialFormInput} from "@platform/features/resources/validate-material";
import type {AdminMaterial,MaterialLabels,CourseChoice} from "@platform/types/materials";
import MaterialAssignments from "./material-assignments";
export default function MaterialForm({initial,courses,labels,onClose}:{initial?:AdminMaterial;courses:CourseChoice[];labels:MaterialLabels;onClose:()=>void}) {
 const command=useAdminSave(endpoints.adminResources,labels.error),[assignments,setAssignments]=useState(initial?.assignments ?? []);
 return <form className="lms-profile-form lms-profile-card lms-material-form" onSubmit={event=>{event.preventDefault();void command.save(materialFormInput(new FormData(event.currentTarget),assignments)).then(saved=>{if(saved) onClose();});}}>
  {initial&&<input type="hidden" name="id" value={initial.id}/>}<input type="hidden" name="revision" value={initial?.revision ?? 0}/>
  <fieldset disabled={command.pending}><div className="lms-settings-name-grid"><FormField label={labels.name} name="title" defaultValue={initial?.title} required maxLength={p.titleMax}/><FormField label={labels.type} name="type" defaultValue={initial?.type} required maxLength={p.typeMax}/></div>
   <FormField label={labels.description} name="description" defaultValue={initial?.description} maxLength={p.descriptionMax}/>
   <Select label={labels.kind} name="kind" defaultValue={initial?.kind ?? "text"} options={p.kinds.map(value=>({value,label:labels[value]}))}/>
   <TextareaField label={labels.content} name="content" defaultValue={initial?.content} required maxLength={p.contentMax} rows={6}/>
   <MaterialAssignments courses={courses} value={assignments} onChange={setAssignments} labels={labels}/>
  </fieldset><SaveFeedback {...command} labels={labels}/><button type="button" className="lms-text-link" onClick={onClose} disabled={command.pending}>{labels.cancel}</button>
 </form>;
}
```

```tsx
 </div>;
```

```tsx
"use client";
import {useState} from "react";
import AdminDialog from "@platform/components/admin/admin-dialog";
import SaveFeedback from "@platform/components/admin/save-feedback";
import {useAdminSave} from "@platform/hooks/use-admin-save";
import {endpoints} from "@platform/config/navigation";
import {formatCourseDate} from "@platform/helpers/format-course-date";
import type {AdminMaterial,MaterialLabels} from "@platform/types/materials";
export default function MaterialRow({material,labels,onEdit}:{material:AdminMaterial;labels:MaterialLabels;onEdit:()=>void}) {
 const [removing,setRemoving]=useState(false),command=useAdminSave(endpoints.adminResources,labels.error);
 return <tr><td data-label={labels.name}>{material.title}</td><td data-label={labels.kind}>{labels[material.kind]}</td><td data-label={labels.assignments}>{material.assignments.length}</td><td data-label={labels.updated}>{formatCourseDate(material.updatedAt,"")}</td><td data-label={labels.edit}><div className="lms-admin-actions"><button type="button" className="lms-text-link" onClick={onEdit}>{labels.edit}</button><button type="button" className="lms-text-link" onClick={()=>setRemoving(true)}>{labels.remove}</button></div>
  {removing&&<AdminDialog title={labels.confirmRemove} closeLabel={labels.cancel} pending={command.pending} onClose={()=>setRemoving(false)}><form onSubmit={event=>{event.preventDefault();void command.save({operation:"delete",id:material.id,revision:material.revision}).then(saved=>{if(saved) setRemoving(false);});}}><p>{material.title}</p><SaveFeedback {...command} labels={{save:labels.remove,saving:labels.saving,saved:labels.saved}}/></form></AdminDialog>}
 </td></tr>;
}
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";

export default function EmptyState({
  title,
  description,
  href,
  label,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
} & ({ href: string; label: string } | { href?: never; label?: never })) {
  if (href !== undefined && (!href.trim() || !label?.trim()))
    throw new Error("Invalid empty-state action");
  return (

      <p>{description}</p>

        <Link href={href} className="btn-primary">

        </Link>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useId, type ComponentPropsWithRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
export interface FormFieldProps extends Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<"input">, "id"> {
  label: string; error?: string; hint?: string; control?: ReactNode;
}
export default function FormField({ label, error, hint, control, ...input }: FormFieldProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const descriptions = [error && `${id}-error`, hint && `${id}-hint`].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
  return (
    <div className="lms-form-field">
      <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
      <div className="lms-field-input-wrap" dir={input.dir} data-has-control={control ? true : undefined}>
        <input {...input} id={id} aria-invalid={Boolean(error)} aria-describedby={descriptions || undefined} />
        {control}
      </div>
      {hint && <small id={`${id}-hint`} className="lms-field-hint">{hint}</small>}
      {error && <p id={`${id}-error`} className="lms-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/ui/image-upload.tsx`

SHA-256: `c7437b86168881109f2659eedd599b720c7da1f0ef997fec71774eb85ac939df`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useId, useState, type ChangeEvent } from "react";
import { useHydrated } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-hydrated";
import { imageUploadPolicy } from "@platform/config/image-upload";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "@platform/hooks/use-async-command";
import { uploadImageFile } from "@platform/helpers/upload-image";
import type { ImageUploadLabels, ImageUploadTarget, UploadedImage } from "@platform/types/image-upload";
import FormFeedback from "@platform/components/account/form-feedback";
export default function ImageUpload({ target, labels, onUploaded }: { target: ImageUploadTarget; labels: ImageUploadLabels; onUploaded?: (image: UploadedImage) => void }) {
  const hydrated = useHydrated(), id = useId(), command = useAsyncCommand(labels.error), [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  async function change(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = event.currentTarget.files?.[0]; event.currentTarget.value = "";
    if (!file) return;
    setSaved(false);
    const image = await command.run(() => uploadImageFile(file, target, labels.error));
    if (image) { setSaved(true); onUploaded?.(image); }
  }
  return <div className="lms-image-upload" aria-busy={command.pending}>
    <span>{labels.title}</span><label className="lms-image-upload-trigger" htmlFor={id}>{command.pending ? labels.uploading : labels.choose}
      <input id={id} type="file" accept={imageUploadPolicy.accept} disabled={!hydrated || command.pending} onChange={change} aria-describedby={`${id}-hint`} />
    </label><small id={`${id}-hint`} className="lms-field-hint">{labels.hint}</small>
    <FormFeedback error={command.error} message={saved ? labels.saved : ""} />
  </div>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import FormField, { type FormFieldProps } from "./form-field";
export default function PasswordField({ showLabel, hideLabel, ...props }: Omit<FormFieldProps, "type" | "control"> & {
  showLabel: string; hideLabel: string;
}) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const action = visible ? hideLabel : showLabel;
  return <FormField {...props} type={visible ? "text" : "password"} control={
    <button className="lms-password-toggle" type="button" disabled={props.disabled}
      aria-label={`${action} ${props.label}`} aria-pressed={visible} onClick={() => setVisible((value) => !value)}>
      {action}
    </button>
  } />;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/ui/progress-bar.tsx`

SHA-256: `24d7a9156c2bc89339b678df5de94eb29fd109a1175be0b63d78491126fa2db7`

```tsx
import {completionPercent} from "@platform/helpers/completion-percent";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

export default function ProgressBar({
  percent,
  count,
  total,
  copy,
}: {
  percent: number;
  count: number;
  total: number;
} & { copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "progress" | "lessons"> }) {
  if (
    ![percent, count, total].every(Number.isFinite) ||
    !Number.isInteger(count) ||
    !Number.isInteger(total) ||
    percent !== completionPercent(count,total) ||
    total < 0 ||
    count < 0 ||
    count > total ||
    percent < 0 ||
    percent > 100
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid progress model");
  return (
    <div className="lms-progress">
      <div className="lms-progress-label">
        <span>{copy.progress}</span>
        <b className="numeral">{percent}%</b>
      </div>
      <progress max="100" value={percent} aria-label={copy.progress} />
      <small className="text-muted">
        {count} / {total} {copy.lessons}
      </small>
    </div>
  );
}
```
