```typescript
import { isValidUsername, normalizeUsername } from "../helpers/validation/username";
import { projectRoutes } from "../../config/project-navigation";
/** Public destinations are owned here; route filenames remain Next.js conventions. */
const learningBase = projectRoutes.learning === "/" ? "" : projectRoutes.learning;
const segment = (value: string) => {
  if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(value))
    throw new Error(`Invalid route segment: ${value}`);
  return value;
};
export const sectionIds = {
  courses: "courses",
  coaching: "coaching",
  instructor: "instructor",
  faq: "faq",
  steps: "how-it-works",
  enrollment: "course-enrollment",
  courseContent: "course-content",
} as const;
export const routes = {
  featured: (slug: string, kind: "course" | "bundle" = "course") => `/featured/${segment(slug)}${kind === "bundle" ? "?kind=bundle" : ""}`,
  bundles: "/bundles",
  bundle: (slug: string) => `/bundles/${segment(slug)}`,
  bundleCheckout: (slug: string) => `/checkout/${segment(slug)}?kind=bundle`,
  adminCommerce: (kind = "bundles") => `/admin/dashboard/commerce/${segment(kind)}`,
  payment: (id: string) => `/payments/${segment(id)}`,
  checkout: (slug: string) => `/checkout/${segment(slug)}`,
  home: projectRoutes.learning,
  portfolio: projectRoutes.portfolio,
  workshop: projectRoutes.workshop,
  courses: projectRoutes.courses,
  dashboard: `${learningBase}/dashboard`,
  login: `${learningBase}/login`,
  signup: `${learningBase}/signup`,
  forgotPassword: `${learningBase}/forgot-password`,
  confirmEmail: `${learningBase}/confirm-email`,
  resetPassword: `${learningBase}/reset-password`,
  purchases: `${learningBase}/dashboard/purchases`,
  library: `${learningBase}/dashboard/courses`,
  resources: `${learningBase}/dashboard/resources`,
  certificates: `${learningBase}/dashboard/certificates`,
  profile: `${learningBase}/dashboard/profile`,
  settings: `${learningBase}/dashboard/settings`,
  admin: "/admin/dashboard/courses",
  adminSales: "/admin/dashboard/sales",
  adminDashboard: "/admin/dashboard",
  adminProfile: "/admin/dashboard/profile",
  adminSettings: "/admin/dashboard/settings",
  adminUsers: "/admin/dashboard/users",
  liveSessions: "/dashboard/live-sessions",
  adminLiveSessions: "/admin/dashboard/live-sessions",
  adminResources: "/admin/dashboard/resources",
  adminTools: "/admin/dashboard/tools",
  adminCertificates: "/admin/dashboard/certificates",
  adminCertificate: (id:string) => `/admin/dashboard/certificates/${segment(id)}`,
  certificate: (slug:string) => `/dashboard/certificates/${segment(slug)}`,
  adminActivity: "/admin/dashboard/activity",
  adminPhoneConfirmations: "/admin/dashboard/phone-confirmations",
  adminUser: (username: string) => {
    if (!isValidUsername(username)) throw new Error("Invalid username route");
    return `/admin/dashboard/users/${normalizeUsername(username)}`;
  },
  adminBundleTemplate: (slug:string) => `/admin/dashboard/commerce/bundles/${segment(slug)}/template`,
  adminCourseCreate: "/admin/dashboard/courses/new",
  adminCourseTemplate: (slug: string) => `/admin/dashboard/courses/${segment(slug)}/template`,
  adminCourseContent: (slug: string) => `/admin/dashboard/courses/${segment(slug)}/content`,
  adminCourse: (slug: string) => `${routes.admin}/${segment(slug)}`,
  workshopPage: (slug: string) => `/workshops/${segment(slug)}`,
  course: (slug: string, _delivery?: "recorded" | "live") => { void _delivery; return `${learningBase}/courses/${segment(slug)}`; },
  lesson: (slug: string, id: string) =>
    `${learningBase}/learn/${segment(slug)}/${segment(id)}`,
  enrollment: (slug: string, delivery?: "recorded" | "live") =>
    `${routes.course(slug, delivery)}#${sectionIds.enrollment}`,
  section: (id: keyof typeof sectionIds) => `${projectRoutes.learning}#${sectionIds[id]}`,
  catalog: (query = "", category = "all") => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (query) params.set("q", query);
    if (category !== "all") params.set("category", category);
    return routes.courses + (params.size ? `?${params}` : "");
  },
};
export const endpoints = {
  certificates: "/api/certificates",
  adminCertificates: "/api/admin/certificates",
  certificatePreview: "/api/admin/certificates/preview",

  myLiveSessions: "/api/live-sessions",
  liveSessions: (slug:string) => `/api/courses/${segment(slug)}/live-sessions`,
  liveJoin: (slug:string,id:string) => `/api/courses/${segment(slug)}/live-sessions/${segment(id)}/join`,
  paymentQuote: "/api/payments/quote",

  paymentStatus: (id: string) => `/api/payments/${segment(id)}`,
  paymentReconcile: (id: string) => `${endpoints.paymentStatus(id)}/reconcile`,
  adminCourses: "/api/admin/courses",
  adminCourseDelete: (slug: string) => `${endpoints.adminCourse(slug)}/delete`,
  imageUpload: "/api/media/images",
  adminSales: "/api/admin/sales",

  adminUser: (id: string) => `/api/admin/users/${segment(id)}`,
  auth: { login: "/api/auth/login", signup: "/api/auth/signup", logout: "/api/auth/logout", session: "/api/auth/session" },
  adminCourse: (slug: string) => `/api/admin/courses/${segment(slug)}`,
  adminMediaStream: (slug: string, url: string) => `${endpoints.adminCourse(slug)}/media/stream?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`,
```

### File: `modules/features/account/handle-confirmation.ts`

SHA-256: `fb0e91bf2ad41f8015172185444f03b5989a4dc8bfc8858d89184d2fe5f553c6`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireAdmin } from "@platform/features/admin/identity";
import {validUuid} from "@platform/helpers/validation/uuid";
import { readUserContacts } from "./repositories/read-user-contacts";
export function handleConfirmation(request: Request, id: string) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    const { client } = await requireAdmin();
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    if (!validUuid(id)) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
    const input = await readJson(request);
    if (!input || input.field !== "phone" || typeof input.value !== "string") throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    const contact = await readUserContacts(id), value = contact.phone_e164;
    if (!value || input.value !== value) throw new ApiError(409, "CONTACT_CHANGED");
    const { error } = await client.rpc("confirm_account_contact", { p_user_id: id, p_field: input.field, p_value: value });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(error.code === "40001" ? 409 : 503, error.code === "40001" ? "CONTACT_CHANGED" : "INTERNAL_ERROR");
    return Response.json({ confirmed: true });
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/handle-email-confirmation.ts`

SHA-256: `bd94b14f198454ea072365bc19b32ab52356710a6d9c036937f17e59550d01ab`

```typescript
import { authPolicy } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { createDatabaseClient } from "@platform/lib/supabase/server";
import { isValidEmail } from "@platform/helpers/validation/email";
import { applicationOrigin } from "@platform/lib/application-origin";
export function handleEmailConfirmation(request: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const input = await readJson(request), client = await createDatabaseClient();
    if (typeof input?.email !== "string" || !isValidEmail(input.email, authPolicy.emailMax)) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    if (input.type !== undefined && input.type !== "signup" && input.type !== "email_change") throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    const pending = input.type === "email_change";
    if (pending) {
      const { data } = await client.auth.getUser();
      if (!data.user || data.user.new_email !== input.email) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const { error } = await client.auth.resend({ type: pending ? "email_change" : "signup", email: input.email, options: { emailRedirectTo: `${applicationOrigin()}/api/auth/callback` } });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(error.status === 429 ? 429 : 503, error.status === 429 ? "RATE_LIMITED" : "AUTH_FAILED");
    return Response.json({ sent: true });
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/handle-password.ts`

SHA-256: `4b8bb31ae9ce5b2fe895770e9df4a7914abf2f0b9f25f578140e67849b8e24a7`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { verifyCurrentPassword } from "./helpers/verify-password";
import { authPolicy } from "@platform/config/auth";
export function handlePassword(request: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const { client, user } = await requireIdentity(), input = await readJson(request);
    if (typeof input?.password !== "string" || input.password.length < authPolicy.passwordMin || input.password.length > authPolicy.passwordMax || input.password !== input.confirmPassword || input.password === input.currentPassword) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    await verifyCurrentPassword(user.email ?? "", typeof input.currentPassword === "string" ? input.currentPassword : "", user.id);
    const { error } = await client.auth.updateUser({ password: input.password, current_password: typeof input.currentPassword === "string" ? input.currentPassword : undefined });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(error.status === 429 ? 429 : 400, error.status === 429 ? "RATE_LIMITED" : "AUTH_FAILED");
    return Response.json({ saved: true });
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/handle-recovery.ts`

SHA-256: `74215dffcda9e59c1f11a54f203f66a5491ee05c707beb5a577e727ad9e3bfd3`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { createDatabaseClient } from "@platform/lib/supabase/server";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { isValidEmail } from "@platform/helpers/validation/email";
import { authPolicy } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { applicationOrigin } from "@platform/lib/application-origin";
import { consumeRecovery } from "./repositories/recovery-grant";
export function handleRecovery(request: Request, mode: "request" | "reset") {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const input = await readJson(request);
    if (mode === "request") {
      if (typeof input?.email !== "string" || !isValidEmail(input.email, authPolicy.emailMax)) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
      const client = await createDatabaseClient();
      const { error } = await client.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(input.email, { redirectTo: `${applicationOrigin()}/api/auth/callback` });
      if (error) throw new ApiError(error.status === 429 ? 429 : 503, error.status === 429 ? "RATE_LIMITED" : "AUTH_FAILED");
      return Response.json({ sent: true });
    }
    const { client, user } = await requireIdentity();
    if (typeof input?.password !== "string" || input.password.length < authPolicy.passwordMin || input.password.length > authPolicy.passwordMax || input.password !== input.confirmPassword) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    await consumeRecovery(client, user.id);
    const { error } = await client.auth.updateUser({ password: input.password });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(400, "AUTH_FAILED");
    await client.auth.signOut({ scope: "global" });
    return Response.json({ saved: true });
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/handle-settings.ts`

SHA-256: `e3d19a832a881865d19ff011641cc02bb71e18ccd4ffc61955bc799a959f5e59`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { validateSettings } from "./helpers/validate-settings";
import { readAccount } from "./repositories/read-account";
import { saveSettings } from "./repositories/save-settings";
export function handleSettings(request?: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!request) return Response.json(await readAccount());
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const input = validateSettings(await readJson(request));
    if (!input) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    return Response.json(await saveSettings(input));
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/helpers/phone-number.ts`

SHA-256: `076acd19dba46c3526bfb229f91193118a11c0f96590ec67fb3b7895009a7ea6`

```typescript
import { parsePhoneNumberFromString } from "libphonenumber-js/max";
/** Accept only the requested +country-national format, with real numbering-plan validation. */
export function readPhoneNumber(value: unknown) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^\+[1-9]\d{0,2}-\d{4,14}$/.test(value)) return null;
  const phone = parsePhoneNumberFromString(value.replace("-", ""));
  if (!phone?.isValid() || value !== `+${phone.countryCallingCode}-${phone.nationalNumber}`) return null;
  return { e164: phone.number, display: value };
}
export function displayPhoneNumber(value: string | null) {
  const phone = value ? parsePhoneNumberFromString(value) : undefined;
  return phone ? `+${phone.countryCallingCode}-${phone.nationalNumber}` : "";
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/helpers/read-account-response.ts`

SHA-256: `f087c927a2c72a0f5425ca8e70449730e6b2da1a804d8316e13e85dacd9f2730`

```typescript
import type { AccountProfile } from "@platform/types/account";
export function readAccountResponse(input: unknown): AccountProfile {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") throw new Error("Invalid account response");
  const v = input as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!["id", "name", "username", "firstName", "lastName", "email", "phone"].every(key => typeof v[key] === "string") ||
    !["admin", "emailVerified", "phoneVerified"].every(key => typeof v[key] === "boolean") ||
    !(v.pendingEmail === null || typeof v.pendingEmail === "string") || !(v.avatarUrl === null || typeof v.avatarUrl === "string")) throw new Error("Invalid account response");
  return v as unknown as AccountProfile;
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/helpers/validate-settings.ts`

SHA-256: `98b833c20a329fd387c5f76ebfc508bafdf4768a189b861f8f69e3d2db06187a`

```typescript
import { authPolicy } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { isValidUsername, normalizeUsername } from "@platform/helpers/validation/username";
import { isValidEmail } from "@platform/helpers/validation/email";
import { readPhoneNumber } from "./phone-number";
import type { AccountSettingsInput } from "@platform/types/account";
export function validateSettings(input: unknown): AccountSettingsInput | null {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") return null;
  const v = input as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!["firstName", "lastName", "email", "phone"].every(key => typeof v[key] === "string")) return null;
  const firstName = (v.firstName as string).trim(), lastName = (v.lastName as string).trim();
  if (!firstName || `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim().length < authPolicy.nameMin || `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim().length > authPolicy.nameMax || /[\r\n\t]/.test(firstName + lastName)) return null;
  if (!isValidUsername(v.username) || !isValidEmail(v.email as string, authPolicy.emailMax) || !readPhoneNumber(v.phone)) return null;
  if (v.currentPassword !== undefined && (typeof v.currentPassword !== "string" || v.currentPassword.length > authPolicy.passwordMax)) return null;
  return { firstName, lastName, username: normalizeUsername(v.username), email: (v.email as string).trim().toLowerCase(), phone: v.phone as string, currentPassword: v.currentPassword as string ?? "" };
}
```

SHA-256: `5e988cdf1a02847ef9526be4afa7858d4058a063e55e7fdc11346d84d79e9a71`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { supabaseEnvironment } from "@platform/lib/supabase/environment";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
/** Reauthentication uses an isolated client and never replaces the active browser session. */
export async function verifyCurrentPassword(email: string, password: string, userId: string) {
  if (!password || password.length > 128) throw new ApiError(400, "CURRENT_PASSWORD_REQUIRED");
  const { url, key } = supabaseEnvironment();
  const client = createClient(url, key, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });
  const { data, error } = await client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
  if (error || data.user?.id !== userId) throw new ApiError(error?.status === 429 ? 429 : 400, error?.status === 429 ? "RATE_LIMITED" : "CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID");
  const signout = await client.auth.signOut({ scope: "local" });
  if (signout.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";

import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { displayPhoneNumber } from "../helpers/phone-number";
import type { AccountProfile } from "@platform/types/account";
export async function readAccount(): Promise<AccountProfile> {
  const { client, user } = await requireIdentity();
  const [profile, contact, admin] = await Promise.all([
    client.from("profiles").select("*").eq("id", user.id).single(),
    client.from("account_contacts").select("*").eq("user_id", user.id).single(), hasAdminAccess(),
  ]);
  if (profile.error || contact.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  const p = profile.data, c = contact.data;
  return { id: user.id, name: p.name, username: p.username, firstName: p.first_name, lastName: p.last_name,
    email: c.email, pendingEmail: c.pending_email, phone: displayPhoneNumber(c.phone_e164),
    avatarUrl: p.avatar_url?.startsWith("https://") ? p.avatar_url : null, admin,
    emailVerified: Boolean(c.email_verified_at && !c.pending_email && user.email_confirmed_at && !user.new_email), phoneVerified: Boolean(c.phone_e164 && c.phone_verified_at) };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/repositories/read-phone-confirmations.ts`

SHA-256: `eb0c64aaace2cf62654b3a49d8ea01ddf996c45a8ab28833609d5eb2c7073209`

```typescript
import {readDatabasePage} from "@platform/lib/supabase/read-page";
import "server-only";
import { requireAdmin } from "@platform/features/admin/identity";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { phoneConfirmationConfig } from "@platform/config/phone-confirmations";
export async function readPhoneConfirmations(page: number) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const client = createAuthAdministrator(), start = (page - 1) * phoneConfirmationConfig.pageSize;
  const query = client.from("account_contacts").select("user_id,email,phone_e164,updated_at", { count: "exact" })
    .is("phone_verified_at", null).not("phone_e164", "is", null).order("updated_at").order("user_id")
    .range(start, start + phoneConfirmationConfig.pageSize - 1);
  const {data,count}=await readDatabasePage(query);
  if (!data?.length) return { requests: [], total: count };
  const profiles = await client.from("profiles").select("id,name,username").in("id", data.map(row => row.user_id));
  if (profiles.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  const byId = new Map(profiles.data.map(profile => [profile.id, profile]));
  return { total: count, requests: data.flatMap(row => {
    const profile = byId.get(row.user_id);
    return profile && row.phone_e164 ? [{ ...row, phone_e164: row.phone_e164, name: profile.name, username: profile.username }] : [];
  }) };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/repositories/recovery-grant.ts`

SHA-256: `8b8f64634d9d51e72d298bc8ef998a2448ad17cf0ee60654307f72ea2f8313b6`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import type { DatabaseClient } from "@platform/types/database-client";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function recoverySession(client: DatabaseClient) {
  const { data, error } = await client.auth.getClaims();
  const id = data?.claims.session_id;
  if (error || typeof id !== "string") throw new ApiError(403, "RECOVERY_EXPIRED");
  return id;
}
export async function authorizeRecovery(client: DatabaseClient, userId: string) {
  const sessionId = await recoverySession(client);
  const { error } = await createAuthAdministrator().from("account_recovery_grants").upsert({ user_id: userId, session_id: sessionId, expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() });
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
}
export async function consumeRecovery(client: DatabaseClient, userId: string) {
  const sessionId = await recoverySession(client);
  const { data, error } = await createAuthAdministrator().from("account_recovery_grants").delete().eq("user_id", userId).eq("session_id", sessionId).gt("expires_at", new Date().toISOString()).select("user_id").maybeSingle();
  if (error || !data) throw new ApiError(403, "RECOVERY_EXPIRED");
}
export async function hasRecoveryGrant(client: DatabaseClient, userId: string) {
  const sessionId = await recoverySession(client);
  const { data, error } = await createAuthAdministrator().from("account_recovery_grants").select("user_id").eq("user_id", userId).eq("session_id", sessionId).gt("expires_at", new Date().toISOString()).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return Boolean(data);
}
```

SHA-256: `e93e6071b28f9126c01961eea30f2143b81a155f68ed9b29e4b581fbb1449fef`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { applicationOrigin } from "@platform/lib/application-origin";
import { readAccount } from "./read-account";
import { verifyCurrentPassword } from "../helpers/verify-password";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readPhoneNumber } from "../helpers/phone-number";
import type { AccountSettingsInput } from "@platform/types/account";
export async function saveSettings(input: AccountSettingsInput) {
  const account = await readAccount(), client = createAuthAdministrator();
  if (input.email !== (account.pendingEmail ?? account.email) && !account.admin) throw new ApiError(403, "EMAIL_LOCKED");
  const emailChanged = input.email !== (account.pendingEmail ?? account.email), phoneChanged = input.phone !== account.phone;
  if (emailChanged || phoneChanged) await verifyCurrentPassword(account.email, input.currentPassword, account.id);
  if (emailChanged) {
    const { client: session } = await requireIdentity();
    const { error } = await session.auth.updateUser({ email: input.email }, { emailRedirectTo: `${applicationOrigin()}/api/auth/callback` });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(error.status === 429 ? 429 : 400, error.status === 429 ? "RATE_LIMITED" : "AUTH_FAILED");
  }
  const { error } = await client.rpc("save_account_settings", {
    p_user_id: account.id, p_first_name: input.firstName, p_last_name: input.lastName,
    p_username: input.username, p_phone: readPhoneNumber(input.phone)!.e164,
  });
  if (error) throw new ApiError(error.code === "23505" ? 409 : 503, error.code === "23505" ? "USERNAME_TAKEN" : "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return readAccount();
}
```

```typescript
export function periodChange(current: number, previous: number) {
  if (previous === 0) return { direction: current === 0 ? "flat" : "new", percent: null } as const;
  const difference = current - previous;
  return { direction: difference === 0 ? "flat" : difference > 0 ? "up" : "down", percent: Math.abs(difference / previous * 100) } as const;
}
```

```typescript
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { analyticsConfig } from "@platform/config/admin-analytics";
import type { AdminAnalytics } from "@platform/types/admin-analytics";
import { objectRecord, isCount, isTimestamp, isDay, isCourse, isSource } from "./validate-records";
export function readAnalyticsSnapshot(value: unknown): AdminAnalytics {
  const r = objectRecord(value), metrics = objectRecord(r?.metrics), courses = objectRecord(r?.courses);
  if (r && metrics && courses && [r.generatedAt, r.weekStart, r.monthStart].every(isTimestamp) && r.timezone === analyticsConfig.timezone
    && analyticsConfig.metrics.every(key => isCount(metrics[key]))
    && Array.isArray(r.daily) && r.daily.length <= 31 && r.daily.every(isDay)
    && analyticsConfig.periods.every(key => Array.isArray(courses[key]) && courses[key].length <= analyticsConfig.trendLimit && courses[key].every(isCourse))
    && Array.isArray(r.sources) && r.sources.every(isSource)) return r as unknown as AdminAnalytics;
  throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/analytics/helpers/validate-records.ts`

SHA-256: `09848fc08679766b99f18de72cf34c55dffba3aada21a94fb6aedf9825a06744`

```typescript
import { analyticsConfig } from "@platform/config/admin-analytics";
import type { AnalyticsDay, AnalyticsSource, TrendingCourse } from "@platform/types/admin-analytics";
export function objectRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  return value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as Record<string, unknown> : null;
}
export const isCount = (value: unknown): value is number => typeof value === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0;
export const isTimestamp = (value: unknown): value is string => typeof value === "string" && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value));
export function isDay(value: unknown): value is AnalyticsDay {
  const r = objectRecord(value);
  return Boolean(r && typeof r.day === "string" && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(r.day) && isTimestamp(r.day) && isCount(r.students) && isCount(r.enrollments)
    && (r.previousStudents === null || isCount(r.previousStudents)) && (r.previousEnrollments === null || isCount(r.previousEnrollments)));
}
export function isCourse(value: unknown): value is TrendingCourse {
  const r = objectRecord(value);
  return Boolean(r && typeof r.slug === "string" && /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(r.slug) && typeof r.title === "string"
    && (r.thumbnail === null || typeof r.thumbnail === "string") && ["recorded", "live"].includes(String(r.delivery))
    && typeof r.published === "boolean" && isCount(r.count) && isCount(r.previous));
}
export function isSource(value: unknown): value is AnalyticsSource {
  const r = objectRecord(value);
  return Boolean(r && analyticsConfig.sources.some(source => source === r.source) && isCount(r.count));
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { requireAdmin } from "../../identity";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import type { PaymentRevenue } from "@platform/types/admin-analytics";
import { readAnalyticsSnapshot } from "../helpers/read-snapshot";
export async function readAdminAnalytics() {
  const { client } = await requireAdmin();
  const [snapshot,revenue] = await Promise.all([client.rpc("admin_dashboard_snapshot"),client.rpc("payment_revenue_snapshot")]);
  if (snapshot.error || revenue.error) throw new ApiError(503,"INTERNAL_ERROR");
  const totals = revenue.data as unknown as PaymentRevenue;
  if (!totals || ![totals.week,totals.month,totals.previousWeek,totals.previousMonth].every(value => Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0)) throw new ApiError(503,"INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return {...readAnalyticsSnapshot(snapshot.data),revenue:totals};
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";

import { enrollmentPolicy } from "@platform/config/enrollment";
import type { EnrollmentChange, EnrollmentEvent } from "@platform/types/enrollment";
export async function manageEnrollment(userId: string, change: EnrollmentChange) {
 const {client} = await requireAdmin();
 const result = await client.rpc("manage_enrollment", {p_user:userId,p_slug:change.courseSlug,p_action:change.action,p_reason:change.reason,p_revision:change.revision});
 if (result.error) {
  const code = ["ENROLLMENT_CONFLICT","CONTACT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED","FORBIDDEN","NOT_FOUND","INVALID_INPUT"].find(code => result.error!.message.includes(code));
  throw new ApiError(code === "ENROLLMENT_CONFLICT" ? 409 : code === "NOT_FOUND" ? 404 : code === "FORBIDDEN" || code === "CONTACT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED" ? 403 : code ? 400 : 503,code ?? "INTERNAL_ERROR");
 }
 return {saved:true};
}
export async function readEnrollmentHistory(userId: string): Promise<EnrollmentEvent[]> {
 const {client} = await requireAdmin();
 const result = await client.from("enrollment_events").select("id,course_slug,action,reason,created_at,actor_id").eq("user_id",userId).order("created_at",{ascending:false}).order("id",{ascending:false}).limit(enrollmentPolicy.historyLimit);
 if(result.error) throw new ApiError(503,"INTERNAL_ERROR");
 const actors=await readActorNames(result.data.map(row=>row.actor_id));
 return result.data.map(row=>({...row,action:row.action as EnrollmentEvent["action"],actor:actors.get(row.actor_id??"")??""}));
```

```typescript
import { enrollmentPolicy } from "@platform/config/enrollment";
import { validRecordRevision } from "@platform/helpers/valid-record-revision";
import type { EnrollmentChange } from "@platform/types/enrollment";
export function validateEnrollment(value: unknown): EnrollmentChange | null {
 if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return null;
 const v = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 if (typeof v.courseSlug !== "string" || !/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(v.courseSlug) || v.courseSlug.length > 100
 || !enrollmentPolicy.actions.some(action => action === v.action) || typeof v.reason !== "string"
 || !v.reason.trim() || v.reason.length > enrollmentPolicy.reasonMax || !validRecordRevision(v.revision, false)) return null;
 return {courseSlug:v.courseSlug,action:v.action as EnrollmentChange["action"],reason:v.reason.trim(),revision:Number(v.revision)};
}
```

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { sameOrigin, readJson } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { requireAdmin } from "./identity";
export function handleCourseDelete(slug: string, request: Request) {
 return apiResponse(async () => {
  if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403,"FORBIDDEN");
  const { client } = await requireAdmin(), input = await readJson(request);
  if (input?.confirmSlug !== slug) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
  const { error } = await client.rpc("delete_admin_course", { p_slug: slug });
  if (error?.message.includes("certificates_course_slug_fkey")) throw new ApiError(409,"COURSE_HAS_CERTIFICATES");
  if (error?.code === "23503") throw new ApiError(409,"COURSE_HAS_COMMERCE");
  if (error?.message.includes("COURSE_HAS_PAYMENTS")) throw new ApiError(409,"COURSE_HAS_PAYMENTS");
  if (error) throw new ApiError(error.message.includes("COURSE_HAS_STUDENTS") ? 409 : error.code === "P0002" ? 404 : 503, error.message.includes("COURSE_HAS_STUDENTS") ? "COURSE_HAS_STUDENTS" : error.code === "P0002" ? "NOT_FOUND" : "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return Response.json({ deleted: true });
 });
}
```

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
```

```typescript
export async function handleAdminCourse(slug: string, request?: Request) {
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/handle-lesson.ts`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireAdmin } from "./identity";
import { readAdminCourses } from "./repositories/courses";
import { persistCurriculum } from "./repositories/persist-curriculum";
import { validMediaUrl } from "./helpers/validate-media-url";
export async function handleAdminLesson(slug: string, id: string, request: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    await requireAdmin();
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403,"FORBIDDEN");
    const body = await readJson(request);
    if (!validMediaUrl(body?.videoUrl) || !body.videoUrl) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
    const record = (await readAdminCourses(slug))[0];
    const lesson = record?.course.modules.flatMap(chapter => chapter.lessons).find(lesson => lesson.id === id);
    if (!record || !lesson) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
    await persistCurriculum(slug,record.revision,record.course.modules,{ id, video_url: body.videoUrl, preview: lesson.preview ?? false });
    return Response.json({ saved: true });
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { requireAdmin } from "./identity";
import { driveFileId } from "@platform/helpers/media/drive-file-id";
import { streamDrive } from "@platform/features/catalog/stream-drive";
import { adminCoursePolicy } from "@platform/config/admin";
export function handleAdminMediaStream(slug: string, request: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    const { client } = await requireAdmin();
    const url = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("url") ?? "";
    if (url.length > adminCoursePolicy.urlMax || !driveFileId(url)) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
    const course = await client.from("courses").select("slug").eq("slug",slug).maybeSingle();
    if (course.error) throw new ApiError(503,"INTERNAL_ERROR");
    if (!course.data) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
    return streamDrive(url, request);
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireAdmin } from "./identity";
import {validUuid} from "@platform/helpers/validation/uuid";
import {readModeration} from "./helpers/read-moderation";
import { moderateUser } from "./repositories/moderate-user";
import { readAdminUser } from "./repositories/users";
import { readUserSubscriptions } from "./repositories/user-subscriptions";
export async function handleAdminUser(id: string, request?: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    await requireAdmin();
    if (!validUuid(id)) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    if (!request) return Response.json({ user: await readAdminUser(id), subscriptions: await readUserSubscriptions(id) });
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const change = readModeration(await readJson(request));
    if (!change) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    return Response.json(await moderateUser(id, change));
  });
}
```

```typescript
import type { User } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import type { AdminUser } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import type { Database } from "@platform/types/database";
type Profile = Database["public"]["Tables"]["profiles"]["Row"];
export function adminUserRecord(user: User, profile: Profile | undefined, admin: boolean): AdminUser {
  const until = (user as User & { banned_until?: string }).banned_until ?? null;
  const avatar = profile?.avatar_url ?? user.user_metadata?.avatar_url;
  const name = profile?.name ?? user.user_metadata?.name;
  return { id: user.id, name: typeof name === "string" ? name : "—",
    username: profile?.username ?? `user-${user.id.replaceAll("-", "")}`, email: user.email ?? "—",
    avatarUrl: typeof avatar === "string" && /^https:\/\//.test(avatar) ? avatar : null,
    admin, confirmed: Boolean(user.email_confirmed_at), suspendedUntil: until,
    permanentlyBanned: Boolean(until && Date.parse(until) - Date.now() > 3650 * 86400000) };
}
```

```typescript
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
import type { CurriculumMutation } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { curriculumCourse } from "./curriculum-course";
import { mutateChapter } from "./mutate-chapter";
import { mutateSection } from "./mutate-section";
import { mutateLesson } from "./mutate-lesson";
import { curriculumPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/curriculum";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export function applyCurriculumMutation(current: Course, input: CurriculumMutation, id: string) {
  const course = curriculumCourse(structuredClone(current));
  const mutate = { chapter: mutateChapter, section: mutateSection, lesson: mutateLesson };
  mutate[input.kind](course,input,id);
  if (course.modules.length > policy.maxChapters || course.modules.some(chapter => (chapter.sections?.length ?? 0) > policy.maxSections) || course.modules.flatMap(chapter => chapter.lessons).length > policy.maxLessons) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
  return course;
}
```

```typescript
import type { CurriculumCourse } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export function curriculumChapter(course: CurriculumCourse, id?: string) {
  const chapter = course.modules.find(chapter => chapter.id === id);
  if (!chapter) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
  return chapter;
}
export function curriculumLesson(course: CurriculumCourse, id?: string) {
  const chapter = course.modules.find(chapter => chapter.lessons.some(lesson => lesson.id === id));
  const lesson = chapter?.lessons.find(lesson => lesson.id === id);
  if (!chapter || !lesson) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
  return { chapter, lesson };
}
export function curriculumSection(course: CurriculumCourse, id?: string, chapterId?: string) {
  const chapter = course.modules.find(chapter => (!chapterId || chapter.id === chapterId) && chapter.sections?.some(section => section.id === id));
  const section = chapter?.sections?.find(section => section.id === id);
  if (!chapter || !section) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
  return { chapter, section };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/mutate-chapter.ts`

SHA-256: `935558f5715fd18dc7ff0f85f8a533b647e2e52f8885925cabd2539c4d690920`

```typescript
import type { CurriculumCourse, CurriculumMutation } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { curriculumChapter } from "./curriculum-lookup";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export function mutateChapter(course: CurriculumCourse, input: CurriculumMutation, id: string) {
  if (input.operation === "create") { course.modules.push({ id, title: input.title!, lessons: [], sections: [] }); return; }
  const chapter = curriculumChapter(course,input.id);
  if (input.operation === "edit") { chapter.title = input.title!; return; }
  if (chapter.lessons.length || chapter.sections?.length) throw new ApiError(409,"CURRICULUM_NOT_EMPTY");
  course.modules = course.modules.filter(record => record.id !== chapter.id);
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/mutate-lesson.ts`

SHA-256: `029cadade1f3bcfb08175b2a824510599a24b74ff40b848896c904cd56ae2bfd`

```typescript
import { formatPlayerTime } from "@khatab/design/helpers/media/format-time";
import type { CurriculumCourse, CurriculumMutation } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { curriculumChapter, curriculumLesson } from "./curriculum-lookup";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export function mutateLesson(course: CurriculumCourse, input: CurriculumMutation, id: string) {
  const destination = curriculumChapter(course,input.chapterId);
  const section = input.sectionId ? destination.sections?.find(section => section.id === input.sectionId) : undefined;
  if (input.sectionId && !section) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
  const existing = input.operation === "create" ? undefined : curriculumLesson(course,input.id);
  const sectionPosition = section?.lessonIds.indexOf(input.id ?? "") ?? -1;
  const position = existing?.chapter.id === destination.id ? destination.lessons.findIndex(lesson => lesson.id === input.id) : -1;
  const lesson = existing?.lesson ?? { id, resourceIds: [], takeaway: [], videoUrl: "" };
  for (const chapter of course.modules) {
    chapter.lessons = chapter.lessons.filter(record => record.id !== lesson.id);
    chapter.sections?.forEach(section => { section.lessonIds = section.lessonIds.filter(id => id !== lesson.id); });
  }
  if (input.operation === "delete") return;
  const updated = {
    ...lesson,
    title: input.title!,
    description: input.description!,
    durationSeconds: input.durationSeconds!,
    duration: formatPlayerTime(input.durationSeconds!),
    preview: input.preview!,
    videoUrl: "",
  };
  if (position >= 0) destination.lessons.splice(position,0,updated); else destination.lessons.push(updated);
  if (sectionPosition >= 0) section?.lessonIds.splice(sectionPosition, 0, lesson.id);
  else section?.lessonIds.push(lesson.id);
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/mutate-section.ts`

SHA-256: `3d1fbcdd851a38c8c64c97e6987a2adf4a3bf10061ec5668dece7b641df011b6`

```typescript
import type { CurriculumCourse, CurriculumMutation } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { curriculumChapter, curriculumSection } from "./curriculum-lookup";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export function mutateSection(course: CurriculumCourse, input: CurriculumMutation, id: string) {
  const destination = curriculumChapter(course,input.chapterId);
  destination.sections ??= [];
  if (input.operation === "create") { destination.sections.push({ id, title: input.title!, lessonIds: [] }); return; }
  const { chapter, section } = curriculumSection(course,input.id,input.sourceChapterId ?? input.chapterId);
  if (input.operation === "delete") {
    if (section.lessonIds.length) throw new ApiError(409,"CURRICULUM_NOT_EMPTY");
    chapter.sections = chapter.sections!.filter(record => record.id !== section.id); return;
  }
  section.title = input.title!;
  if (chapter.id === destination.id) return;
  if (destination.sections.some(record => record.id === section.id)) throw new ApiError(409,"SECTION_ID_CONFLICT");
  const assigned = new Set(section.lessonIds);
  destination.lessons.push(...chapter.lessons.filter(lesson => assigned.has(lesson.id)));
  chapter.lessons = chapter.lessons.filter(lesson => !assigned.has(lesson.id));
  chapter.sections = chapter.sections!.filter(record => record.id !== section.id);
  destination.sections.push(section);
}
```

```typescript
export function readCourseQuery(params: URLSearchParams): AdminCourseQuery {
 const search = (params.get("q") ?? "").trim(), category = params.get("category") ?? "all", statuses = [...new Set(params.getAll("status"))];
 const delivery = params.get("delivery") ?? "all", sort = params.get("sort") ?? "created", direction = params.get("direction") ?? "desc";
 if (search.length > courseAdministration.searchMaxLength || !categories.some(value => value.id === category) || statuses.some(value => !courseStatuses.includes(value as "draft" | "published")) || !courseDeliveries.includes(delivery as AdminCourseQuery["delivery"]) || !courseSorts.includes(sort as AdminCourseQuery["sort"]) || !["asc", "desc"].includes(direction)) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
 return { search, category: category as AdminCourseQuery["category"], statuses: statuses as AdminCourseQuery["statuses"], delivery: delivery as AdminCourseQuery["delivery"], sort: sort as AdminCourseQuery["sort"], direction: direction as AdminCourseQuery["direction"], page: readAdminPage(params.get("page")) };
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/read-course-results.ts`

SHA-256: `9ec34993ec10d8d4b4a3c0f71c9ce36465e075e9fb5d0b6fcd5f7dc47ea0ca76`

```typescript
import { categories } from "@platform/config/catalog";
import type { AdminCourseResults } from "@platform/types/admin-courses";
export function readCourseResults(value: unknown): AdminCourseResults {
  const result = value as AdminCourseResults | null;
  if (!result || !Array.isArray(result.courses) || !Number.isSafeInteger(result.total) || result.total < 0 ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(result.page) || result.page < 1 || typeof result.hasNext !== "boolean") throw new Error("Invalid course results");
  for (const course of result.courses) {
    const validDates = course && [course.createdAt, course.updatedAt].every(date =>
      date === null || (typeof date === "string" && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(date))));
    if (!course || !validDates || typeof course.slug !== "string" || typeof course.title !== "string" ||
        typeof course.published !== "boolean" || !["live", "recorded"].includes(course.delivery) ||
        !categories.some(category => category.id !== "all" && category.id === course.category) ||
        ![course.students, course.lessons, course.chapters, course.sections].every(count => Number.isSafeInteger(count) && count >= 0))
      throw new Error("Invalid course result");
  }
  return result;
}
```

```typescript
import { suspensionPeriods } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export function readModeration(value: unknown): UserModeration | null {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || !("action" in value)) return null;
  if (value.action === "suspend" && "period" in value) {
    const period = suspensionPeriods.find(item => item.id === value.period);
    return period ? { action: "suspend", period: period.id } : null;
  }
  if (value.action === "ban" || value.action === "restore" || value.action === "remove" || value.action === "promote") return { action: value.action };
  return null;
}
```

```typescript
import { userAdministration, userStatusFilters, userSearchModes } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { AdminUserQuery } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readAdminPage } from "./read-admin-page";
export function readUserQuery(params: URLSearchParams): AdminUserQuery {
  const search = (params.get("q") ?? "").trim(), statuses = [...new Set(params.getAll("status"))];
  if (search.length > userAdministration.searchMaxLength || statuses.some(status => !userStatusFilters.includes(status as "suspended" | "banned"))
    || ["admins", "newcomers"].some(key => params.has(key) && params.get(key) !== "1")) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
  const searchMode = params.get("mode") ?? userSearchModes[0];
  if (!userSearchModes.includes(searchMode as AdminUserQuery["searchMode"])) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
  return { searchMode: searchMode as AdminUserQuery["searchMode"], page: readAdminPage(params.get("page")), search, statuses: statuses as AdminUserQuery["statuses"],
    adminsOnly: params.get("admins") === "1", newcomers: params.get("newcomers") === "1" };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/read-user-results.ts`

SHA-256: `fb5ef37a3264d30054c6d18d94ae9fe3169006517adac1642b636943d6c497de`

```typescript
import type { AdminUser, AdminUserPage } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
function isUser(value: unknown): value is AdminUser {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return false;
  const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  return ["id", "name", "username", "email"].every(key => typeof item[key] === "string")
    && ["admin", "confirmed", "permanentlyBanned"].every(key => typeof item[key] === "boolean")
    && ["avatarUrl", "suspendedUntil"].every(key => item[key] === null || typeof item[key] === "string");
}
export function readUserResults(value: unknown): AdminUserPage {
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    const result = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (Array.isArray(result.users) && result.users.every(isUser) && typeof result.page === "number" && Number.isInteger(result.page)
      && typeof result.hasNext === "boolean" && typeof result.total === "number" && Number.isInteger(result.total)) {
      return { users: result.users, page: result.page, hasNext: result.hasNext, total: result.total };
    }
  }
  throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/suspension-remaining.ts`

```typescript
export function suspensionRemaining(until: string, now: number) {
  const minutes = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((Date.parse(until) - now) / 60000));
  return { days: Math.floor(minutes / 1440), hours: Math.floor(minutes % 1440 / 60), minutes: minutes % 60, expired: minutes === 0 };
}
```

```typescript
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import type { AdminUserQuery } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export function userQueryUrl(query: AdminUserQuery, page = query.page) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page) });
  if (query.searchMode === "prefix") params.set("mode", "prefix");
  if (query.search) params.set("q", query.search);
  for (const status of query.statuses) params.append("status", status);
  if (query.adminsOnly) params.set("admins", "1");
  if (query.newcomers) params.set("newcomers", "1");
  return `${routes.adminUsers}?${params}`;
}
```

```typescript
export function validateCourseCreate(input: Record<string, unknown> | null): CreateCourseInput | null {

 const thumbnailUrl = input.thumbnailUrl === undefined ? "" : input.thumbnailUrl, introVideoUrl = input.introVideoUrl === undefined ? "" : input.introVideoUrl;
 if ((input.featured !== undefined && typeof input.featured !== "boolean") || (input.duration !== undefined && (typeof input.duration !== "string" || input.duration.length > policy.durationMax)) || !validMediaUrl(thumbnailUrl) || !validMediaUrl(introVideoUrl)) return null;
 return { featured: input.featured as boolean | undefined, duration: typeof input.duration === "string" ? input.duration.trim() : "", thumbnailUrl, introVideoUrl, slug: input.slug, title: input.title.trim(), description: input.description.trim(), amount: input.amount, category: input.category as CreateCourseInput["category"], delivery: input.delivery as CreateCourseInput["delivery"] };
```

```typescript
import { validCourseAmount } from "./course-price";

export function validateCourseEdit(input: Record<string, unknown> | null) {

    typeof input.description !== "string" || input.description.trim().length < policy.descriptionMin || input.description.length > policy.descriptionMax ||
    !validCourseAmount(input.amount) || (input.featured !== undefined && typeof input.featured !== "boolean") ||
    (input.duration !== undefined && (typeof input.duration !== "string" || input.duration.length > policy.durationMax)) ||
    !categories.some(category => category.id !== "all" && category.id === input.category) ||
    !validMediaUrl(input.thumbnailUrl) || !validMediaUrl(input.introVideoUrl) || typeof input.published !== "boolean") return null;

    ...(typeof input.duration === "string" ? { duration: input.duration.trim() } : {}),
```

SHA-256: `4088921c36a8713178a14ba12e1d8de9b2c011edf3610531604b2fde4fc40da2`

```typescript
import type { CurriculumMutation } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { curriculumPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/curriculum";
import { validMediaUrl } from "./validate-media-url";
const identifier = (value: unknown) => typeof value === "string" && /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(value) && value.length <= 100;
export function validateCurriculumMutation(body: Record<string,unknown> | null): CurriculumMutation | null {
  if (!body || !["chapter","section","lesson"].includes(String(body.kind)) || !["create","edit","delete"].includes(String(body.operation)) || !Number.isSafeInteger(body.revision) || Number(body.revision) < 0) return null;
  if (body.operation !== "create" && !identifier(body.id)) return null;
  if (body.kind !== "chapter" && !identifier(body.chapterId)) return null;
  if (body.sourceChapterId !== undefined && !identifier(body.sourceChapterId)) return null;
  if (body.sectionId !== undefined && body.sectionId !== "" && !identifier(body.sectionId)) return null;
  if (body.operation === "delete") return body as unknown as CurriculumMutation;
  if (typeof body.title !== "string" || body.title.trim().length < policy.titleMin || body.title.trim().length > policy.titleMax) return null;
  if (body.kind === "lesson" && (typeof body.description !== "string" || body.description.length > policy.descriptionMax || !Number.isSafeInteger(body.durationSeconds) || Number(body.durationSeconds) <= 0 || Number(body.durationSeconds) > policy.maxDurationSeconds || !body.videoUrl || !validMediaUrl(body.videoUrl) || typeof body.preview !== "boolean")) return null;
  return { ...body, title: body.title.trim() } as unknown as CurriculumMutation;
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/validate-media-url.ts`

SHA-256: `d09d3e0caf812769e0ba5b491baf708aa9a08e278149a5f570f3d038ccb4cc6a`

```typescript
import { adminCoursePolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/admin";
export function validMediaUrl(value: unknown): value is string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length > policy.urlMax) return false;
  if (!value) return true;
  if (/^\/assets\/[\w\-./]+$/.test(value)) return !value.split("/").includes("..");
  try { const url = new URL(value); return ["https:", "http:"].includes(url.protocol) && !url.username && !url.password; } catch { return false; }
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";
```

```typescript
import {ApiError} from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import {recordPolicy} from "@platform/config/records";
import {recordSearchPattern} from "@platform/helpers/read-record-query";
import type {RecordQuery} from "@platform/types/materials";
export async function readAdminActivity(query:RecordQuery) {
 const {client}=await requireAdmin(),start=(query.page-1)*recordPolicy.pageSize;
 let request=client.from("admin_activity").select("*",{count:"exact"}).order("created_at",{ascending:false}).order("id",{ascending:false}).range(start,start+recordPolicy.pageSize-1);
 if(query.search) request=request.ilike("target",recordSearchPattern(query.search));
 if(query.filter!=="all") request=request.eq("entity",query.filter);
 const result=await readDatabasePage(request);
 const ids=[...new Set(result.data.flatMap(row=>row.actor_id ? [row.actor_id] : []))];
 const profiles=ids.length ? await createAuthAdministrator().from("profiles").select("id,name,username").in("id",ids) : {data:[],error:null};
 if(profiles.error) throw new ApiError(503,"INTERNAL_ERROR");
 return {records:result.data.map(row=>({...row,actor:profiles.data?.find(profile=>profile.id===row.actor_id) ?? null})),total:result.count};
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/repositories/moderate-user.ts`

SHA-256: `6773f4112e683ef65708981160560aaee63e7f4c08f7de1b25c11ecff98d7037`

```typescript
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readAdminUser } from "./users";
import { suspensionPeriods, userAdministration } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export async function moderateUser(id: string, change: UserModeration) {
  const { client, user: actor } = await requireAdmin();
  const target = await readAdminUser(id);
  if (target.admin || actor.id === id) throw new ApiError(403, "PROTECTED_ADMIN");
  if (change.action === "promote") {
    const result = await client.rpc("promote_admin_user", { target_id: id });
    if (result.error) throw new ApiError(result.error.code === "22023" ? 400 : 503, "INVALID_INPUT");
  } else {
    const administrator = createAuthAdministrator();
    const result = change.action === "remove" ? await administrator.auth.admin.deleteUser(id)
      : await administrator.auth.admin.updateUserById(id, { ban_duration: change.action === "restore" ? "none"
        : `${change.action === "ban" ? userAdministration.permanentBanHours : (change.action === "suspend" ? suspensionPeriods.find(item => item.id === change.period)!.hours : 0)}h` });
    if (result.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  }
  return { saved: true };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/repositories/persist-curriculum.ts`

```typescript
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import type { CourseModule } from "@platform/types/lms";
import type { Json } from "@platform/types/database";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function persistCurriculum(slug: string, revision: number, modules: CourseModule[], lesson: { id: string; video_url: string; preview: boolean } | null, deletedId?: string) {
  const { client } = await requireAdmin();
  const { error } = await client.rpc("save_admin_curriculum", { p_slug: slug, p_revision: revision, p_modules: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(modules)) as Json, p_lesson: lesson, p_deleted_id: deletedId });
  if (!error) return;
  const code = ["COURSE_CONFLICT","NOT_FOUND","FORBIDDEN"].find(code => error.message.includes(code));
  throw new ApiError(code === "COURSE_CONFLICT" ? 409 : code === "NOT_FOUND" ? 404 : code === "FORBIDDEN" ? 403 : 503,code ?? "INTERNAL_ERROR");
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/repositories/save-course.ts`

SHA-256: `ec57cd27f1ff16ffbf2166d966189916065d337ba13326048733d3e1aea18f38`

```typescript
import { assertCourseContent } from "../helpers/assert-course-content";
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { readAdminCourses } from "./courses";
import { editCourseMetadata } from "../helpers/edit-course-metadata";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import type { Json } from "@platform/types/database";
import type { validateCourseEdit } from "../helpers/validate-course-edit";
export async function saveCourse(slug: string, values: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof validateCourseEdit>>) {
  const { client } = await requireAdmin();
  const current = (await readAdminCourses(slug))[0];
  if (!current) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  if (values.revision !== undefined && values.revision !== current.revision) throw new ApiError(409,"COURSE_CONFLICT");
  const { amount, published } = values;
  const course = editCourseMetadata(current.course,values);
  if (published && course.delivery === "live" && !course.duration.trim()) throw new ApiError(400, "COURSE_DURATION_REQUIRED");
  assertCourseContent(course,published);
  const { error, data } = await client.from("courses").update({ metadata: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(course)) as NonNullable<Json>, amount, published }).eq("slug",slug).eq("revision",current.revision).select("slug").maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (!data) throw new ApiError(409, "COURSE_CONFLICT");
  return { saved: true };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/repositories/save-curriculum.ts`

SHA-256: `52a096e50c2b93441cf71b5552bdfd86681462e587cd0a88bdabe280e1c521cd`

```typescript
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { readAdminCourses } from "./courses";
import { applyCurriculumMutation } from "../helpers/apply-curriculum-mutation";
import { assertCourseContent } from "../helpers/assert-course-content";
import type { CurriculumMutation } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { persistCurriculum } from "./persist-curriculum";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function saveCurriculum(slug: string, input: CurriculumMutation) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const current = (await readAdminCourses(slug))[0];
  if (!current) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
  if (current.revision !== input.revision) throw new ApiError(409,"COURSE_CONFLICT");
  const id = input.operation === "create" ? `${input.kind}-${randomUUID()}` : input.id!;
  const course = applyCurriculumMutation(current.course,input,id);
  assertCourseContent(course,current.published,"PUBLISHED_CURRICULUM_INCOMPLETE");
  const lesson = input.kind === "lesson" && input.operation !== "delete" ? { id, video_url: input.videoUrl!, preview: input.preview! } : null;
  await persistCurriculum(slug,input.revision,course.modules,lesson,input.kind === "lesson" && input.operation === "delete" ? id : undefined);
  return { saved: true, id };
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { isValidUsername, normalizeUsername } from "@platform/helpers/validation/username";
import {validUuid} from "@platform/helpers/validation/uuid";
import { readAdminUser } from "./users";
/** Resolve a public-facing handle only after authorization; mutations continue using immutable IDs. */
export async function resolveAdminUser(handle: string) {
  await requireAdmin();
  if (!isValidUsername(handle)) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  const { data, error } = await createAuthAdministrator().from("profiles")
    .select("id").eq("username", normalizeUsername(handle)).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (data) return readAdminUser(data.id);
  // Existing UUID bookmarks redirect to the stored username in the page.
  if (validUuid(handle)) return readAdminUser(handle);
  throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/repositories/user-subscriptions.ts`

SHA-256: `22f01e4411d08067890d124cf084007ff2496d865c31d70b3aed06e54434706b`

```typescript
import { courseProgress } from "@platform/features/learning/helpers/course-progress";
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { publicCourse } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers/public-course";
export async function readUserSubscriptions(id: string) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const client = createAuthAdministrator();
  const enrollments = await client.from("enrollments").select("course_slug,created_at,active,revision").eq("user_id", id).order("created_at", { ascending: false });
  if (enrollments.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (!enrollments.data.length) return [];
  const progress = await client.from("lesson_progress").select("course_slug,lesson_id").eq("user_id", id).eq("completed", true);
  if (progress.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  const completed = progress.data.map(row => `${row.course_slug}/${row.lesson_id}`);
  const courses = await client.from("courses").select("slug,metadata,amount").in("slug", enrollments.data.map(row => row.course_slug));
  if (courses.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return enrollments.data.flatMap(row => {
    const record = courses.data.find(course => course.slug === row.course_slug);
    if (!record) return [];
    const course = publicCourse(record.metadata, record.slug, record.amount);
    const { count, total, percent } = courseProgress(course, { completed });
    return [{ count, total, percent, slug: course.slug, title: course.title, delivery: course.delivery ?? "recorded" as const, enrolledAt: row.created_at, active: row.active, revision: row.revision }];
  });
}
```

```typescript
export async function readAdminUsers(query: AdminUserQuery) {

  const result = await client.rpc("search_admin_users", { p_page: query.page, p_limit: userAdministration.pageSize,
    p_search: query.search, p_search_mode: query.searchMode, p_statuses: query.statuses, p_admins_only: query.adminsOnly,
    ...(query.newcomers ? { p_new_since: new Date(Date.now() - userAdministration.newcomerDays * 86400000).toISOString() } : {}) });
```

```typescript
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { authCopy } from "@platform/data/auth";
import type { AuthMode } from "@platform/types/auth";
import { validateAuth } from "./helpers/validate";
import { authenticate } from "./server/authenticate";
export async function handleAuth(request: Request, mode: AuthMode) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const result = validateAuth(await readJson(request), mode);
    if (!result.valid) return Response.json({ error: authCopy.invalidRequest, fields: result.errors }, { status: 400 });
    return Response.json(await authenticate(result.values, mode));
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { readProfileResponse } from "@platform/helpers/read-profile-response";
export function readAuthResponse(input: unknown, failureLabel: string) {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object" || !("status" in input)) throw new Error(failureLabel);
  if (input.status === "confirmation_required") return { status: "confirmation_required" as const };
  if (input.status !== "authenticated" || !("profile" in input)) throw new Error(failureLabel);
  try { return { status: "authenticated" as const, profile: readProfileResponse(input.profile) }; }
  catch { throw new Error(failureLabel); }
}
```

```typescript
import type { AuthValues } from "@platform/types/auth";
export function readAuthValues(input: unknown): AuthValues {
  const source = input && typeof input === "object" && !Array.isArray(input) ? input as Record<string, unknown> : {};
  const text = (key: keyof AuthValues) => typeof source[key] === "string" ? source[key] : "";
  return { name: text("name").trim(), email: text("email").trim().toLowerCase(), password: text("password"), confirmPassword: text("confirmPassword") };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/auth/helpers/validate-field.ts`

SHA-256: `d5b9bf7c4bab9903a8bd15988453668e31c930a7e058e3ae7ac464d6c74fbb0c`

```typescript
import { authPolicy } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { isValidEmail } from "@platform/helpers/validation/email";
import type { AuthField, AuthIssue, AuthValues } from "@platform/types/auth";
export function validateAuthField(field: AuthField, value: AuthValues): AuthIssue | undefined {
  if (field === "name") {
    if (!value.name) return "nameRequired";
    if (value.name.length < authPolicy.nameMin || value.name.length > authPolicy.nameMax) return "nameLength";
  }
  if (field === "email") {
    if (!value.email) return "emailRequired";
    if (!isValidEmail(value.email, authPolicy.emailMax)) return "emailInvalid";
  }
  if (field === "password") {
    if (!value.password) return "passwordRequired";
    if (value.password.length < authPolicy.passwordMin || value.password.length > authPolicy.passwordMax) return "passwordLength";
  }
  if (field === "confirmPassword") {
    if (!value.confirmPassword) return "confirmationRequired";
    if (value.confirmPassword !== value.password) return "confirmationMismatch";
  }
}
```

### File: `modules/features/auth/helpers/validate.ts`

SHA-256: `d604f69a9bc2e7d86a2f2363bbee9578f06be39d5ffc58ebc35fa32965e8b57d`

```typescript
import { authFields } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { readAuthValues } from "./read-values";
import { validateAuthField } from "./validate-field";
import type { AuthErrors, AuthMode, AuthValidation } from "@platform/types/auth";
export function validateAuth(input: unknown, mode: AuthMode): AuthValidation {
  const values = readAuthValues(input), errors: AuthErrors = {};
  for (const field of authFields[mode]) {
    const issue = validateAuthField(field, values);
    if (issue) errors[field] = issue;
  }
  return Object.keys(errors).length ? { valid: false, errors } : { valid: true, values };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/auth/server/authenticate.ts`

SHA-256: `af50854daa5ec23d8db13e2e2d2366b366e894b74de5601802d1426f7e02162b`

```typescript
import { applicationOrigin } from "@platform/lib/application-origin";
import { createDatabaseClient } from "@platform/lib/supabase/server";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { ensureProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/repositories/ensure-profile";
import { readProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/repositories/read-profile";
import type { AuthMode, AuthValues } from "@platform/types/auth";
export async function authenticate(values: AuthValues, mode: AuthMode) {
  const client = await createDatabaseClient();
  const result = mode === "login"
    ? await client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: values.email, password: values.password })
    : await client.auth.signUp({ email: values.email, password: values.password, options: {
      data: { name: values.name }, emailRedirectTo: `${applicationOrigin()}/api/auth/callback`,
    } });
  if (result.error) {
    if (result.error.status === 429) throw new ApiError(429, "RATE_LIMITED");
    throw new ApiError(mode === "login" ? 401 : 400, mode === "login" ? "INVALID_CREDENTIALS" : "AUTH_FAILED");
  }
  if (!result.data.session || !result.data.user) return { status: "confirmation_required" as const };
  await ensureProfile(client, result.data.user);
  return { status: "authenticated" as const, profile: await readProfile(client, result.data.user) };
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { cache } from "react";
import { createDatabaseClient } from "@platform/lib/supabase/server";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export const currentIdentity = cache(async () => {
  const client = await createDatabaseClient();
  const { data, error } = await client.auth.getUser();
  if (error || !data.user) return null;
  const access = await client.rpc("account_access_allowed");

});

  return identity;
}
```

```typescript
import type { CourseModule } from "@platform/types/lms";
export function courseContentGroups(chapter: CourseModule, ungroupedLabel: string) {
  const lessonsById = new Map(chapter.lessons.map(lesson => [lesson.id, lesson]));
  const grouped = new Set(chapter.sections?.flatMap(section => section.lessonIds));
  const groups = (chapter.sections ?? []).map(section => ({
    id: section.id, sectionId: section.id as string | undefined, title: section.title,
    lessons: section.lessonIds.flatMap(id => {
      const lesson = lessonsById.get(id);
      return lesson ? [lesson] : [];
    }),
  }));
  const ungrouped = chapter.lessons.filter(lesson => !grouped.has(lesson.id));
  if (ungrouped.length) groups.push({ id: "ungrouped", sectionId: undefined, title: chapter.sections?.length ? ungroupedLabel : "", lessons: ungrouped });
  return groups;
}
```

SHA-256: `f79d2dfa7304e252b7d3d7de00dbc04d9218a5b4105fcdded63e36130f8c9625`

```typescript

export function formatCourseDuration(seconds: number) {
  const minutes = Math.round(seconds / 60),
    hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60),
    rest = minutes % 60;
  const arabic = (value: number) =>
    String(value).replace(/\d/g, (digit) => "٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩"[Number(digit)]);
  const hour =
    hours === 1 ? "ساعة" : hours === 2 ? "ساعتان" : `${arabic(hours)} ساعات`;
  const minute = `${arabic(rest || minutes)} ${(rest || minutes) >= 3 && (rest || minutes) <= 10 ? "دقائق" : "دقيقة"}`;
  return hours ? (rest ? `${hour} و${minute}` : hour) : minute;
}
```

```typescript

export function parseLessonTime(value: string) {
  if (!/^\d+:\d{2}$/.test(value))
    throw new Error(`Invalid lesson duration: ${value}`);
  const [minutes, seconds] = value.split(":").map(Number);
  if (seconds > 59) throw new Error(`Invalid lesson seconds: ${value}`);
  return minutes * 60 + seconds;
}
```

```typescript
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
import { validateCourse } from "./validate-course";
import { validateLessons } from "./validate-lessons";
import { courseDuration } from "./course-duration";
export function publicCourse(metadata: unknown, slug: string, amount: number, options: { draft?: boolean } = {}): Course {
  const course = metadata as Course;
  const result = { ...course, slug, offer: { ...course.offer, amount } };
  validateCourse(result, new Set(), options);
  validateLessons(result, result.modules.flatMap(section => section.lessons.flatMap(lesson => lesson.resourceIds)), options);
  return { ...result, duration: courseDuration(result), modules: result.modules.map(section => ({ ...section,
    lessons: section.lessons.map(lesson => ({ ...lesson, videoUrl: "" })),
  })) };
}
```

```typescript
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
import { courseLessons } from "./course-lessons";
export function selectPreview(
  catalog: readonly Course[],
  courseId: string,
  lessonIds: readonly string[],
) {
  const course = catalog.find((item) => item.slug === courseId);
  if (!course) return undefined;
  const lessons = courseLessons(course);
  return {
    course,
    lessons: lessonIds.flatMap((id) => {
      const lesson = lessons.find((item) => item.id === id);
      return lesson ? [lesson] : [];
    }),
  };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-course.ts`

SHA-256: `4ea89b411a26b0861ce023913d34d490d1a40903a57f7d06df4a39758c8bac37`

```typescript
import { artworkKinds, categories } from "@platform/config/catalog";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export function validateCourse(course: Course, slugs: Set<string>, { draft = false }: { draft?: boolean } = {}) {
  if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(course.slug) || slugs.has(course.slug) ||
      !course.title.trim() || (!draft && !course.modules.length && course.delivery !== "live") ||
      !categories.some((category) => category.id === course.category) ||
      !artworkKinds.includes(course.artwork) || !Number.isFinite(course.offer.amount) ||
      course.offer.amount < 0 || !course.offer.actionLabel.trim())
    throw new Error(`Invalid course: ${course.slug}`);
  if (!draft && course.delivery === "live" && (!course.deliveryLabel?.trim() || !course.duration.trim())) throw new Error(`Invalid live course: ${course.slug}`);
  if (!draft && course.modules.some((module) => !module.title.trim() || !module.lessons.length))
    throw new Error(`Empty published module: ${course.slug}`);
}
```

### File: `modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-lessons.ts`

SHA-256: `023fa76f410611de6696cf7e8542af23e6ca4fce8300f776bfeeb5e57b186896`

```typescript
import { validateSections } from "./validate-sections";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
import { courseLessons } from "./course-lessons";
export function validateLessons(course: Course, resourceIds: readonly string[], { draft = false }: { draft?: boolean } = {}) {
  validateSections(course);
  const ids = new Set<string>(), lessons = courseLessons(course);
  if (!draft && !lessons.length && course.delivery !== "live") throw new Error(`Empty published course: ${course.slug}`);
  for (const lesson of lessons) {
    if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(lesson.id) || !lesson.title.trim() ||
        ids.has(lesson.id) || !Number.isFinite(lesson.durationSeconds) || lesson.durationSeconds <= 0)
      throw new Error(`Invalid lesson: ${lesson.id}`);
    ids.add(lesson.id);
    if (lesson.resourceIds.some((id) => !resourceIds.includes(id)))
      throw new Error(`Unknown lesson resource: ${lesson.id}`);
  }
}
```

### File: `modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-sections.ts`

SHA-256: `8e35bd79601e6f4c8ef2182a34dc00d417d1cd94063e924a9276eb21cdbb93ca`

```typescript
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export function validateSections(course: Course) {
  for (const chapter of course.modules) {
    const ids = new Set<string>(), assigned = new Set<string>();
    const lessons = new Set(chapter.lessons.map(lesson => lesson.id));
    for (const section of chapter.sections ?? []) {
      if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(section.id) || !section.title.trim() || ids.has(section.id) ||
          new Set(section.lessonIds).size !== section.lessonIds.length ||
          section.lessonIds.some(id => !lessons.has(id) || assigned.has(id)))
        throw new Error(`Invalid course section: ${course.slug}`);
      ids.add(section.id);
      section.lessonIds.forEach(id => assigned.add(id));
    }
  }
}
```

### File: `modules/features/catalog/stream-drive.ts`

SHA-256: `9e5f95bdd49094123d13ee425eb855172cafa6cbf4796f519fcaf703cc0ffef6`

```typescript
import { fetchDrive } from "@platform/lib/security/drive-fetch";
import { validMediaRange } from "@platform/lib/security/media-range";
import "server-only";
import { driveFileId } from "@platform/helpers/media/drive-file-id";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function streamDrive(url: string, request: Request) {
  const id = driveFileId(url);
  if (!id) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
  const range = request.headers.get("range");
  if (range && !validMediaRange(range)) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
  const response = await fetchDrive(new URL(`https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=${id}&export=download&confirm=t`),
    range ? { Range: range } : {}, request.signal);
  if (!response.ok || !/^(video\/|application\/octet-stream)/i.test(response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "")) {
    void response.body?.cancel().catch(() => undefined); throw new ApiError(503,"MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE");
  }
  const headers = new Headers({ "Content-Type": response.headers.get("content-type") === "application/octet-stream" ? "video/mp4" : response.headers.get("content-type")!, "Cache-Control": "private, no-store" });
  for (const name of ["Content-Length","Content-Range","Accept-Ranges"]) { const value = response.headers.get(name); if (value) headers.set(name,value); }
  return new Response(response.body, { status: response.status, headers });
}
```

```typescript
import {requireIdentity} from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";

export async function readStudentCertificate(slug:string) {
 const {client,user}=await requireIdentity();
 const result=await client.from("certificates").select("*").eq("course_slug",slug).eq("user_id",user.id).maybeSingle();
 if(result.error) throw new ApiError(503,"INTERNAL_ERROR");
 if(!result.data) throw new ApiError(403,"CERTIFICATE_INELIGIBLE");
 if(result.data.status==="revoked") throw new ApiError(403,"CERTIFICATE_REVOKED");
 const [course,enrollment]=await Promise.all([client.from("courses").select("slug").eq("slug",slug).eq("published",true).maybeSingle(),client.from("enrollments").select("active").eq("user_id",user.id).eq("course_slug",slug).eq("active",true).maybeSingle()]);
 if(course.error||enrollment.error) throw new ApiError(503,"INTERNAL_ERROR");
 if(!course.data||!enrollment.data) throw new ApiError(403,"FORBIDDEN");
 return result.data;
}

export async function downloadCertificate(slug:string,inline=false) {
 const record=await readStudentCertificate(slug);return certificateResponse(certificateSvg(record),`${learningIdentity.exportPrefix}-${slug}`,inline);
```

```typescript
import {requireIdentity} from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import {requireAdmin} from "@platform/features/admin/identity";
import {apiResponse} from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import {ApiError} from "@platform/lib/api/error";

import {certificatePolicy} from "@platform/config/certificates";
import {listCertificates} from "./repository";
import {validateCertificate} from "./validate";

export function handleCertificates(request:Request,admin=false) {
 return apiResponse(async()=>{
  await (admin?requireAdmin():requireIdentity());
  if(request.method==="GET") return Response.json(await listCertificates(readRecordQuery(Object.fromEntries(new URL(request.url).searchParams),certificatePolicy.statuses),admin));
  if(!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403,"FORBIDDEN");
  const input=validateCertificate(await readJson(request),admin);if(!input) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
  return Response.json(await mutateCertificate(input,admin));
 });
}
```

```typescript
export async function mutateCertificate(input:CertificateAction,admin=false) {

 const result=input.operation==="issue" ? await client.rpc("issue_certificate",{p_slug:input.slug,...(input.username?{p_username:input.username}:{})}) : await client.rpc("moderate_certificate",{p_id:input.id,p_action:input.operation,p_revision:input.revision,p_reason:input.reason});

}
```

```typescript
 if(result.error) throw new ApiError(503,"INTERNAL_ERROR");const actors=await readActorNames(result.data.map(row=>row.actor_id));
```
