```typescript
import {validRecordRevision} from "@platform/helpers/valid-record-revision";
import {requireAdmin} from "@platform/features/admin/identity";
import {apiResponse} from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import {ApiError} from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import {readJson,sameOrigin} from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import {validateMaterial} from "./validate-material";
import {readRecordQuery} from "@platform/helpers/read-record-query";
import {materialPolicy} from "@platform/config/materials";
import {readAdminMaterials,mutateMaterial} from "./admin-repository";
export function handleAdminMaterial(request:Request) {
 return apiResponse(async()=>{
  await requireAdmin();
  if(request.method==="GET") return Response.json(await readAdminMaterials(readRecordQuery(Object.fromEntries(new URL(request.url).searchParams),materialPolicy.kinds)));
  if(!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403,"FORBIDDEN");
  const body=await readJson(request);
  if(body?.operation==="delete") {
   if(typeof body.id!=="string"||!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(body.id)||!validRecordRevision(body.revision)) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
   return Response.json(await mutateMaterial({id:body.id,revision:Number(body.revision)},true));
  }
  const input=validateMaterial(body);if(!input) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
  return Response.json(await mutateMaterial(input));
 });
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import type { Resource } from "@platform/types/lms";
/** Both queries use the learner session; RLS enforces enrollment and publication. */
export async function listLessonResources(slug: string, lessonId: string): Promise<Omit<Resource, "content">[]> {
  const { client } = await requireIdentity();
  const links = await client.from("lesson_resources").select("resource_id").eq("course_slug", slug).eq("lesson_id", lessonId);
  if (links.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (!links.data.length) return [];
  const result = await client.from("resources").select("id,title,description,type").in("id", links.data.map(link => link.resource_id)).order("title");
  if (result.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return result.data;
}
```

```typescript
export function validateMaterial(value:Record<string,unknown>|null):MaterialInput|null {
 if(!value || (value.id!==undefined&&!segment(value.id)) || !validRecordRevision(value.revision,Boolean(value.id)) || (!value.id&&value.revision!==0)) return null;

 if(kind==="link"&&!validMaterialLink(content)) return null;
 if(!Array.isArray(assignments)||assignments.length<1||assignments.length>p.assignmentsMax||!assignments.every(item=>item&&segment(item.courseSlug)&&segment(item.lessonId))) return null;
 if(new Set(assignments.map(item=>`${item.courseSlug}/${item.lessonId}`)).size!==assignments.length) return null;

}
```

```typescript
export function driveFileId(value: string) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.hostname !== "drive.google.com") return null;
    const id = url.pathname.match(/^\/file\/d\/([\w-]+)/)?.[1] ?? url.searchParams.get("id");
    return id && /^[\w-]{8,200}$/.test(id) ? id : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}
```

### File: `modules/helpers/media/probe-video-duration.ts`

SHA-256: `baef68b29b3d586004e48f78cc9a692e7aa47bdf144ee1d0a3af4cab9ac11b06`

```typescript
import { curriculumPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/curriculum";
export function probeVideoDuration(source: string, signal: AbortSignal, errorLabel: string): Promise<number> {
  return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
    const video = document.createElement("video");
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (seconds?: number) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true; clearTimeout(timeout);
      signal.removeEventListener("abort",abort); video.onloadedmetadata = null; video.onerror = null;
      video.removeAttribute("src"); video.load();
      if (seconds) resolve(seconds); else reject(new Error(errorLabel));
    };
    const abort = () => finish();
    const timeout = setTimeout(abort,policy.metadataTimeoutMs);
    video.onloadedmetadata = () => {
      const seconds = Math.ceil(video.duration);
      finish(Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0 && seconds <= policy.maxDurationSeconds ? seconds : undefined);
    };
    video.onerror = abort; signal.addEventListener("abort",abort,{once:true});
    if (signal.aborted) { abort(); return; }
    video.preload = "metadata"; video.src = source; video.load();
  });
}
```

```typescript
/** Highlight every literal match without adding or dropping source text. */
export function highlightText(body: string, emphasis: string) {
  if (!emphasis) return [{ text: body, highlighted: false }];
  return body.split(emphasis).flatMap((text, index) =>
    index ? [{ text: emphasis, highlighted: true }, { text, highlighted: false }]
      : [{ text, highlighted: false }]);
}
```

```typescript
  return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--personal-navigation-root-margin")
    .trim().split(/\s+/).map((value, index) => index % 2 === 0 && value.endsWith("%")
```

### File: `modules/helpers/portfolio/observe-active-section.ts`

SHA-256: `a952574e5f2fc81391ed9e4a1c34d730c4020d91d8d7eb2d5c3b5645454106dc`

```typescript
import { navigationRootMargin } from "./navigation-root-margin";
export function observeActiveSection(ids: readonly string[], onActive: (id: string) => void) {
  const visible = new Set<Element>();
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) visible.add(entry.target);
      else visible.delete(entry.target);
    });
    const current = [...visible].sort((a, b) => b.getBoundingClientRect().top - a.getBoundingClientRect().top)[0];
    onActive(current?.id ?? "");
  }, { rootMargin: navigationRootMargin() });
  ids.forEach((id) => {
    const section = document.getElementById(id);
    if (section) observer.observe(section);
  });
  return observer;
}
```

```typescript
export function updatePortfolioTimeline(root: HTMLElement, reduced: boolean) {
  const rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
  const threshold = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue("--personal-timeline-trigger"));
  const edge = innerHeight * threshold;
  root.style.setProperty("--personal-progress", String(reduced ? 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (edge - rect.top) / rect.height))));
  root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-timeline-item]").forEach((item) =>
    item.classList.toggle("is-active", reduced || item.getBoundingClientRect().top <= edge));
}
```

```typescript
import type { LearningState } from "@platform/types/lms";
import { validateProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/validation";
export function readLearningResponse(input: unknown): LearningState {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") throw new Error("Invalid learning response");
  const value = input as Record<string, unknown>;
  const profile = validateProfile(value.profile, { allowEmptyEmail: true });
  if (!profile || !Array.isArray(value.enrolled) || !Array.isArray(value.completed)
    || !value.enrolled.every((id): id is string => typeof id === "string")
    || !value.completed.every((id): id is string => typeof id === "string"))
    throw new Error("Invalid learning response");
  return { profile, enrolled: value.enrolled, completed: value.completed };
}
```

```typescript
import type { ImageUploadTarget } from "@platform/types/image-upload";
export async function uploadImageFile(file: File, target: ImageUploadTarget, failureLabel: string) {
  if (!file.size || file.size > imageUploadPolicy.maxBytes || !imageUploadPolicy.accept.split(",").includes(file.type)) throw new Error(failureLabel);
  const body = new FormData(); body.set("file", file); body.set("kind", target.kind);
  if (target.kind === "course") body.set("courseSlug", target.courseSlug);
  const response = await fetch(endpoints.imageUpload, { method: "POST", body }).catch(() => { throw new Error(failureLabel); });
  const value: unknown = await response.json().catch(() => { throw new Error(failureLabel); });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(value && typeof value === "object" && "error" in value && typeof value.error === "string" ? value.error : failureLabel);
  return readUploadedImage(value);
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect,useState } from "react";
import { liveSessionPolicy } from "@platform/config/live-sessions";
import { endpoints } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import type { LiveSession } from "@platform/types/live-sessions";
export function useScheduleClock(initial:{sessions:LiveSession[];serverNow:string},slug?:string) {
 const [sessions,setSessions]=useState(initial.sessions),[now,setNow]=useState(Date.parse(initial.serverNow));
 useEffect(()=>{
  let serverTime=Date.parse(initial.serverNow),base=performance.now(),running=true;
  let controller:AbortController|undefined;
  const tick=setInterval(()=>setNow(serverTime+performance.now()-base),liveSessionPolicy.tickMs);
  const refresh=async()=>{
   controller?.abort();controller=new AbortController();
   try{
    const response=await fetch(slug ? endpoints.liveSessions(slug) : endpoints.myLiveSessions,{cache:"no-store",signal:controller.signal});
    if(!response.ok) return;
    const data=await response.json();
    if(running&&Array.isArray(data.sessions)&&Number.isFinite(Date.parse(data.serverNow))){
     serverTime=Date.parse(data.serverNow);base=performance.now();
     setNow(serverTime);setSessions(data.sessions);
    }
   }catch{/* Keep the last schedule on temporary failure; the server still checks joining access. */}
  };
  void refresh();
  const poll=setInterval(()=>void refresh(),liveSessionPolicy.pollMs);
  const visible=()=>{if(document.visibilityState==="visible") void refresh();};
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",visible);
  return()=>{
   running=false;clearInterval(tick);clearInterval(poll);controller?.abort();
   document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange",visible);
  };
 },[initial.serverNow,slug]);
 return {sessions,now};
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { observeActiveSection } from "@platform/helpers/portfolio/observe-active-section";
export function useActiveSection(ids: readonly string[]) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    let observer: IntersectionObserver;
    const observe = () => {
      observer?.disconnect();
      observer = observeActiveSection(ids, setActive);
    };
    observe();
    addEventListener("resize", observe);
    return () => {
      observer?.disconnect();
      removeEventListener("resize", observe);
    };
  }, [ids]);
  return active;
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { createFrameScheduler } from "@khatab/design/helpers/browser/animation-frame";
import { updatePortfolioTimeline } from "@platform/helpers/portfolio/update-timeline";
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from "react";
/** One frame per scroll batch; mutate decorative geometry without React renders. */
export function useTimelineProgress(ref: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = ref.current;
    if (!root) return;
    const preference = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const update = () => updatePortfolioTimeline(root, preference.matches);
    const { schedule, dispose } = createFrameScheduler(update);
    update();
    addEventListener("scroll", schedule, { passive: true });
    addEventListener("resize", schedule);
    preference.addEventListener("change", schedule);
    return () => {
      dispose();
      removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
      removeEventListener("resize", schedule);
      preference.removeEventListener("change", schedule);
    };
  }, [ref]);
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { httpRequest } from "@platform/lib/http-request";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "./use-async-command";
export function useAdminSave(path: string, errorLabel: string, options: { refresh?: boolean } = {}) {
  const router = useRouter(), command = useAsyncCommand(errorLabel);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const save = async (body: unknown) => {
    setSaved(false);

  };
```

### File: `modules/hooks/use-async-command.ts`

SHA-256: `89a32f35eebc94733edbda382f9fba4e1bed7fb50c3cc66cf46f518527e40fba`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
/** Own pending/error and exclusion for the entire workflow, not each HTTP step. */
export function useAsyncCommand(failureLabel: string) {
  const inFlight = useRef(false);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  async function run<T>(command: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T | null> {
    if (inFlight.current) return null;
    inFlight.current = true;
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try { return await command(); }
    catch (error) {
      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : failureLabel);
      return null;
    } finally { inFlight.current = false; setPending(false); }
  }
  return { pending, error, run };
}
```

SHA-256: `30db054f61613bbb9e81ae8ebbdbbe30122611f1bfaa15d3ed87fba9d0305a04`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "./use-async-command";
import { httpRequest } from "@platform/lib/http-request";
import { authFields } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { validateAuth } from "@platform/features/auth/helpers/validate";
import { readAuthValues } from "@platform/features/auth/helpers/read-values";
import { validateAuthField } from "@platform/features/auth/helpers/validate-field";
import { readAuthResponse } from "@platform/features/auth/helpers/read-response";
import type { AuthErrors, AuthPageModel } from "@platform/types/auth";
export function useAuthForm({ mode, endpoint, redirectTo, copy }: Pick<AuthPageModel, "mode" | "endpoint" | "redirectTo" | "copy">) {
  const command = useAsyncCommand(copy.requestError);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<AuthErrors>({});
  const [edited, setEdited] = useState(false);
  const [confirmation, setConfirmation] = useState(false);
  function change(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    if (!(event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return;
    const field = authFields[mode].find((field) => field === (event.target as HTMLInputElement).name);
    if (field) setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: undefined }));
    setEdited(true);
    setConfirmation(false);
  }
  function blur(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    if (!(event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return;
    const field = authFields[mode].find((field) => field === (event.target as HTMLInputElement).name);
    if (!field) return;
    const issue = validateAuthField(field, readAuthValues(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(event.currentTarget))));
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: issue }));
  }
  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.currentTarget;
    const result = validateAuth(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form)), mode);
    setEdited(false);
    if (!result.valid) {
      setErrors(result.errors);
      const field = authFields[mode].find((field) => result.errors[field]);
      const input = field && form.elements.namedItem(field);
      if (input instanceof HTMLElement) input.focus();
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});
    const response = await command.run(() => httpRequest({ path: endpoint, body: result.values, failureLabel: copy.requestError, decode: (input) => readAuthResponse(input, copy.requestError) }));
    if (response?.status === "confirmation_required") { form.reset(); setConfirmation(true); }
    if (response?.status === "authenticated") { form.reset(); window.location.assign(redirectTo); }
  }
  return { submit, change, blur, errors, pending: command.pending, confirmation, error: edited ? "" : command.error };
}
```

```typescript
import { startCourse } from "@platform/features/learning/client/start-course";

export function useCourseEnrollment({ slug, firstLesson, enrolled, paid = false, errorLabel }: {
  slug: string; firstLesson?: string; enrolled: boolean; paid?: boolean; errorLabel: string;
}) {

}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect,useState } from "react";
/** Fixed campaign deadline; long delays are rescheduled within the browser timer limit. */
export function useDeadlineExpired(endsAt:string|null,initialSeconds:number) {
 const [expired,setExpired]=useState(Boolean(endsAt && initialSeconds<=0));
 useEffect(()=>{
  if(!endsAt) return;
  const deadline=Date.parse(endsAt);let timer:ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
  const schedule=()=>{const remaining=deadline-Date.now();if(remaining<=0){setExpired(true);return;}timer=setTimeout(schedule,Math.min(remaining,2_147_483_647));};
  schedule();return ()=>clearTimeout(timer);
 },[endsAt]);
 return expired;
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { persistencePolicy } from "@platform/config/persistence";
import { useCallback, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
export function useLessonNotes(key: string) {
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const subscribe = useCallback((notify: () => void) => {
    window.addEventListener("storage", notify);
    window.addEventListener(persistencePolicy.notesEvent, notify);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("storage", notify);
      window.removeEventListener(persistencePolicy.notesEvent, notify);
    };
  }, []);
  const snapshot = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(key) ?? "";
    } catch {
      return "";
    }
  }, [key]);
  const value = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, snapshot, () => "");
  function save(text: string) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, text);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(persistencePolicy.notesEvent));
      setFailed(false);
    } catch {
      setFailed(true);
    }
  }
  return { value, save, failed };
}
```

```typescript
    if (!paymentNeedsPolling(initial.status, initial.enrolled, initial.accessRevoked)) return;
    let stopped = false,
      attempts = 0,
      timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const poll = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(endpoints.paymentReconcile(initial.id), {
          method: "POST",
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (!response.ok) return;
        const next = (await response.json()) as Receipt;
        if (!stopped) setOrder(next);
        if (next.status === "paid" || next.status === "expired" || next.status === "failed") return;
      } catch {
        if (stopped) return;
      }
      if (!stopped && ++attempts < 6) timer = setTimeout(poll, 16000);
    };
    void poll();
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      controller.abort();
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [initial.id, initial.status, initial.enrolled, initial.accessRevoked]);
  return { order, refresh, pending: command.pending, error: command.error };
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "./use-async-command";
import { httpRequest } from "@platform/lib/http-request";
import { readProfileResponse } from "@platform/helpers/read-profile-response";
import { validateProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/validation";
import { endpoints, routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
export function useProfileSubmission(entry: boolean, errorLabel: string) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { run, pending, error } = useAsyncCommand(errorLabel);
  const [validationError, setValidationError] = useState("");
  const [emailChangePending, setEmailChangePending] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSaved(false);
    setValidationError("");
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const input = { name: form.get("name"), email: form.get("email"), ...(form.has("username") ? { username: form.get("username") } : {}) };
    if (!validateProfile(input)) {
      setValidationError(errorLabel);
      return;
    }
    const result = await run(() => httpRequest({ path: endpoints.profile,
      body: input,
      failureLabel: errorLabel, decode: input => ({ profile: readProfileResponse(input), emailChangePending: Boolean(input && typeof input === "object" && "emailChangePending" in input && input.emailChangePending) }) }));
    if (result) {
      setSaved(true);
      setEmailChangePending(result.emailChangePending);
      if (entry) router.push(routes.dashboard);
      router.refresh();
    }
  }
  return { submit, pending, error: validationError || error, saved, emailChangePending };
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useHistoryRestoration } from "@khatab/design/ui/history-boundary";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
/** Server layouts authorize initial rendering; client route changes and restored history are rechecked. */
export function useProtectedSession(pathname: string, endpoint: string, login: string) {
  const restoration = useHistoryRestoration();
  const [verifiedPath, setVerifiedPath] = useState<{ path: string; restoration: number } | null>(restoration ? null : { path: pathname, restoration });
  const lastPath = useRef(pathname);
  useEffect(() => {
    let controller: AbortController | undefined;
    const verify = async () => {
      controller?.abort();
      controller = new AbortController();
      const signal = controller.signal;
      setVerifiedPath(null);
      try {
        const response = await fetch(endpoint, { cache: "no-store", signal });
        if (!response.ok || (await response.json()).status !== "authenticated") {
          window.location.replace(login);
          return;
        }
        if (!signal.aborted) setVerifiedPath({ path: pathname, restoration });
      } catch {
        if (!signal.aborted) window.location.replace(login);
      }
    };
    const navigation = performance.getEntriesByType("navigation")[0] as PerformanceNavigationTiming | undefined;
    if (restoration || navigation?.type === "back_forward" || lastPath.current !== pathname) { lastPath.current = pathname; void verify(); }
    const restored = (event: PageTransitionEvent) => { if (event.persisted) void verify(); };
    const leaving = () => setVerifiedPath(null);
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", restored);
    window.addEventListener("pagehide", leaving);
    return () => {
      controller?.abort();
      window.removeEventListener("pageshow", restored);
      window.removeEventListener("pagehide", leaving);
    };
  }, [pathname, endpoint, login, restoration]);
  return verifiedPath?.path === pathname && verifiedPath.restoration === restoration;
}
```

```typescript
import { headers } from "next/headers";
import { auditEvent } from "@platform/lib/security/audit-event";
import { ApiError } from "./error";
import { backendCopy } from "@platform/data/backend-copy";
export async function apiResponse(action: () => Promise<Response>) {
  try {
    const response = await action();
    response.headers.set("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    const missing = error instanceof Error && error.message === "SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED";
    const status = error instanceof ApiError ? error.status : missing ? 503 : 500;
    const code = error instanceof ApiError ? error.code : missing ? "SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED" : "INTERNAL_ERROR";
    if (status >= 500 || code === "INVALID_PAYMENT_SIGNATURE" || code === "FORBIDDEN") {
      const requestId = (await headers()).get("x-request-id") ?? "unavailable";
      auditEvent(code, status, requestId);
    }
    const responseHeaders: Record<string, string> = { "Cache-Control": "private, no-store" };
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.retryAfter) responseHeaders["Retry-After"] = String(error.retryAfter);
    return Response.json({ error: backendCopy[code] ?? backendCopy.INTERNAL_ERROR, code }, { status, headers: responseHeaders });
  }
}
```

```typescript
export function applicationOrigin() {
  const value = process.env.APP_ORIGIN;
  if (!value) throw new Error("SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED");
  const url = new URL(value);
  if (!["http:", "https:"].includes(url.protocol) || url.pathname !== "/" || url.search || url.hash)

  return url.origin;
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { cloudinaryEnvironment } from "./environment";
import { imageUploadPolicy } from "@platform/config/image-upload";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function cloudinaryRequest(action: "upload" | "destroy", parameters: Record<string, string>, file?: File, fetcher = fetch) {
  const { cloudName, apiKey, secret } = cloudinaryEnvironment();
  const values = { ...parameters, timestamp: String(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)) };
  const signature = createHash("sha256").update(Object.entries(values).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${value}`).join("&") + secret).digest("hex");
  const body = new FormData();
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) body.set(key, value);
  body.set("signature", signature); body.set("api_key", apiKey);
  if (file) body.set("file", file, "image");
  const response = await fetcher(`https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${cloudName}/image/${action}`, { method: "POST", redirect: "error", body, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(imageUploadPolicy.timeoutMs) }).catch(() => { throw new ApiError(503, "IMAGE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE"); });
  const data: unknown = await response.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!response.ok || !data || typeof data !== "object") throw new ApiError(503, "IMAGE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE");
  return data as Record<string, unknown>;
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpError } from "./http-error";
export interface HttpRequestOptions<T> {
  path: string; body: unknown; failureLabel: string;
  decode: (input: unknown) => T;
  fetcher?: typeof fetch; signal?: AbortSignal;
}
export async function httpRequest<T>({ path, body, failureLabel, decode, fetcher = fetch, signal }: HttpRequestOptions<T>): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetcher(path, {
    method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body), signal,
  }).catch(() => { throw new Error(failureLabel); });
  const data: unknown = await response.json().catch(() => { throw new Error(failureLabel); });
  if (!response.ok) {
    const error = data && typeof data === "object" && "error" in data ? data.error : undefined;
    throw new HttpError(response.status, typeof error === "string" ? error : failureLabel);
  }
  return decode(data);
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/read-request-bytes.ts`

SHA-256: `aff37358d3026324b3bf00bf5f4456eb6c24f6cd0997346a3173c7e6f7a31fbb`

```typescript
import { securityPolicy } from "@platform/config/security";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readStream } from "./security/read-stream";
/** Size and time bounded even when Content-Length is absent or forged. */
export async function readRequestBytes(request: Request, maxBytes: number, timeoutMs: number = securityPolicy.bodyTimeoutMs): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
  if (!request.body) return null;
  const length = request.headers.get("content-length");
  if (length && (!/^\d+$/.test(length) || Number(length) > maxBytes)) throw new ApiError(413, "REQUEST_TOO_LARGE");
  const reader = request.body.getReader();
  const signal = AbortSignal.any([request.signal, AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs)]);
  try {
    const { chunks, length: size } = await readStream(reader, maxBytes, signal);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
    let offset = 0;
    for (const chunk of chunks) { bytes.set(chunk, offset); offset += chunk.length; }
    return bytes;
  } catch (error) {
    // Cancellation may itself stall; never await an untrusted source's cancel hook.
    void reader.cancel().catch(() => undefined);
    if (signal.aborted) throw new ApiError(408, "REQUEST_TIMEOUT");
    throw error;
  } finally { reader.releaseLock(); }
}
```

```typescript
/** Bounded, secret-free security records. Do not pass request bodies, identities, or exceptions. */
export function auditEvent(code: string, status: number, requestId: string) {
  // Sample repeated flood denials to keep logging from becoming a resource attack.
  if ((status === 429 || status === 413 || status === 403) && !requestId.endsWith("0")) return;
  console.warn(JSON.stringify({ event: "security", code, status, requestId }));
}
```

SHA-256: `1ee1893fc160cbf8b92a266f5779ade3c37428e19c7037d3bf90dc43a7c0f3c8`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { securityPolicy } from "@platform/config/security";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
function allowedDriveUrl(url: URL) {
  return url.protocol === "https:" && !url.username && !url.password && (!url.port || url.port === "443") &&
    (url.hostname === "drive.usercontent.google.com" || url.hostname.endsWith(".googleusercontent.com"));
}
/** Validate every redirect before fetching; the header deadline does not truncate video playback. */
export async function fetchDrive(url: URL, headers: HeadersInit, requestSignal: AbortSignal) {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const signal = AbortSignal.any([requestSignal, controller.signal]);
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), securityPolicy.upstreamHeadersTimeoutMs);
  try {
    for (let hop = 0; hop <= securityPolicy.maxRedirects; hop++) {
      if (!allowedDriveUrl(url)) throw new ApiError(503, "MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE");
      const response = await fetch(url, { headers, signal, cache: "no-store", redirect: "manual" });
      if (![301, 302, 303, 307, 308].includes(response.status)) return response;
      const location = response.headers.get("location");
      void response.body?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);
      if (!location) break;
      url = new URL(location, url);
    }
    throw new ApiError(503, "MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE");
  } catch { throw new ApiError(503, "MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE"); }
  finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}
```

```typescript
import { isTemplateEndpoint,templatePolicy } from "@platform/config/workshop-template";
import { sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { endpoints } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { imageUploadPolicy } from "@platform/config/image-upload";
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { securityPolicy } from "@platform/config/security";
import { requestPolicy } from "@platform/config/request";
import { backendCopy } from "@platform/data/backend-copy";
import { requestBudget } from "./request-budget";
import { auditEvent } from "./audit-event";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
function denial(code: string, status: number, requestId: string, retryAfter?: number) {
  auditEvent(code, status, requestId);
  const response = NextResponse.json({ error: backendCopy[code], code }, { status });
  response.headers.set("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
  response.headers.set("X-Request-Id", requestId);
  if (retryAfter) response.headers.set("Retry-After", String(retryAfter));
  return response;
}
export async function checkIngress(request: NextRequest, requestId: string) {
  const webhook = request.nextUrl.pathname === "/api/payments/fawaterak/webhook_json";
  if (!["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"].includes(request.method) && !webhook && !sameOrigin(request)) {
    return denial("FORBIDDEN", 403, requestId);
  }
  if (request.url.length > securityPolicy.maxUrlLength) return denial("INVALID_INPUT", 414, requestId);
  const length = request.headers.get("content-length");
  const max = request.nextUrl.pathname === endpoints.imageUpload ? imageUploadPolicy.maxRequestBytes : isTemplateEndpoint(request.nextUrl.pathname) ? templatePolicy.maxRequestBytes : requestPolicy.maxJsonBytes;
  if (length && (!/^\d+$/.test(length) || Number(length) > max)) return denial("REQUEST_TOO_LARGE", 413, requestId);
  try {
    const budget = await requestBudget(request);
    return budget.allowed ? null : denial("RATE_LIMITED", 429, requestId, budget.retryAfter);
  } catch (error) {
    return denial(error instanceof ApiError ? error.code : "SECURITY_UNAVAILABLE", 503, requestId);
  }
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/security/media-range.ts`

SHA-256: `1a54fefb0c274b441289f1c75ce3c877f2cadf0bab53c218e7a6ecce42f0f847`

```typescript
import { securityPolicy } from "@platform/config/security";
/** One valid byte range only: rejects empty ranges, reversed bounds, and unsafe integers. */
export function validMediaRange(range: string) {
  if (range.length > securityPolicy.maxRangeLength) return false;
  const match = /^bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)$/.exec(range);
  if (!match || (!match[1] && !match[2])) return false;
  const start = match[1] ? Number(match[1]) : null;
  const end = match[2] ? Number(match[2]) : null;
  if ((start !== null && !Number.isSafeInteger(start)) || (end !== null && !Number.isSafeInteger(end))) return false;
  if (start === null) return end !== null && end > 0;
  return end === null || end >= start;
}
```

```typescript
import { endpoints } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { securityPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/security";
export function ratePolicy(path: string, method: string) {
  if (!path.startsWith("/api/")) return { name: "page", ...policy.page };
  if (path === "/api/payments/fawaterak/webhook_json") return { name: "webhook", ...policy.webhook };
  if (method === "GET" || method === "HEAD") return { name: "api", ...policy.api };
  if (/\/auth\/(?:login|signup)$/.test(path)) return { name: "auth", ...policy.auth };
  if (/\/(?:auth\/forgot-password|account\/verification)/.test(path)) return { name: "email", ...policy.email };
  if (path === endpoints.imageUpload) return { name: "upload", ...policy.upload };
  return { name: "mutation", ...policy.mutation };
}
```

```typescript
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
/** A deadline covers the entire body, including stalled/chunked clients. */
export async function readStream(reader: ReadableStreamDefaultReader<Uint8Array>, maxBytes: number, signal: AbortSignal) {
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let length = 0;
  while (true) {
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    const result = await abortableRead(reader, signal);
    if (result.done) return { chunks, length };
    length += result.value.byteLength;
    if (length > maxBytes) throw new ApiError(413, "REQUEST_TOO_LARGE");
    chunks.push(result.value);
  }
}
function abortableRead(reader: ReadableStreamDefaultReader<Uint8Array>, signal: AbortSignal) {
  return new Promise<ReadableStreamReadResult<Uint8Array>>((resolve, reject) => {
    const abort = () => reject(new ApiError(408, "REQUEST_TIMEOUT"));
    signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
    reader.read().then(resolve, reject).finally(() => signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort));
    if (signal.aborted) abort();
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/security/request-budget.ts`

SHA-256: `d8f50f3fcc5cd8aa7fb98544bf256b285bb2653447d58c0ccdf8a5ed26e9d5b2`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { createHmac } from "node:crypto";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { securityPolicy } from "@platform/config/security";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { clientAddress } from "./client-address";
import { ratePolicy } from "./rate-policy";
/** Atomic database counters persist across serverless instances; raw IPs are never stored. */
export async function requestBudget(request: Request, userId?: string) {
  const policy = ratePolicy(new URL(request.url).pathname, request.method);
  const secret = process.env.SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!secret) throw new ApiError(503, "SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED");
  const bucket = createHmac("sha256", secret).update(`${policy.name}:${userId ? `user:${userId}` : `ip:${clientAddress(request.headers)}`}`).digest("hex");
  const result = await createAuthAdministrator().rpc("consume_request_budget", {
    p_bucket: bucket, p_limit: policy.limit, p_seconds: policy.seconds,
  }).abortSignal(AbortSignal.timeout(securityPolicy.budgetTimeoutMs));
  if (result.error || !result.data || typeof result.data !== "object" || Array.isArray(result.data)) {
    throw new ApiError(503, "SECURITY_UNAVAILABLE");
  }
  return { allowed: result.data.allowed === true, retryAfter: Number(result.data.retryAfter) || policy.seconds };
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/security/request-policy.ts`

SHA-256: `c5b74e26588e2be779756931457f63a9864221f81a0b5d7c6c4d19f601fa069d`

```typescript
import {endpoints} from "@platform/config/navigation";
import {certificateDocumentPolicy} from "@platform/config/certificates";
import {contentPolicy} from "./content-policy";
/** Proxy response headers are authoritative; scope embedded-font access to SVG endpoints. */
export function requestPolicy(request:Pick<Request,"method"|"url">,nonce:string) {
 const path=new URL(request.url).pathname;
 const document=request.method==="GET"&&[endpoints.certificates+"/",endpoints.adminCertificates+"/"].some(prefix=>path.startsWith(prefix)&&/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/i.test(path.slice(prefix.length)));
 return document?certificateDocumentPolicy:contentPolicy(nonce);
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/server-request.ts`

SHA-256: `1cf38e11aebd66a2ae8ed82a58e4d0b37df156b98df4fa497fc599a905b850f5`

```typescript
import { ApiError } from "./api/error";
import { readRequestBytes } from "./read-request-bytes";
import { requestPolicy } from "@platform/config/request";
export async function readJson(request: Request): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
  try {
    if (!/^application\/json(?:\s*;|$)/i.test(request.headers.get("content-type") ?? "")) return null;
    const bytes = await readRequestBytes(request, requestPolicy.maxJsonBytes);
    if (!bytes) return null;
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));
    return value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as Record<string, unknown> : null;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError) throw error;
    return null;
  }
}

export function sameOrigin(request: Request) {
  if (request.headers.get("sec-fetch-site") === "cross-site") return false;
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  if (!origin) return true; // Non-browser callers still require authentication/signatures.
  try {
    const expected = process.env.APP_ORIGIN ?? new URL(request.url).origin;
    return new URL(origin).origin === new URL(expected).origin;
  } catch { return false; }
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import type { Database } from "@platform/types/database";
import { supabaseEnvironment } from "./environment";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
/** Never exports the secret or shares a cookie-bound authenticated client. */
export function createAuthAdministrator() {
  const { url } = supabaseEnvironment();
  const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!key) throw new ApiError(503, "SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED");
  return createClient<Database>(url, key, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });
}
```

```typescript
  const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY;
```

### File: `modules/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`

SHA-256: `050e755cb2aab9d1092cb437af616c4cf53369749e677b75d1a6671571c7cff3`

```typescript
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { supabaseEnvironment } from "./environment";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || !process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY) return NextResponse.next();
  const { url, key } = supabaseEnvironment();
  let response = NextResponse.next({ request });
  const client = createServerClient(url, key, { cookies: {
    getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
    setAll(values, headers) {
      values.forEach(({ name, value }) => request.cookies.set(name, value));
      response = NextResponse.next({ request });
      values.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => response.cookies.set(name, value, options));
      Object.entries(headers).forEach(([name, value]) => response.headers.set(name, value));
    },
  } });
  const { data, error } = await client.auth.getClaims();
  if (request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith("/admin/") || request.nextUrl.pathname === routes.dashboard || request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(`${routes.dashboard}/`)) {
    if (error || !data?.claims) {
      const target = request.nextUrl.clone();
      target.pathname = routes.login;
      target.search = "";
      const denied = NextResponse.redirect(target);
      response.cookies.getAll().forEach(cookie => denied.cookies.set(cookie));
      denied.headers.set("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
      return denied;
    }
  }
  response.headers.set("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
  return response;
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/supabase/read-page.ts`

SHA-256: `415d26b9cee5b58ab8be3fae0530df95ba44432d00080e41b4386575086634ce`

```typescript
import {ApiError} from "@platform/lib/api/error";
type PageResult<Row>={data:Row[]|null;count:number|null;error:{code:string}|null};
type PageRequest<Row>=PromiseLike<PageResult<Row>>&{range(from:number,to:number):PromiseLike<PageResult<Row>>};
/** PostgREST rejects an out-of-range offset; retain the filtered count without fetching an unbounded list. */
export async function readDatabasePage<Row>(request:PageRequest<Row>) {
 const result=await request;
 if(result.error?.code==="PGRST103") {
  const first=await request.range(0,0);
  if(first.error) throw new ApiError(503,"INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return {data:[] as Row[],count:first.count??0};
 }
 if(result.error) throw new ApiError(503,"INTERNAL_ERROR");
 return {data:result.data??[],count:result.count??0};
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/supabase/server.ts`

SHA-256: `ef3a18d0f0a3cca2f441086046339e65ba0005e64ef0bdbe66f5107ff8b31c10`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import type { Database } from "@platform/types/database";
import { supabaseEnvironment } from "./environment";
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

/**
 * If using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a global variable. Always create a new client within each
 * function when using it.
 */
export async function createDatabaseClient() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies()
  const { url, key } = supabaseEnvironment()

  return createServerClient<Database>(
    url,
    key,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return cookieStore.getAll()
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          try {
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
            )
          } catch {
            // The `setAll` method was called from a Server Component.
            // This can be ignored if you have middleware refreshing
            // user sessions.
          }
        },
      },
    }
  )
}
```

```css
  .lms-admin-table tbody tr { display: block; min-width: 0; border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--bg-surface); padding: var(--space-md); }
  .lms-admin-table tbody tr > * { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; }
  .lms-admin-table tbody th:nth-child(1) { width: 100%; }
  .lms-admin-table tbody td { margin-top: var(--space-md); }
  .lms-admin-table td[data-label]::before { content: attr(data-label); display: block; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); margin-bottom: var(--space-xs); }
  .lms-admin-table .lms-admin-row-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-sm); border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); padding-top: var(--space-md); }
  .lms-admin-row-actions > * { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .lms-admin-row-actions > * + * { margin-top: 0; }
  .lms-admin-table .lms-admin-name { font-size: var(--font-size-body); }
}
@media (min-width: 480px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
  .lms-admin-table tbody tr { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); column-gap: var(--space-lg); }
  .lms-admin-table tbody th, .lms-admin-table tbody td:nth-child(4), .lms-admin-table .lms-admin-row-actions { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
}
.lms-admin-filters { padding: var(--space-lg); margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--bg-surface); }
.lms-admin-search label { display: block; font-weight: var(--font-weight-action); margin-bottom: var(--space-sm); }
.lms-admin-search input { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: var(--size-44px); border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); background: var(--bg-main); color: var(--text-primary); font: inherit; }
.lms-admin-search input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }
.lms-admin-filters fieldset { min-width: 0; border: 0; padding: 0; margin: var(--space-md) 0 0; }
.lms-admin-filters legend { padding: 0; font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: var(--space-sm); }
.lms-admin-filter-options { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-sm); }
.lms-admin-filter-options label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-sm); min-height: var(--size-44px); padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--transition-smooth), border-color var(--transition-smooth); }
.lms-admin-filter-options label:has(input:checked) { background: var(--primary-red-subtle); border-color: var(--primary-red); color: var(--text-primary); }
.lms-admin-filter-hint { margin-top: var(--space-sm); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-muted); }
.lms-admin-filter-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-md); margin-top: var(--space-md); }
.lms-admin-filter-footer .lms-admin-actions { margin: 0; }
.lms-admin-filter-footer .btn-primary, .lms-admin-filter-footer .lms-secondary-button { min-height: var(--size-44px); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); }
.lms-admin-result-count { margin: 0; font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-muted); }
.lms-admin-result-count strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.lms-admin-filters :focus-visible { outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--text-primary); outline-offset: var(--size-2px); }
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .lms-admin-filters { padding: var(--space-md); }
  .lms-admin-filter-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .lms-admin-filter-options label { padding-inline: var(--space-sm); }
  .lms-admin-filter-footer .lms-admin-actions { width: 100%; }
  .lms-admin-filter-footer .lms-admin-actions > * { flex: 1; white-space: normal; }
}

.lms-course-filter-selects { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: var(--space-md); margin-top: var(--space-md); }
.lms-course-table thead th:nth-child(n) { width: auto; }
.lms-course-table thead th:first-child { width: 22%; }
.lms-course-table th, .lms-course-table td { overflow-wrap: anywhere; padding-inline: var(--space-sm); }
.lms-course-table .lms-admin-row-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-sm); }
.lms-course-table .lms-secondary-button { padding: var(--space-sm); }
.lms-course-editor-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-md); margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); }
@media (max-width: 1024px) { .lms-course-filter-selects { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); } }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .lms-course-filter-selects { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); } }

.lms-course-delete > button { width: 100%; }

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .lms-page-heading[data-actions-first] { flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-start; }
  .lms-page-heading[data-actions-first] > div { order: -1; flex-basis: 100%; }
  .lms-page-heading[data-actions-first] > .btn-primary { width: auto; }
}
.lms-course-editor-tabs a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--text-accent-readable); border-color: var(--primary-red); background: var(--primary-red-subtle); }

.lms-course-editor-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap: var(--space-lg); align-items: stretch; }

.lms-course-editor-layout h2, .lms-curriculum h2 { font-size: var(--size-1_25rem); margin: 0; }
.lms-course-details { grid-row: span 2; }
.lms-curriculum { display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); }
.lms-curriculum .lms-profile-card { max-width: none; min-width: 0; }
.lms-curriculum-heading, .lms-curriculum-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-md); }
.lms-curriculum-heading > div, .lms-curriculum-row > div { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.lms-curriculum-heading .lms-admin-actions, .lms-curriculum-row .lms-admin-actions { margin: 0; }
.lms-curriculum-groups { display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); margin-top: var(--space-lg); }
.lms-curriculum-group { border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); padding-top: var(--space-lg); }
.lms-curriculum-lessons { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: var(--space-md) 0 0; display: grid; gap: var(--space-sm); }
.lms-curriculum-row { border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: var(--space-md); }
.lms-curriculum-row small, .lms-curriculum-note { display: block; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.lms-curriculum-dialog .lms-profile-form { gap: var(--space-md); }
@media (max-width: 1024px) { .lms-course-editor-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); } .lms-course-details { grid-row: auto; } }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .lms-curriculum-heading, .lms-curriculum-row { align-items: stretch; } .lms-curriculum-heading .lms-admin-actions, .lms-curriculum-row .lms-admin-actions { width: 100%; } }

.lms-course-price-field { display: grid; gap: var(--space-sm); min-width: 0; }
```

### File: `modules/styles/analytics.css`

SHA-256: `0c49c8087882256aeccf2d6052d291853da399266e3b12b98a4a8f23db730b3d`

```css
.analytics-overview { display: grid; gap: var(--space-xl); min-width: 0; }
.analytics-overview-header { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-lg); }
.analytics-overview-header p, .analytics-period-note { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); margin: 0; }
.analytics-overview-header > div:last-child { display: grid; gap: var(--space-sm); justify-items: end; }
.analytics-overview-header .lms-secondary-button { min-height: var(--control-target-size); }
.analytics-metrics-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-md); }
.analytics-primary-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-lg); }
.analytics-secondary-grid, .analytics-revenue-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-lg); }
.analytics-metric { padding: var(--space-lg); min-width: 0; border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--bg-surface); }
.analytics-metric h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-body); font-weight: var(--font-weight-label); }
.analytics-value { display: block; font-size: var(--size-2rem); margin-block: var(--space-md); color: var(--text-primary); line-height: var(--analytics-number-leading); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.analytics-metric > p { margin: var(--space-sm) 0; font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-change { display: inline-flex; gap: var(--space-xs); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-change[data-direction="up"], .analytics-change[data-direction="new"] { color: var(--text-primary); }
.analytics-change[data-direction="down"] { color: var(--text-accent-readable); }
.analytics-unavailable { color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-chart-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-md); border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0; min-width: 0; }
.analytics-chart-controls legend { margin-bottom: var(--space-sm); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-md); color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.analytics-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-sm); }
.analytics-legend span::before { content: ''; width: var(--space-md); border-top: var(--size-2px) solid var(--analytics-chart-current); }
.analytics-legend [data-series="previous"]::before { border-color: var(--analytics-chart-previous); border-top-style: dashed; }
.analytics-empty-note { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); padding-block: var(--space-md); }
.analytics-periods { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-xs); margin-bottom: var(--space-md); border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); }
.analytics-periods a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: var(--control-target-size); padding-inline: var(--space-md); border-bottom: var(--size-2px) solid transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); transition: color var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast); }
.analytics-periods a[aria-current], .analytics-periods a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); border-color: var(--primary-red); }
.analytics-course-ranking, .analytics-sources-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.analytics-course-ranking > li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: start; gap: var(--space-md); padding-block: var(--space-md); border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); }
.analytics-course-ranking > li:last-child { border: 0; }
.analytics-rank { color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: var(--font-weight-action); }
.analytics-course-ranking > li:first-child .analytics-rank { color: var(--text-accent-readable); }
.analytics-course-ranking a { color: var(--text-primary); transition: color var(--transition-fast); }
.analytics-course-ranking a:hover { color: var(--text-accent-readable); }
.analytics-course-ranking small { display: block; font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: var(--font-weight-body); }
.analytics-course-ranking strong { text-align: end; }
.analytics-rank-bar { margin-block: var(--space-sm); }
.analytics-overview progress { display: block; width: 100%; height: var(--space-xs); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: var(--border-subtle); color: var(--primary-red); overflow: hidden; appearance: none; }
.analytics-overview progress::-webkit-progress-bar { background: var(--border-subtle); }
.analytics-overview progress::-webkit-progress-value { background: var(--primary-red); }
.analytics-overview progress::-moz-progress-bar { background: var(--primary-red); }
.analytics-sources-list > li { padding-block: var(--space-sm); }
.analytics-sources-list > li > div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-md); margin-bottom: var(--space-sm); }
.analytics-sources-list small { color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-learning { display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); margin: 0; }
.analytics-learning > div { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-md); border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); padding-bottom: var(--space-md); }
.analytics-learning dd { margin: 0; font-size: var(--size-2rem); font-weight: var(--font-weight-action); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.analytics-learning dt { color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-definitions, .analytics-data-table { font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-definitions summary, .analytics-data-table summary { min-height: var(--control-target-size); padding-block: var(--space-sm); }
.analytics-table-scroll { overflow-x: auto; }
.analytics-data-table table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: start; }
.analytics-data-table th, .analytics-data-table td { padding: var(--space-sm); border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); text-align: start; }
.analytics-overview :focus-visible { outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--text-primary); outline-offset: var(--space-xs); }
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .analytics-metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .analytics-primary-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .analytics-overview-header { flex-direction: column; }
  .analytics-overview-header > div:last-child { justify-items: start; }
  .analytics-secondary-grid, .analytics-revenue-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .analytics-metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .analytics-metric, .analytics-panel-heading, .analytics-panel-body { padding: var(--space-md); }
  .analytics-panel-body { padding-top: 0; }
  .analytics-course-ranking > li { gap: var(--space-sm); }
}
.analytics-loading { display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-skeleton { min-height: var(--space-5xl); background: var(--bg-surface); border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
.analytics-skeleton-chart { min-height: var(--analytics-chart-height); }
.analytics-error { display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); justify-items: start; }

/* A single focal chart and quieter supporting figures preserve the platform identity. */
.analytics-chart-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-lg); margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); }
.analytics-chart-summary { display: grid; gap: var(--space-xs); }
.analytics-chart-summary > span:first-child { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.analytics-chart-summary > strong { font-size: var(--size-2rem); line-height: var(--analytics-number-leading); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.analytics-chart-controls { justify-content: end; }
.analytics-legend { margin-bottom: var(--space-md); }
.analytics-revenue-grid .analytics-metric { background: transparent; }
.analytics-revenue-grid .analytics-value { display: none; }
.analytics-revenue-grid .analytics-unavailable { display: inline-block; margin-top: var(--space-sm); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.analytics-definitions { padding-top: var(--space-md); border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); }
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .analytics-chart-toolbar { flex-direction: column; }
  .analytics-chart-controls { justify-content: start; }
}
```

### File: `modules/styles/auth.css`

```css
.lms-form-field { display: grid; gap: var(--space-control); min-width: 0; }
.lms-field-input-wrap { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.lms-field-input-wrap[data-has-control] input { padding-inline-end: var(--size-80px); }
.lms-password-toggle {
  position: absolute; inset-inline-end: var(--space-control); top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
  border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption); cursor: pointer; padding: var(--space-unit);
  transition: color var(--motion-duration-control) var(--motion-easing);
}
.lms-password-toggle:hover, .lms-password-toggle:focus-visible { color: var(--primary-red); }
.lms-password-toggle:disabled { cursor: default; }
.lms-field-hint { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.lms-auth-card .lms-error { color: var(--color-ffb3aa); margin: 0; }

.lms-auth-form .btn-primary { justify-self: stretch; }
.lms-auth-alternate {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-control);
  margin-top: var(--space-lg); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-auth-alternate a { color: var(--primary-red); transition: color var(--motion-duration-control) var(--motion-easing); }
.lms-auth-alternate a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.lms-auth-status { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
```

```css
.lms-course-overview { margin-bottom: var(--space-xl); }

.lms-course-author { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); transition: color var(--transition-smooth); }
.lms-course-author:hover, .lms-course-author:focus-visible { color: var(--primary-red); }
.lms-course-detail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) var(--size-360px); gap: var(--space-xl); align-items: start; }
.lms-course-detail-content, .lms-course-detail-body { display: grid; gap: var(--space-xl); min-width: 0; }
.lms-course-intro { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; overflow: hidden; border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--bg-surface); }
.lms-course-intro > .lms-course-art, .lms-course-intro .media-player-poster > .lms-course-art { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 0; }
.lms-course-intro .media-player { height: 100%; }
.lms-course-description h2, .lms-course-instructor h2 { font-size: var(--lms-size-1_4rem); margin: 0 0 var(--space-md); }
.lms-course-prose { display: grid; gap: var(--space-md); color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: var(--leading-longform); }
.lms-course-prose p { margin: 0; white-space: pre-line; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.lms-course-details-page .lms-outcomes { margin: 0; }
.lms-course-curriculum { scroll-margin-top: var(--size-110px); min-width: 0; }
.lms-course-detail-sidebar { position: sticky; top: var(--size-110px); display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); min-width: 0; }
.lms-enrollment-card { background: var(--bg-surface); border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden; scroll-margin-top: var(--size-110px); }
.lms-course-purchase-hint { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); line-height: var(--leading-copy); margin: var(--space-md) 0 0; }
.lms-course-facts { display: grid; gap: var(--space-control); margin: var(--space-lg) 0; padding-top: var(--space-lg); border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); }
.lms-course-facts > div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-control); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.lms-course-facts dt { color: var(--text-muted); }
.lms-course-facts dd { margin: 0; color: var(--text-primary); }
.lms-course-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-sm); color: var(--text-primary); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); transition: color var(--transition-smooth); }
.lms-course-text-link:hover, .lms-course-text-link:focus-visible { color: var(--primary-red); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: var(--space-xs); }
.lms-course-instructor { padding: var(--space-lg); border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); }
.lms-course-instructor > div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-md); margin-bottom: var(--space-md); }
.lms-course-instructor img { width: var(--space-3xl); height: var(--space-3xl); object-fit: cover; object-position: top; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
.lms-course-instructor h3 { font-size: var(--font-size-body); margin: 0 0 var(--space-xs); }
.lms-course-instructor p { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); line-height: var(--leading-copy); margin: 0; }
.lms-course-curriculum summary { flex-wrap: wrap; min-height: var(--control-target-size); }
.lms-course-curriculum summary b { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.lms-course-curriculum summary::after { margin-inline-start: 0; }
.lms-course-curriculum summary small { flex-shrink: 0; }
.lms-curriculum-chapter-body h3 { margin: 0; padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-comfortable); font-size: var(--font-size-body); color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-main); border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline); }
.lms-course-curriculum li { align-items: center; }
.lms-curriculum-lesson-title { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.lms-curriculum-lesson-title a { transition: color var(--transition-smooth); }
.lms-curriculum-lesson-title a:hover, .lms-curriculum-lesson-title a:focus-visible { color: var(--primary-red); }
.lms-curriculum-lesson-title small { display: block; margin-top: var(--space-xs); color: var(--text-accent-readable); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.lms-course-curriculum time { margin: 0; white-space: nowrap; font-size: var(--font-size-caption); flex-shrink: 0; }
.lms-lesson-lock { flex-shrink: 0; display: inline-flex; color: var(--text-muted); }
.lms-lesson-lock .lms-icon { width: var(--space-md); height: var(--space-md); }
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .lms-course-detail { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); gap: var(--space-lg); }
  .lms-course-detail-content { display: contents; }
  .lms-course-intro { order: 0; }
  .lms-course-detail-sidebar { position: static; order: 1; }
  .lms-course-detail-body { order: 2; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .lms-course-title { font-size: var(--lms-size-1_7rem); }
  .lms-course-overview { margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); }
  .lms-course-instructor, .lms-course-details-page .lms-enrollment-body { padding: var(--space-md); }
  .lms-course-curriculum summary { gap: var(--space-sm); }
  .lms-course-curriculum summary small { width: 100%; order: 1; padding-inline-start: var(--space-lg); }
  .lms-course-curriculum li { padding: var(--space-md); gap: var(--space-sm); }
}
```

### File: `modules/styles/live-sessions.css`

SHA-256: `15e266cb9fe68ef0677395fb7e3fd70f4db6d26c168106e4ff7648f2e2e495ef`

```css
.lms-live-schedule { display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); margin-block: var(--space-xl); min-width: 0; }
.lms-live-schedule > h2 { margin: 0; font-size: var(--lms-size-1_5rem); }
.lms-live-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-lg); }
.lms-live-card { display: grid; align-content: start; gap: var(--space-sm); min-width: 0; max-width: none; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.lms-live-card h3, .lms-live-card p { margin: 0; }
.lms-live-card p { color: var(--text-secondary); }
.lms-live-card .btn-primary { justify-self: start; margin-top: var(--space-md); }
.lms-live-status { justify-self: start; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.lms-live-status-active { color: var(--text-accent-readable); }
.lms-live-form { max-width: none; }
@media (max-width: 768px) { .lms-live-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }

.lms-live-filters { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,2fr) minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: end; gap: var(--space-md); }
.lms-live-filters .btn-primary { min-height: var(--size-44px); font-size: var(--font-size-body); padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); }
.lms-live-assignment { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: var(--space-md); }
@media (max-width: 768px) { .lms-live-filters, .lms-live-assignment { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); } }
```

### File: `modules/styles/lms.css`

SHA-256: `59c51c01c2a88e968704c6ed84207c89ec692a5d788392da0cdcec92681aa943`

```css
.lms-icon {
  width: var(--size-20px);
  height: var(--size-20px);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

}

}

}

  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.lms-marketing-links a[aria-current] {

}

}
.lms-nav-button {

}
.lms-text-link {

  align-items: center;

}
.lms-text-link:hover {

}
.lms-mobile-toggle {

}

  padding-top: var(--space-3xl);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-3xl);
}

}

  margin-right: auto;
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-2rem), var(--size-4_2vw), var(--size-3_8rem));
  line-height: var(--leading-control);
}
.lms-landing-hero .highlight-editors {
  font-size: var(--lms-size-0_96em);
}
.lms-hero-actions {
  display: flex;

}
.lms-secondary-button {

  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;

  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  background: var(--bg-surface-soft);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--size-20px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-size: var(--size-0_95rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  transition:
    background var(--transition-fast),

    transform var(--transition-fast);
}
.lms-secondary-button:hover {
  border-color: var(--primary-red-border);

}
.lms-secondary-button:active {

}
button:disabled {

  cursor: wait !important;
}
.lms-hero-preview {

  overflow: hidden;

  background: var(--bg-surface);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--size-22px) var(--size-60px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-25);
}
.lms-preview-titlebar {

}

}

}
.lms-preview-lessons {

}

}

}

}
.lms-course-grid {
  display: grid;

.lms-course-card {

  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);

.lms-public-main {

.lms-page-heading {

}
.lms-search:focus-within {
```
