SHA-256: `48af511dbde652ddf4187dd2bcdc1ed9909e64866709db967fcd2b591e22c8b9`

```typescript
import type { RevealSession } from "./reveal-session";
import { registerReveals } from "./register-reveals";
export function updateRevealPreference(session: RevealSession) {
  if (session.preference.matches) {
    session.observer?.disconnect();
    session.active.forEach((animation, target) => {
      if (animation.playState === "running") session.seen.add(target);
      animation.cancel();
    });
    session.active.clear();
    session.pending.clear();
  }
  registerReveals(session);
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/navigation/subscribe-dismissal.ts`

SHA-256: `3253eaf3460110a0e79d60a3c1878ff73b053f7251d0341857e4ea5dc73c4468`

```typescript
export interface DismissalOptions {
  root: HTMLElement;
  onClose: () => void;
  toggle?: HTMLElement | null;
  desktopQuery?: string;
  restoreFocus?: boolean;
}
/** Subscribe only while open; the owner controls state and supplies layout policy. */
export function subscribeDismissal({ root, toggle, onClose, desktopQuery, restoreFocus = true }: DismissalOptions) {
  const media = desktopQuery ? window.matchMedia(desktopQuery) : undefined;
  const key = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (event.key !== "Escape") return;
    onClose();
    if (restoreFocus) toggle?.focus();
  };
  const outside = (event: PointerEvent) => {
    if (event.target instanceof Node && !root.contains(event.target) && !toggle?.contains(event.target)) onClose();
  };
  const desktop = () => { if (media?.matches) onClose(); };
  document.addEventListener("keydown", key);
  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
  media?.addEventListener("change", desktop);
  return () => {
    document.removeEventListener("keydown", key);
    document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
    media?.removeEventListener("change", desktop);
  };
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/place-select-menu.ts`

SHA-256: `a6dfb5283bccd8298c5ef3941812d49912dafae45cf108b3386408a9e1ad7c73`

```typescript
/** Keep the top-layer menu within the viewport, including small landscape screens. */
export function placeSelectMenu(button: HTMLElement, panel: HTMLElement, minimumWidth = 0) {
  const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();
  const style = getComputedStyle(panel), gap = parseFloat(style.getPropertyValue("--space-sm")) || 0;
  const width = Math.min(Math.max(rect.width, minimumWidth), window.innerWidth - gap * 2);
  panel.style.width = `${width}px`;
  const roomBelow = window.innerHeight - rect.bottom - gap * 2, roomAbove = rect.top - gap * 2;
  const desired = Math.min(panel.scrollHeight, parseFloat(style.getPropertyValue("--control-menu-max-height")));
  const above = roomBelow < desired && roomAbove > roomBelow;
  const height = Math.min(desired, above ? roomAbove : roomBelow);
  panel.style.maxHeight = `${Math.max(gap, height)}px`;
  const left = style.direction === "rtl" ? rect.right - width : rect.left;
  panel.style.left = `${Math.max(gap, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - width - gap))}px`;
  panel.style.top = `${above ? rect.top - gap - height : rect.bottom + gap}px`;
}
```

```typescript
import type { SelectOption } from "../types/select";
export function selectNavigation(key: string, active: number, options: readonly SelectOption[]) {
  const available = options.map((option, index) => option.disabled ? -1 : index).filter(index => index >= 0);
  if (key === "Home") return available[0] ?? -1;
  if (key === "End") return available.at(-1) ?? -1;
  const direction = key === "ArrowUp" ? -1 : 1, current = available.indexOf(active);
  return available[(current + direction + available.length) % available.length] ?? -1;
}
export function selectTypeahead(text: string, options: readonly SelectOption[]) {
  return options.findIndex(option => !option.disabled && option.label.toLocaleLowerCase().startsWith(text.toLocaleLowerCase()));
}
```

SHA-256: `317e8fd0c618303ff72f0b8abf1dc1e1e1ebf1b7b2bb0bf5f25d12dab217d5b7`

```typescript
export function parseThemeTime(value: string, name: string) {
  // Optimized CSS may use .5s instead of 500ms.
  if (!/^(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\.\d+)(?:ms|s)$/.test(value)) throw new Error(`Invalid motion time ${name}`);
  return parseFloat(value) * (value.endsWith("ms") ? 1 : 1000);
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/theme/read-reveal-options.ts`

SHA-256: `6859484c28b716ee680d9f3564046ea63eee2698d89da8222ced0ed34236afe5`

```typescript
import { parseThemeTime } from "./parse-time";
import { parseThemeNumber } from "./parse-number";
import type { RevealOptions } from "../../types/interactions";

/** Resolve inherited theme tokens on the client; keep motion values in theme.css. */
export function readRevealOptions(root: HTMLElement): RevealOptions {
  const style = getComputedStyle(root);
  const token = (name: string) => style.getPropertyValue(name).trim();
  const number = (name: string) => parseThemeNumber(token(name), name);
  const milliseconds = (name: string) => parseThemeTime(token(name), name);
  const entrance = {
    y: number("--motion-reveal-distance"),
    duration: milliseconds("--motion-duration-reveal"),
  };
  return {
    viewportThreshold: number("--motion-reveal-viewport"),
    easing: token("--motion-easing"),
    groups: [
      {
        trigger: "[data-reveal-group=hero]",
        children: true,
        stagger: milliseconds("--motion-reveal-stagger"),
        ...entrance,
      },
      {
        trigger: "[data-reveal]:not([data-reveal-group=hero] > *)",
        ...entrance,
      },
    ],
  };
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { placeSelectMenu } from "../helpers/place-select-menu";
export function useActionMenu() {
  const button = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null), panel = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  function close() { panel.current?.hidePopover(); setOpen(false); }
  function toggle() { if (open) close(); else { panel.current?.showPopover(); setOpen(true); } }
  function keyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) {
    const items = Array.from(panel.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('a,button:not(:disabled)') ?? []);
    if (["ArrowDown", "ArrowUp", "Home", "End"].includes(event.key)) {
      event.preventDefault(); if (!open) { panel.current?.showPopover(); setOpen(true); }
      const current = items.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
      const index = event.key === "Home" ? 0 : event.key === "End" ? items.length - 1 : (current + (event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -1 : 1) + items.length) % items.length;
      items[index]?.focus();
    } else if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); close(); button.current?.focus(); }
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const place = () => { if (button.current && panel.current) placeSelectMenu(button.current, panel.current, parseFloat(getComputedStyle(panel.current).getPropertyValue("--action-menu-width"))); };
    place(); window.addEventListener("resize", place); window.addEventListener("scroll", place, true);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener("resize", place); window.removeEventListener("scroll", place, true); };
  }, [open]);
  return { button, panel, open, setOpen, close, toggle, keyDown };
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useCallback, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

/** Read a theme breakpoint without changing the server's initial markup. */
export function useBelowBreakpoint(token: string) {
  const query = useCallback(() => window.matchMedia(
    `(width <= ${getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(token).trim()})`,
  ), [token]);
  const subscribe = useCallback((notify: () => void) => {
    const media = query();
    media.addEventListener("change", notify);
    return () => media.removeEventListener("change", notify);
  }, [query]);
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => query().matches, () => false);
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/hooks/use-exclusive-player.ts`

SHA-256: `ead7aac6ed4d3d49a480ccb0c1c161d799dcde8a457e555afbb3374ee9acebda`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from "react";

const activationEvent = "khatab:player-activation";

/** Claim playback before retrieval starts, resetting other deferred instances. */
export function useExclusivePlayer(reset: () => void) {
  const identity = useRef(Symbol("player"));
  useEffect(() => {
    const onActivation = (event: Event) => {
      if ((event as CustomEvent<symbol>).detail !== identity.current) reset();
    };
    document.addEventListener(activationEvent, onActivation);
    return () => document.removeEventListener(activationEvent, onActivation);
  }, [reset]);
  return useCallback(() => {
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(activationEvent, { detail: identity.current }));
  }, []);
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/hooks/use-fragment-navigation.ts`

SHA-256: `68112c64697c75a4cc86a1b008dc69d85cd68a8fc61990232e3727d12ab25e93`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from "react";

/** Align fragments after streamed page content commits, including hash changes. */
export function useFragmentNavigation({ rootRef, enabled = true }: {
  rootRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  enabled?: boolean;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    let frame = 0;
    const align = () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        let id: string;
        try { id = decodeURIComponent(window.location.hash.slice(1)); }
        catch { return; }
        const target = id && document.getElementById(id);
        if (target && rootRef.current?.contains(target)) target.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" });
      });
    };
    align();
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", align);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      window.removeEventListener("hashchange", align);
    };
  }, [rootRef, enabled]);
}
```

```typescript
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { usePlayerFullscreen } from "./use-player-fullscreen";
import { usePlayerViewportReset } from "./use-player-viewport-reset";
export function useMediaPlayerSession(resetOnScrollOut: boolean) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
```

### File: `packages/design-system/hooks/use-near-viewport.ts`

SHA-256: `7fa8394f1a0d418f687928671edc92c8b7d28d0feec2aa2791599ba6fb755e8b`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { lazyLoading } from "../config/lazy-loading";
/** Mount expensive optional content once near view, without repeated scroll work. */
export function useNearViewport<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null), [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = ref.current;
    if (!element) return;
    let disposed = false;
    if (!window.IntersectionObserver) {
      queueMicrotask(() => { if (!disposed) setReady(true); });
      return () => { disposed = true; };
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      if (entries.some(entry => entry.isIntersecting)) { setReady(true); observer.disconnect(); }
    }, { rootMargin: lazyLoading.viewportMargin });
    observer.observe(element);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return { ref, ready };
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/hooks/use-player-fullscreen.ts`

SHA-256: `f700ea3c465416d10fd700d39b7ee845caec0e1e900f6a830823ae98a78bccaa`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState, type RefObject } from "react";
export function usePlayerFullscreen(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>) {
  const [fullscreen, setFullscreen] = useState(false);
  const [supported, setSupported] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => {
      setFullscreen(document.fullscreenElement === ref.current);
      setSupported(
        Boolean(document.fullscreenEnabled && ref.current?.requestFullscreen),
      );
    };
    document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange", update);
    update();
    return () => document.removeEventListener("fullscreenchange", update);
  }, [ref]);
  const enterFullscreen = useCallback(async () => {
    const element = ref.current;
    if (!element?.requestFullscreen || !document.fullscreenEnabled) return;
    try {
      if (document.fullscreenElement !== element)
        await element.requestFullscreen();
      element.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    } catch {
      /* Keep inline playback usable if browser policy rejects fullscreen. */
    }
  }, [ref]);
  const exitFullscreen = useCallback(async () => {
    if (document.fullscreenElement !== ref.current) return;
    try { await document.exitFullscreen(); } catch { /* Already exiting. */ }
  }, [ref]);
  const toggleFullscreen = async () => {
    if (document.fullscreenElement === ref.current) await exitFullscreen();
    else await enterFullscreen();
  };
  return { fullscreen, supported, toggleFullscreen, enterFullscreen, exitFullscreen };
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/hooks/use-player-viewport-reset.ts`

SHA-256: `20725ab34fed1fb8c8e06727a70c62fa92e5deef5956f446dd70f9988b231442`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from "react";

/** Release playback only after a visible player leaves the viewport. */
export function usePlayerViewportReset(
  ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
  reset: () => void,
  enabled: boolean,
) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = ref.current;
    if (!enabled || !element) return;
    let wasVisible = false;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
      const visible = entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0;
      if (wasVisible && !visible && !element.contains(document.fullscreenElement))
        reset();
      wasVisible = visible;
    });
    observer.observe(element);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [ref, reset, enabled]);
}
```

```typescript
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from "react";
import type { RevealOptions } from "../types/interactions";
import { createScrollReveals } from "../lib/scroll-reveals";

export interface ScrollRevealHookOptions {
  rootRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  options?: RevealOptions;
  enabled?: boolean;
}
/** Defaults read inherited theme tokens; an explicit options object replaces them. */
export function useScrollReveals({ rootRef, options, enabled = true }: ScrollRevealHookOptions) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = rootRef.current;
    if (!enabled || !root || !window.IntersectionObserver || !Element.prototype.animate) return;

  }, [rootRef, options, enabled]);
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/hooks/use-select-menu.ts`

SHA-256: `7d9271414fe4bc97ecaa1c24b25fe6e9f5492b13974d204a9d7d2acf6f25f00b`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { formControlBehavior } from "../config/form-controls";
import type { SelectOption } from "../types/select";
import { placeSelectMenu } from "../helpers/place-select-menu";
import { selectNavigation, selectTypeahead } from "../helpers/select-navigation";
export function useSelectMenu(options: readonly SelectOption[], selected: string, choose: (value: string) => void) {
  const button = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null), panel = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false), [active, setActive] = useState(-1);
  const typing = useRef({ text: "", time: 0 });
  function toggle(show = !open) {
    setOpen(show);
    if (show) { setActive(Math.max(0, options.findIndex(option => option.value === selected))); panel.current?.showPopover(); }
    else panel.current?.hidePopover();
  }
  function commit(index: number) {
    const option = options[index];
    if (!option || option.disabled) return;
    choose(option.value); toggle(false); button.current?.focus();
  }
  function keyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) {
    if (["ArrowDown", "ArrowUp", "Home", "End"].includes(event.key)) {
      event.preventDefault(); if (!open) toggle(true);
      setActive(current => selectNavigation(event.key, open ? current : options.findIndex(option => option.value === selected), options));
    } else if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
      event.preventDefault(); if (open) commit(active); else toggle(true);
    } else if (event.key === "Escape" && open) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); toggle(false); }
    else if (event.key === "Tab") { toggle(false); }
    else if (event.key.length === 1 && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey) {
      const now = performance.now(); typing.current = { text: (now - typing.current.time < formControlBehavior.typeaheadResetMs ? typing.current.text : "") + event.key, time: now };
      const index = selectTypeahead(typing.current.text, options);
      if (index >= 0) { if (!open) toggle(true); setActive(index); }
    }
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const reposition = () => { if (button.current && panel.current) placeSelectMenu(button.current, panel.current); };
    reposition(); window.addEventListener("resize", reposition); window.addEventListener("scroll", reposition, true);
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(reposition); if (button.current) observer.observe(button.current);
    return () => { observer.disconnect(); window.removeEventListener("resize", reposition); window.removeEventListener("scroll", reposition, true); };
  }, [open]);
  useEffect(() => { if (open) panel.current?.querySelector(`[data-index="${active}"]`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" }); }, [active, open]);
  return { button, panel, open, active, setOpen, toggle, commit, keyDown, setActive };
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/hooks/use-select-value.ts`

SHA-256: `40ce451c401e872a393ed4ba2ab84305e9c5d680ccfcf37f3aa64098056207d5`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { SelectProps } from "../types/select";
/** Native validity and reset events stay synchronized with controlled or local selection. */
export function useSelectValue({ value, defaultValue, options, onValueChange }: SelectProps) {
  const initial = defaultValue ?? options.find(option => !option.disabled)?.value ?? "";
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState(initial), [error, setError] = useState("");
  const nativeRef = useRef<HTMLSelectElement>(null);
  function choose(next: string) { setInternal(next); setError(""); onValueChange?.(next); }
  useEffect(() => {
    const form = nativeRef.current?.form;
    const reset = () => { setInternal(initial); setError(""); onValueChange?.(initial); };
    form?.addEventListener("reset", reset);
    return () => form?.removeEventListener("reset", reset);
  }, [initial, onValueChange]);
  return { selected: value ?? internal, choose, error, setError, nativeRef };
}
```

```typescript
import { toggleYouTubeMute } from "../helpers/media/youtube/toggle-mute";
import { setYouTubeVolume } from "../helpers/media/youtube/set-volume";
export function useYouTubePlayer(hostRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>, url: string, title: string, callbacks: { onPlay?: () => void; onEnded?: () => void } = {}) {
```

### File: `packages/design-system/lib/scroll-reveals.ts`

SHA-256: `09393f442a137865ccd9400aea46401d929b5edb71e8493064c6633f43d6785f`

```typescript
import type { RevealOptions } from "../types/interactions";
import { createRevealSession } from "../helpers/motion/reveal-session";
import { registerReveals } from "../helpers/motion/register-reveals";
import { observeReveals } from "../helpers/motion/observe-reveals";
import { updateRevealChildren } from "../helpers/motion/update-reveal-children";
import { updateRevealPreference } from "../helpers/motion/update-reveal-preference";
import { disposeReveals } from "../helpers/motion/dispose-reveals";
/** One lifecycle coordinates focused reveal helpers without owning their details. */
export interface ScrollRevealLifecycle {
  root: HTMLElement;
  options: RevealOptions;
  preference: MediaQueryList;
}
export function createScrollReveals({ root, options, preference }: ScrollRevealLifecycle) {
  const session = createRevealSession(root, options, preference);
  const observe = () => observeReveals(session);
  const onPreferenceChange = () => updateRevealPreference(session);
  const mutations = new MutationObserver((records) => updateRevealChildren(session, records));
  mutations.observe(root, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  preference.addEventListener("change", onPreferenceChange);
  window.addEventListener("resize", observe, { passive: true });
  registerReveals(session);
  return () => {
    disposeReveals(session);
    mutations.disconnect();
    preference.removeEventListener("change", onPreferenceChange);
    window.removeEventListener("resize", observe);
  };
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/lib/theme.cjs`

SHA-256: `acac3700bee50f00f4748a48633f4cffb20b0b1e2544a08475c0f4b8c93f682b`

```typescript
/** Controlled token contract: root declarations, recursive var aliases, literal values. */
function parseTokens(sources) {
  const tokens = {};
  for (const source of sources) {
    const clean = source.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "");
    for (const block of clean.matchAll(/:root\s*\{([^}]+)\}/g))
      for (const entry of block[1].matchAll(/(--[\w-]+)\s*:\s*([^;]+);/g))
        tokens[entry[1]] = entry[2].trim();
  }
  return tokens;
}
function resolveToken(tokens, name, trail = []) {
  if (trail.includes(name))
    throw new Error(`Cyclic token: ${[...trail, name].join(" -> ")}`);
  if (!Object.hasOwn(tokens, name))
    throw new Error(`Missing theme token ${name}`);
  const result = tokens[name].replace(/var\((--[\w-]+)\)/g, (_, alias) =>
    resolveToken(tokens, alias, [...trail, name]),
  );
  if (/var\(|(?:color-mix|calc)\(/.test(result))
    throw new Error(`Unsupported export expression: ${name}`);
  return result;
}
module.exports = { parseTokens, resolveToken };
```

### File: `packages/design-system/lib/video.ts`

SHA-256: `26035f3f56d5448e20db45894faa490347bcd458561c9aeb6078edfb8d6a77fb`

```typescript
/** Validate a YouTube ID and normalize it to the privacy-enhanced iframe host. */
export function getYouTubeEmbedUrl(rawUrl: string): string | null {
  try {
    const url = new URL(rawUrl);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password || url.port) return null;
    const hosts = [
      "youtube.com",
      "www.youtube.com",
      "m.youtube.com",
      "youtube-nocookie.com",
      "www.youtube-nocookie.com",
    ];
    const id =
      url.hostname === "youtu.be"
        ? url.pathname.slice(1)
        : hosts.includes(url.hostname)
          ? url.pathname === "/watch"
            ? url.searchParams.get("v")
            : url.pathname.match(/^\/(?:embed|shorts|live)\/([\w-]{11})\/?$/)?.[1]
          : null;
    if (!id || !/^[\w-]{11}$/.test(id)) return null;
    return `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${id}?autoplay=1&playsinline=1`;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```

```css
.coming-soon {

}
```

```css
.ds-choice-copy small { color: var(--text-muted); }
.ds-select { position: relative; display: grid; gap: var(--space-sm); min-width: 0; }
.ds-select-trigger { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-md); width: 100%; min-height: var(--control-target-size); padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-md); border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--bg-main); color: var(--text-primary); font: inherit; text-align: start; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), background var(--transition-fast); }

.ds-select-trigger:focus-visible { outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--primary-red); outline-offset: var(--space-xs); }
.ds-select-trigger:disabled { opacity: var(--player-disabled-opacity); cursor: not-allowed; }
.ds-select-menu { position: fixed; inset: auto; margin: 0; padding: var(--space-xs); max-height: var(--control-menu-max-height); overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--bg-surface-elevated); color: var(--text-primary); font: inherit; box-shadow: var(--control-menu-shadow); }
.ds-select-menu [role="option"] { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-md); min-height: var(--control-target-size); padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-control); border-radius: var(--radius-xs); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast); }
.ds-select-menu [role="option"][data-active="true"] { background: var(--bg-surface); }
```

```css
/* Cursor belongs to the interactive target; its contents inherit it. */
:is(a[href], button, summary, [role="button"], [role="link"], [role="option"],
    input[type="submit"], input[type="button"], input[type="reset"],
    input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"]) {
  cursor: pointer;

:where(a[href], button, summary, [role="button"], [role="link"], [role="option"]) :where(*) {
  cursor: inherit;
}
:is(button, input):disabled,
[aria-disabled="true"] {
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
```

```css
/* Shared visual foundation of the two client-approved reference sites.
   CSS breakpoint conditions remain literals because native @media cannot resolve var().
   Size aliases retain the original measurements; prefer named space/radius tokens when extending. */
:root {
  /* Email exports resolve these roles to literal inline styles for Gmail/Outlook. */
  --email-content-width: 600px;
  --email-border: #36404f;
  --email-font: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif;
  --email-body-size: 16px;
  --email-heading-size: 28px;
  --email-caption-size: 14px;

  --analytics-chart-height: 320px;
  --analytics-heading-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
  --analytics-number-leading: var(--leading-compact);
  --analytics-chart-current: var(--primary-red);
  --analytics-chart-previous: var(--text-secondary);
  --analytics-chart-grid: var(--border-subtle);

  --action-menu-width: 256px;

  --control-select-min-width: 200px;
  --control-target-size: 44px;
  --control-marker-size: 20px;
  --control-radio-dot: 8px;
  --control-menu-max-height: 288px;
  --control-menu-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35);
  /* Reusable teaser-poster artwork; type scales with its container. */
  --coming-soon-title-size: clamp(2rem, 14cqi, 5.5rem);
  --coming-soon-ghost-size: clamp(3rem, 19cqi, 10rem);
  --coming-soon-detail-size: clamp(.65rem, 2.2cqi, .875rem);
  --coming-soon-detail-tracking: .18em;
  --coming-soon-ribbon-size: clamp(.75rem, 2.7cqi, 1.125rem);
  --coming-soon-ribbon-angle: -10deg;
  --coming-soon-mark-angle: 45deg;
  --coming-soon-ribbon-bottom: 14%;
  --coming-soon-ghost-top: -7%;
  --coming-soon-copy-offset: -18%;
  /* Shared interaction roles: quick feedback, slower surface settling. */
  --motion-easing: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --motion-duration-control: 300ms;
  --motion-duration-surface: 500ms;
  --motion-duration-press: 120ms;
  --motion-duration-reveal: 500ms;
  --motion-duration-instant: 0ms;
  --motion-reveal-distance: 32px;
  --motion-reveal-stagger: 80ms;
  --motion-reveal-viewport: 0.9;
  --motion-press-scale: 0.98;
  --motion-play-hover-scale: 1.04;
  --motion-card-lift: -8px;
  --motion-button-lift: -4px;
  --motion-cover-scale: 1.055;
  --motion-arrow-shift: -6px;

  /* Custom player: dimensions and visual roles, independent of YouTube policy. */
  --player-min-video-height: 200px;
  --player-controls-height: 80px;
  --player-control-size: 40px;
  --player-icon-size: 22px;
  --player-time-size: 0.875rem;
  --player-range-height: 16px;
  --player-volume-width: 88px;
  --player-volume-compact-width: 44px;
  --player-disabled-opacity: 0.45;
  --player-overlay-size: var(--space-2xl);
  --player-glow-strength: 45%;
  --bg-main: #101317;
  --bg-section-alt: #161b22;
  --bg-surface: #1c222b;
  --bg-surface-elevated: #232b36;
  --bg-surface-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
  --primary-red: #fc3522;
  --primary-red-hover: rgb(
    from var(--primary-red) calc(r - 28) calc(g - 13) calc(b - 12)
  );
  --primary-red-glow: rgb(from var(--primary-red) r g b / 0.22);
  --primary-red-subtle: rgb(from var(--primary-red) r g b / 0.1);
  --primary-red-border: rgb(from var(--primary-red) r g b / 0.35);
  --accent-green: #36f329;
  --accent-green-subtle: rgba(54, 243, 41, 0.1);
  --accent-green-border: rgba(54, 243, 41, 0.25);
  --text-primary: #ffffff;
  --text-secondary: #cbd5e1;
  --text-muted: #8492a6;
  --text-faint: #475569;
  --border-hairline: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --border-subtle: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  --border-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
  --font-arabic:
    "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI",
    Roboto, sans-serif;
  --space-unit: 8px;
  --space-xs: 4px;
  --space-sm: 8px;
  --space-md: 16px;
  --space-heading-tight: 14px;
  --blur-navigation: 14px;

  --transition-fast: var(--motion-duration-control) var(--motion-easing);
  --transition-smooth: var(--motion-duration-surface) var(--motion-easing);
  --inner-corridor-width: 940px;
  --top-capsule-width: 760px;
  --font-heading: var(--font-arabic);
  --color-canvas: var(--bg-main);
  --color-brand: var(--primary-red);
  --portfolio-surface: #14171d;
  --portfolio-elevated: #161a20;

/* Semantic roles preserve approved values independently of radius and product content.
   Heavy/black weights intentionally retain the reference synthetic-weight treatment. */
:root {
  --dimension-12: 12px;
  --dimension-14: 14px;
  --dimension-18: 18px;
  --dimension-4: 4px;
  --dimension-8: 8px;
  --easing-reference: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --easing-responsive: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  --font-quotation: Georgia, serif;
  --layer-base: 0;
  --layer-content: 1;
  --layer-dashboard-header: 30;
  --layer-decoration: 2;
  --layer-navigation: 1000;
  --layer-navigation-menu: 1001;
  --layer-sidebar: 25;
  --layer-timeline: 10;
  --layer-timeline-badge: 12;
  --layer-timeline-label: 14;
  --layer-timeline-top: 15;
  --layer-toast: 999;
  --leading-1-52: 1.52;
  --leading-body: 1.7;
  --leading-compact: 1.2;
  --leading-control: 1.4;
  --leading-copy: 1.75;
  --leading-headline: 1.1;
  --leading-label: 1.35;
  --leading-longform: 1.85;
  --leading-normal: 1.5;
  --leading-relaxed: 1.6;
  --leading-solid: 1;
  --leading-spacious: 1.8;
  --leading-summary: 1.45;
  --leading-tight: 1.25;
  --leading-title: 1.3;
  --measure-footer-copy: 44ch;
  --scale-decoration-1-08: 1.08;
  --scale-decoration-1-15: 1.15;
  --scale-decoration-1-3: 1.3;
  --shadow-offset-12: 12px;
  --shadow-offset-14: 14px;
  --shadow-offset-18: 18px;
  --shadow-offset-4: 4px;
  --shadow-offset-8: 8px;
  --space-comfortable: 18px;
  --space-control: 12px;
  --space-detail: 14px;
  --weight-black: 900;
  --weight-bold: 700;
  --weight-heavy: 800;
  --weight-medium: 500;
  --weight-regular: 400;
  --weight-semibold: 600;
}

/* Original workshop entrance roles; exported at build time for its supplied motion contract. */
:root {
  --workshop-reveal-viewport: 0.75;
  --workshop-reveal-easing: var(--motion-easing);
  --workshop-reveal-distance-card: 24px;
  --workshop-reveal-distance-text: 20px;
  --workshop-reveal-distance-preview: 26px;
  --workshop-reveal-distance-action: 18px;
  --workshop-reveal-distance-panel: 25px;
  --workshop-reveal-offset-photo: 35px;
  --workshop-reveal-offset-copy: -35px;
  --workshop-reveal-duration-main: var(--motion-duration-reveal);
  --workshop-reveal-duration-heading: var(--motion-duration-reveal);
  --workshop-reveal-duration-card: var(--motion-duration-reveal);
  --workshop-reveal-duration-faq: var(--motion-duration-surface);
  --workshop-reveal-delay-heading: 50ms;
  --workshop-reveal-delay-support: 200ms;
  --workshop-reveal-delay-preview: 350ms;
  --workshop-reveal-delay-action: 480ms;
  --workshop-reveal-stagger-heading: 100ms;
  --workshop-reveal-stagger-faq: 70ms;
  --workshop-reveal-scale-preview: 0.97;
  --workshop-reveal-scale-review: 0.98;
}

/* Personal portfolio interaction geometry. */
:root {
  --personal-header-scroll-threshold: 30;
  --personal-navigation-desktop: 992px;
  --personal-navigation-root-margin: -15% 0px -65% 0px;
  --personal-timeline-trigger: .72;
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/styles/video-player.css`

```css
.hero-video-shell:has(.custom-video-player:not(.custom-video-player--overlay)) {
  min-height: calc(
    var(--player-min-video-height) + var(--player-controls-height) + 2 *
      var(--size-1px)
  );
}
.custom-video-player {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--bg-main);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  position: relative;
}
.custom-video-stage {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: var(--player-min-video-height);
}
.custom-video-iframe-host {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
}
.custom-video-iframe-host iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: 0;
  display: block;
}
.custom-video-controls {
  flex: none;
  padding: var(--space-unit) var(--space-control);
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
}
.custom-video-control-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
}
.custom-video-control {
  width: var(--player-control-size);
  height: var(--player-control-size);
  flex: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  transition:
    color var(--transition-fast),
    background-color var(--transition-fast);
}
.custom-video-control svg {
  width: var(--player-icon-size);
  height: var(--player-icon-size);
  fill: currentColor;
}
.custom-video-control:disabled {
  opacity: var(--player-disabled-opacity);
  cursor: default;
}
.custom-video-control:not(:disabled):hover,
.custom-video-control:focus-visible {
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.custom-video-time {
  font-size: var(--player-time-size);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
  direction: ltr;
}
.custom-video-volume-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-xs);
  margin-left: auto;
}
.custom-video-seek,
.custom-video-volume {
  accent-color: var(--primary-red);
  cursor: pointer;
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  height: var(--player-range-height);
}
.custom-video-seek {
  width: 100%;
}
.custom-video-volume {
  width: var(--player-volume-width);
}
.custom-video-status {
  position: static;
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-unit);
  background: var(--bg-main);
  font-size: var(--player-time-size);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.custom-video-error {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}
.custom-video-error p {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.custom-video-retry {
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-lg);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: var(--size-1rem);
}
.custom-video-player:fullscreen {
  height: 100vh;
  width: 100vw;
}
.custom-video-player:fullscreen .custom-video-stage {
  min-height: 0;
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .custom-video-controls {
    padding-inline: var(--space-unit);
    gap: var(--space-xs);
  }
  .custom-video-control-row {
    gap: var(--space-xs);
  }
  .custom-video-volume {
    width: var(--player-volume-compact-width);
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .custom-video-control {
    transition: none;
  }
}

.custom-video-element {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
}
.reel-video-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  position: relative;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: var(--bg-main);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.reel-video-placeholder img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.reel-video-placeholder .reel-play-btn {
  position: absolute;

}
.reel-video-placeholder:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--primary-red);
  outline-offset: calc(-1 * var(--space-xs));
}
.reel-preview .custom-video-stage {
  min-height: 0;
}
.reel-preview .custom-video-volume {
  display: none;
}
.reel-preview .custom-video-control-row {
  gap: var(--space-xs);
}
.reel-preview .custom-video-controls {
  padding-inline: var(--space-unit);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .client-work-card:hover .reel-video-placeholder .reel-play-btn {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-15));
  }
}

.custom-video-overlay-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  border: 0;
  z-index: var(--layer-decoration);
}
.custom-video-overlay-toggle svg {
  width: var(--player-icon-size);
  height: var(--player-icon-size);
  fill: currentColor;
  margin: 0;
}
.custom-video-overlay-toggle:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--text-primary);
  outline-offset: var(--space-xs);
}
.custom-video-overlay-toggle:disabled {
  opacity: var(--player-disabled-opacity);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .client-work-card:hover .custom-video-overlay-toggle {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-15));
  }
}
.custom-video-player--overlay .custom-video-status {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--space-control);
  left: var(--space-control);
}

.hero-video-placeholder img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.hero-video-placeholder .video-play-button {
  position: relative;
}
.hero-video-shell .custom-video-player--overlay .custom-video-stage {
  min-height: 0;
}
.hero-video-shell .custom-video-overlay-toggle {
  width: var(--size-68px);
  height: var(--size-68px);
}
.hero-video-shell .custom-video-overlay-toggle svg {
  width: var(--size-26px);
  height: var(--size-26px);
}

/* Public player wrapper owns sizing and accent overrides for each instance. */
.media-player {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.media-player-poster {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: var(--bg-main);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.media-player-poster img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.media-player-toggle,
.custom-video-overlay-toggle {
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
  width: var(--player-overlay-size);
  height: var(--player-overlay-size);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red));
  color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--size-20px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);
}

/* New views fade in without retaining the old video's stream for an exit effect. */
.media-player-poster,
.media-player .custom-video-player,
.custom-video-overlay-toggle {
  animation: playerFadeIn var(--motion-duration-surface) var(--motion-easing);
}
@keyframes playerFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .media-player-poster,
  .media-player .custom-video-player,
  .custom-video-overlay-toggle {
    animation: none;
  }
  .media-player-toggle,
  .custom-video-overlay-toggle {
    transition: none;
  }
}
.media-player-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
.media-player-toggle svg {
  width: var(--player-icon-size);
  height: var(--player-icon-size);
  fill: currentColor;
}
.media-player .custom-video-player--overlay .custom-video-stage {
  min-height: 0;
}
.media-player-poster:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red));
  outline-offset: calc(-1 * var(--space-xs));
}
.media-player .custom-video-seek,
.media-player .custom-video-volume {
  accent-color: var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red));
}
.media-player .custom-video-retry {
  border-color: var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red));
}
/* Reference hover styling must preserve the configured accent and centered icon. */
.media-player .media-player-toggle {
  background: var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red));
}
.hero-video-placeholder .media-player-toggle {
  position: absolute;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .media-player-poster:hover .media-player-toggle {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-08));
  }
  .client-work-card:hover .media-player-toggle.reel-play-btn {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-15));
  }
}

.media-player .media-player-toggle,
.media-player .custom-video-overlay-toggle {
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--size-20px)
    color-mix(
      in srgb,
      var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red)) var(--player-glow-strength),
      transparent
    );
}
.hero-video-placeholder .media-player-toggle {
  width: var(--size-68px);
  height: var(--size-68px);
}
.hero-video-placeholder .media-player-toggle svg {
  width: var(--size-26px);
  height: var(--size-26px);
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .media-player-poster:hover .media-player-toggle {
    background: var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red-hover));
  }
  .client-work-card:hover .media-player-poster .media-player-toggle {
    background: var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red));
  }
}

/* Fullscreen keeps the intrinsic portrait/landscape frame, never crops footage. */
.media-player:fullscreen {
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  max-width: none;
  aspect-ratio: auto;
  background: var(--bg-main);
  animation: none;
}
.media-player:fullscreen .custom-video-stage { min-height: 0; }
.media-player-fullscreen {
  cursor: pointer;
  position: absolute;
  top: max(var(--space-md), env(safe-area-inset-top));
  right: max(var(--space-md), env(safe-area-inset-right));
  z-index: var(--layer-decoration);
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}
.media-player-fullscreen:not(:disabled):hover,
.media-player-fullscreen:focus-visible {
  background: transparent;
}
.media-player-fullscreen svg {
  stroke: none;
  filter:
    drop-shadow(0 var(--size-1px) var(--size-1px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-8))
    drop-shadow(0 0 var(--size-3px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-8));
}

.media-player-fullscreen {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity var(--transition-smooth), background-color var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
}
.media-player:hover .media-player-fullscreen,
.media-player-fullscreen:focus-visible,
.media-player-fullscreen.is-fullscreen {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}
@media (hover: none) {
  .media-player-fullscreen { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .media-player-fullscreen { transition: none; }
}
/* Keep the thumbnail caption clear of the top-right fullscreen action. */
.reel-video-placeholder .reel-tag {
  right: auto;
  left: var(--size-10px);
}
```
