          playButtonClassName="video-play-button"
        >
          <span className="video-meta-label" hidden>
            {content.caption}
          </span>
          <span className="video-meta-time" hidden>
            {content.hint}
          </span>
        </MediaPlayer>
      </div>
    );
  return (
    <div className="hero-video-shell">
      <DeferredVideoPlayer
        {...(content.source
          ? { source: content.source }
          : { url: content.url })}
        controlsVariant={content.controlsVariant}
        returnToPosterOnEnd={content.returnToPosterOnEnd}
        title={content.title}
        labels={content.controls}
        playLabel={content.playLabel}
        placeholderClassName="hero-video-placeholder"
      >
        <span className="video-play-button" aria-hidden="true">
          <Icon name="play" />
        </span>
        <span className="video-meta-label" hidden={Boolean(content.poster)}>
          {content.caption}
        </span>
        <span className="video-meta-time" hidden={Boolean(content.poster)}>
          {content.hint}
        </span>
      </DeferredVideoPlayer>
    </div>
  );
}

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/history-boundary.tsx`

SHA-256: `4a29496c3e64c3a7632f7856c5274ea89081ae2b08cfa8d7440c6e6a6c42657d`

```tsx
"use client";
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
const HistoryRestoration = createContext(0);
/** Persist history notifications across route unmounts, including visits to public pages. */
export default function HistoryBoundary({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [restoration, setRestoration] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const restored = () => setRestoration(value => value + 1);
    window.addEventListener("popstate", restored);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("popstate", restored);
  }, []);
  return <HistoryRestoration.Provider value={restoration}>{children}</HistoryRestoration.Provider>;
}
export function useHistoryRestoration() { return useContext(HistoryRestoration); }
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/media-player.tsx`

SHA-256: `d757e30f8bd6aece13a5adb84f3459f4af2441518c80bc17925d1294401cd4c1`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useMediaPlayerSession } from "../hooks/use-media-player-session";
import { mediaPlayerStyle } from "../helpers/media/appearance";
import type { MediaPlayerProps } from "../types/media-player";
import { arabicPlayerLabels } from "../lib/player-labels";
import DeferredVideoPlayer from "./deferred-video-player";
import PlayerIcon from "./player-icon";
import { getYouTubeEmbedUrl } from "../lib/video";

/** Portable file/YouTube player: configuration changes appearance, not playback logic. */
export default function MediaPlayer({
  videoUrl,
  thumbnailUrl,
  title,
  width,
  height,
  aspectRatio = "16 / 9",
  color,
  controlsVariant = "overlay",
  returnToPosterOnEnd = true,
  fullscreenOnPlay = false,
  resetOnScrollOut = true,
  labels = arabicPlayerLabels,
  playLabel,
  className = "",
  placeholderClassName = "",
  playButtonClassName = "",
  thumbnailLoading = "lazy",
  children,
}: MediaPlayerProps) {
  const { ref, generation, fullscreen, supported, enterFullscreen, exitFullscreen } = useMediaPlayerSession(resetOnScrollOut);
  const style = mediaPlayerStyle({ width, height, aspectRatio, color });
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={`media-player ${className}`.trim()} style={style}
      tabIndex={-1}
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && fullscreen) {
          event.preventDefault();
          void exitFullscreen();
        }
      }}
    >
      <DeferredVideoPlayer
        key={`${videoUrl}:${generation}`}
        {...(getYouTubeEmbedUrl(videoUrl) ? { url: videoUrl } : { source: { kind: "file" as const, url: videoUrl, poster: thumbnailUrl } })}
        title={title ?? labels.controls}
        labels={labels}
        playLabel={playLabel ?? labels.play}
        controlsVariant={controlsVariant}
        returnToPosterOnEnd={returnToPosterOnEnd}
        onActivate={fullscreenOnPlay ? () => void enterFullscreen() : undefined}
        onDeactivate={exitFullscreen}
        placeholderClassName={`media-player-poster ${placeholderClassName}`.trim()}
      >
        {/* Arbitrary thumbnail URLs stay portable and bypass Next image-host configuration. */}
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        {thumbnailUrl && <img
          src={thumbnailUrl}
          alt=""
          loading={thumbnailLoading}
          decoding="async"
          fetchPriority={thumbnailLoading === "eager" ? "high" : undefined}
        />}
        <span
          className={`media-player-toggle ${playButtonClassName}`.trim()}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <PlayerIcon name="play" />
        </span>
        {children}
      </DeferredVideoPlayer>
      {supported ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`media-player-fullscreen custom-video-control${fullscreen ? " is-fullscreen" : ""}`}
          aria-label={fullscreen ? labels.exitFullscreen : labels.enterFullscreen}
          title={fullscreen ? labels.exitFullscreen : labels.enterFullscreen}
          onClick={() => void (fullscreen ? exitFullscreen() : enterFullscreen())}
        >
          <PlayerIcon name={fullscreen ? "exit-fullscreen" : "fullscreen"} />
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/player-shell.tsx`

SHA-256: `ab7523d136189c5ab23690f8548cef6b87000929009b3ab7a5aac91ad59969c9`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { usePlayerFullscreen } from "../hooks/use-player-fullscreen";
import { getPlaybackAction } from "../helpers/media/playback-action";
import { handlePlayerKey } from "../helpers/media/player-keyboard";
import type {
  PlayerController,
  PlayerControlsVariant,
  VideoPlayerLabels,
} from "../types/video-player";
import PlayerIcon from "./player-icon";
import VideoControls from "./video-controls";
export default function PlayerShell({
  title,
  labels,
  controller,
  children,
  controlsVariant = "full",
}: {
  title: string;
  labels: VideoPlayerLabels;
  controller: PlayerController;
  children: ReactNode;
  controlsVariant?: PlayerControlsVariant;
}) {
  const shellRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const { snapshot, toggle, retry } = controller;
  const { fullscreen, supported, toggleFullscreen } =
    usePlayerFullscreen(shellRef);
  const action = getPlaybackAction(snapshot, labels);
  return (
    <div
      className={`custom-video-player${controlsVariant === "overlay" ? " custom-video-player--overlay" : ""}`}
      ref={shellRef}
      tabIndex={0}
      role="region"
      aria-label={title}
      onKeyDown={(event) => handlePlayerKey(event, controller, toggleFullscreen)}
    >
      <div className="custom-video-stage" onClick={(event) => {
        if (event.target instanceof HTMLVideoElement && snapshot.ready) {
          shellRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
          toggle();
        }
      }}>
        {children}
        {controlsVariant === "overlay" && (snapshot.status === "paused" || snapshot.status === "ended") ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="custom-video-overlay-toggle"
            aria-label={action.label}
            title={action.label}
            disabled={!snapshot.ready}
            onClick={() => {
              shellRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
              toggle();
            }}
          >
            <PlayerIcon name={action.icon} />
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {controlsVariant === "full" ? (
        <VideoControls
          state={snapshot}
          labels={labels}
          toggle={toggle}
          seek={controller.seek}
          toggleMute={controller.toggleMute}
          volume={controller.volume}
          fullscreen={fullscreen}
          fullscreenSupported={supported}
          toggleFullscreen={() => void toggleFullscreen()}
        />
      ) : null}
      {snapshot.status === "loading" || snapshot.status === "buffering" ? (
        <span className="custom-video-status" role="status">
          {labels.loading}
        </span>
      ) : null}
      {snapshot.status === "error" ? (
        <div className="custom-video-error" role="alert">
          <p>{labels.error}</p>
          <button type="button" className="custom-video-retry" onClick={retry}>
            {labels.retry}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

"use client";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import type { TestimonialsContent } from "../types/marketing";
import ReviewCard from "./review-card";

export default function ReviewList({ reviews, expansion }: Pick<TestimonialsContent, "reviews" | "expansion">) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const id = useId();
  const count = expansion ? Math.max(0, expansion.initialCount) : reviews.length;
  const visibleReviews = expanded ? reviews : reviews.slice(0, count);
  return (
    <>
      <div id={id} className="testimonials-grid">
        {visibleReviews.map((review, index) => (
          <div key={`${review.name}:${index}`} className={expanded && index >= count ? "review-revealed" : undefined}>
            <ReviewCard {...review} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {expansion && !expanded && count < reviews.length ? (
        <div className="testimonials-more">
          <button type="button" className="testimonials-more-button" aria-controls={id} aria-expanded={expanded} onClick={() => setExpanded(true)}>
            {expansion.showMoreLabel}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/rich-text.tsx`

SHA-256: `e675e0fbfcbbf9115b1d717081df89f72cd709ed6511a293f480b6e178a7d76f`

```tsx
import { Fragment } from "react";
import Icon from "./ui-icon";
import type { RichTextContent } from "../types/ui";

export default function RichText({ content }: { content: RichTextContent }) {
  return content.map((part, index) => {
    if (typeof part === "string")
      return <Fragment key={index}>{part}</Fragment>;
    if (part.kind === "break") return <br key={index} />;
    const Tag = part.kind === "strong" ? "b" : "span";
    return (
      <Tag
        key={index}
        className={part.className}
        aria-hidden={part.decorative || undefined}
      >
        {part.icon && <Icon {...part.icon} fill="currentColor" />}
        <RichText content={part.children} />
      </Tag>
    );
  });
}
```

"use client";
import { useId } from "react";
import { useSelectValue } from "../hooks/use-select-value";
import { useSelectMenu } from "../hooks/use-select-menu";
import type { SelectProps } from "../types/select";
export default function Select({ options, label, name, id, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, required, disabled, validationMessage, placeholder = "—", className = "" }: SelectProps) {
  const generated = useId(), controlId = id ?? generated;
  const { selected, choose, error, setError, nativeRef } = useSelectValue({ options, label, value, defaultValue, onValueChange });
  const { button: buttonRef, panel: panelRef, open, active, setOpen, toggle, commit, keyDown, setActive } = useSelectMenu(options, selected, choose);
  return <div className={`ds-select ${className}`}>
    <label id={`${controlId}-label`} htmlFor={controlId}>{label}</label>
    <select ref={nativeRef} aria-hidden="true" tabIndex={-1} className="ds-select-native" name={name} value={selected} required={required} disabled={disabled}
      onChange={event => choose(event.target.value)}
      onInvalid={event => { event.preventDefault(); setError(validationMessage ?? event.currentTarget.validationMessage); buttonRef.current?.focus(); }}>
      {!selected && <option value="">{placeholder}</option>}
      {options.map(option => <option key={option.value} value={option.value} disabled={option.disabled}>{option.label}</option>)}
    </select>
    <button ref={buttonRef} id={controlId} type="button" className="ds-select-trigger" role="combobox" disabled={disabled}
      aria-labelledby={`${controlId}-label`} aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={`${controlId}-menu`}
      aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-required={required} aria-invalid={Boolean(error)} aria-describedby={error ? `${controlId}-error` : undefined} aria-activedescendant={open && active >= 0 ? `${controlId}-option-${active}` : undefined}
      onClick={() => toggle()} onKeyDown={keyDown}>
      <span id={`${controlId}-value`}>{options.find(option => option.value === selected)?.label ?? placeholder}</span>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 7 5 5 5-5" /></svg>
    </button>
    <div ref={panelRef} popover="auto" id={`${controlId}-menu`} className="ds-select-menu" role="listbox" aria-labelledby={`${controlId}-label`}
      onToggle={event => setOpen(event.newState === "open")} onMouseDown={event => event.preventDefault()}>
      {options.map((option, index) => <div key={option.value} id={`${controlId}-option-${index}`} role="option" data-index={index}
        aria-selected={selected === option.value} aria-disabled={option.disabled || undefined} data-active={active === index}
        onPointerMove={event => !option.disabled && (event.movementX || event.movementY) && setActive(index)} onClick={() => commit(index)}>
        <span>{option.label}</span>{selected === option.value && <span aria-hidden="true">✓</span>}
      </div>)}
    </div>
    {error && <p id={`${controlId}-error`} className="ds-control-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
  </div>;
}
```

"use client";
import { useId } from "react";
import { Area, CartesianGrid, ComposedChart, Line, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts";
import type { TimeSeriesPoint, TimeSeriesLabels } from "../types/charts";
import { chartGeometry } from "../config/charts";
import ChartTooltip from "./chart-tooltip";
export default function TimeSeriesPlot({ data, labels, title }: { data: TimeSeriesPoint[]; labels: TimeSeriesLabels; title: string }) {
  const gradient = `chart-fill-${useId().replaceAll(":", "")}`;
  return <div className="analytics-chart" dir="ltr" role="group" aria-label={title}>
    <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%" minWidth={0}>
      <ComposedChart data={data} accessibilityLayer margin={chartGeometry.margin}>
        <defs><linearGradient id={gradient} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" stopColor="var(--analytics-chart-current)" stopOpacity="0.2" />
          <stop offset="100%" stopColor="var(--analytics-chart-current)" stopOpacity="0" />
        </linearGradient></defs>
        <CartesianGrid vertical={false} stroke="var(--analytics-chart-grid)" strokeDasharray={chartGeometry.dash} />
        <XAxis dataKey="tick" axisLine={false} tickLine={false} minTickGap={chartGeometry.tickGap} tick={{ fill: "var(--text-secondary)" }} />
        <YAxis allowDecimals={false} width={chartGeometry.axisWidth} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} tick={{ fill: "var(--text-secondary)" }} />
        <Tooltip content={<ChartTooltip labels={labels} />} cursor={{ stroke: "var(--border-strong)" }} />
        <Area type="linear" dataKey="current" name={labels.current} fill={`url(#${gradient})`} stroke="var(--analytics-chart-current)"
          strokeWidth={chartGeometry.strokeWidth} isAnimationActive={false} />
        <Line type="linear" dataKey="previous" name={labels.previous} stroke="var(--analytics-chart-previous)"
          strokeDasharray={chartGeometry.dash} strokeWidth={chartGeometry.strokeWidth} dot={false} connectNulls={false} isAnimationActive={false} />
      </ComposedChart>
    </ResponsiveContainer>
  </div>;
}

"use client";
import { formatPlayerTime } from "../helpers/media/format-time";
import { getPlaybackAction } from "../helpers/media/playback-action";
import type { PlayerSnapshot, VideoPlayerLabels } from "../types/video-player";
import PlayerIcon from "./player-icon";
import VideoVolumeControls from "./video-volume-controls";
export default function VideoControls({
  state,
  labels,
  toggle,
  seek,
  toggleMute,
  volume,
  fullscreen,
  fullscreenSupported,
  toggleFullscreen,
}: {
  state: PlayerSnapshot;
  labels: VideoPlayerLabels;
  toggle: () => void;
  seek: (time: number) => void;
  toggleMute: () => void;
  volume: (value: number) => void;
  fullscreen: boolean;
  fullscreenSupported: boolean;
  toggleFullscreen: () => void;
}) {
  const action = getPlaybackAction(state, labels);
  return (
    <div
      className="custom-video-controls"
      role="group"
      aria-label={labels.controls}
      dir="ltr"
    >
      <input
        className="custom-video-seek"
        type="range"
        min={0}
        max={state.duration || 1}
        step="0.1"
        value={state.time}
        aria-label={labels.seek}
        aria-valuetext={`${formatPlayerTime(state.time)} / ${formatPlayerTime(state.duration)}`}
        disabled={!state.ready || state.duration <= 0}
        onChange={(event) => seek(Number(event.target.value))}
      />
      <div className="custom-video-control-row">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="custom-video-control"
          aria-label={action.label}
          title={action.label}
          disabled={!state.ready}
          onClick={toggle}
        >
          <PlayerIcon name={action.icon} />
        </button>
        <span className="custom-video-time">
          <time>{formatPlayerTime(state.time)}</time>
          <span aria-hidden="true"> / </span>
          <time>{formatPlayerTime(state.duration)}</time>
        </span>
        <VideoVolumeControls state={state} labels={labels} toggleMute={toggleMute} volume={volume} />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="custom-video-control"
          aria-label={
            fullscreen ? labels.exitFullscreen : labels.enterFullscreen
          }
          title={fullscreen ? labels.exitFullscreen : labels.enterFullscreen}
          disabled={!fullscreenSupported}
          onClick={toggleFullscreen}
        >
          <PlayerIcon name={fullscreen ? "exit-fullscreen" : "fullscreen"} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

SHA-256: `e453e00064fc8d46b6c444c81641c43cb520102c06f7ae4fbd6f6a3ccf4b44fa`

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Test/build AST boundary inspection. */
const { inspectFunctionSizes } = require("./architecture/function-size.cjs");
const ts = require("typescript"),
  fs = require("node:fs"),
  path = require("node:path");
const normalize = (file) => path.normalize(file).replaceAll("\\", "/");
function inspect(input) {
  const files = new Map(input.map(([file, text]) => [normalize(file), text]));
  const failures = new Set(),
    graph = new Map(),
    sources = new Map();
  const fail = (file, rule, target = "") =>
    failures.add(`${file}: ${rule}${target ? " " + target : ""}`);
  const resolve = (file, request) => {
    let base;
    if (request.startsWith("@/app/")) base = request.slice(2);
    else if (request.startsWith("@platform/")) base = "modules/" + request.slice(10);
    else if (request.startsWith("@/"))
      base = request.slice(2);
    else if (request.startsWith("@khatab/design/"))
      base =
        "packages/design-system/" + request.slice("@khatab/design/".length);
    else if (request.startsWith("."))
      base = path.join(path.dirname(file), request);
    else return request;
    base = normalize(base);
    return (
      [
        base,
        base + ".ts",
        base + ".tsx",
        base + ".json",
        base + "/index.ts",
        base + "/index.tsx",
      ].find((candidate) => files.has(candidate)) ?? base
    );
  };
  for (const [file, text] of files) {
    if (file.endsWith(".css")) {
      if (/^(?:app|modules)\/styles\//.test(file) && !file.endsWith("/theme.css") && /^@import ['"].*packages\/design-system\/styles\/[^'"]+['"];?$/.test(text.trim()))
        fail(file, "redundant shared stylesheet adapter");
      if (/transition\s*:\s*all\b/.test(text)) fail(file, "transition all");
      if (
        file !== "packages/design-system/styles/theme.css" &&
        /--(?:primary-red|bg-main)\s*:/.test(text)

        fail(file, "copied base token ownership");

      file,

      file.endsWith(".tsx") ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS,
    );

    if (/^(?:app|modules)\//.test(file) && declarations.length && declarations.every((node) =>
      ts.isExportDeclaration(node) && node.moduleSpecifier && ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier) && /^(?:packages\/design-system\/|config\/)/.test(resolve(file, node.moduleSpecifier.text))))
      fail(file, "redundant shared forwarding file");
    sources.set(file, source);
    const edges = [];
    source.forEachChild((node) => {
      if (
        !(ts.isImportDeclaration(node) || ts.isExportDeclaration(node)) ||
        !node.moduleSpecifier ||
        node.isTypeOnly ||
        node.importClause?.isTypeOnly
      )
        return;
      const clause = node.importClause?.namedBindings ?? node.exportClause;
      if (
        clause &&
        ts.isNamedImports(clause) &&
        !node.importClause.name &&
        clause.elements.every((item) => item.isTypeOnly)
      )
        return;
      const request = node.moduleSpecifier.text;
      edges.push(resolve(file, request));
      if (
        /design-system\/(?:ui|hooks|types|helpers)/.test(file) &&
        /features|\/app\//.test(request)
      )
        fail(file, "app dependency", request);
    });
    graph.set(file, edges);
    const visit = (node) => {
      if (
        ts.isCallExpression(node) &&
        (node.expression.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ImportKeyword ||
          (ts.isIdentifier(node.expression) &&
            node.expression.text === "require")) &&
        node.arguments.length &&
        ts.isStringLiteral(node.arguments[0])
      ) {
        edges.push(resolve(file, node.arguments[0].text));
      }
      if (
        ts.isJsxAttribute(node) &&
        node.name.getText(source) === "href" &&
        node.initializer &&
        ts.isStringLiteral(node.initializer) &&
        /^\/(?:[a-z0-9-]+\/)?(?:courses|learn|api|dashboard)(?:\/|$)/.test(
          node.initializer.text,
        ) &&
        file.startsWith("modules/components/")
      )
        fail(file, "literal internal destination", node.initializer.text);
      if (
        file.startsWith("modules/") &&
        file !== "modules/config/navigation.ts" &&
        ts.isTemplateExpression(node) &&
        /^\/(?:[a-z0-9-]+\/)?(?:courses|learn|api)\//.test(node.head.text)
      )
        fail(file, "duplicated route builder");
      if (
        /\/app\/.*page\.tsx$/.test(file) &&
        ts.isJsxAttribute(node) &&
        node.name.getText(source) === "className" &&
        node.initializer &&
        ts.isStringLiteral(node.initializer) &&
        /\blms-(?:course-card|resource-card|certificate)\b/.test(
          node.initializer.text,
        )

        fail(file, "page owns reusable card markup");
      ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
    };
    visit(source);
  }
  function reachable(start, predicate) {
    const visited = new Set();
    const walk = (file, chain) => {
      if (predicate(file)) return [...chain, file];
      if (visited.has(file)) return;
      visited.add(file);
      for (const edge of graph.get(file) ?? []) {
        const found = walk(edge, [...chain, file]);
        if (found) return found;
      }
    };
    return walk(start, []);
  }
  for (const [file, source] of sources) {
    const renderer =
      /components\//.test(file) || /design-system\/(?:ui|hooks|helpers)/.test(file);
    const pure =
      /(?:selectors|view-models|renderer|sanitize|validation)\.ts$/.test(file) ||
      /(?:modules\/helpers\/|features\/(?:catalog|learning)\/helpers\/)/.test(file);
    if (renderer || pure) {
      const chain = reachable(
        file,
        (target) => target !== file && /\/data\//.test(target),
      );
      if (chain)
        fail(
          file,
          "transitive concrete content dependency",
          chain.join(" -> "),
        );
    }
    const client = source.statements.some(
      (node) =>
        ts.isExpressionStatement(node) &&
        ts.isStringLiteral(node.expression) &&
        node.expression.text === "use client",
    );
    if (client || pure || /design-system\/(?:ui|hooks|helpers)/.test(file)) {
      const chain = reachable(
        file,
        (target) =>
          /^(?:next\/headers|node:fs|fs|server-only)$/.test(target) ||
          /certificate-font\.json$/.test(target),

  const visiting = new Set(),
    done = new Set();
  const cycle = (file, chain) => {
    if (visiting.has(file)) {
      fail(file, "runtime import cycle", [...chain, file].join(" -> "));
      return;
    }
    if (done.has(file) || !graph.has(file)) return;
    visiting.add(file);
    for (const edge of graph.get(file)) cycle(edge, [...chain, file]);

    done.add(file);
  };

  return [...failures];
}
function collect(directories) {
  const files = [];
  const visit = (directory) => {
    for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      if (["node_modules", ".next", "test-results"].includes(entry.name))
        continue;
      const file = path.join(directory, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory()) visit(file);
      else if (/\.(tsx?|css)$/.test(file))
        files.push([file, fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8")]);
    }
  };
  directories.forEach(visit);
  return files;
}
module.exports = { inspect, collect };
if (require.main === module) {
  const files = collect([
    "app",
    "modules/components",
    "modules/config",
    "modules/data",
    "modules/features",
    "modules/hooks",
    "modules/helpers",
    "modules/lib",
    "modules/styles",
    "modules/types",
    "config",
    "packages/design-system",
  ]);

  console.log(JSON.stringify({ files: files.length, errors }, null, 2));

### File: `scripts/architecture/function-size.cjs`

SHA-256: `a0a3370e692076897cc8b11e2936823550f86d36c3aa624d0ef49e6decb0c6e9`

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- AST-backed production function budgets. */
const ts = require("typescript");
const helper = /\/helpers\//, hook = /\/hooks\//;
function containsMarkup(node) {
  if (ts.isJsxElement(node) || ts.isJsxSelfClosingElement(node) || ts.isJsxFragment(node)) return true;
  return Boolean(ts.forEachChild(node, containsMarkup));
}
function inspectFunctionSizes(file, text) {
  if (/\/(?:data|types|styles)\//.test(file)) return [];
  const source = ts.createSourceFile(file, text, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true);
  const failures = [], lines = text.trimEnd().split("\n").length;
  const fileLimit = helper.test(file) ? 80 : hook.test(file) ? 60 : /(?:\/components\/|\/ui\/|\/app\/|^app\/.*page\.tsx$)/.test(file) ? 100 : undefined;
  if (fileLimit && lines > fileLimit) failures.push(`${file}: file exceeds ${fileLimit} lines (${lines})`);
  const visit = (node) => {
    if (ts.isFunctionLike(node) && node.body && !containsMarkup(node.body)) {
      const start = source.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(node.body.getStart(source)).line;
      const count = source.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(node.body.end).line - start + 1;
      const limit = hook.test(file) ? 45 : 35;
      if (count > limit) failures.push(`${file}:${start + 1}: function exceeds ${limit} lines (${count})`);
    }
    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
  };
  visit(source);
  return failures;
}
module.exports = { inspectFunctionSizes };
```

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Checks commit candidates without exposing secrets. */
const fs = require('node:fs');
const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');
if (fs.existsSync('.env.local')) process.loadEnvFile('.env.local');
const secrets = Object.entries(process.env).filter(([name,value]) => /(?:DB_URL|SERVICE_ROLE_KEY|SECRET_KEY|API_SECRET|CLIENT_SECRET|HASH_API_KEY|PROVIDER_KEY|PASSWORD|ACCESS_TOKEN)$/.test(name) && value?.length >= 8).map(([,value]) => value);
if (process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL) secrets.push(decodeURIComponent(new URL(process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL).password));
const paths = execFileSync('git', ['ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z']).toString().split('\0').filter(Boolean);
const violations = [];
for (const path of paths) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(path) || !fs.lstatSync(path).isFile()) continue;
  const content = fs.readFileSync(path);
  if (secrets.some(value => content.includes(Buffer.from(value))) || /-----BEGIN (?:RSA |OPENSSH |EC )?PRIVATE KEY-----/.test(content.toString())) violations.push(path);
}
console.log(JSON.stringify({ filesChecked: paths.length, violations },null,2));
process.exitCode = violations.length ? 1 : 0;
```

import accounts from "../../config/admin-accounts.json";
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { courses } from "../../modules/data/courses";
import { resources } from "../../modules/data/resources";
const quote = (value: unknown) => `'${String(value).replaceAll("'", "''")}'`;
const statements = ["-- Generated by npm run backend:seed:generate. Public metadata excludes playback URLs."];
for (const [position, course] of courses.entries()) {
  const metadata = { ...course, modules: course.modules.map(section => ({ ...section, lessons: section.lessons.map(lesson => ({ ...lesson, videoUrl: "" })) })) };
  statements.push(`insert into public.courses(slug,metadata,amount,published,position) values (${quote(course.slug)},${quote(JSON.stringify(metadata))}::jsonb,${course.offer.amount},true,${position}) on conflict(slug) do nothing;`);
  for (const section of course.modules) for (const lesson of section.lessons) {
    statements.push(`insert into public.lessons(course_slug,id,preview,video_url) values (${quote(course.slug)},${quote(lesson.id)},${Boolean(lesson.preview)},${quote(lesson.videoUrl)}) on conflict(course_slug,id) do nothing;`);
  }
}
for (const resource of resources) statements.push(`insert into public.resources(id,title,description,type,content) values (${[resource.id,resource.title,resource.description,resource.type,resource.content].map(quote).join(",")}) on conflict(id) do update set title=excluded.title,description=excluded.description,type=excluded.type,content=excluded.content;`);
for (const course of courses) for (const section of course.modules) for (const lesson of section.lessons) for (const id of lesson.resourceIds)
  statements.push(`insert into public.lesson_resources(resource_id,course_slug,lesson_id) values (${[id,course.slug,lesson.id].map(quote).join(",")}) on conflict do nothing;`);
for (const account of accounts) statements.push(`insert into public.admin_allowlist(email) values (${quote(account.email)}) on conflict do nothing;`);
statements.push("insert into public.admin_users(user_id) select id from auth.users where email_confirmed_at is not null and lower(email) in (select email from public.admin_allowlist) on conflict do nothing;");
writeFileSync("supabase/seed.sql", statements.join("\n") + "\n");
```

```typescript
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { uniqueNamesGenerator } from "unique-names-generator";
// Curated friendly words; the package runs only in migration tooling, never in the browser.
const gerunds = ["learning", "drawing", "dancing", "reading", "writing", "running", "swimming", "building", "coding", "singing", "painting", "exploring", "creating", "growing", "dreaming", "traveling"];
const adjectives = ["brave", "kind", "bright", "calm", "clever", "gentle", "happy", "lively", "patient", "proud", "quiet", "sunny", "swift", "warm", "wise", "bold"];
const bases = new Set<string>();
for (let seed = 1; seed <= 10000 && bases.size < 256; seed++) {
  bases.add(uniqueNamesGenerator({ dictionaries: [gerunds, adjectives], separator: "-", length: 2, style: "lowerCase", seed }));
}
if (bases.size !== 256) throw new Error("Incomplete username vocabulary");
const sql = `create or replace function private.username_fallback_base(seed integer)
returns text language sql immutable set search_path='' as $function$
select (array[${[...bases].sort().map(word => `'${word}'`).join(",")}])[1 + (seed % 256)];
$function$;
revoke all on function private.username_fallback_base(integer) from public, anon, authenticated;
`;
writeFileSync(process.argv[2] ?? "/tmp/khatab-username-vocabulary.sql", sql);
```

process.stderr.write(redact(result.stderr));
process.exitCode = result.status ?? 1;

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- One-time Auth provisioning; secrets remain local. */
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');
const accounts = require('../../config/admin-accounts.json');
process.loadEnvFile('.env.local');
const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY;
if (!key) throw new Error('Set SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY in ignored .env.local');
const client = createClient(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, key, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });
(async () => {
  const { data, error } = await client.auth.admin.listUsers({ perPage: 1000 });
  if (error) throw new Error('Cannot access hosted Auth admin API');
  for (const account of accounts) {
    const password = process.env[account.passwordEnvironment];
    if (!password) throw new Error('Missing local account password');
    const existing = data.users.find(user => user.email?.toLowerCase() === account.email);
    const values = { email: account.email, password, email_confirm: true, user_metadata: { name: account.name } };
    const result = existing ? await client.auth.admin.updateUserById(existing.id, values) : await client.auth.admin.createUser(values);
    if (result.error || !result.data.user) throw new Error('Admin provisioning failed; credentials omitted');
    const user = result.data.user;
    const profile = await client.from('profiles').upsert({ id: user.id, name: account.name }, { ignoreDuplicates: true });
    const membership = await client.from('admin_users').upsert({ user_id: user.id });
    if (profile.error || membership.error) throw new Error('Admin membership provisioning failed');
    console.log(`Provisioned verified admin: ${account.email}`);
  }
})().catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1; });
```

  } catch { throw new Error('Hosted verification failed; credentials are deliberately omitted'); }
  finally { await client.end(); }
})().catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode=1; });

const fs=require('node:fs');

const root=path.resolve('docs/evidence/architecture-acceptance');

const before=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'baseline/screens.json')));
const after=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,phase,'screens.json')));
const results=before.map(base=>{
 const current=after.find(item=>item.name===base.name);
 const a=PNG.sync.read(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'baseline',base.name+'.png')));
 const b=PNG.sync.read(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,phase,base.name+'.png')));

 }
 const bounds=[];
 base.geometry.forEach((item,index)=>{
  const next=current.geometry[index];
  if(!next||next.class!==item.class||['x','y','width','height'].some(key=>Math.abs(item[key]-next[key])>1))bounds.push({before:item,after:next});
 });
 return {name:base.name,dimensions:[a.width,a.height,b.width,b.height],pixelRatio:a.width===b.width&&a.height===b.height?changed/(a.width*a.height):null,bounds,overflow:current.overflow,errors:current.errors};
});
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,phase,'comparison.json'),JSON.stringify(results,null,2));

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Server-only Supabase Management API CLI; never bundled. */
const fs=require('node:fs');
process.loadEnvFile('.env.local');
const token=process.env.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN;
if(!token) throw new Error('Add a Supabase personal access token as SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN in ignored .env.local. Auth secret keys cannot configure hosted templates.');
const host=new URL(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL).hostname;
if(!/^[a-z0-9]+\.supabase\.co$/.test(host)) throw new Error('Expected the dedicated hosted Supabase project URL.');
const endpoint=`https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/${host.split('.')[0]}/config/auth`;
const headers={Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'};
const payload=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('supabase/templates/hosted-config.json','utf8'));
async function request(method,body) {
  const result=await fetch(endpoint,{method,headers,body:body&&JSON.stringify(body),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(30000)});
  if(!result.ok) throw new Error(`Supabase Management API returned HTTP ${result.status}; templates were not verified.`);
  return result.json();
}
(async()=>{
  const before=await request('GET');
  fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/khatab-email-templates-before.json',JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(payload).map(key=>[key,before[key]])),null,2),{mode:0o600});
  await request('PATCH',payload);
  const after=await request('GET');
  if(!Object.entries(payload).every(([key,value])=>after[key]===value)) throw new Error('Hosted template verification failed.');
  console.log(`Verified ${Object.keys(payload).length/2} hosted email templates. SMTP, redirects and security notification switches were preserved.`);
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error.message);process.exitCode=1;});

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Build-time generation from canonical CSS; no runtime source parsing. */
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const {
  parseTokens,
  resolveToken,
} = require("../packages/design-system/lib/theme.cjs");
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const base = fs.readFileSync(
  path.join(root, "packages/design-system/styles/theme.css"),
  "utf8",
);
for (const entry of ["app/styles", "modules/styles"]) {
  const tokens = parseTokens([
    base,
    fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, entry, "theme.css"), "utf8"),
  ]);
  const theme = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries({
      primary: "--primary-red",
      background: "--bg-main",
      text: "--text-primary",
      font: "--font-arabic",
    }).map(([key, name]) => [key, resolveToken(tokens, name)]),
  );
  if (entry === "app/styles") {
    theme.workshopMotion = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(tokens)
        .filter((name) => name.startsWith("--workshop-reveal-"))
        .map((name) => {
          const key = name
            .slice("--workshop-reveal-".length)
            .replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter) => letter.toUpperCase());
          const raw = resolveToken(tokens, name);
          return [
            key,
            key === "easing"
              ? raw
              : parseFloat(raw) *
                (raw.endsWith("s") && !raw.endsWith("ms") ? 1000 : 1),
          ];
        }),
    );
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(
    path.join(root, entry, "theme-server.json"),
    JSON.stringify(theme, null, 2) + "\n",
  );
}
// Server-only export asset: baked into the server bundle, independent of runtime cwd.
const certificateFont = fs
  .readFileSync(
    path.join(root, "public/assets/fonts/ibm-plex-arabic-700.ttf"),
  )
  .toString("base64");
fs.writeFileSync(
  path.join(root, "modules/styles/certificate-font.json"),
  JSON.stringify({ base64: certificateFont }) + "\n",
);

// Email HTML shares the canonical theme and is regenerated with each build.
require("node:child_process").execFileSync("npx", ["tsx", "scripts/email/generate.ts"], { stdio: "inherit" });

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Production browser measurements, separate from screenshot capture. */
const fs = require("node:fs"),
  path = require("node:path"),
  { chromium } = require("@playwright/test");
const destination = path.resolve(
  __dirname,
  "../docs/evidence/architecture-acceptance/final",
);
const routes = [
  "/",
  "/courses",
  "/courses?category=motion",
  "/courses?q=missing-term",
  "/courses/editing-foundations",
  "/courses/motion-essentials",
  "/login",
  "/dashboard",
  "/dashboard/courses",
  "/dashboard/profile",
  "/dashboard/resources",
  "/dashboard/certificates",
  "/learn/editing-foundations/first-cut",
  "/courses/unknown-course",
];
(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch();
  const rows = [];
  for (const [app, url, paths] of [
    ["workshop", "http://localhost:3040", ["/7days-freelance"]],
    ["lms", "http://localhost:3040", routes],
  ])
    for (const route of paths) {
      for (let run = 0; run < 5; run++) {
        const context = await browser.newContext({
            viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 },
          }),
          page = await context.newPage();
        await page.addInitScript(() => {
          window.__audit = {
            cls: 0,
            longTasks: [],
            frames: [],
            scrollStart: 0,
            scrollEnd: 0,
          };
          new PerformanceObserver((list) =>
            list.getEntries().forEach((entry) => {
              if (!entry.hadRecentInput) window.__audit.cls += entry.value;
            }),
          ).observe({ type: "layout-shift", buffered: true });
          new PerformanceObserver((list) =>
            window.__audit.longTasks.push(
              ...list
                .getEntries()
                .map((entry) => ({
                  start: entry.startTime,
                  duration: entry.duration,
                })),
            ),
          ).observe({ type: "longtask", buffered: true });
        });
        await page.route("https://www.youtube.com/**", (route) =>
          route.fulfill({ body: "Preview deliberately deferred" }),
        );
        await page.goto(url + route);
        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
        await page.evaluate(async () => {
          window.__audit.scrollStart = performance.now();
          let last = performance.now();
          for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++)
            await new Promise((resolve) =>
              requestAnimationFrame((now) => {
                window.__audit.frames.push(now - last);
                last = now;
                scrollBy(0, 60);
                resolve();
              }),
            );
          window.__audit.scrollEnd = performance.now();
          await new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(resolve));
        });
        rows.push({
          app,
          route,
          run,
          ...(await page.evaluate(() => ({
            ...window.__audit,
            resources: performance
              .getEntriesByType("resource")
              .filter((entry) => /\.(js|css)(\?|$)/.test(entry.name))
              .map((entry) => ({
                url: entry.name.replace(location.origin, ""),
                bytes: entry.encodedBodySize,
              })),
          }))),
        });
        await context.close();
      }
      console.log(`${app} ${route}: five runs`);
    }
  await browser.close();
  fs.writeFileSync(
    path.join(destination, "route-performance.json"),
    JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2) + "\n",
  );
  const median = (values) =>
    values.sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.floor(values.length / 2)];
  const p95 = (values) =>
    [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.floor(values.length * 0.95)];
  const summaries = [];
  for (const key of new Set(rows.map((row) => row.app + " " + row.route))) {
    const runs = rows.filter((row) => row.app + " " + row.route === key);
    summaries.push({
      route: key,
      cls: median(runs.map((row) => row.cls)),
      p95FrameMs: median(runs.map((row) => p95(row.frames))),
      jsBytes: median(
        runs.map((row) =>
          row.resources
            .filter((r) => r.url.includes(".js"))
            .reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.bytes, 0),
        ),
      ),
      cssBytes: median(
        runs.map((row) =>
          row.resources
            .filter((r) => r.url.includes(".css"))
            .reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.bytes, 0),
        ),
      ),
      scrollLongTasks: runs.map(
        (row) =>
          row.longTasks.filter(
            (task) =>
              task.start >= row.scrollStart && task.start <= row.scrollEnd,
          ).length,
      ),
    });
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(
    path.join(destination, "route-performance-summary.json"),
    JSON.stringify(summaries, null, 2) + "\n",
  );
  console.log(JSON.stringify(summaries, null, 2));
  if (
    summaries.some(
      (row) => row.cls > 0.1 || row.scrollLongTasks.some((count) => count > 1),
    )
  )
    process.exitCode = 1;
})().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
```

### File: `scripts/refresh-design-snapshot.cjs`

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Deterministic portable source snapshot, never screenshot regeneration. */
const fs = require("node:fs"),
  path = require("node:path"),
  crypto = require("node:crypto");
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, ".."),
  prompt = path.join(root, "DESIGN_REPRODUCTION_PROMPT.md");
const hash = (text) => crypto.createHash("sha256").update(text).digest("hex");
const files = [];
function collect(relative) {
  const location = path.join(root, relative),
    stat = fs.lstatSync(location);
  if (stat.isSymbolicLink()) return;
  if (stat.isDirectory()) {
    if (
      [
        "node_modules",
        ".next",
        "test-results",
        "test-results-development",
        ".git",
      ].includes(path.basename(relative))
    )
      return;
    for (const name of fs.readdirSync(location).sort())
      collect(path.join(relative, name));
  } else if (
    /\.(ts|tsx|css|json|cjs|mjs|fixture)$/.test(relative) &&
    !relative.endsWith("certificate-font.json") &&
    !relative.endsWith("next-env.d.ts")
  )
    files.push(relative.replaceAll("\\", "/"));
}
for (const directory of [
  "app",
  "config",
  "packages/design-system",
  "modules/components",
  "modules/config",
  "modules/data",
  "modules/features",
  "modules/hooks",
  "modules/helpers",
  "modules/lib",
  "modules/styles",
  "modules/types",
  "scripts",
  "tests",
])
  collect(directory);
for (const file of [
  "package.json",
  "next.config.ts",
  "tsconfig.json",
  "eslint.config.mjs",
  "playwright.config.ts",
  "playwright.development.config.ts",
  "playwright.crossbrowser.config.ts",
])
  if (!files.includes(file)) files.push(file);
files.sort();
const original = fs.readFileSync(prompt, "utf8");
const begin = original.indexOf(
    "## 14. Exact embedded implementation and verification files",
  ),
  end = original.lastIndexOf("\n## 15. Embedded text assets\n");
if (begin < 0 || end < 0) throw new Error("Missing source appendix boundaries");
const appendix = [
  "## 14. Exact embedded implementation and verification files",
  "",
  "Current shared architecture snapshot. Materialize all paths together; run npm ci once at the root using the companion lockfile, then prebuild generation. The separate test fixture is not a shipped application route. Generated .next/node_modules and server font JSON are excluded. Source hashes verify reconstruction, not visual approval.",
  "",
];
for (const file of files) {
  const text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), "utf8");
  const ext = path.extname(file).slice(1);
  appendix.push(
    `### File: \`${file}\``,
    "",
    `SHA-256: \`${hash(text)}\``,
    "",
    `\`\`\`${ext === "tsx" ? "tsx" : ext === "css" ? "css" : ext === "json" ? "json" : "typescript"}`,
    text.trimEnd(),
    "```",
    "",
  );
}
let result =
  original.slice(0, begin) + appendix.join("\n") + "\n" + original.slice(end);
const lock = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "package-lock.json"));
result = result.replace(
  /Companion `package-lock.json`: \*\*\d+ bytes\*\*; SHA-256 `[a-f0-9]+`/,
  `Companion \`package-lock.json\`: **${lock.length} bytes**; SHA-256 \`${hash(lock)}\``,
);
result = result.replace(/\n+LMS companion lockfile:[^\n]+\n+/g, "\n");
if (process.argv.includes("--check")) {
  if (result !== original) throw new Error("Source snapshot is stale");
} else fs.writeFileSync(prompt, result);
console.log(
  `${files.length} source files ${process.argv.includes("--check") ? "verified" : "snapshotted"}`,
);

  const faq =
    before.app === "lms" &&
    before.route === "/" &&

  const duration =
    before.app === "lms" &&
    before.route === "/ta3allam/courses/editing-foundations" &&

  const rowMap = [];
  for (let y = 0; y < a.height; y++)
    if (!cuts.some(([start, end]) => y >= start && y < end)) rowMap.push(y);
  if (a.width !== b.width || rowMap.length !== b.height)
    throw new Error(`Unexpected dimensions ${before.name}`);
  for (let index = 0; index < before.geometry.length; index++) {
    const old = before.geometry[index],
      next = after.geometry[index];
    if (!next || old.class !== next.class)
      throw new Error(`Unexpected geometry class ${before.name} ${old.class}`);
    let expectedY = old.y,
      expectedHeight = old.height;
    if (faq && old.id === "faq") expectedHeight -= 80;
    if (faq && old.class === "faq-answer-panel") {
      const position = before.geometry
        .filter((item) => item.class === "faq-answer-panel")
        .indexOf(old);
      expectedY -= position * 16;
      expectedHeight = 0;
    }
    if (faq && old.class === "section final-cta-section") expectedY -= 80;
    if (
      !near(old.x, next.x) ||
      !near(old.width, next.width) ||
      !near(expectedY, next.y) ||
      !near(expectedHeight, next.height)
    )
      throw new Error(`Unexpected geometry ${before.name} ${old.class}`);
  }
  let changed = 0,
    total = 0;
  const notes = [];
  if (faq)
    notes.push(
      "Five erroneous 16px collapsed FAQ gaps removed; lower pixels aligned by those exact rows.",
    );
  if (duration)
    notes.push(
      "Numeric duration now two hours: metadata reflows by 38px; only its text region is excepted, lower raster edges allow the documented 1px geometry tolerance.",
    );
  if (faq && before.width === 320)
    notes.push(
      "Baseline capture missed the instructor portrait despite matching frame geometry. Asset-load region is excluded from comparison; current loaded source is separately verified against the approved asset.",
    );
  for (let y = 0; y < b.height; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < b.width; x++) {
      if (duration && y >= 660 && y < 730) continue;
      if (
        faq &&
        before.width === 320 &&
        x >= 16 &&
        x < 304 &&
        y >= 4185 &&
        y < 4550
      )
        continue;
      const j = (y * b.width + x) * 4;
      let delta = 255;
      for (const offset of duration && y >= 727 ? [-1, 0, 1] : [0]) {
        const yy = Math.max(0, Math.min(a.height - 1, rowMap[y] + offset)),
          i = (yy * a.width + x) * 4;
        delta = Math.min(
          delta,
          Math.max(
            Math.abs(a.data[i] - b.data[j]),
            Math.abs(a.data[i + 1] - b.data[j + 1]),
            Math.abs(a.data[i + 2] - b.data[j + 2]),
          ),
        );
      }
      total++;
      if (delta > 25.5) changed++;
    }
  const ratio = changed / total,
    pass = ratio <= 0.001 && after.overflow <= 1 && !after.errors.length;
  results.push({
    name: before.name,
    pass,
    pixelRatio: ratio,
    notes,
    rawPixelRatio: comparison.pixelRatio,
  });
}
fs.writeFileSync(
  path.join(root, phase + "/visual-gate.json"),
  JSON.stringify(results, null, 2) + "\n",
);
const failures = results.filter((item) => !item.pass);
console.log(
  `${results.length - failures.length}/${results.length} screens passed; ${results.filter((item) => item.notes.length).length} narrowly documented baseline exceptions.`,
);
if (failures.length) {
  console.error(failures);
  process.exitCode = 1;
}
```

### File: `tests/architecture.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `58af43a38aa62ed0f5adefeb9d48dc603c0155c93443a42fb8bc911ba39fd695`

```typescript
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import ts from "typescript";
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

function sources(directory: string): string[] {
  return readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
    const path = join(directory, entry.name);
    return entry.isDirectory()
      ? sources(path)
      : /\.tsx?$/.test(path)
        ? [path]
        : [];
  });
}

test("renderers and hooks do not import page data or configuration", () => {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const path of [...sources("app/components"), ...sources("app/hooks")]) {
    const source = ts.createSourceFile(
      path,
      readFileSync(path, "utf8"),
      ts.ScriptTarget.Latest,
      true,
    );
    source.forEachChild((node) => {
      if (
        !ts.isImportDeclaration(node) ||
        !ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier)
      )
        return;
      const target = node.moduleSpecifier.text;
      if (/\/(data|config)\//.test(target))
        violations.push(`${path}: ${target}`);
      if (path.includes("components/ui/") && /workshop/.test(target))
        violations.push(`${path}: feature dependency ${target}`);
    });
  }
  expect(violations).toEqual([]);
});

test("component content and asset destinations are supplied through props", () => {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const path of sources("app/components")) {
    const source = ts.createSourceFile(
      path,
      readFileSync(path, "utf8"),
      ts.ScriptTarget.Latest,
      true,
    );
    const visit = (node: ts.Node) => {
      if (
        (ts.isStringLiteral(node) || ts.isJsxText(node)) &&
        /[\u0600-\u06ff]|https?:\/\/|\/assets\//.test(node.text)
      )
        violations.push(`${path}: ${node.text}`);
      ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
    };
    visit(source);
  }
  expect(violations).toEqual([]);
});

test("reusable modules do not create accidental Next.js special-file routes", () => {
  const specialFiles =
    /^(page|route|layout|template|default|loading|error|not-found|global-error|icon|apple-icon|opengraph-image|twitter-image)\.tsx?$/;
  expect(
    [
      "app/components",
      "app/hooks",
      "app/data",
      "app/lib",
      "packages/design-system/types",
      "app/config",
    ]
      .flatMap(sources)
      .filter((path) => specialFiles.test(path.split("/").at(-1)!)),
  ).toEqual([]);
});

const demo = { name: "طالب التجربة", email: "student@example.com", password: "demo-pass-123", confirmPassword: "demo-pass-123" };
async function fill(page: Page, signup = false) {
  if (signup) await page.getByLabel("اسمك", { exact: true }).fill(demo.name);
  await page.getByLabel("البريد الإلكتروني", { exact: true }).fill(demo.email);
  await page.getByLabel("كلمة المرور", { exact: true }).fill(demo.password);
  if (signup) await page.getByLabel("تأكيد كلمة المرور", { exact: true }).fill(demo.confirmPassword);
}
test("shared validation normalizes identity, preserves passwords and rejects malformed values", () => {
  for (const input of [null, [], {}, { email: 123, password: false }]) expect(validateAuth(input, "login")).toEqual({ valid: false, errors: { email: "emailRequired", password: "passwordRequired" } });
  expect(validateAuth({}, "signup")).toEqual({ valid: false, errors: { name: "nameRequired", email: "emailRequired", password: "passwordRequired", confirmPassword: "confirmationRequired" } });
  const valid = validateAuth({ ...demo, name: ` ${demo.name} `, email: " STUDENT@EXAMPLE.COM ", password: " password ", confirmPassword: " password " }, "signup");
  expect(valid).toMatchObject({ valid: true, values: { name: demo.name, email: demo.email, password: " password " } });
  expect(validateAuth({ ...demo, name: "a", email: "invalid", password: "short", confirmPassword: "other" }, "signup")).toMatchObject({ valid: false, errors: { name: "nameLength", email: "emailInvalid", password: "passwordLength", confirmPassword: "confirmationMismatch" } });
  expect(validateAuth({ ...demo, name: "a".repeat(authPolicy.nameMax + 1), password: "a".repeat(authPolicy.passwordMax + 1) }, "signup")).toMatchObject({ valid: false, errors: { name: "nameLength", password: "passwordLength" } });
  expect(validateAuth({ email: demo.email, password: demo.password }, "login").valid).toBe(true);
});

  for (const path of ["login", "signup"]) {

    expect((await request.post(`/api/auth/${path}`, { data: demo, headers: { Origin: "https://other.example" } })).status()).toBe(403);

    await expect(page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني',{exact:true})).toBeEditable();verify(true,'Admin email is editable in its own dashboard');

const { Client } = require('pg');
const parse = response => JSON.parse(response.data);
module.exports = async function accountSettings({ admin, provision, anonymous, verify, url, config }) {
  const manager = await provision('Account Manager'), student = await provision('Account Student');

  verify((await student.api(settings,{...body,currentPassword:''})).status===400,'Phone changes require current password');
  verify((await student.api(settings,{...body,currentPassword:'Wrong-Password-19!'})).status===400,'Incorrect current password rejected');
  verify((await student.api(settings,{...body,email:'forged@example.com'})).status===403,'Students cannot change email through settings');
  verify((await student.api('/api/profile',{name:'Account Student',email:'forged@example.com'})).status===403,'Legacy profile endpoint cannot bypass email lock');

  verify((await student.api(settings,{...body,firstName:'Updated',lastName:'Student',currentPassword:''})).status===200,'Non-critical profile changes do not require a password');
  const stored=(await admin.from('profiles').select('name,first_name,last_name').eq('id',student.id).single()).data;
  verify(stored.name==='Updated Student' && stored.first_name==='Updated' && stored.last_name==='Student','Normalized name fields remain consistent with display name');
    const managerProfile=await read(manager);
  const duplicate=await student.api(settings,{...body,username:managerProfile.username,firstName:'Failed',phone:'+20-1001234567'});
  verify(duplicate.status===409,'Duplicate username rejects the entire settings save');
  const unchanged=await read(student);verify(unchanged.name==='Updated Student' && unchanged.phone===body.phone,'Failed settings save cannot partially change name or phone');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.rpc('save_account_settings',{p_user_id:student.id,p_first_name:'Forged',p_last_name:'User',p_username:'forged-user',p_phone:'+201201024880'})).error),'Atomic settings RPC is server-only');

  verify((await student.direct.from('account_contacts').select('*').eq('user_id',manager.id)).data.length===0,'Contact RLS hides other users');
  const catalog=parse(await anonymous('/api/courses')).courses, source=catalog.find(course=>course.delivery!=='live');
  const free={...source,slug:'backend-test-account-free',offer:{...source.offer,amount:0}};
  const free2={...free,slug:'backend-test-account-next'};
  await admin.from('courses').upsert([{slug:free.slug,metadata:free,amount:0,published:true,position:99},{slug:free2.slug,metadata:free2,amount:0,published:true,position:100}]);
  try {

    verify(Boolean((await admin.from('enrollments').insert({user_id:student.id,course_slug:free.slug})).error),'Database also guards trusted new grants');

    verify((await student.api('/api/enrollments',{courseSlug:free2.slug})).status===403,'Phone edit blocks another new course');

    } finally {await db.end();}
    const credentials={currentPassword:student.password,password:'New-Account-Password-19!',confirmPassword:'New-Account-Password-19!'};
    verify((await student.api('/api/account/password',{...credentials,confirmPassword:'Mismatch-Password-19!'})).status===400,'Password confirmation mismatch rejected');
    verify((await student.api('/api/account/password',{...credentials,currentPassword:'Incorrect-Password-19!'})).status===400,'Password change verifies current password');

    verify((await student.api('/api/account/password',credentials)).status===200,'Current-password authenticated change succeeds');

    student.password=credentials.password;

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Isolated analytics database and responsive browser acceptance. */
const {Client}=require('pg');
const {chromium,expect}=require('@playwright/test');
const fs=require('node:fs');
module.exports=async function analyticsChecks({admin,provision,anonymous,verify,url,config}) {
  const manager=await provision('Analytics Manager');
  await admin.from('admin_users').insert({user_id:manager.id});
  const initial=JSON.parse((await manager.api('/api/admin/analytics')).data);
  const current=await provision('Analytics Current'), previous=await provision('Analytics Previous');
  verify((await anonymous('/api/admin/analytics')).status===401,'Anonymous analytics access denied');
  verify((await current.api('/api/admin/analytics')).status===403,'Student analytics access denied');
  verify(Boolean((await current.direct.rpc('admin_dashboard_snapshot')).error),'Direct student RPC denied');
  const db=new Client({connectionString:config.DB_URL});await db.connect();
  try {
    await db.query("update auth.users set raw_user_meta_data=raw_user_meta_data || '{\"acquisition_source\":\"youtube\"}'::jsonb where id=$1",[current.id]);
    await db.query("update auth.users set created_at=((date_trunc('week',now() at time zone 'Africa/Cairo') - interval '7 days') + ((now() at time zone 'Africa/Cairo')-date_trunc('week',now() at time zone 'Africa/Cairo'))/2) at time zone 'Africa/Cairo' where id=$1",[previous.id]);
    const {rows}=await db.query('select slug from public.courses order by slug limit 2');
    for(const row of rows) await db.query('insert into public.enrollments(user_id,course_slug) values($1,$2)',[current.id,row.slug]);
    await db.query('insert into public.enrollments(user_id,course_slug,created_at) select id,$2,created_at from auth.users where id=$1',[previous.id,rows[0].slug]);
    const response=await manager.api('/api/admin/analytics'),data=JSON.parse(response.data);
    verify(response.status===200&&/no-store/.test(response.headers.get('cache-control')),'Admin analytics returns uncached aggregates');
    verify(data.timezone==='Africa/Cairo','Analytics uses explicit Cairo timezone');
    verify(data.metrics.totalStudents===initial.metrics.totalStudents+2,'Admin accounts excluded from total students');
    verify(data.metrics.studentsWeek===initial.metrics.studentsWeek+1,'Current week excludes prior-week signup');
    verify(data.metrics.studentsPreviousWeek===initial.metrics.studentsPreviousWeek+1,'Previous week uses equal elapsed duration');
    verify(data.metrics.enrollmentsWeek===initial.metrics.enrollmentsWeek+2,'Actual enrollments counted separately from signups');
    verify(data.metrics.enrollmentsPreviousWeek===initial.metrics.enrollmentsPreviousWeek+1,'Previous enrollment comparison counts actual records');
    verify(data.courses.week[0].count>=1&&data.courses.all[0].count>=data.courses.week[0].count,'Popular course ranking is based on enrollments');
    verify(data.sources.some(s=>s.source==='youtube'&&s.count===1),'Recorded attribution retained');
    verify(data.sources.some(s=>s.source==='unknown'),'Missing attribution stays unknown');
    verify(!JSON.stringify(data).includes(current.email)&&!('revenue' in data.metrics),'Aggregate response omits email and invented revenue');
    verify(data.daily.length===Number(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en',{timeZone:'Africa/Cairo',day:'numeric'}).format(new Date())),'Daily chart ends at Cairo today');
    const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true});
    try {
      const page=await browser.newPage(); const errors=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));
      await page.goto(url+'/login');await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني',{exact:true}).fill(manager.email);
      await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور',{exact:true}).fill(manager.password);await page.getByRole('button',{name:'تسجيل الدخول',exact:true}).click();
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(url+'/admin/dashboard');await expect(page.getByRole('heading',{name:'المنصة في أرقام',exact:true})).toBeVisible();
      verify(!/Supabase|مصدر البيانات/.test(await page.locator('.analytics-overview').innerText()),'Technical data-source copy removed from Home');
      await expect(page.locator('.analytics-chart-summary strong')).toHaveText(String(data.metrics.studentsMonth));
      fs.mkdirSync('docs/evidence/admin-analytics',{recursive:true});
      for(const width of [320,390,768,1440]) {
        await page.setViewportSize({width,height:960});await expect(page.locator('.recharts-surface')).toBeVisible();
        verify(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth),`Analytics has no overflow at ${width}px`);
        await page.screenshot({path:`docs/evidence/admin-analytics/home-${width}.png`,fullPage:true});
      }
      await page.getByLabel('اشتراكات',{exact:true}).check();await expect(page.getByLabel('اشتراكات',{exact:true})).toBeChecked();
      await expect(page.locator('.analytics-chart-summary strong')).toHaveText(String(data.metrics.enrollmentsMonth));
      await page.getByText('عرض الأرقام اليومية',{exact:true}).click();await expect(page.locator('.analytics-data-table table')).toBeVisible();
      await page.getByRole('link',{name:'هذا الشهر',exact:true}).click();await expect(page).toHaveURL(/period=month/);
      await page.getByRole('link',{name:'كل الوقت',exact:true}).click();await expect(page).toHaveURL(/period=all/);
      await page.getByRole('button',{name:'تحديث الأرقام',exact:true}).click();await expect(page.getByRole('button',{name:'تحديث الأرقام',exact:true})).toBeEnabled();
      verify(await page.getByText('غير متاح',{exact:true}).count()===0,'Week and month revenue show actual verified-payment totals');
      await page.getByRole('link',{name:'المستخدمون',exact:true}).click();await expect(page).toHaveURL(url+'/admin/dashboard/users');
      await expect(page.getByRole('heading',{name:'إدارة المستخدمين',exact:true})).toBeVisible();
      verify(errors.length===0,'Chart and navigation have no browser errors');
    } finally {await browser.close();}
    await admin.from('admin_users').delete().eq('user_id',manager.id);
    verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/analytics')).status===403,'Revoked admin denied immediately');
    verify(Boolean((await manager.direct.rpc('admin_dashboard_snapshot')).error),'Revoked admin RPC denied');
  } finally {await db.end();}
};

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Isolated course-management integration checks. */
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { randomUUID } = require('node:crypto');
module.exports = async ({ admin, provision, anonymous, verify, url }) => {
 const manager = await provision('Catalog Manager'), student = await provision('Catalog Student');
 assert.ok(!(await admin.from('admin_users').insert({user_id:manager.id})).error);
 const prefix = 'catalog-' + randomUUID().slice(0,8), slugs = [];
 const body = index => ({slug:`${prefix}-${index}`,title:`${prefix} دورة ${index}`,description:'وصف دورة تجريبية للاختبار',amount:100+index,category:'editing',delivery:'recorded'});
 const parse = response => JSON.parse(response.data);
 const list = query => manager.api('/api/admin/courses?' + new URLSearchParams(query));
 try {
  verify((await anonymous('/api/admin/courses')).status === 401,'Guest cannot read course management');
  verify((await student.api('/api/admin/courses')).status === 403,'Student cannot read course management');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.rpc('search_admin_courses')).error),'Direct student RPC cannot read course management');
  verify((await student.api('/api/admin/courses',body(0))).status === 403,'Student cannot create course');
  verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/courses',body(0),{headers:{Origin:'https://attacker.example'}})).status === 403,'Cross-origin course creation blocked');
  for (const value of [{slug:'Bad Slug'}, {slug:'new'}, {amount:-1}, {category:'all'}, {delivery:'unknown'}, {title:''}]) {
   // "new" is reserved by the create-page route.
   verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/courses',{...body(0),...value})).status === 400,`Invalid course creation blocked: ${Object.keys(value)[0]}=${Object.values(value)[0]}`);
  }
  for (let index=0;index<7;index++) {
   const response=await manager.api('/api/admin/courses',body(index));
   verify(response.status===201,`Course draft ${index} created`);slugs.push(body(index).slug);
  }
  verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/courses',body(0))).status===409,'Duplicate course slug rejected');
  let result=parse(await list({q:prefix}));
  verify(result.total===7 && result.courses.length===5 && result.hasNext,'Five courses per page with total and next page');
  verify(result.courses.every(course=>!course.published && course.lessons===0 && course.chapters===0 && course.sections===0 && course.students===0 && course.createdAt && course.updatedAt),'Empty drafts have real timestamps and zero separate counts');
  verify(parse(await list({q:prefix,page:'2'})).courses.length===2,'Second page returns remaining courses');
  verify(parse(await list({q:prefix,page:'3'})).courses.length===0,'Out-of-range page is empty');
  verify((await anonymous('/api/courses/'+slugs[0])).status===404,'Draft is hidden from public catalog');
  const draft=parse(await manager.api('/api/admin/courses/'+slugs[0])).course;
  const edit={title:draft.title,description:draft.description,amount:200,category:'editing',thumbnailUrl:'',introVideoUrl:'',published:false};
  verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/courses/'+slugs[0],edit)).status===200,'Empty draft can be edited');
  verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/courses/'+slugs[0],{...edit,published:true})).status===400,'Empty recorded draft cannot be published');
  const timestamps=(await admin.from('courses').select('created_at,updated_at').eq('slug',slugs[0]).single()).data;
  const seed=(await admin.from('courses').select('metadata').eq('slug','editing-foundations').single()).data.metadata;
  const metadata={...seed,slug:slugs[0],title:body(0).title,modules:seed.modules.map((chapter,index)=>({...chapter,sections:index===0?[{id:'first-section',title:'قسم تجريبي',lessonIds:[chapter.lessons[0].id]}]:[]}))};
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('courses').update({metadata,published:true}).eq('slug',slugs[0])).error);
  const lesson=metadata.modules[0].lessons[0];
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('lessons').insert({id:lesson.id,course_slug:slugs[0],video_url:'/assets/video/workshop-intro.mp4'})).error);
  result=parse(await list({q:slugs[0]})).courses[0];
  verify(result.lessons===1 && result.chapters===metadata.modules.length && result.sections===1,'Chapter, section and actual lesson counts are distinct');
  let stored=(await admin.from('courses').select('created_at,updated_at').eq('slug',slugs[0]).single()).data;
  verify(stored.created_at===timestamps.created_at && new Date(stored.updated_at)>new Date(timestamps.updated_at),'Curriculum changes update date without changing creation date');
  const previous=stored.updated_at;
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('lessons').delete().eq('course_slug',slugs[0])).error);
  stored=(await admin.from('courses').select('updated_at').eq('slug',slugs[0]).single()).data;
  verify(new Date(stored.updated_at)>new Date(previous),'Lesson deletion updates course timestamp');
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('lessons').insert({id:lesson.id,course_slug:slugs[0],video_url:'/assets/video/workshop-intro.mp4'})).error);
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('enrollments').insert({user_id:student.id,course_slug:slugs[0]})).error);
  verify(parse(await list({q:prefix,sort:'students',direction:'desc'})).courses[0].students===1,'Sort by students places subscribed course first');
  verify(parse(await list({q:prefix,sort:'students',direction:'asc'})).courses[0].students===0,'Ascending student sort reverses order');
  verify(parse(await list({q:prefix,sort:'created',direction:'asc'})).courses[0].slug===slugs[0],'Creation sorting ascending');
  verify(parse(await list({q:prefix,sort:'created',direction:'desc'})).courses[0].slug===slugs[6],'Creation sorting descending');
  verify(parse(await list({q:prefix,sort:'updated',direction:'desc'})).courses[0].slug===slugs[0],'Updated sorting reflects latest real edit');
  verify(parse(await list({q:prefix,status:'published',category:'editing',delivery:'recorded'})).total===1,'Search, publication, category and delivery filters combine');
  verify(parse(await list({q:prefix,status:'draft'})).total===6,'Draft filter excludes published course');
  verify(parse(await manager.api('/api/admin/courses?q='+prefix+'&status=draft&status=published')).total===7,'Publication statuses combine without dropping either group');
  verify(parse(await list({q:'editing-foundations'})).courses[0].createdAt===null,'Unknown legacy creation dates remain unknown');
  verify(parse(await list({q:prefix,category:'motion'})).total===0,'Category filter combines with search');
  for (const q of ['%','_']) verify(parse(await list({q})).total===0,`Search treats ${q} literally`);
  for (const query of [{sort:'price'},{direction:'bad'},{status:'bad'},{page:'0'},{page:'-1'},{q:'x'.repeat(101)}]) verify((await list(query)).status===400,'Invalid course query rejected');
  verify(Boolean((await manager.direct.rpc('search_admin_courses',{p_limit:6})).error),'RPC caps page size at five');
  const remove=slug=>'/api/admin/courses/'+slug+'/delete';
  verify((await student.api(remove(slugs[1]),{confirmSlug:slugs[1]})).status===403,'Student cannot delete course');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.rpc('delete_admin_course',{p_slug:slugs[1]})).error),'Direct student deletion RPC denied');
  verify((await manager.api(remove(slugs[1]),{confirmSlug:slugs[1]},{headers:{Origin:'https://attacker.example'}})).status===403,'Cross-origin deletion blocked');
  verify((await manager.api(remove(slugs[1]),{confirmSlug:'wrong'})).status===400,'Delete confirmation must match course');
  verify((await manager.api(remove(slugs[0]),{confirmSlug:slugs[0]})).status===409,'Subscribed course deletion blocked');
  await require('./admin-course-management-browser.cjs')({manager,verify,url,prefix,slugs});
  verify((await manager.api(remove(slugs[2]),{confirmSlug:slugs[2]})).status===200,'Unsubscribed course can be deleted');
  verify((await manager.api(remove(slugs[2]),{confirmSlug:slugs[2]})).status===404,'Missing course deletion returns not found');
  const liveInput={...body(8),delivery:'live'};
  verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/courses',liveInput)).status===201,'Live draft creation succeeds without duration');slugs.push(liveInput.slug);
  const liveEndpoint='/api/admin/courses/'+liveInput.slug,liveEdit={...edit,title:liveInput.title,published:true};
  const missingDuration=await manager.api(liveEndpoint,liveEdit);
  verify(missingDuration.status===400 && parse(missingDuration).code==='COURSE_DURATION_REQUIRED','Live publication identifies missing duration explicitly');
  verify((await manager.api(liveEndpoint,{...liveEdit,published:false})).status===200,'Live course remains editable as a draft without duration');
  verify((await manager.api(liveEndpoint,{...liveEdit,duration:'x'.repeat(81)})).status===400,'Oversized course duration rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(liveEndpoint,{...liveEdit,duration:42})).status===400,'Non-text course duration rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(liveEndpoint,{...liveEdit,duration:' ٧ أيام '})).status===200,'Live course publishes after providing duration');
  verify(parse(await anonymous('/api/courses/'+liveInput.slug)).duration==='٧ أيام','Saved duration is normalized and public');
  verify((await manager.api(liveEndpoint,liveEdit)).status===200 && parse(await manager.api(liveEndpoint)).course.duration==='٧ أيام','Legacy edits without duration retain existing duration');
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('admin_users').delete().eq('user_id',manager.id)).error);
  verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/courses')).status===403,'Revoked admin access is immediately denied');
  verify(Boolean((await manager.direct.rpc('search_admin_courses')).error),'RPC rechecks revoked membership');
 } finally { await admin.from('enrollments').delete().in('course_slug',slugs);await admin.from('courses').delete().in('slug',slugs); }
};
