```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Real isolated database and browser fixtures. */
const { Client } = require('pg');
const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
module.exports = async function userSearchChecks({ admin, provision, anonymous, verify, url, config }) {
  const manager = await provision('Search Manager');
  await admin.from('admin_users').insert({ user_id: manager.id });
  const prefix = `Filter-${Date.now()}`, fixtures = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < 8; index++) fixtures.push(await provision(`${prefix} Account ${index}`));
  const [suspended, banned, old, expired, promoted] = fixtures;
  await manager.api(`/api/admin/users/${suspended.id}`, { action: 'suspend', period: 'week' });
  await manager.api(`/api/admin/users/${banned.id}`, { action: 'ban' });
  await manager.api(`/api/admin/users/${promoted.id}`, { action: 'promote' });
  const db = new Client({ connectionString: config.DB_URL });
  await db.connect();
  try {
    await db.query("update auth.users set created_at = now() - interval '30 days' where id = $1", [old.id]);
    await db.query("update auth.users set banned_until = now() - interval '1 minute' where id = $1", [expired.id]);
  } finally { await db.end(); }
  const params = { p_page: 1, p_limit: 5, p_search: '', p_statuses: [], p_admins_only: false };
  verify(Boolean((await fixtures[5].direct.rpc('search_admin_users', params)).error), 'Database rejects direct student user search');
  verify((await anonymous('/api/admin/users?q=' + prefix)).status === 401, 'Anonymous cannot search accounts');
  const get = async query => { const response = await manager.api('/api/admin/users?' + query); verify(response.status === 200, `Search request succeeds: ${query}`); return JSON.parse(response.data); };
  const first = await get('q=' + prefix), second = await get('q=' + prefix + '&page=2');
  verify(first.users.length === 5 && first.total === 8 && first.hasNext, 'Search paginates five of eight matches');
  verify(second.users.length === 3 && second.total === 8 && !second.hasNext, 'Second page includes remaining matches');
  verify(new Set([...first.users, ...second.users].map(user => user.id)).size === 8, 'Pages contain no overlapping or missing accounts');
  const specific = await get('q=' + encodeURIComponent(old.email.toUpperCase()));
  verify(specific.users.length === 1 && specific.users[0].id === old.id, 'Case-insensitive email search finds account beyond first page');
  const username = (await manager.api('/api/admin/users/' + old.id)).data;
  const byUsername = await get('q=' + JSON.parse(username).user.username);
  verify(byUsername.users[0]?.id === old.id, 'Username search works');
  const blocked = await get('q=' + prefix + '&status=suspended');
  verify(blocked.total === 1 && blocked.users[0].id === suspended.id, 'Suspended filter excludes permanent bans and expired suspension');
  const bannedOnly = await get('q=' + prefix + '&status=banned');
  verify(bannedOnly.total === 1 && bannedOnly.users[0].id === banned.id, 'Banned filter matches permanent restriction');
  const both = await get('q=' + prefix + '&status=suspended&status=banned&newcomers=1');
  verify(both.total === 2, 'Both status filters combine with search and newcomer window');
  const admins = await get('q=' + prefix + '&admins=1&newcomers=1');
  verify(admins.total === 1 && admins.users[0].id === promoted.id, 'Admin and newcomer filters intersect with search');
  const newcomers = await get('q=' + prefix + '&newcomers=1');
  verify(newcomers.total === 7 && !newcomers.users.some(user => user.id === old.id), 'Newcomers excludes accounts older than seven days');
  verify((await get('q=' + prefix + '&admins=1&status=banned')).total === 0, 'Contradictory filters show an empty result');
  verify((await get('q=' + encodeURIComponent("%' OR 1=1 --"))).total === 0, 'Search treats wildcard and SQL syntax literally');
  for (const query of ['status=unknown', 'admins=yes', 'newcomers=30', 'q=' + 'x'.repeat(101)])
    verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/users?' + query)).status === 400, `Malformed query rejected: ${query.slice(0, 30)}`);
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  try {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 900 } });
    const errors = []; page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message));
    await page.goto(url + '/login');
    await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true }).fill(manager.email);
    await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(manager.password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الدخول', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(url + '/admin/dashboard');
    await page.goto(url + '/admin/dashboard/users');
    await page.getByRole('searchbox').fill(prefix);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تطبيق البحث والفلاتر' }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp('q=' + prefix));
    await expect(page.locator('.lms-admin-table tbody tr')).toHaveCount(5);
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'التالي', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp('page=2.*q=' + prefix));
    await expect(page.locator('.lms-admin-table tbody tr')).toHaveCount(3);
    await page.getByLabel('المنضمون خلال آخر ٧ أيام').check();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تطبيق البحث والفلاتر' }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp('newcomers=1'));
    verify(!new URL(page.url()).searchParams.has('page'), 'Changing filters resets pagination to page one');
    await expect(page.locator('.lms-admin-table tbody tr')).toHaveCount(5);
    await page.getByLabel('معلّق', { exact: true }).check();
    await page.getByLabel('محظور', { exact: true }).check();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تطبيق البحث والفلاتر' }).click();
    await expect(page.locator('.lms-admin-table tbody tr')).toHaveCount(2);
    verify(await page.getByRole('searchbox').inputValue() === prefix, 'Combined filters preserve search');
    await page.screenshot({ path: 'docs/evidence/admin-dashboard/filters-mobile.png', fullPage: true });
    await page.reload(); await expect(page.getByLabel('معلّق', { exact: true })).toBeChecked();
    await page.goBack(); await expect(page.getByLabel('معلّق', { exact: true })).not.toBeChecked();
    verify(true, 'Filter values survive refresh and browser history');
    for (const width of [320, 390, 768, 1440]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
      verify(await page.evaluate(() => Math.max(document.body.scrollWidth, document.documentElement.scrollWidth) <= innerWidth), `Search/filter UI fits ${width}px`);
    }
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'مسح الفلاتر', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(url + '/admin/dashboard/users');
    await expect(page.getByRole('searchbox')).toHaveValue('');
    verify((await page.locator('.lms-admin-table tbody tr').count()) <= 5, 'Clear filters keeps five-record page limit');
    verify(errors.length === 0, 'Search/filter browser has no JavaScript errors');
  } finally { await browser.close(); }
};
```

### File: `tests/backend/admin-users.cjs`

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Isolated real Auth, API, RLS and browser acceptance tests. */
module.exports = async function userManagementChecks({ admin, provision, anonymous, student, verify, url }) {
  const manager = await provision('User Manager'), target = await provision('Moderation Student');
  await admin.from('admin_users').insert({ user_id: manager.id });
  const base = '/api/admin/users', endpoint = `${base}/${target.id}`;
  const json = response => JSON.parse(response.data);
  verify((await anonymous(base)).status === 401, 'Anonymous cannot list private users');
  verify((await anonymous('/admin/dashboard')).headers.get('location')?.includes('/login'), 'Anonymous admin dashboard redirects to login');
  verify((await student.api(base)).status === 403, 'Student cannot list private users');
  const deniedPage = await student.api('/admin/dashboard');
  verify(deniedPage.headers.get('location')?.endsWith('/dashboard') || (deniedPage.data.includes('NEXT_REDIRECT') && deniedPage.data.includes('/dashboard')), 'Student admin page redirects to private student dashboard');
  verify((await student.api(endpoint)).status === 403, 'Student cannot read another user detail');
  verify((await student.api(endpoint,{ action: 'promote' })).status === 403, 'Student cannot promote users');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.rpc('promote_admin_user',{ target_id: student.id })).error), 'Database rejects direct student role promotion');
  const list = await manager.api(base);
  verify(list.status === 200 && json(list).users.some(user => user.id === target.id && user.email === target.email), 'Admin sees names usernames and emails');
  verify(!list.data.includes('encrypted_password') && !list.data.includes('access_token'), 'User listing exposes only selected public account fields');
  verify(/no-store/.test(list.headers.get('cache-control')), 'User data is never cached');
  verify((await manager.api(base + '?page=-1')).status === 400, 'Invalid pagination rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(base + '?page=99999')).status === 200 && json(await manager.api(base + '?page=99999')).users.length === 0, 'Empty pagination is handled');
  verify((await manager.api(`${base}/not-an-id`)).status === 400, 'Malformed user ID rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(`${base}/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000`)).status === 404, 'Unknown user returns 404');
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint, { action: 'suspend', period: 'forever' })).status === 400, 'Unsupported suspension duration rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint, { action: 'remove' }, { headers: { Origin: 'https://attacker.example' } })).status === 403, 'Cross-origin user deletion rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(`${base}/${manager.id}`, { action: 'remove' })).status === 403, 'Admin cannot delete self');
  verify((await manager.api(`${base}/${manager.id}`, { action: 'ban' })).status === 403, 'Admin cannot ban self');
  verify(Boolean((await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(manager.id,{ ban_duration: '24h' })).error), 'Database prevents administrator ban races');
  await admin.from('enrollments').insert({ user_id: target.id, course_slug: 'editing-foundations' });
  const detail = json(await manager.api(endpoint));
  verify(detail.user.name === 'Moderation Student' && /^moderationstudent[0-9]{6}$/.test(detail.user.username), 'User detail contains real profile and username');
  verify(detail.subscriptions.some(course => course.slug === 'editing-foundations'), 'User detail reads actual subscribed courses');
  for (const [period, hours] of [['day',24],['week',168],['month',720],['year',8760]]) {
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'suspend', period })).status === 200, `${period} suspension succeeds`);
    const until = json(await manager.api(endpoint)).user.suspendedUntil;
    verify(Math.abs((Date.parse(until)-Date.now())/3600000-hours) < 0.01, `${period} suspension has correct expiry`);
    verify((await target.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 401, 'Suspension blocks previously issued API session');
    verify((await target.direct.from('enrollments').select('*')).data.length === 0, 'Suspension blocks direct Data API with existing JWT');
    verify((await target.direct.from('lessons').select('*').eq('course_slug','editing-foundations')).data.length === 0, 'Suspension blocks direct course playback retrieval');
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'restore' })).status === 200, 'Admin restores access before expiry');
    verify((await target.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 200, 'Restored account regains authorized session access');
  }
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'ban' })).status === 200, 'Permanent ban succeeds');
  verify(json(await manager.api(endpoint)).user.permanentlyBanned, 'Permanent ban has separate status from suspension');
  const denied = await target.direct.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: target.email, password: target.password });
  verify(Boolean(denied.error), 'Banned account cannot sign in');
  await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'restore' });
  await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(target.id,{ ban_duration: '1s' });
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1200));
  verify((await target.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 200, 'Expired suspension automatically restores access');
  await require('./admin-users-browser.cjs')({ manager, target, verify, url });
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'remove' })).status === 200, 'Admin can delete student account');
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint)).status === 404, 'Deleted user disappears from private detail');
  verify((await admin.from('enrollments').select('*').eq('user_id',target.id)).data.length === 0, 'Delete cascades subscribed courses');
  verify((await target.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 401, 'Deleted user existing session is denied');
  verify((await target.direct.rpc('account_access_allowed')).data !== true, 'Deleted user old JWT cannot pass database access check');
  const promoted = await provision('Promoted User');
  try {
    verify((await manager.api(`${base}/${promoted.id}`,{ action: 'promote' })).status === 200, 'Admin promotes confirmed student');
    verify((await promoted.api(base)).status === 200, 'Promoted user gains admin access');
    await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(promoted.id,{ email_confirm: true });
    verify((await promoted.api(base)).status === 200, 'Promotion persists after provider email confirmation updates');
    verify((await manager.api(`${base}/${promoted.id}`,{ action: 'ban' })).status === 403, 'Other administrators are protected');
  } finally { await admin.from('admin_allowlist').delete().eq('email',promoted.email); }
};
```

```typescript
const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
module.exports = async function adminChecks({ admin, provision, anonymous, student, verify, url }) {
  const endpoint = '/api/admin/courses/7days-freelance';
  verify((await anonymous(endpoint)).status === 401, 'Anonymous cannot access course editor API');
  verify((await student.api(endpoint)).status === 403, 'Student cannot access course editor API');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.from('admin_users').insert({ user_id: student.id })).error), 'Student cannot assign own admin role');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.from('admin_allowlist').insert({ email: student.email })).error), 'Student cannot add admin allowlist email');
  await student.direct.auth.updateUser({ data: { role: 'admin' } });
  verify((await student.api(endpoint)).status === 403, 'User metadata cannot grant admin privileges');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.from('enrollments').insert({ user_id: student.id, course_slug: '7days-freelance' })).error), 'Live workshop cannot self-enroll directly');
  const manager = await provision('Course Manager');
  verify(!(await admin.from('admin_users').insert({ user_id: manager.id })).error, 'Trusted admin membership assigned');
  const original = (await admin.from('courses').select('metadata,amount,published').eq('slug','7days-freelance').single()).data;
  try {
    const record = await manager.api(endpoint);
    verify(record.status === 200, 'Admin reads course editor data');
    const saved = { title: 'ورشة اختبار الإدارة', description: 'وصف جديد محفوظ في قاعدة البيانات', amount: 777, category: 'editing',
      thumbnailUrl: '/assets/images/workshop-intro-poster.jpg', introVideoUrl: '/assets/video/workshop-intro.mp4', published: true };
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint,saved)).status === 200, 'Admin edits name description price category and media');
    const publicCourse = JSON.parse((await anonymous('/api/courses/7days-freelance')).data);
    verify(publicCourse.title === saved.title && publicCourse.offer.amount === 777 && publicCourse.category === 'editing', 'Database edits appear in public catalog');
    verify((await anonymous('/workshops/7days-freelance')).data.includes(saved.title), 'Workshop landing reads database changes');
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ ...saved, thumbnailUrl: 'javascript:alert(1)' })).status === 400, 'Unsafe media URL rejected');
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ ...saved, amount: -1 })).status === 400, 'Negative price rejected');
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint,saved,{ headers: { Origin: 'https://attacker.example' } })).status === 403, 'Cross-origin admin mutation rejected');
    verify((await student.api(endpoint,saved)).status === 403, 'Student cannot mutate through admin API');
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ ...saved, published: false })).status === 200, 'Admin unpublishes course');
    verify((await anonymous('/api/courses/7days-freelance')).status === 404, 'Unpublished course disappears publicly');
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint)).status === 200, 'Admin retains unpublished course access');
    await manager.api(endpoint,saved);
    const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
    try {
      const page = await browser.newPage();
      await page.goto(url + '/login');
      await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true }).fill(manager.email);
      await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(manager.password);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الدخول', exact: true }).click();
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(url + '/admin/dashboard');
      await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: 'المستخدمون', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await page.goto(url + '/dashboard/admin/courses/7days-freelance');
      await page.getByLabel('اسم الدورة', { exact: true }).fill('ورشة محفوظة من لوحة التحكم');
      await page.getByLabel('السعر (ج.م)', { exact: true }).fill('888');
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'حفظ التغييرات', exact: true }).click();
      await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toHaveText('تم حفظ التغييرات');
      await page.reload();
      await expect(page.getByLabel('اسم الدورة', { exact: true })).toHaveValue('ورشة محفوظة من لوحة التحكم');
      verify(true, 'Browser editor persists changes across refresh');
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 900 });
      verify(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), 'Admin editor fits mobile');
      await page.screenshot({ path: 'docs/evidence/backend/admin-editor-390.png', fullPage: true });
    } finally { await browser.close(); }
    const driveCourse = { ...saved, introVideoUrl: 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZHecu6hIzcXtpyMxa-Rexq0csHcmOKJt/view' };
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint,driveCourse)).status === 200, 'Google Drive link persists in admin editor');
    const view = await anonymous('/workshops/7days-freelance');
    verify(view.data.includes('/api/courses/7days-freelance/intro'), 'Drive intro uses the custom streaming player');
    const media = await fetch(url + '/api/courses/7days-freelance/intro', { headers: { Range: 'bytes=0-1023' }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) });
    const reader = media.body.getReader();
    const sample = await reader.read();
    await reader.cancel();
    verify(media.ok && media.headers.get('content-type').startsWith('video/') && Buffer.from(sample.value).includes(Buffer.from('ftyp')), 'Drive streaming retrieves actual MP4 bytes and supports cancellation');
    const privateVideo = '/api/admin/courses/editing-foundations/lessons/first-cut';
    const initial = (await admin.from('lessons').select('video_url').eq('course_slug','editing-foundations').eq('id','first-cut').single()).data.video_url;
    try {
      verify((await manager.api(privateVideo,{ videoUrl: driveCourse.introVideoUrl })).status === 200, 'Admin can edit protected lesson video');
      verify((await student.api(privateVideo,{ videoUrl: driveCourse.introVideoUrl })).status === 403, 'Student cannot edit protected lesson video');
      verify((await anonymous('/api/courses/editing-foundations/lessons/first-cut/stream')).status === 403, 'Protected stream enforces enrollment before retrieving Drive bytes');
    } finally { await admin.from('lessons').update({ video_url: initial }).eq('course_slug','editing-foundations').eq('id','first-cut'); }
  } finally { await admin.from('courses').update(original).eq('slug','7days-freelance'); }
  const response = await anonymous('/7days-freelance?test=1');
  verify(response.status === 308 && response.headers.get('location').includes('/workshops/7days-freelance?test=1'), 'Legacy workshop redirects with query preserved');
  const legacyDetail = await anonymous('/ta3allam/courses/7days-freelance');
  verify(legacyDetail.status === 308, 'Generic workshop detail URL redirects to approved landing');
  const copy = { ...original.metadata, slug: 'test-live-free', offer: { ...original.metadata.offer, amount: 0 } };
  await admin.from('courses').insert({ slug: copy.slug, metadata: copy, amount: 0, published: true, position: 100 });
  try { verify(Boolean((await student.direct.from('enrollments').insert({ user_id: student.id, course_slug: copy.slug })).error), 'RLS also blocks zero-price live self-enrollment'); }
  finally { await admin.from('courses').delete().eq('slug',copy.slug); }
  const provider = await admin.auth.admin.createUser({ email: `allowlist-${Date.now()}@example.com`, password: 'Local-Test-Password-19!', email_confirm: true });
  const id = provider.data.user.id;
  try {
    const email = provider.data.user.email;
    await admin.from('admin_allowlist').insert({ email });
    await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(id,{ email_confirm: true });
    verify((await admin.from('admin_users').select('*').eq('user_id',id)).data.length === 1, 'Verified allowlisted email receives role through trusted trigger');
    await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(id,{ email: `not-allowed-${Date.now()}@example.com`, email_confirm: true });
    verify((await admin.from('admin_users').select('*').eq('user_id',id)).data.length === 1, 'Confirmed email change preserves the administrator account role');
    await admin.from('admin_allowlist').delete().eq('email',email);
  } finally {
    const user=await admin.auth.admin.getUserById(id);
    await admin.from('admin_allowlist').delete().eq('email',user.data.user.email);
    await admin.from('admin_users').delete().eq('user_id',id);
    await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(id);
  }
};
```

```typescript
// This preloader is used only by the isolated live-readiness acceptance server.
if (!/^http:\/\/127\.0\.0\.1:/.test(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL ?? "")) throw new Error("Local database required");
const original = globalThis.fetch;
globalThis.fetch = (input, options) => {
  const url = new URL(typeof input === "string" ? input : input instanceof URL ? input.href : input.url);
  if (["app.fawaterk.com", "staging.fawaterk.com"].includes(url.hostname)) throw new Error("Live provider network access disabled in acceptance tests");
  return original(input, options);
};
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Browser checks against isolated local accounts. */
const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
const fs = require('node:fs');
module.exports = async function browserChecks({ url, config, admin, identities, verify, student }) {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  const errors = [];
  page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message));
  page.on('console', message => { if (/Content Security Policy|violates.*directive/.test(message.text())) errors.push(message.text()); });
  fs.mkdirSync('docs/evidence/backend', { recursive: true });
  try {
    await page.goto(url + '/login');
    await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true }).fill(student.email);
    await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(student.password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الدخول', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard$/);
    verify(true, 'Browser login navigates to protected dashboard');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'قائمة الحساب', exact: true }).click();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الخروج', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
    verify(true, 'Browser logout returns to login');
    await page.goto(url + '/signup');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'إنشاء حساب', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByLabel('اسمك', { exact: true })).toBeFocused();
    verify(true, 'Invalid browser signup focuses first field');
    const email = `signup-browser-${Date.now()}@example.com`, password = 'Local-Test-Password-19!';
    await page.getByLabel('اسمك', { exact: true }).fill('طالب جديد');
    await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true }).fill(email);
    await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(password);
    await page.getByLabel('تأكيد كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'إنشاء حساب', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: 'راجع بريدك الإلكتروني' })).toBeVisible();
    verify(!page.url().endsWith('/dashboard'), 'Signup waits for email confirmation');
    const users = await admin.auth.admin.listUsers();
    const created = users.data.users.find(user => user.email === email);
    if (created) identities.push(created.id);
    verify(Boolean(created && !created.email_confirmed_at), 'Signup creates an unconfirmed real account');
    const messages = await (await fetch(config.MAILPIT_URL + '/api/v1/messages')).json();
    const message = messages.messages.find(message => message.To.some(recipient => recipient.Address === email));
    verify(Boolean(message), 'Supabase sends confirmation email to local Mailpit');
    const mail = await (await fetch(config.MAILPIT_URL + '/api/v1/message/' + message.ID)).json();
    const link = mail.HTML.match(/href="([^"]+\/auth\/v1\/verify[^\"]+)"/)?.[1].replaceAll('&amp;', '&');
    verify(Boolean(link), 'Confirmation email includes valid Auth verification link');
    await page.goto(link);
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard$/);
    verify(true, 'Email verification and PKCE callback establish browser session');
    for (const width of [390, 1440]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
      await page.goto(url + '/login');
      await expect(page.locator('.lms-auth-card')).toBeVisible();
      verify(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `Auth layout fits ${width}px`);
      await page.screenshot({ path: `docs/evidence/backend/login-${width}.png`, fullPage: true });
    }
    verify(errors.length === 0, 'Real authentication browser flows have no JavaScript errors' + (errors.length ? ': ' + errors.join(' | ') : ''));
  } finally { await browser.close(); }
};
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Real issuance into disposable local course fixtures. */
const assert=require('node:assert/strict');
module.exports=async({admin,student,manager,base,sourceLesson,extras,verify})=>{
 for(let index=0;index<6;index++) {
  const slug='backend-certificate-pagination-'+index;extras.push(slug);
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('courses').insert({...base,slug,metadata:{...base.metadata,slug,title:'Pagination course '+index,modules:[{id:'chapter',title:'Chapter',lessons:[{...base.metadata.modules[0].lessons[0],id:sourceLesson.id}]}]}})).error);
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('lessons').insert({...sourceLesson,course_slug:slug})).error);
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('enrollments').insert({user_id:student.id,course_slug:slug})).error);
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('lesson_progress').insert({user_id:student.id,course_slug:slug,lesson_id:sourceLesson.id,completed:true})).error);
  verify((await student.api('/api/certificates',{operation:'issue',slug})).status===200,'Pagination fixture issued from actual completion '+index);
 }
 const query='?q=Pagination&filter=issued',endpoint='/api/admin/certificates';
 const first=JSON.parse((await manager.api(endpoint+query)).data),second=JSON.parse((await manager.api(endpoint+query+'&page=2')).data);
 verify(first.total===6&&first.certificates.length===5&&second.certificates.length===1,'Admin certificates use five-record pagination');
 verify(!first.certificates.some(row=>second.certificates.some(other=>other.id===row.id)),'Stable certificate pagination has no duplicate rows');
 const own=JSON.parse((await student.api('/api/certificates'+query)).data);verify(own.total===6&&own.certificates.length===5,'Student certificate pagination matches admin');
 const record=first.certificates[0];await manager.api(endpoint,{operation:'revoke',id:record.id,revision:record.revision,reason:'Filter fixture'});
 const filtered=JSON.parse((await manager.api(endpoint+'?q=Pagination&filter=revoked')).data);
 verify(filtered.total===1&&filtered.certificates[0].id===record.id,'Combined certificate status/search excludes all unrelated courses');
};
```

```typescript
const json=result=>JSON.parse(result.data);

 const manager=await provision('Certificate Manager'),student=await provision('أحمد محمد علي'),other=await provision('Certificate Outsider');
 assert.ok(!(await admin.from('admin_users').insert({user_id:manager.id})).error);
 const slug='backend-certificate-course',base=(await admin.from('courses').select('*').eq('slug','editing-foundations').single()).data;

 assert.ok(!(await admin.from('courses').insert({...base,slug,metadata:{...base.metadata,slug,title:'دورة اختبار الشهادات',modules:[{id:'chapter',title:'Chapter',lessons:metadataLessons}]}})).error);

 try {

   verify((await anonymous(path)).status===401,'Guest cannot read '+path);

  verify((await student.api('/api/certificates',issue)).status===403,'One unfinished lesson blocks issuance');
  verify(!(await student.direct.rpc('eligible_certificate_courses')).data.some(course=>course.slug===slug),'Lightweight eligibility excludes unfinished courses');

  const race=await Promise.all([student.api('/api/certificates',issue),student.api('/api/certificates',issue)]);
  verify(race.every(result=>result.status===200),'Concurrent issuance is idempotent');
  let records=(await admin.from('certificates').select('*').eq('course_slug',slug)).data;verify(records.length===1,'Exactly one saved certificate per learner/course');
  const record=records[0];
```

```typescript
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { validateSections } from "../../modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-sections";
import { createCourseMetadata } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/create-course-metadata";
import { validateCourse } from "../../modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-course";
import { validateLessons } from "../../modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-lessons";
import type { Course } from "../../modules/types/lms";
const draft = () => createCourseMetadata({slug:"test-course",title:"دورة اختبار",description:"وصف دورة",amount:0,category:"editing",delivery:"recorded"},{currency:"ج.م",action:"اشتراك",liveLabel:"مباشرة"});
function fixture(): Course {
 const course=draft();course.modules=[{title:"Chapter",lessons:[{id:"first",title:"Lesson",duration:"1:00",durationSeconds:60,resourceIds:[],description:"",videoUrl:"",takeaway:[]}],sections:[{id:"intro",title:"Intro",lessonIds:["first"]}]}];return course;
}
test("Drafts are editable but cannot be published without curriculum",()=>{
 const course=draft();assert.doesNotThrow(()=>validateCourse(course,new Set(),{draft:true}));assert.doesNotThrow(()=>validateLessons(course,[],{draft:true}));assert.throws(()=>validateCourse(course,new Set()));assert.throws(()=>validateLessons(course,[]));
});
test("Sections reference real lessons and cannot assign a lesson twice",()=>{
 const course=fixture();assert.doesNotThrow(()=>validateSections(course));course.modules[0].sections![0].lessonIds.push("first");assert.throws(()=>validateSections(course));
 course.modules[0].sections![0].lessonIds=["missing"];assert.throws(()=>validateSections(course));
 course.modules[0].sections![0].lessonIds=["first"];course.modules[0].sections!.push({id:"second",title:"Second",lessonIds:["first"]});assert.throws(()=>validateSections(course));
});
test("Empty named sections are valid and chapter section identifiers stay unique",()=>{
 const course=fixture();course.modules[0].sections!.push({id:"empty",title:"Empty",lessonIds:[]});assert.doesNotThrow(()=>validateSections(course));course.modules[0].sections!.push({id:"intro",title:"Duplicate",lessonIds:[]});assert.throws(()=>validateSections(course));
});
test("Live courses require duration but may have no recorded lessons",()=>{
 const course=draft();course.delivery="live";course.deliveryLabel="ورشة مباشرة";
 assert.throws(()=>validateCourse(course,new Set()));course.duration="٧ أيام";
 assert.doesNotThrow(()=>validateCourse(course,new Set()));assert.doesNotThrow(()=>validateLessons(course,[]));
});
```

### File: `tests/backend/course-create-fields.test.ts`

```typescript
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { validateCourseCreate } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/validate-course-create";
import { createCourseMetadata } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/create-course-metadata";
const base = { slug:"new-course",title:"New course",description:"Course description",amount:100,category:"editing",delivery:"recorded" };
test("New optional overview fields validate and persist without breaking older creation requests", () => {
  const legacy = validateCourseCreate(base); assert.ok(legacy); assert.equal(legacy.thumbnailUrl,"");
  const input = validateCourseCreate({...base,delivery:"live",duration:" ٧ أيام ",thumbnailUrl:"https://example.com/photo.jpg",introVideoUrl:"https://drive.google.com/file/d/123/view"}); assert.ok(input);
  const course = createCourseMetadata(input,{currency:"ج.م",action:"اشترك",liveLabel:"مباشرة"});
  assert.equal(course.duration,"٧ أيام");assert.equal(course.thumbnailUrl,input.thumbnailUrl);assert.equal(course.introVideoUrl,input.introVideoUrl);
});
test("Creation rejects invalid media or duration values", () => {
  for(const field of ["thumbnailUrl","introVideoUrl"]) for(const value of [null,42,"javascript:alert(1)","https://user:pass@example.com/file","/assets/../file"])
    assert.equal(validateCourseCreate({...base,[field]:value}),null);
  for(const duration of [42,null,"x".repeat(10000)]) assert.equal(validateCourseCreate({...base,duration}),null);
});
```

### File: `tests/backend/course-price.test.ts`

SHA-256: `c9fb06768f0e5b5bfe0e939ddd9b7933e1f5240b6e216013c75ad88145f69a7d`

```typescript
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { validCourseAmount, validPaidPriceInput, normalizeCoursePrice } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/course-price";
import { validateCourseEdit } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/validate-course-edit";
import { validateCourseCreate } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/validate-course-create";
test("Paid text prices accept positive integers and exclude zero, signs, decimals and exponents", () => {
  for (const value of ["1","499","1000000"]) assert.equal(validPaidPriceInput(value),true);
  for (const value of ["0","00","01","-1","+1","1.5","1e3","NaN","1000001"," 5 "]) assert.equal(validPaidPriceInput(value),false);
  assert.equal(validPaidPriceInput(""),true); // Editing may be empty; the required field blocks submission.
});
test("Arabic and Persian digits normalize without accepting malformed prices", () => {
  assert.equal(normalizeCoursePrice("١٢٣٤"),"1234");assert.equal(normalizeCoursePrice("۱۲۳۴"),"1234");
  assert.equal(validPaidPriceInput(normalizeCoursePrice("١٫٥")),false);
});
test("Creation and editing enforce integer amounts; zero remains the canonical free-course value", () => {
  const base={slug:"price-test",title:"Price test",description:"Course description",amount:1,category:"editing",delivery:"recorded",thumbnailUrl:"",introVideoUrl:"",published:false};
  for(const amount of [0,1,1000000]) { assert.equal(validCourseAmount(amount),true);assert.ok(validateCourseCreate({...base,amount}));assert.ok(validateCourseEdit({...base,amount})); }
  for(const amount of [-1,0.5,1200.99,1000001,Infinity,NaN,"10",null]) { assert.equal(validCourseAmount(amount),false);assert.equal(validateCourseCreate({...base,amount}),null);assert.equal(validateCourseEdit({...base,amount}),null); }
});
```

```typescript
const assert=require('node:assert/strict'),{randomUUID}=require('node:crypto');
module.exports=async({admin,provision,anonymous,verify,url})=>{
 const manager=await provision('Curriculum Manager'),student=await provision('Curriculum Student');
 assert.ok(!(await admin.from('admin_users').insert({user_id:manager.id})).error);
 const slug='curriculum-'+randomUUID(),base='/api/admin/courses/'+slug;
 const parse=result=>JSON.parse(result.data),record=async()=>parse(await manager.api(base));
 const overview=current=>({title:current.course.title,description:current.course.description,amount:current.course.offer.amount,category:current.course.category,duration:current.course.duration,thumbnailUrl:current.course.thumbnailUrl??'',introVideoUrl:current.course.introVideoUrl??'',published:current.published,revision:current.revision});
 const mutate=async(input)=>manager.api(base+'/content',{revision:(await record()).revision,...input});
 try {
  verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/courses',{slug,title:'Curriculum test course',description:'Course authoring test content',amount:500,category:'editing',delivery:'recorded'})).status===201,'Create empty draft for curriculum');
  const initial=await record();
  const probe=base+'/media/stream?url='+encodeURIComponent('https://drive.google.com/file/d/1234567890/view');
  verify((await anonymous(probe)).status===401,'Guest cannot probe Drive media');verify((await student.api(probe)).status===403,'Student cannot probe Drive media');
  for(const media of ['http://127.0.0.1/private','https://example.com/video.mp4','https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1234567890','javascript:alert(1)']) verify((await manager.api(base+'/media/stream?url='+encodeURIComponent(media))).status===400,'Metadata stream restricts upstream to Drive files');
  verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/courses/missing-probe-course/media/stream?url='+encodeURIComponent('https://drive.google.com/file/d/1234567890/view'))).status===404,'Probe requires an existing course');
  verify((await anonymous(base+'/content',{kind:'chapter',operation:'create',title:'First chapter',revision:0})).status===401,'Guest cannot author curriculum');
  verify((await student.api(base+'/content',{kind:'chapter',operation:'create',title:'First chapter',revision:0})).status===403,'Student cannot author curriculum');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.rpc('save_admin_curriculum',{p_slug:slug,p_revision:0,p_modules:[]})).error),'Student cannot bypass API using RPC');
  verify((await manager.api(base+'/content',{kind:'chapter',operation:'create',title:'First chapter',revision:0},{headers:{Origin:'https://attacker.example'}})).status===403,'Cross-origin authoring rejected');
  for(const values of [{kind:'bad'},{revision:-1},{title:''},{revision:'0'},{operation:'edit',id:'bad id'}]) verify((await mutate({kind:'chapter',operation:'create',title:'Valid title',...values})).status===400,'Invalid curriculum command rejected');
  let response=await mutate({kind:'chapter',operation:'create',title:'First chapter'});verify(response.status===200,'Create chapter');const chapter=parse(response).id;
  response=await mutate({kind:'chapter',operation:'create',title:'Second chapter'});verify(response.status===200,'Create second chapter');const second=parse(response).id;
  response=await mutate({kind:'section',operation:'create',title:'First section',chapterId:chapter});verify(response.status===200,'Create section in chosen chapter');const section=parse(response).id;
  const lessonValues={kind:'lesson',operation:'create',title:'First lesson',description:'Lesson description',durationSeconds:125,videoUrl:'/assets/video/workshop-intro.mp4',preview:false,chapterId:chapter,sectionId:section};
  for(const values of [{durationSeconds:0},{durationSeconds:1.5},{durationSeconds:86401},{videoUrl:'javascript:alert(1)'},{preview:'false'},{sectionId:'missing'}]) verify((await mutate({...lessonValues,...values})).status===400,'Invalid lesson metadata or assignment rejected');
  response=await mutate(lessonValues);verify(response.status===200,'Create lesson assigned to course and section');const lesson=parse(response).id;
  let current=await record(),stored=(await admin.from('lessons').select('*').eq('course_slug',slug).eq('id',lesson).single()).data;
  verify(current.course.duration==='٢ دقيقة','Course duration derives from newly added lesson');
  verify(stored.video_url===lessonValues.videoUrl&&!current.course.modules[0].lessons[0].videoUrl,'Playback stored separately from public metadata');
  verify(current.course.modules[0].sections[0].lessonIds.includes(lesson),'Section references canonical lesson');
  verify((await mutate({kind:'section',operation:'delete',id:section,chapterId:chapter})).status===409,'Non-empty section deletion blocked');
  verify((await mutate({kind:'chapter',operation:'delete',id:chapter})).status===409,'Non-empty chapter deletion blocked');
  await admin.from('enrollments').insert({user_id:student.id,course_slug:slug});await admin.from('lesson_progress').insert({user_id:student.id,course_slug:slug,lesson_id:lesson,completed:true});
  const resource=(await admin.from('resources').select('id').limit(1)).data[0].id;await admin.from('lesson_resources').insert({resource_id:resource,course_slug:slug,lesson_id:lesson});
  verify((await mutate({kind:'section',operation:'edit',id:section,sourceChapterId:chapter,chapterId:second,title:'Moved section'})).status===200,'Move section and its lessons to another chapter');
  current=await record();verify(current.course.modules[0].lessons.length===0&&current.course.modules[1].lessons[0].id===lesson,'Section move preserves lesson identity');
  verify((await mutate({...lessonValues,operation:'edit',id:lesson,chapterId:chapter,sectionId:'',title:'Updated lesson',durationSeconds:185,preview:true})).status===200,'Edit lesson and reassign chapter without section');
  verify((await record()).course.duration==='٣ دقائق','Lesson duration edits update course total');
  const progress=(await admin.from('lesson_progress').select('*').eq('course_slug',slug)).data,resources=(await admin.from('lesson_resources').select('*').eq('course_slug',slug)).data;
  verify(progress.length===1&&progress[0].completed&&resources.length===1,'Moving and editing retain progress and resource associations');
  verify((await admin.from('lessons').select('preview').eq('course_slug',slug).eq('id',lesson).single()).data.preview,'Preview changes reach protected playback records');
  verify((await mutate({kind:'section',operation:'delete',id:section,chapterId:second})).status===200,'Delete empty section');
  verify((await mutate({kind:'chapter',operation:'delete',id:second})).status===200,'Delete empty chapter');
  verify((await mutate({kind:'chapter',operation:'edit',id:chapter,title:'Renamed chapter'})).status===200,'Rename chapter');

  response=await mutate({kind:'lesson',operation:'delete',id:lesson,chapterId:chapter});verify(response.status===400&&parse(response).code==='PUBLISHED_CURRICULUM_INCOMPLETE','Deleting last published lesson blocked');
  verify((await mutate({kind:'chapter',operation:'create',title:'Empty chapter'})).status===400,'Published course cannot acquire empty chapter');
  const publicCourse=parse(await anonymous('/api/courses/'+slug));verify(publicCourse.duration==='٣ دقائق','Public course uses the same derived duration');verify(publicCourse.modules[0].lessons[0].videoUrl==='','Published metadata never leaks video URL');
  current=await record();const concurrent=await Promise.all([manager.api(base+'/content',{kind:'chapter',operation:'edit',id:chapter,title:'Concurrent first',revision:current.revision}),manager.api(base+'/content',{kind:'chapter',operation:'edit',id:chapter,title:'Concurrent second',revision:current.revision})]);
  verify(concurrent.map(result=>result.status).sort().join(',')==='200,409','Concurrent edits accept one and reject stale revision');
  verify((await manager.api(base,overview(current))).status===409,'Stale overview cannot overwrite curriculum changes');
  const before=await record();const rollback=await manager.direct.rpc('save_admin_curriculum',{p_slug:slug,p_revision:before.revision,p_modules:[],p_lesson:{id:'invalid',video_url:null,preview:false}});
  verify(Boolean(rollback.error)&&(await record()).revision===before.revision,'Failed lesson write rolls back curriculum and revision');
  current=await record();verify((await manager.api(base,{...overview(current),published:false})).status===200,'Unpublish before destructive curriculum change');
  verify((await mutate({kind:'lesson',operation:'delete',id:lesson,chapterId:chapter})).status===200,'Delete draft lesson');
  verify((await record()).course.duration==='','Removing final lesson clears derived course duration');
  verify((await admin.from('lesson_progress').select('*').eq('course_slug',slug)).data.length===0&&(await admin.from('lesson_resources').select('*').eq('course_slug',slug)).data.length===0,'Lesson removal cleans progress and resource links atomically');
  verify((await mutate({...lessonValues,operation:'edit',id:'missing',chapterId:chapter,sectionId:''})).status===404,'Unknown lesson edit rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(base+'/content',{kind:'chapter',operation:'edit',id:chapter,title:'Old edit',revision:initial.revision})).status===409,'Initial revision cannot overwrite subsequent changes');

  verify((await mutate({kind:'chapter',operation:'create',title:'Denied chapter'})).status===403,'Revoked admin access denies new mutations');
 } finally { await admin.from('courses').delete().eq('slug',slug); }
};
```

```typescript
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { applyCurriculumMutation } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/apply-curriculum-mutation";
import { curriculumCourse } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/curriculum-course";
import { createCourseMetadata } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/create-course-metadata";
import { courseContentGroups } from "../../modules/features/catalog/helpers/course-content-groups";
import type { Course } from "../../modules/types/lms";
function fixture(): Course {
  const course = createCourseMetadata({slug:"reusable-course",title:"Reusable course",description:"Description",amount:0,category:"editing",delivery:"recorded"},{currency:"EGP",action:"Enroll",liveLabel:"Live"});
  const lesson = (id: string) => ({id,title:id,description:"",duration:"1:00",durationSeconds:60,videoUrl:"",resourceIds:["resource"],takeaway:["Outcome"]});
  course.modules = [{title:"First",lessons:[lesson("one"),lesson("two")],sections:[{id:"intro",title:"Intro",lessonIds:["one"]}]},{title:"Second",lessons:[],sections:[{id:"intro",title:"Other intro",lessonIds:[]}]}];
  return course;
}
test("Legacy chapter identifiers are stable and normalization does not modify its input", () => {
  const course = fixture(), snapshot = structuredClone(course);
  assert.deepEqual(curriculumCourse(course).modules.map(chapter=>chapter.id),["chapter-1","chapter-2"]);
  assert.deepEqual(curriculumCourse(course),curriculumCourse(course));assert.deepEqual(course,snapshot);
});
test("Repeated lesson edits preserve order, resources and learning outcomes without mutating inputs", () => {
  const course = fixture(), snapshot = structuredClone(course);
  const edit = {kind:"lesson" as const,operation:"edit" as const,revision:0,id:"one",chapterId:"chapter-1",sectionId:"intro",title:"Edited",description:"Updated",durationSeconds:3601,videoUrl:"/assets/video/workshop-intro.mp4",preview:true};
  for(const input of [course,fixture()]) {
    const updated = applyCurriculumMutation(input,edit,"one"),lesson=updated.modules[0].lessons[0];
    assert.deepEqual(updated.modules[0].lessons.map(lesson=>lesson.id),["one","two"]);
    assert.deepEqual(lesson.resourceIds,["resource"]);assert.deepEqual(lesson.takeaway,["Outcome"]);
    assert.equal(lesson.duration,"1:00:01");assert.equal(lesson.videoUrl,"");assert.equal(lesson.preview,true);
    assert.deepEqual(updated.modules[0].sections![0].lessonIds,["one"]);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(course,snapshot);
});
test("Legacy section ids repeated across chapters resolve within the selected source chapter", () => {
  const updated = applyCurriculumMutation(fixture(),{kind:"section",operation:"edit",revision:0,id:"intro",sourceChapterId:"chapter-2",chapterId:"chapter-2",title:"Renamed second"},"intro");
  assert.equal(updated.modules[0].sections![0].title,"Intro");assert.equal(updated.modules[1].sections![0].title,"Renamed second");
  assert.throws(()=>applyCurriculumMutation(fixture(),{kind:"section",operation:"edit",revision:0,id:"intro",sourceChapterId:"chapter-1",chapterId:"chapter-2",title:"Move"},"intro"),/SECTION_ID_CONFLICT/);
});
test("A real section named ungrouped remains distinguishable from unassigned lessons", () => {
  const chapter=fixture().modules[0];chapter.sections=[{id:"ungrouped",title:"Real section",lessonIds:["one"]}];
  const groups=courseContentGroups(chapter,"Without section");assert.equal(groups[0].sectionId,"ungrouped");assert.equal(groups[1].sectionId,undefined);
});
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Isolated real-account access regression. */
const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
module.exports = async function dashboardAccess({ url, student, verify }) {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  const context = await browser.newContext();
  const page = await context.newPage();
  const login = async () => {
    await page.goto(url + '/login');
    await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true }).fill(student.email);
    await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(student.password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الدخول', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard$/);
  };
  try {
    await login();
    const admin = await context.request.get(url + '/api/admin/courses/7days-freelance');
    verify(admin.status() === 403, 'Signed-in student cannot use admin course APIs');
    await context.clearCookies();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'قائمة الحساب', exact: true }).click();
    await page.locator('.ds-action-panel a[href="/dashboard/profile"]').click();
    await expect(page, 'Lost session navigation').toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Isolated local lock-order verification. */
const {Client}=require('pg');
const assert=require('node:assert/strict');
module.exports=async({admin,manager,outsider,slug,lessonId,config,verify})=>{
 const endpoint=`/api/admin/users/${outsider.id}/enrollments`;
 assert.equal((await manager.api(endpoint,{courseSlug:slug,action:'grant',revision:0,reason:'Local concurrency fixture'})).status,200);
 const db=new Client({connectionString:config.DB_URL});await db.connect();
 try {
  const token=(await outsider.direct.auth.getSession()).data.session.access_token;
  const claims=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token.split('.')[1],'base64url').toString());
  await db.query('begin');await db.query("select set_config('request.jwt.claims',$1,true)",[JSON.stringify(claims)]);await db.query('set local role authenticated');
  await db.query('select public.save_lesson_note($1,$2,$3,0)',[slug,lessonId,'Committed before revocation']);
  await db.query('insert into public.lesson_progress(user_id,course_slug,lesson_id,completed) values($1,$2,$3,true)',[outsider.id,slug,lessonId]);
  const pending=manager.api(endpoint,{courseSlug:slug,action:'revoke',revision:1,reason:'Concurrent revocation'});
  let blocked=false;
  for(let attempt=0;attempt<60;attempt++) {
   const result=await db.query('select exists(select 1 from pg_stat_activity where pg_backend_pid()=any(pg_blocking_pids(pid))) waiting');
   if(result.rows[0].waiting){blocked=true;break;}
   await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,50));
  }
  verify(blocked,'Revocation waits for in-flight note and progress transaction');
  await db.query('commit');verify((await pending).status===200,'Revocation completes after learning write commits');
  const row=(await admin.from('enrollments').select('active').eq('user_id',outsider.id).eq('course_slug',slug).single()).data;
  const note=(await admin.from('lesson_notes').select('text').eq('user_id',outsider.id).eq('course_slug',slug).single()).data;
  const progress=(await admin.from('lesson_progress').select('completed').eq('user_id',outsider.id).eq('course_slug',slug).single()).data;
  verify(!row.active&&note.text==='Committed before revocation'&&progress.completed,'Serialized revocation preserves the completed learning write');
 }finally{await db.query('rollback').catch(()=>{});await db.end();}
};
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Isolated local integration coverage. */
const assert=require('node:assert/strict');
module.exports=async({admin,provision,anonymous,verify,url,config})=>{
 const manager=await provision('Enrollment Manager'),student=await provision('Enrollment Student'),outsider=await provision('Enrollment Outsider');
 assert.ok(!(await admin.from('admin_users').insert({user_id:manager.id})).error);
 const slug='backend-enrollment-course',endpoint=`/api/admin/users/${student.id}/enrollments`,created=[];
 const source=(await admin.from('courses').select('*').eq('slug','editing-foundations').single()).data;
 const lessonId=source.metadata.modules[0].lessons[0].id;
 const lesson=(await admin.from('lessons').select('*').eq('course_slug',source.slug).eq('id',lessonId).single()).data;
 assert.ok(!(await admin.from('courses').insert({...source,slug,metadata:{...source.metadata,slug,title:'Enrollment test course'}})).error);
 assert.ok(!(await admin.from('lessons').insert({...lesson,course_slug:slug,preview:false})).error);
 const input={courseSlug:slug,action:'grant',reason:'Manual admission after support review',revision:0};
 const notePath=`/api/courses/${slug}/lessons/${lessonId}/notes`;
 try {
  verify((await anonymous(endpoint,input)).status===401,'Guest cannot manage enrollment');
  verify((await student.api(endpoint,input)).status===403,'Student cannot manage enrollment');
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,input,{headers:{Origin:'https://evil.example'}})).status===403,'Cross-origin enrollment mutation denied');
  for(const patch of [{reason:''},{reason:'x'.repeat(501)},{action:'delete'},{revision:-1},{revision:'0'},{courseSlug:"x'; drop table courses;--"}]) verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{...input,...patch})).status===400,'Invalid enrollment request rejected');
  verify(Boolean((await outsider.direct.rpc('manage_enrollment',{p_user:student.id,p_slug:slug,p_action:'grant',p_reason:'forged',p_revision:0})).error),'Direct student RPC cannot grant access');
  await admin.from('account_contacts').update({phone_verified_at:null}).eq('user_id',student.id);
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,input)).status===403,'New manual enrollment retains verification gate');
  await admin.from('account_contacts').update({phone_verified_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('user_id',student.id);
  const baseline=JSON.parse((await manager.api('/api/admin/analytics')).data).metrics.totalEnrollments;
  const grants=await Promise.all([manager.api(endpoint,input),manager.api(endpoint,input)]);
  verify(grants.map(r=>r.status).sort().join(',')==='200,409','Concurrent grants have one winner');
  verify((await student.direct.from('lessons').select('video_url').eq('course_slug',slug)).data.length===1,'Granted student can read protected playback');
  assert.ok(!(await student.direct.from('lesson_progress').insert({user_id:student.id,course_slug:slug,lesson_id:lessonId,completed:true})).error);
  verify((await student.api(notePath,{text:'Preserved private note',revision:0})).status===200,'Granted student saves a private note');
  const material=await admin.from('resources').insert({id:'backend-entitlement-material',title:'Enrollment material',description:'',type:'TXT',kind:'text',content:'retained material'}).select('id').single();assert.ok(!material.error);created.push(material.data.id);
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('lesson_resources').insert({resource_id:material.data.id,course_slug:slug,lesson_id:lessonId})).error);
  const session=await admin.from('live_sessions').insert({course_slug:slug,title:'Enrollment live',starts_at:new Date(Date.now()-60000).toISOString(),ends_at:new Date(Date.now()+3600000).toISOString()}).select('id').single();assert.ok(!session.error,JSON.stringify(session.error));
  await admin.from('live_session_links').insert({session_id:session.data.id,join_url:'https://meet.google.com/aaa-bbbb-ccc'});
  verify((await student.direct.from('live_session_links').select('join_url').eq('session_id',session.data.id)).data.length===1,'Granted learner has active live joining link');
  const revoke={...input,action:'revoke',revision:1,reason:'Support requested suspension of this course'};
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,revoke)).status===200,'Administrator revokes course access');
  const row=(await admin.from('enrollments').select('*').eq('user_id',student.id).eq('course_slug',slug).single()).data;
  verify(row.active===false&&row.revision===2,'Revocation keeps durable enrollment with incremented revision');
  const listed=JSON.parse((await manager.api('/api/admin/courses?q=Enrollment%20test')).data).courses.find(course=>course.slug===slug);
  verify(listed.students===0,'Admin course student count excludes revoked access');
  verify(JSON.parse((await manager.api('/api/admin/analytics')).data).metrics.totalEnrollments===baseline,'Analytics excludes revoked entitlement without deleting its history');
  for(const [table,select,filter] of [['lessons','video_url','course_slug'],['lesson_progress','*','course_slug'],['lesson_notes','*','course_slug'],['lesson_resources','*','course_slug'],['resources','content','id'],['live_session_links','join_url','session_id']]) {
   const value=table==='resources' ? material.data.id : table==='live_session_links' ? session.data.id : slug;
   const r=await student.direct.from(table).select(select).eq(filter,value);
   verify(!r.error&&r.data.length===0,'Revoked JWT denied '+table);
  }
  verify((await student.api('/api/resources/'+material.data.id)).status===404,'Revoked material download denied');
  verify((await student.api(notePath)).status===403,'Revoked note endpoint denied');
  const state=JSON.parse((await student.api('/api/enrollments')).data);
  verify(!state.enrolled.includes(slug)&&!state.completed.includes(slug+'/'+lessonId),'Learner state excludes revoked course and its progress');
  verify((await student.api('/api/enrollments',{courseSlug:slug})).status===403,'Self enrollment cannot override administrative revocation');
  verify((await student.api('/api/progress',{courseSlug:slug,lessonId,completed:false})).status===403,'Progress API denies revoked enrollment');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.from('enrollments').insert({user_id:student.id,course_slug:'motion-essentials',active:true,revision:99})).error),'Student cannot supply administrative state or revision on insert');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.rpc('save_lesson_note',{p_slug:slug,p_lesson:lessonId,p_text:'Forged',p_revision:1})).error),'Revoked learner cannot bypass note API through RPC');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.from('lesson_progress').upsert({user_id:student.id,course_slug:slug,lesson_id:lessonId,completed:false})).error),'Revoked learner cannot write progress directly');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.from('enrollments').update({active:true}).eq('course_slug',slug)).error),'Learner cannot restore enrollment directly');
  const before=(await admin.from('lesson_progress').select('*').eq('user_id',student.id)).data;
  verify(before.some(p=>p.course_slug===slug&&p.completed),'Revocation preserves completed lesson in storage');
  const restore={...input,action:'restore',revision:2,reason:'Resolved support review'};
  const restores=await Promise.all([manager.api(endpoint,restore),manager.api(endpoint,restore)]);
  verify(restores.map(r=>r.status).sort().join(',')==='200,409','Concurrent restores reject stale writer');
  verify(JSON.parse((await student.api(notePath)).data).text==='Preserved private note','Restoration recovers saved notes');
  verify((await student.direct.from('lesson_progress').select('*').eq('course_slug',slug)).data[0].completed,'Restoration recovers saved progress');
  const events=(await manager.direct.from('enrollment_events').select('*').eq('user_id',student.id).order('revision')).data;
  verify(events.map(e=>e.action).join(',')==='grant,revoke,restore'&&events.every(e=>e.actor_id===manager.id&&e.reason),'History records reason and verified administrator actor');
  verify((await student.direct.from('enrollment_events').select('*')).data.length===0,'Student cannot read private administrative reasons');
  verify(Boolean((await manager.direct.from('enrollment_events').insert({user_id:student.id,course_slug:slug,action:'grant',reason:'fake',revision:8})).error),'History cannot be forged even by admin direct JWT');
  await require('./enrollments-payment.cjs')({admin,student,manager,endpoint,input,slug,verify});
  await require('./enrollments-race.cjs')({admin,manager,outsider,slug,lessonId,config,verify});
  await require('./enrollments-browser.cjs')({admin,manager,student,slug,url,verify});
 } finally {
  await admin.from('payment_orders').delete().eq('user_id',student.id);
  await admin.from('resources').delete().in('id',created);
  await admin.from('courses').delete().eq('slug',slug);
 }
};
```

```typescript
 page.on('pageerror',error=>errors.push(error.message));

  await page.clock.install();
  await page.goto(url+'/admin/dashboard/commerce/bundles/'+bundleSlug+'/template');
  await page.locator('.lms-template-editor > fieldset > details').first().locator('summary').first().click();
  await page.getByLabel('الوصف',{exact:true}).first().fill('Bundle content saved from browser');
  const response=page.waitForResponse(r=>r.url().endsWith(api)&&r.request().method()==='POST');
  await page.getByRole('button',{name:'حفظ التصميم',exact:true}).click();verify((await response).status()===200,'Shared browser editor saves bundle template');
  for(const width of [390,1440]){

   await expect(page.getByRole('heading',{name:'Distinct bundle heading',exact:true})).toBeVisible();
   verify(await page.locator('header.lms-site-header').count()===1&&await page.locator('footer').count()===1,'Bundle has one navbar/footer at '+width);
   await expect(page.locator('.top-scarcity-bar')).toContainText('Actual bundle sale');
   await expect(page.locator('.top-scarcity-bar')).not.toContainText('بيشاهدوا');
   verify(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth),'Bundle featured layout fits '+width);
   await expect(page.locator('.hero-section a[href="/checkout/'+bundleSlug+'?kind=bundle"]').first()).toHaveAttribute('href','/checkout/'+bundleSlug+'?kind=bundle');
  }
  await page.clock.fastForward(3_700_000);await expect(page.locator('.top-scarcity-bar')).toHaveCount(0);verify(true,'Offer strip disappears at the real deadline without reloading');
  verify(errors.length===0,'Bundle editor and public page have no runtime errors');
 }finally{await browser.close();}
};
```

```typescript
const request = (image: File, kind = "avatar", slug?: string) => {
 const form = new FormData();form.set("file",image);form.set("kind",kind);if(slug)form.set("courseSlug",slug);
 return new Request("https://example.com/api/media/images",{method:"POST",body:form});
};
test("Bounded readers reject a streamed body without relying on Content-Length",async()=>{
 const req = new Request("https://example.com",{method:"POST",body:new ReadableStream({start(controller){controller.enqueue(new Uint8Array(5));controller.enqueue(new Uint8Array(5));controller.close();}}),duplex:"half"} as RequestInit);
 await assert.rejects(readRequestBytes(req,8), { status: 413, code: "REQUEST_TOO_LARGE" });
});
test("Multipart reader accepts image data and rejects invalid scope, paths and size",async()=>{
 assert.equal((await readImageUpload(request(file()))).kind,"avatar");
 for(const req of [request(file(),"video"),request(file(),"course","../victim"),request(file(),"course")]) await assert.rejects(readImageUpload(req));
 await assert.rejects(readImageUpload(request(file(new Uint8Array(imageUploadPolicy.maxBytes+1)))),/IMAGE_TOO_LARGE/);
 await assert.rejects(readImageUpload(new Request("https://example.com",{method:"POST",body:"broken",headers:{"Content-Type":"multipart/form-data; boundary=missing"}})),/INVALID_IMAGE/);
});
test("Image validation rejects MIME spoofing, SVG, videos and empty content",async()=>{
 await validateImage(file());
 for(const image of [file(png,"video/mp4"),file(Buffer.from("<svg></svg>"),"image/svg+xml"),file(Buffer.from("text")),file(new Uint8Array())]) await assert.rejects(validateImage(image),/INVALID_IMAGE/);
});
test("Cloudinary requests sign only server-approved parameters without exposing secrets",async()=>{
 process.env.CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME="test-cloud";process.env.CLOUDINARY_API_KEY="test-key";process.env.CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET="test-secret";
 const fetcher: typeof fetch = async (input,init)=>{

  const body=init!.body as FormData;
  assert.equal(body.get("api_key"),"test-key");assert.equal(body.get("api_secret"),null);

  assert.equal(body.get("signature"),createHash("sha256").update(signed).digest("hex"));
```

```typescript
  const progress = parse(await a.api('/api/progress'));
  verify(lessons.slice(0,2).every(lesson => progress.completed.includes(`${course.slug}/${lesson.id}`)), 'Concurrent progress preserves both lessons');
  verify((await b.direct.from('lesson_progress').select('*').eq('user_id', a.id)).data.length === 0, 'RLS hides another account progress');
  verify(Boolean((await b.direct.from('lesson_progress').insert({ user_id: a.id, course_slug: course.slug, lesson_id: privateLesson.id, completed: true })).error), 'RLS rejects forged progress owner');
  verify((await a.api('/api/progress', { courseSlug: course.slug, lessonId: 'missing', completed: true })).status === 404, 'Unknown lesson rejected');
  verify((await a.api(`/api/certificates/${course.slug}`)).status === 403, 'Incomplete course certificate denied');
  for (const lesson of lessons) await a.api('/api/progress', { courseSlug: course.slug, lessonId: lesson.id, completed: true });
  verify((await a.api('/api/certificates',{operation:'issue',slug:course.slug})).status===200,'Completed student explicitly issues certificate');
  verify((await a.api(`/api/certificates/${course.slug}`)).status === 200, 'Completed enrolled course certificate allowed');
  const resourceId = lessons.flatMap(lesson => lesson.resourceIds)[0];
  if (resourceId) {
    verify((await a.api(`/api/resources/${resourceId}`)).status === 200, 'Enrolled student can download resource');
    verify((await b.api(`/api/resources/${resourceId}`)).status === 404, 'Other student cannot download resource');
  }
  const profile = await a.api('/api/profile', { name: 'Updated Student', email: a.email });
  verify(profile.status === 200 && parse(profile).name === 'Updated Student', 'Own profile updates persist');
  verify(/no-store/.test(profile.headers.get('cache-control')), 'Personalized responses never cached');
  const changedEmail = await a.api('/api/profile', { name: 'Updated Student', email: `changed-${Date.now()}@example.com` });
  verify(changedEmail.status === 403 && parse(changedEmail).code === 'EMAIL_LOCKED', 'Student email change is locked on the legacy endpoint');
  await admin.from('enrollments').delete().eq('user_id',a.id).eq('course_slug',course.slug);
  verify((await a.api(playback(privateLesson))).status === 403, 'Revoked grant immediately denies playback');
  verify((await a.api('/api/auth/logout', {})).status === 200, 'Logout succeeds');
  verify((await a.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 401, 'Logout removes authenticated session');
}
(async () => {
  try { await run(); console.log(`Backend integration: ${checks} checks passed`); }
  finally {
    for (const id of identities) {
      const user=await admin.auth.admin.getUserById(id);
      if(user.data.user?.email) await admin.from("admin_allowlist").delete().eq("email",user.data.user.email);
      await admin.from("admin_users").delete().eq("user_id", id);
      await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(id);
    }
    await admin.from('courses').delete().eq('slug','backend-test-free');
    paymentMock?.server.close();server.kill('SIGTERM'); fs.closeSync(log);
  }
})().catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1; });
```

```typescript
 const manager=await provision('Live Manager'),student=await provision('Live Student'),outsider=await provision('Live Outsider');
 assert.ok(!(await admin.from('admin_users').insert({user_id:manager.id})).error);
 const slug='backend-live-sessions',liveSlug=slug+'-workshop',endpoint='/api/admin/live-sessions';
 const source=(await admin.from('courses').select('*').eq('slug','editing-foundations').single()).data;
 assert.ok(source);
 const metadata={...source.metadata,slug,title:'Scheduled recorded course',modules:source.metadata.modules.map((chapter,index)=>index===0 ? {...chapter,id:'session-chapter',sections:[{id:'session-section',title:'Critique section',lessonIds:[]}]} : chapter)};

  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,input,{headers:{Origin:'https://evil.example'}})).status===403,'Cross-origin schedule mutation denied');
  for(const patch of [{endsLocal:input.startsLocal},{chapterId:'unknown'},{sectionId:'unknown'},{startsLocal:'2026-04-24T00:30',endsLocal:'2026-04-24T01:30'},{joinUrl:'javascript:alert(1)'}]) verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{...input,...patch})).status===400,'Invalid schedule rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,input)).status===200,'Admin creates live session on recorded course');
  let session=json(await manager.api(endpoint+'?q=Live%20critique')).sessions[0];assert.ok(session);
  verify(session.chapterId==='session-chapter'&&session.sectionId==='session-section','Live lesson preserves recorded chapter and section assignment');
  const join=`/api/courses/${slug}/live-sessions/${session.id}/join`;
  const scheduleResponse=await anonymous(`/api/courses/${slug}/live-sessions`);assert.equal(scheduleResponse.status,200,scheduleResponse.data);let schedule=json(scheduleResponse);
  verify(schedule.sessions.length===1&&!JSON.stringify(schedule).includes('private-live')&&!('joinUrl' in schedule.sessions[0]),'Public schedule excludes the private meeting URL');
  verify((await student.api(join)).status===403,'Upcoming session URL denied');
  verify((await student.direct.from('live_session_links').select('*')).data.length===0,'Upcoming meeting URL denied by RLS');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.rpc('save_live_session',{p_input:input})).error),'Direct student RPC mutation denied');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.from('live_sessions').update({title:'Forged'}).eq('id',session.id)).error),'Student direct table mutation denied');
  const editing={...input,id:session.id,revision:session.revision,title:'Live revision'};
  const races=await Promise.all([manager.api(endpoint,editing),manager.api(endpoint,editing)]);
  verify(races.map(r=>r.status).sort().join(',')==='200,409','Concurrent edits preserve one winning revision');
  verify(Boolean((await manager.direct.rpc('delete_live_session',{p_id:session.id,p_revision:null})).error),'Null revision cannot bypass concurrency guard');
  session=json(await manager.api(endpoint+'?q=Live%20revision')).sessions[0];
  await admin.from('live_sessions').update({starts_at:new Date(Date.now()-60000).toISOString(),ends_at:new Date(Date.now()+60000).toISOString()}).eq('id',session.id);

  verify((await anonymous(join)).status===401,'Guest denied active URL');
  verify((await outsider.direct.from('live_session_links').select('*').eq('session_id',session.id)).data.length===0,'Active meeting URL denied to unenrolled JWT');
  verify((await student.direct.from('live_session_links').select('*').eq('session_id',session.id)).data.length===1,'Enrolled JWT may read active URL');
  for(const account of [student]){
```

```typescript
const assert=require('node:assert/strict');

 assert.ok(!(await admin.from('admin_users').insert({user_id:manager.id})).error);

 for(const target of [slug,secondSlug]){
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('courses').insert({...source,slug:target,metadata:{...source.metadata,slug:target,title:'Material course '+target}})).error);
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('lessons').insert({...lesson,course_slug:target})).error);
 }

   verify((await student.api(path)).status===403,'Student denied '+path);
  }
  const input={revision:0,title:'Private exercise',description:'Lesson practice',type:'TXT',kind:'text',content:'private-material-body',assignments:[{courseSlug:slug,lessonId},{courseSlug:secondSlug,lessonId}]};
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,input,{headers:{Origin:'https://evil.example'}})).status===403,'Cross-origin material mutation rejected');
  for(const patch of [{kind:'link',content:'javascript:alert(1)'},{kind:'link',content:'https://user:pass@example.com'},{assignments:[]},{assignments:[input.assignments[0],input.assignments[0]]},{content:'x'.repeat(2001)},{assignments:[{courseSlug:slug,lessonId:'missing'}]}]) verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{...input,...patch})).status===400,'Invalid material rejected');
  const create=await manager.api(endpoint,input);assert.equal(create.status,200,create.data);
  let material=json(await manager.api(endpoint+'?q=Private%20exercise')).materials[0];assert.ok(material);created.push(material.id);
  verify(material.assignments.length===2,'Material retains multi-course attachments');
  verify(Boolean((await outsider.direct.rpc('save_admin_material',{p_input:input})).error),'Student cannot author through direct RPC');
  const privateUrl='/api/resources/'+material.id;
  verify((await anonymous(privateUrl)).status===401,'Material download requires login');
  verify((await outsider.api(privateUrl)).status===404,'Material hidden from unenrolled student');
  const download=await student.api(privateUrl);verify(download.status===200&&download.data===input.content&&download.headers.get('content-disposition').includes('.txt'),'Owner downloads stored text');
  verify((await outsider.direct.from('resources').select('*').eq('id',material.id)).data.length===0,'Material body denied through direct JWT');
  const edit={...input,id:material.id,revision:material.revision,title:'Updated exercise'};
  const races=await Promise.all([manager.api(endpoint,edit),manager.api(endpoint,edit)]);
  verify(races.map(r=>r.status).sort().join(',')==='200,409','Concurrent material edits have one winner');
  material=json(await manager.api(endpoint+'?q=Updated%20exercise')).materials[0];

  verify(invalid.status===400&&(await admin.from('lesson_resources').select('*').eq('resource_id',material.id)).data.length===2,'Invalid attachment change rolls back without losing links');
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{...edit,revision:material.revision,kind:'link',content:'https://drive.google.com/file/d/example/view'})).status===200,'Admin switches material to HTTPS link');
  const redirect=await student.api(privateUrl);verify(redirect.status===302&&redirect.headers.get('location').includes('drive.google.com')&&redirect.headers.get('referrer-policy')==='no-referrer','Protected link redirects after access check');
  const publicCourse=await anonymous('/api/courses/'+slug);verify(!publicCourse.data.includes('drive.google.com/file/d/example')&&!publicCourse.data.includes('private-material-body'),'Public course payload excludes material content and links');

  verify((await outsider.api(notePath)).status===403,'Notes require enrollment');
  const empty=await student.api(notePath);assert.equal(empty.status,200,empty.data);verify(json(empty).text===''&&json(empty).revision===0,'First note starts at revision zero');

  verify(firstSaves.map(r=>r.status).sort().join(',')==='200,409','Concurrent first note saves cannot overwrite each other');

  verify((await manager.direct.from('admin_activity').delete().eq('entity','resources')).error!==null,'Administrator JWT cannot delete history');
  verify(Boolean((await manager.direct.from('admin_activity').insert({actor_id:manager.id,entity:'courses',target:'fake',action:'INSERT'})).error),'Admin cannot forge history rows');

   assert.equal((await manager.api(endpoint,{...input,title:'Paging material '+index,assignments:[input.assignments[0]]})).status,200);
```

```typescript
 const course={...source,slug,title:'Workflow acceptance course',modules:[{id:'chapter',title:'Learning chapter',sections:[{id:'intro',title:'Introduction section',lessonIds:['second','first']}],lessons:[make('first'),make('second'),make('third')]}]};
```

### File: `tests/backend/payment-gateway.cjs`

SHA-256: `5dab018e31675bd9254de4a6123d4e8533e273471e7b0f38819b8f24da5b47ce`

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Isolated local payment provider, never charges money. */
const http = require('node:http'), {randomBytes}=require('node:crypto');
function paymentGateway() {
 const transactions = new Map(); let created = 0, lookups = 0;
 const server=http.createServer(async(req,res)=>{
  let raw='';for await(const chunk of req) raw+=chunk;
  const body=raw?JSON.parse(raw):{};
  res.setHeader('Content-Type','application/json');
  if(req.url==='/oauth/token'){res.end(JSON.stringify({access_token:'local-payment-token',expires_in:3600}));return;}
  if(req.headers.authorization!=='Bearer local-payment-token'){res.statusCode=401;res.end('{}');return;}
  if(req.url==='/api/v3/createTransaction'){
   const intent=randomBytes(9).toString('hex');created++;transactions.set(intent,{intent_key:intent,transaction_id:created,paid:0,total:body.cartTotal,currency:body.currency,pay_load:body.pay_load,status_text:'unpaid',paid_at:null,request:body});
   res.end(JSON.stringify({status:'success',data:{intent_key:intent,url:`http://127.0.0.1:3046/ts/${intent}?lg=ar`,expires_in:172800}}));return;
  }
  if(req.url==='/api/v3/getTransactionData'){lookups++;res.end(JSON.stringify({status:'success',data:transactions.get(body.intent_key)}));return;}
  res.statusCode=404;res.end('{}');
 });
 return {server,transactions,counts:()=>({created,lookups})};
}
module.exports={paymentGateway};
```
