```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Local payment security integration tests. */
const assert=require('node:assert/strict'),{createHmac,randomUUID}=require('node:crypto');
module.exports=async function({admin,provision,anonymous,verify,url,gateway}){
 const learner=await provision('Payment Learner'),other=await provision('Payment Other');
 const template=(await admin.from('courses').select('*').eq('published',true).limit(1).single()).data;
 const slug=`payment-${randomUUID()}`, metadata={...template.metadata,title:'Local Payment Course',slug};
 assert.ok(!(await admin.from('courses').insert({slug,amount:1200,metadata,published:true})).error);
 const parse=r=>JSON.parse(r.data);
 const checkout=()=>learner.api('/api/payments/checkout',{courseSlug:slug});
 const enrolled=async()=>Boolean((await admin.from('enrollments').select('*').eq('user_id',learner.id).eq('course_slug',slug).maybeSingle()).data);
 const webhook=async(intent,id,patch={})=>{
  const body={transaction_key:intent,transaction_id:id,payment_method:'Fawry',status:'paid',paidAmount:'1200',paidCurrency:'EGP',...patch};
  body.transactionHashKey=createHmac('sha256','local-payment-hmac').update(`TransactionId=${body.transaction_id}&TransactionKey=${body.transaction_key}&PaymentMethod=${body.payment_method}`).digest('hex');
  return fetch(url+'/api/payments/fawaterak/webhook_json',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(body)});
 };
 try{
  verify((await anonymous('/api/payments/checkout',{courseSlug:slug})).status===401,'Anonymous checkout rejected');
  verify((await learner.api('/api/payments/checkout',{courseSlug:slug,amount:1})).status===400,'Client-supplied price rejected');
  verify((await learner.api('/api/payments/checkout',{courseSlug:slug},{headers:{Origin:'https://evil.example'}})).status===403,'Cross-origin checkout rejected');
  await admin.from('account_contacts').update({phone_verified_at:null}).eq('user_id',learner.id);
  verify((await checkout()).status===403,'Unverified contact cannot initiate payment');
  await admin.from('account_contacts').update({phone_verified_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('user_id',learner.id);
  const responses=await Promise.all([checkout(),checkout()]);
  const success=responses.find(r=>r.status===200);verify(Boolean(success),'Verified account creates checkout');
  const initial=parse(success),again=await checkout();verify(again.status===200&&parse(again).orderId===initial.orderId&&gateway.counts().created===1,'Concurrent and repeated checkout reuse one provider intent');
  let order=(await admin.from('payment_orders').select('*').eq('id',initial.orderId).single()).data;
  const intent=order.provider_intent_key,tr=gateway.transactions.get(intent);
  verify(tr.request.cartTotal===1200&&tr.request.cartItems[0].price===1200&&tr.request.currency==='EGP','Provider amount comes from persisted course price');
  verify(tr.request.sendEmail===false&&tr.request.sendSMS===false&&tr.request.redirectionUrls.webhookUrl.endsWith('webhook_json'),'Checkout uses JSON webhook and disables duplicate provider messages');
  verify((await other.api(`/api/payments/${order.id}`)).status===404,'Other account cannot read payment order');
  verify((await other.api(`/api/payments/${order.id}/reconcile`,{})).status===404,'Other account cannot reconcile payment');
  verify(!(await enrolled()),'Creating checkout never grants course access');
  const fake=await fetch(url+'/api/payments/fawaterak/webhook_json',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({transaction_id:tr.transaction_id,transaction_key:intent,payment_method:'Fawry',transactionHashKey:'0'.repeat(64)})});
  verify(fake.status===401&&!(await enrolled()),'Forged signature cannot grant enrollment');
  verify((await webhook(intent,tr.transaction_id)).status===200&&!(await enrolled()),'Signed paid claim does not override unpaid provider status');
  const owner=await learner.api(`/api/payments/${order.id}`);verify(owner.status===200&&!owner.data.includes(intent)&&!owner.data.includes('checkout_url'),'Owner status excludes provider keys and redirect URL');
  verify((await learner.direct.rpc('settle_course_payment',{p_order:order.id,p_intent:intent,p_transaction:tr.transaction_id,p_amount:120000,p_currency:'EGP'})).error,'Student cannot execute privileged settlement RPC');
  verify((await learner.direct.from('payment_orders').update({status:'paid'}).eq('id',order.id)).error,'RLS prevents student from marking payment paid');
  tr.paid=1;tr.total=1;
  verify((await webhook(intent,tr.transaction_id)).status===409&&!(await enrolled()),'Mismatched provider amount rejected');tr.total=1200;
  tr.currency='USD';verify((await webhook(intent,tr.transaction_id)).status===409&&!(await enrolled()),'Mismatched currency rejected');tr.currency='EGP';
  tr.pay_load={merchant_reference:randomUUID()};verify((await webhook(intent,tr.transaction_id)).status===409&&!(await enrolled()),'Mismatched merchant reference rejected');tr.pay_load={merchant_reference:order.id};
  verify((await webhook(intent,tr.transaction_id+100)).status===409&&!(await enrolled()),'Signed callback transaction ID must match provider record');
  await admin.from('courses').update({amount:1500}).eq('slug',slug);
  verify((await webhook(intent,tr.transaction_id)).status===200&&await enrolled(),'Verified payment activates course using immutable original price');
  const replay=await Promise.all([webhook(intent,tr.transaction_id),webhook(intent,tr.transaction_id)]);
  verify(replay.every(r=>r.status===200),'Concurrent webhook replay is idempotent');
  const count=await admin.from('enrollments').select('*',{count:'exact'}).eq('user_id',learner.id).eq('course_slug',slug);
  verify(count.count===1,'Exactly one enrollment exists after callback replay');
  verify((await checkout()).status===409,'Already enrolled student cannot create another charge');
  verify((await learner.api(`/payments/${order.id}`)).status===200,'Owned payment result page renders');

  const stateUser=await provision('Payment State Checks');

  const failed=parse(await stateUser.api(`/api/payments/${stateOrder.id}/reconcile`,{}));
  verify(failed.status==='failed'&&!failed.enrolled,'Independently verified failed transaction never grants enrollment');
  const nextState=parse(await stateUser.api('/api/payments/checkout',{courseSlug:slug}));verify(nextState.orderId!==stateOrder.id,'Failed checkout can be retried with a new provider intent');
  await admin.from('payment_orders').update({expires_at:new Date(Date.now()-1000).toISOString()}).eq('id',nextState.orderId);
  const expired=parse(await stateUser.api(`/api/payments/${nextState.orderId}/reconcile`,{}));verify(expired.status==='expired','Expired unpaid order stops holding the active checkout slot');
  const retained=parse(await stateUser.api('/api/payments/checkout',{courseSlug:slug}));
  await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(stateUser.id);
  const preserved=(await admin.from('payment_orders').select('id,user_id').eq('id',retained.orderId).single()).data;
  verify(preserved&&preserved.user_id===null,'Account deletion preserves payment audit records without retaining account identity');
  await require('./payment-browser.cjs')({url,user:other,slug,verify});
  const second=(await admin.from('payment_orders').select('*').eq('course_slug',slug).eq('user_id',other.id).single()).data;
  const secondTransaction=gateway.transactions.get(second.provider_intent_key);
  const before=gateway.counts().lookups;
  await other.api(`/api/payments/${second.id}/reconcile`,{});await other.api(`/api/payments/${second.id}/reconcile`,{});
  verify(gateway.counts().lookups===before+1,'Persisted reconciliation cooldown limits provider polling');
  await admin.from('account_contacts').update({phone_verified_at:null}).eq('user_id',other.id);
  secondTransaction.paid=1;
  verify((await webhook(second.provider_intent_key,secondTransaction.transaction_id)).status===200,'Payment is durably recorded if contacts change while checkout is pending');
  const receipt=parse(await other.api(`/api/payments/${second.id}`));
  verify(receipt.status==='paid'&&!receipt.enrolled,'Unverified contacts defer activation without losing payment');
  const paidCheckout=await other.api('/checkout/'+slug);verify(!paidCheckout.data.includes('الانتقال للدفع الآمن')&&paidCheckout.data.includes(second.id),'Checkout redirects paid but unactivated customer back to the existing receipt');
  await admin.from('account_contacts').update({phone_verified_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('user_id',other.id);
  verify((await other.api('/api/payments/checkout',{courseSlug:slug})).status===409,'Previously paid customer cannot be charged again before activation');
  const activated=parse(await other.api(`/api/payments/${second.id}/reconcile`,{}));
  verify(activated.status==='paid'&&activated.enrolled,'Reverification activates the paid course without another provider charge');
  verify((await other.direct.rpc('payment_revenue_snapshot')).error,'Students cannot read admin payment totals');
  await admin.from('admin_users').insert({user_id:other.id});
  const baseline=await other.direct.rpc('payment_revenue_snapshot');verify(!baseline.error,'Administrator can read payment revenue');
  await admin.from('payment_orders').update({live:true}).eq('id',second.id);
  const revenue=await other.direct.rpc('payment_revenue_snapshot');
  verify(revenue.data.week===baseline.data.week+150000&&revenue.data.month===baseline.data.month+150000,'Revenue counts verified live payment amounts and excludes test payments');
  const analytics=await other.api('/api/admin/analytics');verify(analytics.status===200&&parse(analytics).revenue.week===revenue.data.week,'Admin analytics includes verified payment revenue');
 }finally{await admin.from('payment_orders').delete().eq('course_slug',slug);await admin.from('enrollments').delete().eq('course_slug',slug);await admin.from('courses').delete().eq('slug',slug);}
};
```

```typescript
  await expect(page.locator('.hero-video-shell')).toBeVisible();verify(videos.length===0,'No video retrieval before activation');

  await page.locator('.instructor-photo-img').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();await expect(page.locator('.instructor-photo-img')).toHaveAttribute('src',/\/_next\/image\?/);
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Adversarial tests against isolated services only. */
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { randomUUID, createHash } = require('node:crypto');
const { Client } = require('pg');
module.exports = async function securityChecks({ admin, provision, anonymous, verify, url, config }) {
  assert.match(config.DB_URL, /^postgresql:\/\/postgres:postgres@127\.0\.0\.1:/);
  const db = new Client({ connectionString: config.DB_URL });
  await db.connect();
  const learner = await provision('Security Learner'), manager = await provision('Security Manager');
  await admin.from('admin_users').insert({ user_id: manager.id });
  const slug = 'security-' + randomUUID(), intent = randomUUID(), order = randomUUID();
  try {
    const template = (await admin.from('courses').select('metadata').eq('published', true).limit(1).single()).data.metadata;
    await db.query('insert into public.courses(slug,amount,metadata,published) values($1,1200,$2,true)', [slug, { ...template, slug, title: "Security's fixture" }]);
    await db.query("insert into public.payment_orders(id,user_id,course_slug,course_title,amount_minor,provider_intent_key,status,expires_at,live) values($1,$2,$3,'Security fixture',120000,$4,'pending',now()-interval '1 minute',false)", [order, learner.id, slug, intent]);
    await require('../security/payment-locks.cjs')({ connectionString: config.DB_URL, user: learner.id, slug, order, intent });
    verify(true, 'Checkout expiration and settlement cannot deadlock');
    const settled = await db.query("select status,(select count(*) from public.enrollments where user_id=$2 and course_slug=$3) as enrollments from public.payment_orders where id=$1", [order, learner.id, slug]);
    verify(settled.rows[0].status === 'paid' && Number(settled.rows[0].enrollments) === 1, 'Raced payment remains paid with exactly one enrollment');
    const bucket = createHash('sha256').update(randomUUID()).digest('hex');

    await db.query("update private.request_buckets set expires_at=now()-interval '1 second' where bucket=$1", [bucket]);
    verify((await admin.rpc('consume_request_budget', { p_bucket: bucket, p_limit: 7, p_seconds: 60 })).data.allowed, 'Expired windows recover automatically');

    verify(Boolean((await manager.direct.rpc('search_admin_courses', { p_sort: attack })).error), 'SQL-like sort expressions fail the database allowlist');
    verify(Boolean((await manager.direct.rpc('search_admin_courses', { p_page: 2147483647 })).error), 'Oversized pagination cannot overflow offsets');
    verify((await db.query('select count(*) from public.courses where slug=$1', [slug])).rows[0].count === '1', 'Injection attempts cannot delete course data');

    verify(Boolean((await learner.direct.rpc('settle_course_payment', { p_order: order, p_intent: intent, p_transaction: 999001, p_amount: 120000, p_currency: 'EGP' })).error), 'Direct Data API calls cannot forge settlements');
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Real isolated database acceptance. */
const { Client } = require('pg');
module.exports = async function usernameControls({ admin, provision, anonymous, verify, url, config }) {
  const manager = await provision('Control Manager');
  await admin.from('admin_users').insert({ user_id: manager.id });
  const students = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 12 }, () => provision('Zack Middle River')));
  const profiles = (await admin.from('profiles').select('id,username').in('id',students.map(student => student.id))).data;
  verify(profiles.length === 12 && profiles.every(profile => /^zackriver\d{6}$/.test(profile.username)), 'Concurrent same-name signups merge first and last names with six random digits');
  verify(new Set(profiles.map(profile => profile.username)).size === 12, 'All concurrent generated usernames are unique');
  const arabic = await provision('محمد أحمد خطاب'), single = await provision('Cher');
  verify(/^[a-z]+ing-[a-z]+\d{6}$/.test(JSON.parse((await arabic.api('/api/profile')).data).username), 'Non-English names generate an English gerund-adjective username');
  verify(/^cher\d{6}$/.test(JSON.parse((await single.api('/api/profile')).data).username), 'Single-name accounts generate a valid username');
  const [a,b] = students;
  const handle = profiles.find(profile => profile.id === b.id).username;
  const detail = await manager.api('/admin/dashboard/users/'+handle);
  verify(detail.status === 200, 'Admin can open user details by username');
  const legacyPage = await manager.api('/admin/dashboard/users/'+b.id);
  verify(legacyPage.headers.get('location')?.endsWith('/'+handle) || legacyPage.data.includes('NEXT_REDIRECT'), 'Legacy UUID URL redirects to the username');
  const missingPage = await manager.api('/admin/dashboard/users/missing-handle');
  verify(missingPage.status === 404 || missingPage.data.includes('NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;404'), 'Unknown username returns not found');
  const deniedPage = await b.api('/admin/dashboard/users/'+handle);
  verify(deniedPage.status !== 200 || deniedPage.data.includes('NEXT_REDIRECT'), 'Student cannot open username-based admin details');
  const change = (student, username) => student.api('/api/profile', { name: 'Zack Middle River', email: student.email, username });
  verify((await change(a,' My-Custom_Name ')).status === 200, 'Student can choose a normalized username');
  verify(JSON.parse((await a.api('/api/profile')).data).username === 'my-custom_name', 'Chosen username persists in profile');
  await a.api('/api/profile', { name: 'New Name', email:a.email });
  verify(JSON.parse((await a.api('/api/profile')).data).username === 'my-custom_name', 'Name-only profile upsert preserves chosen username');
  await Promise.all([a.api('/api/profile',{name:'Concurrent Name',email:a.email}),change(a,'kept-during-upsert')]);
  verify(JSON.parse((await a.api('/api/profile')).data).username === 'kept-during-upsert', 'Concurrent name-only upsert cannot overwrite a chosen username');
  await change(a,'my-custom_name');
  const duplicate = await change(b,'MY-CUSTOM_NAME');
  verify(duplicate.status === 409 && JSON.parse(duplicate.data).code === 'USERNAME_TAKEN', 'Case-insensitive duplicate rename returns helpful conflict');
  const racing = await Promise.all([change(a,'shared-race'),change(b,'shared-race')]);
  verify(racing.filter(response => response.status === 200).length === 1 && racing.filter(response => response.status === 409).length === 1, 'Concurrent custom renames reserve a username atomically');
  for (const invalid of ['ab','invalid name','x'.repeat(49),'../evil','محمدخطاب123456','zäck123']) verify((await change(b,invalid)).status === 400, 'Invalid username rejected: '+invalid.slice(0,20));
  verify((await anonymous('/api/profile',{ name:'New Name',email:a.email,username:'forged' })).status === 401, 'Anonymous cannot rename a profile');
  verify((await b.direct.from('profiles').update({username:'forged'}).eq('id',a.id).select()).data?.length === 0, 'RLS blocks another account rename');
  const db = new Client({ connectionString: config.DB_URL }); await db.connect();
  try {
    const result = await db.query("select private.username_base($1) as base, private.username_base($2) as fallback",[' ZACK   Middle River ','!!!']);
    verify(result.rows[0].base === 'zackriver' && result.rows[0].fallback === null, 'Username helper handles whitespace, case and fallback');
    const legacy = students[2], chosen = students[3];
    await db.query("update public.profiles set username='user-' || replace(id::text,'-','') where id=$1",[legacy.id]);
    await db.query("update public.profiles set username='chosen-keep' where id=$1",[chosen.id]);
    await db.query("update public.profiles set username=private.generate_default_username(name) where username='user-' || replace(id::text,'-','')");
    const migrated=await db.query('select id,username from public.profiles where id=any($1::uuid[])',[[legacy.id,chosen.id]]);
    verify(migrated.rows.find(row=>row.id===chosen.id).username==='chosen-keep' && /^zackriver\d{6}$/.test(migrated.rows.find(row=>row.id===legacy.id).username), 'Migration backfills legacy defaults and preserves chosen usernames');
    await db.query('begin');
    try {
      await db.query('alter table public.profiles drop constraint profiles_username_check');
      await db.query("update public.profiles set username='محمدخطاب123456' where id=$1",[arabic.id]);
      await db.query("update public.profiles set username=private.generate_default_username(name) where username !~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{2,47}$'");
      const backfill = await db.query('select username,name from public.profiles where id=$1',[arabic.id]);
      verify(/^[a-z]+ing-[a-z]+\d{6}$/.test(backfill.rows[0].username) && backfill.rows[0].name==='محمد أحمد خطاب','Backfill converts non-English handles while preserving display names');
      const retained = await db.query('select username from public.profiles where id=$1',[chosen.id]);
      verify(retained.rows[0].username==='chosen-keep','English chosen handles survive the ASCII backfill');
    } finally { await db.query('rollback'); }
    const invalidDb = await db.query("update public.profiles set username='محمد123' where id=$1",[arabic.id]).catch(error=>error);
    verify(invalidDb.code==='23514','Database rejects non-English handles independently of API validation');
    const variants = await db.query("select private.generate_default_username(name) as username from (values ('محمد River'),('Zack خطاب'),('李 明'),('!!!')) names(name)");
    verify(variants.rows.every(row=>/^[a-z]+ing-[a-z]+\d{6}$/.test(row.username)), 'Mixed-script, Chinese and punctuation-only names use English fallbacks');
    await db.query('set enable_seqscan=off');
    const plan = await db.query("explain select id from public.profiles where lower(name) ^@ lower($1)", ['محمد']);
    verify(plan.rows.some(row => row['QUERY PLAN'].includes('profiles_name_prefix_idx')), 'Actual parameterized prefix predicate can use the SP-GiST name index');
  } finally { await db.end(); }
  await a.api('/api/profile', { name:'Other Name',email:a.email });
  const search = async value => JSON.parse((await manager.api('/api/admin/users?mode=prefix&q='+encodeURIComponent(value))).data);
  verify((await search('محمد')).users.some(user => user.id === arabic.id), 'Arabic first-letter indexed search finds the right account');
  verify((await search(a.email)).total === 0, 'Prefix mode searches names rather than email');
  verify((await search('ZaCk')).total === 11, 'Name-prefix search ignores Latin case');
  verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/users?mode=unknown')).status === 400, 'Unknown search mode rejected');
  await require('./form-controls-browser.cjs')({ manager, student:b, verify, url });
};
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { offerConfig } from "../app/config/offer";
import { splitCountdown } from "../app/lib/countdown";

test("countdown splits day boundaries and stops at zero", () => {
  expect(splitCountdown(86400)).toEqual({
    days: "01",
    hours: "00",
    minutes: "00",
    seconds: "00",
  });
  expect(splitCountdown(-1)).toEqual({
    days: "00",
    hours: "00",
    minutes: "00",
    seconds: "00",
  });
});

test("reference countdown ticks and keeps its deadline after refreshing", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-03T10:00:00Z");
  const remaining = 3 * 86400 + 19 * 3600 + 27 * 60 + 13;
  await page.clock.setFixedTime(now);
  await page.addInitScript(
    ({ key, deadline }) => {
      if (!localStorage.getItem(key))
        localStorage.setItem(key, String(deadline));
    },
    { key: offerConfig.storageKey, deadline: now.getTime() + remaining * 1000 },
  );
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  const timer = page.getByRole("timer");
  await expect(
    page.getByText("ينتهي الخصم خلال :", { exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="days"]')).toHaveText("03");
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="hours"]')).toHaveText("19");
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="minutes"]')).toHaveText(
    "27",
  );
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="seconds"]')).toHaveText(
    "13",
  );
  await page.clock.setFixedTime(new Date(now.getTime() + 1000));
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="seconds"]')).toHaveText(
    "12",
  );
  const deadline = await page.evaluate(
    (key) => localStorage.getItem(key),
    offerConfig.storageKey,
  );
  await page.reload();
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="seconds"]')).toHaveText(
    "12",
  );
  expect(
    await page.evaluate(
      (key) => localStorage.getItem(key),
      offerConfig.storageKey,
    ),
  ).toBe(deadline);
});

test("expired discount stays expired and blocked storage does not crash", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.addInitScript(
    (key) => localStorage.setItem(key, "1"),
    offerConfig.storageKey,
  );
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  await expect(page.locator('[data-countdown-unit="days"]')).toHaveText("00");
  await expect(page.locator('[data-countdown-unit="seconds"]')).toHaveText(
    "00",
  );
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-countdown-unit="days"]')).toHaveText("00");
  const errors: string[] = [];
  page.on("pageerror", (error) => errors.push(error.message));
  await page.addInitScript(() =>
    Object.defineProperty(window, "localStorage", {
      get() {
        throw new Error("Storage blocked");
      },
    }),
  );
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByRole("timer")).toBeVisible();
  expect(errors).toEqual([]);
});
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("hero thumbnail activates original MP4 with only centered play/pause", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const errors: string[] = [],
    providerRequests: string[] = [];
  page.on("pageerror", (error) => errors.push(error.message));
  page.on("request", (request) => {
    if (/youtube(?:-nocookie)?\.com/.test(request.url()))
      providerRequests.push(request.url());
  });
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  const hero = page.locator(".hero-video-shell");
  await expect(hero.locator(".hero-video-placeholder img")).toHaveAttribute(
    "src",
    "/assets/images/workshop-intro-poster.jpg",
  );
  await expect(hero.locator("video,iframe")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "تشغيل الفيديو التعريفي", exact: true })
    .click();
  const video = hero.locator("video");
  await expect
    .poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState))
    .toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
  await expect(video).toHaveAttribute(
    "src",
    "/assets/video/workshop-intro.mp4",
  );
  expect(
    await video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).controls),
  ).toBe(false);
  await expect(
    hero.locator(".custom-video-controls,input,iframe,a"),
  ).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(hero.locator(".custom-video-stage button")).toHaveCount(0);
  await video.click();
  await expect
    .poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused))
    .toBe(true);
  await hero
    .getByRole("button", { name: "تشغيل الفيديو", exact: true })
    .click();
  await expect
    .poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused))
    .toBe(false);
  await video.evaluate((node) => {
    const v = node as HTMLVideoElement;
    v.currentTime = v.duration - 0.1;
    void v.play();
  });
  await expect(hero.locator(".hero-video-placeholder")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(video).toHaveCount(0);
  expect(providerRequests).toEqual([]);
  expect(errors).toEqual([]);
});
for (const width of [320, 390, 768, 1440])
  test(`hero thumbnail and overlay fit 16:9 at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
    await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
    const hero = page.locator(".hero-video-shell");
    await expect
      .poll(() =>
        hero
          .locator("img")
          .evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLImageElement).naturalWidth),
      )
      .toBeGreaterThan(0);
    await hero.locator(".hero-video-placeholder").click();

    await expect(hero.locator(".custom-video-controls")).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(
      await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth),
    ).toBeLessThanOrEqual(width);
    await expect
      .poll(() =>
        hero
          .locator("video")
          .evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState),
      )
      .toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    await hero.locator("video").click();
    await expect(hero.locator(".custom-video-overlay-toggle")).toBeVisible();
    const geometry = await hero.evaluate((node) => {
      const v = node.querySelector("video")!.getBoundingClientRect(),
        b = node
          .querySelector(".custom-video-overlay-toggle")!
          .getBoundingClientRect();
      return {
        heightError: Math.abs(v.height - (v.width * 9) / 16),
        intrinsicRatio:
          (node.querySelector("video") as HTMLVideoElement).videoWidth /
          (node.querySelector("video") as HTMLVideoElement).videoHeight,
        dx: Math.abs(v.left + v.width / 2 - b.left - b.width / 2),
        dy: Math.abs(v.top + v.height / 2 - b.top - b.height / 2),
      };
    });
    // The existing 1px shell border affects its inner viewport by under 1px.
    expect(geometry.heightError).toBeLessThan(1);
    expect(geometry.intrinsicRatio).toBeCloseTo(16 / 9, 5);
    expect(geometry.dx).toBeLessThan(1);
    expect(geometry.dy).toBeLessThan(1);
```

### File: `tests/dashboard-access.spec.ts`

```typescript
import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";
import { routes } from "../modules/config/navigation";
const protectedPages = [routes.dashboard, routes.library, routes.profile, routes.resources, routes.certificates, routes.admin, routes.adminCourse("7days-freelance")];
for (const path of protectedPages) test(`logged-out requests cannot render ${path}`, async ({ request, page }) => {
  const response = await request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0 });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(307);
  expect(response.headers().location).toMatch(/\/login$/);
  expect(await response.text()).not.toContain("lms-dashboard");
  const rsc = await request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0, headers: { RSC: "1" } });
  expect(rsc.status()).toBe(307);
  expect(await rsc.text()).not.toContain("lms-dashboard");
  await page.goto(path);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
  await expect(page.locator(".lms-dashboard-stats")).toHaveCount(0);
});
test("forged session and old demo cookies cannot unlock the dashboard", async ({ request }) => {
  const response = await request.get(routes.dashboard, { maxRedirects: 0, headers: { Cookie: "ta3allam-session=forged; ta3allam-learning=forged; sb-tatseklsvfdpuxuepbfo-auth-token=forged" } });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(307);
  expect(response.headers().location).toMatch(/\/login$/);
});
```

```typescript
import { createRequire } from "node:module";

test("T03 page modules resolve the single maintained foundation", () => {
```

### File: `tests/helpers/browser-module.cjs`

SHA-256: `8a9b4ffbaf48683adcd452cf4ccd9936fbb64535d8e806cdfc43ee6de19199a5`

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Bundle the real helper graph for browser lifecycle tests. */
const fs = require("node:fs"), path = require("node:path"), ts = require("typescript");
function bundleBrowserModule(entry) {
  const modules = {};
  function collect(file) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(modules, file)) return;
    modules[file] = "";
    const code = ts.transpileModule(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"), {
      compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020 },
    }).outputText;
    modules[file] = code.replace(/require\("([^\"]+)"\)/g, (_, request) => {
      if (!request.startsWith(".")) throw new Error(`Unsupported browser dependency: ${request}`);
      const dependency = path.resolve(path.dirname(file), `${request}.ts`);
      collect(dependency);
      return `require(${JSON.stringify(dependency)})`;
    });
  }
  const root = path.resolve(entry);
  collect(root);
  return `const sources=${JSON.stringify(modules)},cache={};
    function load(id){if(cache[id])return cache[id];const result=cache[id]={};
      new Function('require','exports',sources[id])(load,result);return result;}
    Object.assign(exports,load(${JSON.stringify(root)}));`;
}
module.exports = { bundleBrowserModule };
```

```typescript
const fs = require("node:fs"), path = require("node:path"), Module = require("node:module"), ts = require("typescript");
const resolve = Module._resolveFilename;

  const target = request.startsWith("@platform/") ? path.resolve("modules", request.slice(10))
```

```typescript
import { expect,test } from "@playwright/test";
test("body tolerance leaves child hydration warnings enabled in development", async ({
  page,
  baseURL,
}) => {
  const target = baseURL!.replace("127.0.0.1", "localhost") + "/7days-freelance";
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  page.on("console", (message) => {
    if (
```

### File: `tests/hydration.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `caf6ded8d001e77c46aaffc0c27585ab532987834ae87898d9a68035de761355`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("extension-injected body attributes do not warn or prevent hydration", async ({
  page,
  baseURL,
}) => {
  const hydrationWarnings: string[] = [];
  page.on("console", (message) => {
    if (
      message.type() === "error" &&
      /hydrat|didn't match/i.test(message.text())
    )
      hydrationWarnings.push(message.text());
  });
  // Simulate a document-start extension without altering Next's streamed response.
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const inject = () => {
      if (!document.body) return false;
      document.body.setAttribute("cz-shortcut-listen", "true");
      return true;
    };
    if (!inject()) {
      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (inject()) observer.disconnect();
      });
      observer.observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
  });
  // Next's dev-origin guard permits localhost by default, unlike its IP alias.
  await page.goto(baseURL!.replace("127.0.0.1", "localhost") + "/7days-freelance");
  await expect(page.locator("body")).toHaveAttribute(
    "cz-shortcut-listen",
    "true",
  );
  expect(hydrationWarnings).toEqual([]);
  await page.locator(".faq-question-btn").first().click();
  await expect(page.locator(".faq-question-btn").first()).toHaveAttribute(
    "aria-expanded",
    "true",
  );
  expect(hydrationWarnings).toEqual([]);
});
```

### File: `tests/learning-command-contracts.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `6da1ce81f66e6390faa5046e2ebd15c72a0c5b4c7f462c570eb1e7e7997ef437`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { startCourse } from "../modules/features/learning/client/start-course";
import { setLessonCompletion } from "../modules/features/learning/client/complete-lesson";
import { httpRequest } from "../modules/lib/http-request";
import { readLearningResponse } from "../modules/helpers/read-learning-response";

test("R07 workflows order enrollment, progress and navigation and stop on failures", async () => {
  const calls: string[] = [];
  const enroll = async () => { calls.push("enroll"); };
  const navigation = { push: () => { calls.push("push"); }, refresh: () => { calls.push("refresh"); } };
  const model = { slug: "course", firstLesson: "lesson", enrolled: true, enroll, lessonHref: () => "/lesson", navigation };
  await startCourse(model);
  expect(calls).toEqual(["push"]);
  calls.length = 0;
  await startCourse({ ...model, enrolled: false });
  expect(calls).toEqual(["enroll", "push", "refresh"]);
  calls.length = 0;
  await expect(startCourse({ ...model, enrolled: false, enroll: async () => { throw new Error("FAIL"); } })).rejects.toThrow("FAIL");
  expect(calls).toEqual([]);
  const progress = async () => { calls.push("progress"); };
  await setLessonCompletion({ slug: "course", lessonId: "lesson", enrolled: false, completed: true, enroll, progress, refresh: navigation.refresh });
  expect(calls).toEqual(["enroll", "progress", "refresh"]);
  calls.length = 0;
  await expect(setLessonCompletion({ slug: "course", lessonId: "lesson", enrolled: true, completed: true, enroll, progress: async () => { throw new Error("FAIL"); }, refresh: navigation.refresh })).rejects.toThrow("FAIL");
  expect(calls).toEqual([]);
  await expect(setLessonCompletion({ slug: "course", lessonId: "lesson", enrolled: false, completed: true,
    enroll: async () => { throw new Error("ENROLL FAILED"); }, progress, refresh: navigation.refresh })).rejects.toThrow("ENROLL FAILED");
  expect(calls).toEqual([]);
});

test("R07 successful HTTP responses require decoding and transport allows cancellation/substitution", async () => {
  const signal = new AbortController().signal;
  let passedSignal: AbortSignal | null | undefined;
  const fetcher: typeof fetch = async (_input, init) => { passedSignal = init?.signal; return Response.json({ enrolled: [], completed: [], profile: { name: "Student", email: "student@example.com" } }); };
  const options = { path: "/custom", body: {}, failureLabel: "FAIL", decode: readLearningResponse, fetcher, signal };
  expect((await httpRequest(options)).profile.name).toBe("Student");
  expect(passedSignal).toBe(signal);
  await expect(httpRequest({ ...options, fetcher: async () => Response.json({ enrolled: "bad" }) })).rejects.toThrow("Invalid learning response");
  await expect(httpRequest({ ...options, fetcher: async () => Response.json({ error: "REJECTED" }, { status: 400 }) })).rejects.toThrow("REJECTED");
});

test("R07 completion locks the entire two-request workflow and allows retry after failure", async ({ page }) => {
  const calls: string[] = [];
  let release = () => {};
  const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
  const state = { enrolled: ["first-client"], completed: [], profile: { name: "Student", email: "" } };
  await page.route("**/api/enrollments", async (route) => {
    calls.push("enroll");
    await gate;
    await route.fulfill({ contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify(state) });
  });
  await page.route("**/api/progress", async (route) => {
    calls.push("progress");
    await route.fulfill({ status: 400, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify({ error: "TRY AGAIN" }) });
  });
  await page.goto("/learn/first-client/portfolio");
  const button = page.getByRole("button", { name: "أتممت هذا الدرس", exact: true });
  await button.evaluate((element) => { (element as HTMLButtonElement).click(); (element as HTMLButtonElement).click(); });
  await expect.poll(() => calls).toEqual(["enroll"]);
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "جارٍ الحفظ…", exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
  release();
  await expect(page.locator(".lms-error[role=alert]")).toHaveText("TRY AGAIN");
  expect(calls).toEqual(["enroll", "progress"]);
  await expect(button).toBeEnabled();
  await button.click();
  await expect.poll(() => calls.length).toBe(4);
});
```

```typescript
for (const trigger of ["scroll", "another video"] as const)
  test(`${trigger} reset aborts an unfinished media response while buffering`, async ({ page }) => {
  const bytes = await readFile("public/assets/video/workshop-intro.mp4");
  const active = new Set<ServerResponse>();
  let aborted = 0;
  const server = createServer((request, response) => {
    const start = Number(request.headers.range?.match(/bytes=(\d+)-/)?.[1] ?? 0);
    response.writeHead(request.headers.range ? 206 : 200, {
      "Content-Type": "video/mp4", "Content-Length": bytes.length - start,
      "Accept-Ranges": "bytes", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
      ...(request.headers.range ? { "Content-Range": `bytes ${start}-${bytes.length - 1}/${bytes.length}` } : {}),
    });
    active.add(response);
    let offset = start;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      const end = Math.min(offset + 32768, bytes.length);
      response.write(bytes.subarray(offset, end));
      offset = end;
      if (offset === bytes.length) response.end();
    }, 100);
    response.on("close", () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      active.delete(response);
      if (offset < bytes.length) aborted++;
    });
  });
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
  const address = server.address();
  if (!address || typeof address === "string") throw new Error("Missing media server port");
  try {
    await page.goto(`${fixtureUrl}/media-player`);
    await page.getByLabel("Video URL").fill(`http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}/slow.mp4`);
    const player = page.locator('[data-player="custom"]');
    await player.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    await expect.poll(() => active.size).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const before = aborted;
    if (trigger === "scroll")
      await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight));
    else
      await page.locator('[data-player="other"]').getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(player.locator("video")).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect.poll(() => aborted).toBeGreaterThan(before);
    await expect.poll(() => active.size).toBe(0);
    await player.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
    await expect(player.locator(".media-player-poster")).toBeVisible();
    expect(active.size).toBe(0);
  } finally {
    server.closeAllConnections();
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.close(() => resolve()));
  }
});


for (const previousState of ["playing", "paused"] as const)
  test(`starting another video restores the ${previousState} player's thumbnail and releases its source`, async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto(`${fixtureUrl}/media-player`);
    const first = page.locator('[data-player="custom"]');
    const second = page.locator('[data-player="other"]');

    const video = first.locator("video");
    await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);

      ready: (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState,
    }))).toEqual({ src: null, paused: true, ready: 0 });
    await expect.poll(() => second.locator("video").evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused)).toBe(false);

    await first.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(second.locator(".media-player-poster")).toBeVisible();
```

```tsx
import Symbol from "../../modules/components/ui/symbol";

/** Compile-only negative contracts; unexpected acceptance fails TypeScript. */
export function verifyTypeContracts(course:Course){
 // @ts-expect-error a navigation action cannot be an unlabeled empty-state link
 const empty=<EmptyState title="EMPTY" description="BODY" href="/courses"/>;
```

### File: `tests/platform/engine-lifecycle.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `34dca361f985126fb8752933e80468036f99d053f2a9f8ec6bebce594dfc2d65`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import type { createScrollReveals } from "../../packages/design-system/lib/scroll-reveals";
const require = createRequire(resolve("package.json"));
const { bundleBrowserModule } = require("./tests/helpers/browser-module.cjs");
const compiled = bundleBrowserModule("packages/design-system/lib/scroll-reveals.ts");
test("T25 T26 T27 T28 engine owns targets, future motion and ten clean lifecycles", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 900 });
  await page.setContent(
    "<style>body{margin:0;padding-bottom:1000px}[data-reveal]{height:40px}</style>",
  );
  const result = await page.evaluate(async (code) => {
    const create = new Function(
      "exports",
      code + ";return exports.createScrollReveals;",
    )({}) as typeof createScrollReveals;
    const frame = () =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve()));
    const tick = async () => {
      await frame();
      await frame();
    };
    const observers = new Set<object>();
    const NativeIntersection = window.IntersectionObserver;
    const NativeMutation = window.MutationObserver;
    window.IntersectionObserver = class extends NativeIntersection {
      observe(target: Element) {
        observers.add(this);
        super.observe(target);
      }
      disconnect() {
        observers.delete(this);
        super.disconnect();
      }
    };
    window.MutationObserver = class extends NativeMutation {
      observe(target: Node, options: MutationObserverInit) {
        observers.add(this);
        super.observe(target, options);
      }
      disconnect() {
        observers.delete(this);
        super.disconnect();
      }
    };
    const listeners = new Set<EventListenerOrEventListenerObject>();
    const preference = new EventTarget() as EventTarget & { matches: boolean };
    preference.matches = false;
    const add = preference.addEventListener.bind(preference),
      remove = preference.removeEventListener.bind(preference);
    preference.addEventListener = (type, listener, options) => {
      if (listener) listeners.add(listener);
      add(type, listener, options);
    };
    preference.removeEventListener = (type, listener, options) => {
      if (listener) listeners.delete(listener);
      remove(type, listener, options);
    };
    const media = preference as unknown as MediaQueryList;
    const options = {
      viewportThreshold: 0.9,
      easing: "linear",
      groups: [{ trigger: "[data-reveal]", y: 32, duration: 1000 }],
    };
    let occurrences = 0,
      duplicate = false,
      offscreenPremature = false,
      intermediate = false,
      reinsertion = false;
    for (let cycle = 0; cycle < 10; cycle++) {
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      const root = document.createElement("div");
      root.dataset.revealScope = "outer";
      root.innerHTML =
        '<div data-reveal>ONE</div><div data-reveal-scope="inner"><div data-reveal>TWO</div></div><div data-reveal style="margin-top:2000px">FUTURE</div>';
      document.body.append(root);
      const one = root.children[0],
        inner = root.children[1] as HTMLElement,
        future = root.children[2];
      const cleanup = create({ root, options, preference: media }),
        cleanupInner = create({ root: inner, options, preference: media });
      await tick();
      const animation = one.getAnimations()[0];
      occurrences += one.getAnimations().length;
      duplicate ||= inner.children[0].getAnimations().length !== 1;
      offscreenPremature ||= future.getAnimations()[0]?.playState !== "paused";
      animation.pause();
      animation.currentTime = 500;
      const opacity = Number(getComputedStyle(one).opacity);
      intermediate ||= opacity > 0 && opacity < 1;
      animation.play();
      // Reduction settles current content and leaves the future occurrence eligible.
      preference.matches = true;
      preference.dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
      await tick();
      duplicate ||= root.getAnimations({ subtree: true }).length !== 0;
      preference.matches = false;
      preference.dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
      await tick();
      duplicate ||= one.getAnimations().length !== 0;
      offscreenPremature ||= future.getAnimations()[0]?.playState !== "paused";
      future.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "instant" });
      await tick();
      duplicate ||= future.getAnimations()[0]?.playState !== "running";
      // Reusing the same DOM object after removal is a new occurrence.
      future.remove();
      root.append(future);
      await tick();
      reinsertion ||= future.getAnimations().length === 1;
      cleanupInner();
      cleanup();
      root.remove();
      await tick();
      if (observers.size || listeners.size || document.getAnimations().length)
        duplicate = true;
    }
    return {
      occurrences,
      duplicate,
      offscreenPremature,
      intermediate,
      reinsertion,
      observers: observers.size,
      listeners: listeners.size,
    };
  }, compiled);
  expect(result).toEqual({
    occurrences: 10,
    duplicate: false,
    offscreenPremature: false,
    intermediate: true,
    reinsertion: true,
    observers: 0,
    listeners: 0,
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";
const fixture = (process.env.REUSE_BASE_URL ?? "http://localhost:3043") + "/form-controls";
test("shared controls preserve keyboard, validity, reset and native form data", async ({page}) => {
  const errors:string[]=[];page.on("pageerror",error=>errors.push(error.message));await page.goto(fixture);
  const category=page.getByRole("combobox",{name:"Category",exact:true});
  await expect(page.getByRole("combobox",{name:"Disabled",exact:true})).toBeDisabled();
  await expect(page.getByRole("checkbox",{name:"Unavailable",exact:true})).toBeDisabled();
  await page.getByRole("button",{name:"Submit",exact:true}).click();await expect(category).toBeFocused();
  await expect(category).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid","true");await expect(page.locator("form").getByRole("alert")).toHaveText("Choose a category.");
  await category.press("ArrowDown");await category.press("Enter");await expect(category).toContainText("Alpha");
  await expect(category).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid","false");
  await category.press("ArrowDown");await category.press("Enter");await expect(category).toContainText("Gamma");
  await category.press("Home");await category.press("Enter");await expect(category).toContainText("Alpha");
  await category.press("g");await category.press("Enter");await expect(category).toContainText("Gamma");
  const agree=page.getByRole("checkbox",{name:"Agree",exact:true});await agree.focus();await page.keyboard.press("Space");await expect(agree).toBeChecked();
  await page.getByRole("radio",{name:"First",exact:true}).focus();await page.keyboard.press("ArrowDown");await expect(page.getByRole("radio",{name:"Second",exact:true})).toBeChecked();
  await page.getByRole("button",{name:"Submit",exact:true}).click();
  await expect(page.locator("output")).toHaveText(JSON.stringify({category:"gamma",controlled:"gamma",agree:"yes",choice:"second"}));
  await page.getByRole("button",{name:"Reset",exact:true}).click();await expect(category).toContainText("Choose");
  await expect(page.getByRole("combobox",{name:"Controlled",exact:true})).toContainText("Alpha");await expect(agree).not.toBeChecked();
  await category.click();await expect(page.getByRole("listbox")).toBeVisible();await page.getByRole("heading").click();await expect(category).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded","false");
  const ids=await page.locator("[id]").evaluateAll(nodes=>nodes.map(node=>node.id));expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(ids.length);expect(errors).toEqual([]);
});
test("shared dropdown stays inside narrow viewports and respects reduced motion", async ({page})=>{
  await page.setViewportSize({width:320,height:568});await page.emulateMedia({reducedMotion:"reduce"});await page.goto(fixture);
  await page.getByRole("combobox",{name:"Controlled",exact:true}).click();const menu=page.getByRole("listbox");await expect(menu).toBeVisible();
  const box=await menu.boundingBox();expect(box!.x).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);expect(box!.x+box!.width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(320);expect(box!.y+box!.height).toBeLessThanOrEqual(568);
  await expect(menu).toHaveCSS("transition-duration","0s");await expect(menu.getByRole("option",{name:"Beta",exact:true})).toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled","true");
  await page.keyboard.press("Escape");await expect(menu).not.toBeVisible();expect(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth)).toBe(true);
});
```

```typescript
test("readable action labels, metadata and lesson status on mobile", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 900 });
  const readability = async (selector: string) =>
    page
      .locator(selector)
      .first()
      .evaluate((element) => {
        const parse = (value: string) => value.match(/[\d.]+/g)!.map(Number);
        const composite = (foreground: number[], background: number[]) =>
          foreground
            .slice(0, 3)
            .map(
              (value, index) =>
                value * (foreground[3] ?? 1) +
                background[index] * (1 - (foreground[3] ?? 1)),
            );
        const luminance = (color: number[]) =>
          color.slice(0, 3).reduce((sum, value, index) => {
            const channel = value / 255;
            return (
              sum +
              (channel <= 0.04045
                ? channel / 12.92
                : ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4) *
                [0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722][index]
            );
          }, 0);
        const ancestors: Element[] = [];
        for (
          let node: Element | null = element;
          node;
          node = node.parentElement
        )
          ancestors.unshift(node);
        const background = ancestors.reduce(
          (color, node) =>
            composite(parse(getComputedStyle(node).backgroundColor), color),
          [255, 255, 255],
        );
        const style = getComputedStyle(element);
        const foreground = composite(parse(style.color), background);
        const a = luminance(foreground),
          b = luminance(background);
        return {
          size: parseFloat(style.fontSize),
          weight: Number(style.fontWeight),
          contrast: (Math.max(a, b) + 0.05) / (Math.min(a, b) + 0.05),
        };
      });
  await page.goto("/courses");
  const action = page.locator(".lms-card-action").first();
  for (const hover of [false, true]) {
    if (hover) await action.hover();
    const label = await readability(".lms-card-action");
    expect(label.contrast).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
    expect(label.size).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(20);
    expect(label.weight).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(700);
    await expect(action).toHaveCSS("color", "rgb(255, 255, 255)");
  }
  expect((await readability(".lms-card-meta")).size).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(14);
  expect(
    (await readability(".lms-nav-button")).contrast,
  ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);
  expect((await readability(".lms-search input")).size).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
    16,
  );
  expect(
    (await readability(".lms-search button")).contrast,
  ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);
  await page.goto("/learn/editing-foundations/first-cut");
  const status = await readability(".lms-outline-module a small");
  expect(status.size).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(14);
  expect(status.contrast).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);
  const lessonTitle = await readability(".lms-outline-module a");
  expect(lessonTitle.size).toBeGreaterThan(status.size);
  expect(lessonTitle.weight).toBeGreaterThan(status.weight);
  expect(
    (await readability(".lms-lesson-information p")).size,
  ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(16);
  expect(
    (await readability(".lms-notes textarea")).size,
  ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(16);
  await page.goto("/dashboard/profile");
  expect(
    (await readability(".lms-profile-form input")).size,
  ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(16);
});

test("FAQ transitions finish and reduced motion exposes reveal content", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.goto("/");
  const question = page.locator(".faq-question-btn").first();
  const panel = page.locator(".faq-answer-panel").first();
  await question.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("inert", "");
  const opening = await question.evaluate(async (button) => {
    const panel = document.getElementById(
      button.getAttribute("aria-controls")!,
    )!;
    panel.getBoundingClientRect();
    (button as HTMLButtonElement).click();
    await Promise.resolve();
    panel.getBoundingClientRect();
    return panel
      .getAnimations()
      .some((animation) => animation.playState === "running");
  });
  expect(opening).toBe(true);
  await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
  await expect
    .poll(async () => (await panel.boundingBox())?.height ?? 0)
    .toBeGreaterThan(0);
  await question.click();
  await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("inert", "");
  await expect
    .poll(async () => (await panel.boundingBox())?.height ?? 0)
    .toBe(0);
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "reduce" });
  await question.click();
  await expect(panel).toHaveCSS("transition-duration", "0s");
  await expect
    .poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.getAnimations().length))
    .toBe(0);
  const opacity = await page
    .locator(".lms-reveal")
    .evaluateAll((elements) =>
      elements.map((element) => getComputedStyle(element).opacity),
    );
  expect(opacity.every((value) => value === "1")).toBe(true);
});
```

```typescript
test("original section copy is preserved apart from authorized media and catalog action changes", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const html = readFileSync(
    "docs/evidence/portfolio-reference/source.html",
    "utf8",
  );
  await page.goto("/founder");
  const differences = await page.evaluate((html) => {
    const reference = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, "text/html");
    // HTML formatting inserts whitespace between blocks; React does not.
    // Compare every meaningful text node in order, retaining word spacing.
    const text = (root: Element | null) => {
      if (!root) return "";
      const walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
      const parts: string[] = [];
      while (walker.nextNode()) {
        const value = (walker.currentNode.textContent ?? "")
          .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
          .trim();
        if (value) parts.push(value);
      }
      return parts.join(" ");
    };
    return [
      ...reference.querySelectorAll("body > section, body > footer"),
    ].flatMap((section) => {
      const actual =
        section.tagName === "FOOTER"
          ? document.querySelector(".personal-footer")
          : document.querySelector(`main > section[id="${section.id}"]`);
      const actualCopy = actual?.cloneNode(true) as Element | null;
      // User approved removing reel captions and replacing the upcoming thumbnail.
      section
        .querySelectorAll(".reel-title, .reel-stats")
        .forEach((node) => node.remove());
      actualCopy
        ?.querySelectorAll(".p-ref-reel-title, .p-ref-reel-stats")
        .forEach((node) => node.remove());
      section.querySelector('.course-yt-card[href="#collab"] .course-yt-thumb')?.remove();
      actualCopy?.querySelector('.personal-course-upcoming .p-ref-course-yt-thumb')?.remove();
      // The added catalog link is approved; original course copy must still match.
      actualCopy?.querySelector(".personal-courses-action")?.remove();
      actualCopy?.querySelectorAll("[data-project-navigation]").forEach((node) => node.remove());
      section.querySelector(".footer-designer-credit")?.remove();
      actualCopy?.querySelector(".p-ref-footer-designer-credit")?.remove();
      const expected = text(section);
      const received = text(actualCopy);
      return expected === received
        ? []
        : [{ section: section.id || "footer", expected, received }];
    });
  }, html);
  expect(differences).toEqual([]);
});
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
const files = (directory: string): string[] =>
  readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) =>
    entry.isDirectory()
      ? files(join(directory, entry.name))
      : [join(directory, entry.name)],
  );
test("T05 T21 T33 T37 server-only export assets and standalone artifact identity", async ({
  request,
  page,
}) => {
  const sourceId = readFileSync(".next/BUILD_ID", "utf8").trim();
  const stagedId = readFileSync(
    "/tmp/khatab-acceptance-artifacts/platform/.next/BUILD_ID",
    "utf8",
  ).trim();
  expect(stagedId).toBe(sourceId);
  const html = await (await request.get("/")).text();
  expect(html).toContain(stagedId);
  expect(html).toContain('as="font"');
  expect(html).toContain("/assets/fonts/ibm-plex-arabic-700.ttf");
  const portrait = readFileSync("public/assets/images/instructor.webp");
  expect(
    await (await request.get("/assets/images/instructor.webp")).body(),
  ).toEqual(portrait);
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 900 });
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "reduce" });
  await page.goto("/");
  const image = page.locator(".instructor-photo-img");
  await image.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await expect
    .poll(() =>
      image.evaluate(
        (node) =>
          node instanceof HTMLImageElement &&
          node.complete &&
          node.naturalWidth > 0,
      ),
    )
    .toBe(true);
  const font = JSON.parse(readFileSync("modules/styles/certificate-font.json", "utf8"))
    .base64 as string;
  expect(font.length).toBeGreaterThan(10000);
  for (const file of files(".next/static/chunks").filter((file) =>
    file.endsWith(".js"),
  ))
    expect(readFileSync(file, "utf8"), file).not.toContain(font.slice(0, 120));
  expect(
    files(".next/server/chunks").some(
      (file) =>
        file.endsWith(".js") &&
        readFileSync(file, "utf8").includes(font.slice(0, 120)),
    ),
  ).toBe(true);
  const fonts = await request.get("/assets/fonts/ibm-plex-arabic-700.ttf");
  expect(fonts.status()).toBe(200);
  expect((await fonts.body()).length).toBeGreaterThan(10000);
  const before = await (await request.get("/api/enrollments")).json();
  for (const [path, body, status] of [
    ["/api/enrollments", { courseSlug: "unknown" }, 404],
    ["/api/enrollments", {}, 400],
    [
      "/api/progress",
      {
        courseSlug: "editing-foundations",
        lessonId: "missing",
        completed: true,
      },
      404,
    ],
    [
      "/api/progress",
      {
        courseSlug: "editing-foundations",
        lessonId: "first-cut",
        completed: "yes",
      },
      400,
    ],
  ] as const) {
    const response = await request.post(path, { data: body });
    expect(response.status(), path).toBe(status);
    expect(response.headers()["content-type"]).toContain("application/json");
    expect(await response.json()).toHaveProperty("error");
  }
  expect(await (await request.get("/api/enrollments")).json()).toEqual(before);
  expect((await request.get("/api/resources/missing")).status()).toBe(404);
  expect((await request.get("/api/certificates/missing")).status()).toBe(404);
  const course = (

  ).course;
  for (const courseModule of course.modules)
    for (const lesson of courseModule.lessons)
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("T06 radius does not control spacing or footer measure", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.goto("/");
  await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
  const measure = () =>
    page
      .locator(".lms-navbar,.lms-secondary-button,.lms-footer p")
      .evaluateAll((elements) =>
        elements.map((element) => {
          const css = getComputedStyle(element);
          return { padding: css.padding, gap: css.gap, width: css.maxWidth };
        }),
      );
  const before = await measure();
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--radius-md", "40px");
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--portfolio-radius", "55px");
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
      "--measure-testimonial-summary",
      "2ch",
    );
  });
  expect(await measure()).toEqual(before);
  const spacing = await page
    .locator(".lms-secondary-button")
    .first()
    .evaluate((node) => ({
      padding: getComputedStyle(node).padding,
      radius: getComputedStyle(node).borderRadius,
    }));
  await page.evaluate(() =>
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--space-control", "43px"),
  );
  const changed = await page
    .locator(".lms-secondary-button")
    .first()
    .evaluate((node) => ({
      padding: getComputedStyle(node).padding,
      radius: getComputedStyle(node).borderRadius,
    }));
  expect(changed.radius).toBe(spacing.radius);
  expect(changed.padding).not.toBe(spacing.padding);
});

test("T08 palette follows primary without changing production identity", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.goto("/");
  const tokens = () =>
    page.evaluate(() => {
      const sample = document.createElement("div");
      document.body.append(sample);
      const values = [
        "--primary-red-glow",
        "--primary-red-subtle",
        "--primary-red-border",
        "--color-ffa59c",
        "--color-d42010",
      ].map((token) => {
        sample.style.backgroundColor = `var(${token})`;
        return getComputedStyle(sample).backgroundColor;
      });
      sample.remove();
      return values;
    });
  const before = await tokens();
  await page.evaluate(() =>
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--primary-red", "#2255fc"),
  );
  const after = await tokens();
  after.forEach((color, index) => expect(color).not.toBe(before[index]));
  expect(after.every((color) => color !== "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)")).toBe(true);
});
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

for (const kind of ["reel", "hero"] as const) {
  test(`${kind} opens fullscreen without cropping and exits through its button`, async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
    const player = page.locator(kind === "reel" ? ".reel-card .media-player" : ".hero-video-shell .media-player").first();
    await player.locator(".media-player-poster").click();
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.fullscreenElement === null)).toBe(true);
    await player.hover();
    await player.getByRole("button", { name: "ملء الشاشة", exact: true }).click();
    await expect.poll(() => player.evaluate(node => document.fullscreenElement === node)).toBe(true);
    const video = player.locator("video");
    await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate(node => (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    const frame = await video.evaluate(node => {
      const video = node as HTMLVideoElement;
      return { fit: getComputedStyle(video).objectFit, portrait: video.videoHeight > video.videoWidth, controls: video.controls };
    });
    expect(frame.fit).toBe("contain");
    expect(frame.portrait).toBe(kind === "reel");
    expect(frame.controls).toBe(false);
    await video.click();
    await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate(node => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused)).toBe(true);
    await player.getByRole("button", { name: "الخروج من ملء الشاشة" }).click();
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.fullscreenElement === null)).toBe(true);
    await expect(video).toBeVisible();
  });
}

test("Escape exits fullscreen; finishing restores poster and exits fullscreen", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  const player = page.locator(".reel-card .media-player").first();
  await player.locator(".media-player-poster").click();
  await player.getByRole("button", { name: "ملء الشاشة", exact: true }).click();
  await expect.poll(() => player.evaluate(node => document.fullscreenElement === node)).toBe(true);
  await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.fullscreenElement === null)).toBe(true);
  await page.locator(".reel-card .media-player").nth(1).locator(".media-player-poster").click();
  await expect(player.locator(".media-player-poster")).toBeVisible();
  const next = page.locator(".reel-card .media-player").nth(1);
  await next.getByRole("button", { name: "ملء الشاشة", exact: true }).click();
  await expect.poll(() => next.evaluate(node => document.fullscreenElement === node)).toBe(true);
  await expect.poll(() => next.locator("video").evaluate(node => (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
  await next.locator("video").evaluate(node => { const v = node as HTMLVideoElement; v.currentTime = v.duration - .1; void v.play(); });
  await expect(next.locator(".media-player-poster")).toBeVisible();
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.fullscreenElement === null)).toBe(true);
});
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { youtubeSdkStub } from "./helpers/youtube-sdk-stub";
const require = createRequire(resolve("package.json"));
const { bundleBrowserModule } = require("./tests/helpers/browser-module.cjs");
const fixtureUrl = process.env.REUSE_BASE_URL ?? "http://localhost:3043";
async function installSdk(page: import("@playwright/test").Page) {
  await page.route("https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api", (route) => route.fulfill({ contentType: "application/javascript", body: youtubeSdkStub }));
  await page.route("**/embed/**", (route) => route.fulfill({ contentType: "text/html", body: "<html></html>" }));
}
async function endSdk(page: import("@playwright/test").Page) {
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const players = (window as unknown as { sdkPlayers: { destroyed: boolean; events: { onStateChange: (event: { data: number }) => void } }[] }).sdkPlayers;
    players.findLast((p) => !p.destroyed)!.events.onStateChange({ data: 0 });
  });
}

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Activate second" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Activate SDK", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reset on end" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Activate SDK", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(player).toBeVisible();
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { sdkPlayers?: unknown[] }).sdkPlayers?.length ?? 0)).toBe(3);
  await endSdk(page);
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Activate SDK", exact: true })).toBeVisible();

test("R08 media bounds handle nonfinite and out-of-range inputs before real property assignments", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/");
  const sources = Object.fromEntries(["native/seek", "native/set-volume", "youtube/seek", "youtube/set-volume"].map((file) => [file, bundleBrowserModule(`packages/design-system/helpers/media/${file}.ts`)]));
  const actual = await page.evaluate((sources) => {
    const modules: Record<string, Record<string, (...args: unknown[]) => void>> = {};
    for (const [name, source] of Object.entries(sources)) { const exports = {}; new Function("exports", source as string)(exports); modules[name] = exports; }
    const video = document.createElement("video"); Object.defineProperty(video, "duration", { value: 100 });
    const levels: number[] = [], seeks: number[] = [];
    const sdk = { seekTo: (value: number) => seeks.push(value), setVolume: (value: number) => levels.push(value), mute() {}, unMute() {}, isMuted: () => false };
    let publications = 0; const publish = () => publications++;
    for (const value of [NaN, Infinity, -Infinity]) {
      modules["native/seek"].seekNativeVideo(video, value, publish);
      modules["native/set-volume"].setNativeVolume(video, value);
      modules["youtube/seek"].seekYouTubePlayer(sdk, 100, value, publish);
      modules["youtube/set-volume"].setYouTubeVolume(sdk, value, publish);
    }
    const invalidPublications = publications;
    for (const value of [-1, 200]) {
      modules["native/seek"].seekNativeVideo(video, value, publish);
      modules["native/set-volume"].setNativeVolume(video, value);
      modules["youtube/seek"].seekYouTubePlayer(sdk, 100, value, publish);
      modules["youtube/set-volume"].setYouTubeVolume(sdk, value, publish);
    }
    modules["youtube/seek"].seekYouTubePlayer(sdk, Infinity, 1, publish);
    return { invalidPublications, seeks, levels, time: video.currentTime, volume: video.volume };
  }, sources);
  expect(actual).toEqual({ invalidPublications: 0, seeks: [0, 100], levels: [0, 100], time: 100, volume: 1 });
});

    const exports: { updatePortfolioHeader?: (header: HTMLElement, hero: HTMLElement | null) => void } = {};
    new Function("exports", code)(exports);
    const header = document.querySelector("header")!;
    exports.updatePortfolioHeader!(header, document.getElementById("custom-hero"));
    const active = header.querySelector("span")!.classList.contains("p-ref-is-hero-active");
    exports.updatePortfolioHeader!(header, null);
    return { active, inactiveWithoutTarget: !header.querySelector("span")!.classList.contains("p-ref-is-hero-active") };
  }, code);
  expect(actual).toEqual({ active: true, inactiveWithoutTarget: true });
});
```

### File: `tests/player-snapshot-helpers.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `7219aa33ff3d5c311b5365c79136ebfadf71800295dd147e8453c837d04bff2f`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { initialPlayerSnapshot } from "../packages/design-system/helpers/media/initial-snapshot";
import { readNativeSnapshot } from "../packages/design-system/helpers/media/native/read-snapshot";

test("native snapshot priority preserves loading, error and completion across nonfinite media values", () => {
  const previous = initialPlayerSnapshot();
  const video = { error: null as MediaError | null, ended: false, paused: true, readyState: 0,
    currentTime: Number.NaN, duration: Infinity, volume: .375, muted: true };
  expect(readNativeSnapshot(video as HTMLVideoElement, previous)).toEqual({
    status: "loading", ready: false, time: 0, duration: 0, volume: 38, muted: true,
  });
  video.readyState = 2;
  video.paused = false;
  expect(readNativeSnapshot(video as HTMLVideoElement, previous).status).toBe("buffering");
  video.readyState = 3;
  expect(readNativeSnapshot(video as HTMLVideoElement, previous).status).toBe("playing");
  video.ended = true;
  expect(readNativeSnapshot(video as HTMLVideoElement, previous).status).toBe("ended");
  video.error = {} as MediaError;
  expect(readNativeSnapshot(video as HTMLVideoElement, previous)).toMatchObject({ status: "error", ready: false });
});
```

### File: `tests/reel-motion.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `b94165999a57e400659253260bf195379a1a34be49caa6c110b84d7b13c05a82`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("creator marquee moves left and repeats without a gap or position jump", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "no-preference" });
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
  await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
  const track = page.locator(".creators-track");
  await expect.poll(() => track.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().length)).toBe(1);
  const motion = await track.evaluate((node) => {
    const animation = node.getAnimations()[0];
    animation.pause();
    const duration = Number(animation.effect!.getTiming().duration);
    animation.currentTime = 0;
    const first = node.children[0].getBoundingClientRect().left;
    const start = new DOMMatrixReadOnly(getComputedStyle(node).transform).m41;
    animation.currentTime = duration / 4;
    const quarter = new DOMMatrixReadOnly(getComputedStyle(node).transform).m41;
    animation.currentTime = duration - 1;
    const repeat = node.children[node.children.length / 2].getBoundingClientRect().left;
    return { start, quarter, seam: Math.abs(first - repeat), iterations: animation.effect!.getTiming().iterations };
  });
  expect(motion.quarter).toBeLessThan(motion.start);
  expect(motion.iterations).toBe(Infinity);
  expect(motion.seam).toBeLessThan(0.2);
});

test("reduced motion reproduces the static reels and turning it off restores animation", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "reduce" });
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  const card = page.locator(".reel-card").first();
  const track = page.locator(".creators-track");
  await expect(track).toHaveCSS("animation-name", "none");
  await expect(card).toHaveCSS("transition-duration", "0s");
  await expect(card.locator(".reel-play-btn")).toHaveCSS("transition-duration", "0s");
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "no-preference" });
  await expect(track).toHaveCSS("animation-name", "marqueeScroll");
  await expect.poll(() => track.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().some((animation) => animation.playState === "running"))).toBe(true);
  expect(await card.evaluate((node) => getComputedStyle(node).transitionDuration)).toContain("0.5s");
  await card.hover();
  await expect.poll(() => card.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().some((animation) =>
    animation instanceof CSSTransition && animation.transitionProperty === "transform",
  ))).toBe(true);
});
```

### File: `tests/reusability.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `ef6e41aa0459404d47d0a87d011f5270da43e577b918fab5b2b482d62670a1c4`

```typescript
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import {
  remainingCountdownSeconds,
  resolveCountdownDeadline,
} from "../app/lib/countdown";

test("alternate content and multiple instances work independently", () => {
  execFileSync(process.execPath, ["tests/helpers/render-reuse.cjs"], {
    stdio: "pipe",
  });
});

test("campaigns isolate storage and refresh cadence does not alter elapsed seconds", () => {
  const values = new Map<string, string>();
  const storage = {
    getItem: (key: string) => values.get(key) ?? null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => {
      values.set(key, value);
    },
  };
  const options = {
    endsAt: null,
    durationSeconds: 60,
    storageKey: "campaign-a",
    tickMs: 250,
  };
  const first = resolveCountdownDeadline(options, 1000, storage);
  expect(first).toBe(61000);
  expect(remainingCountdownSeconds(first, 2000)).toBe(59);
  expect(resolveCountdownDeadline(options, 2000, storage)).toBe(first);
  expect(
    resolveCountdownDeadline(
      { ...options, storageKey: "campaign-b" },
      2000,
      storage,
    ),
  ).toBe(62000);
  expect(remainingCountdownSeconds(first, 70000)).toBe(0);
  expect(
    resolveCountdownDeadline(
      { ...options, endsAt: "2026-10-07T00:00:00Z" },
      0,
      storage,
    ),
  ).toBe(Date.parse("2026-10-07T00:00:00Z"));
  expect(
    resolveCountdownDeadline(options, 0, {
      getItem() {
        throw new Error("blocked");
      },
      setItem() {},
    }),
  ).toBe(60000);
});
```

```typescript
test("R05 alternate About text round trips absent, repeated, empty and single emphasis", () => {
  for (const [body, emphasis] of [["before NAME middle NAME after", "NAME"], ["no match", "NAME"], ["empty emphasis", ""], ["before NAME after", "NAME"]]) {
    const markup = renderToStaticMarkup(createElement(About, { content: { ...personalPortfolio.about, body, emphasis } }));
    const text = markup.match(/<p class="p-ref-about-paragraph"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/p>/)![1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "");
    expect(text).toBe(body);
  }
});

  for (const contextVariant of ["badge", "plain"] as const) {
    const html = renderToStaticMarkup(createElement(Instructor, { content: instructor, contextVariant, reveal: contextVariant === "plain" }));
    expect(html).toContain("ALTERNATE");
    expect(html).not.toContain("data-instructor-actions");
    expect(html.includes("data-reveal=\"true\"")).toBe(contextVariant === "plain");
    const transform = renderToStaticMarkup(createElement(Transformation, { content: workshopPage.transformation, contextVariant }));
    expect(transform.includes("lms-heading-context")).toBe(contextVariant === "plain");
  }
  const faq = { ...workshopPage.faq, heading: { title: ["QUESTIONS"] }, items: [{ question: "Q", answer: "A" }] };
  const html = renderToStaticMarkup(createElement("div", null, createElement(Faq, { content: { ...faq, section: { ...faq.section, id: "faq-one" } } }), createElement(Faq, { content: { ...faq, section: { ...faq.section, id: "faq-two" } }, contextVariant: "plain", reveal: true })));
  const ids = [...html.matchAll(/ id="([^"]+)"/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
  expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(ids.length);
});

test("R04 R06 model owns identity variants and reordered actions keep semantic presentation", () => {
  expect(socialLinks).toEqual(Object.values(creatorSocials));
  expect(portfolioSocials.map((s) => s.platform)).toEqual(socialLinks.map((s) => s.platform));
  expect(personalPortfolio.collaboration.actions.find((a) => a.icon === "email")?.href).toBe(creatorContacts.portfolioEmail);
  const actions = [...personalPortfolio.collaboration.actions].reverse();
```
